worn_newsboy_cap.name: Worn Newsboy Cap
worn_newsboy_cap.description: Found in a gutter on Cahuenga, still shaped to a smaller head. The boy who owned it shouted headlines for two cents a paper.
worn_newsboy_cap.icon: Flat eight-panel newsboy cap with short stubby brim, faded grey-brown tweed gone shiny with wear, frayed cloth button on top, small torn seam at the brim edge.

newsboy_cap_of_intellect.name: Newsboy Cap of Intellect
newsboy_cap_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a copy boy at the Examiner who read every edition before he sold it and could quote the box scores back to the sports editor. Nobody got the better of him on change.
newsboy_cap_of_intellect.icon: Eight-panel newsboy cap in charcoal herringbone tweed, short brim, a stub of yellow pencil tucked through a narrow navy-blue side band.

newsboy_cap_of_spirit.name: Newsboy Cap of Spirit
newsboy_cap_of_spirit.description: Worn by a paperboy on the Boulevard who whistled through every headline, good news or bad. The Dome went up and he kept whistling, which some found heartening and others did not.
newsboy_cap_of_spirit.icon: Eight-panel newsboy cap in warm tan tweed, short brim, a small sky-blue feather tucked into the side seam.

newsboy_cap_of_stamina.name: Newsboy Cap of Stamina
newsboy_cap_of_stamina.description: Sweat-stained from twelve-hour days hawking extras along the Pacific Electric platforms. The lining has outlasted three owners and one riot.
newsboy_cap_of_stamina.icon: Thick brown wool newsboy cap, eight panels with bold red stitching, heavy quilted inner band showing at the edge, short firm brim.

newsboy_cap_of_the_engineer.name: Newsboy Cap of the Engineer
newsboy_cap_of_the_engineer.description: A studio grip's cap, smudged with machine oil from the Paramount electrical shop. There is a coil of fuse wire stitched into the lining, either for luck or because he ran out of pockets.
newsboy_cap_of_the_engineer.icon: Dark grey wool newsboy cap with black oil smudges across the panels, short brim, small brass wrench charm pinned at the side.

newsboy_cap_of_the_doctor.name: Newsboy Cap of the Doctor
newsboy_cap_of_the_doctor.description: Left behind on a bench at the Highland aid station. Its owner pencilled dosages inside the brim in a hand only a pharmacist could read, and possibly not even one.
newsboy_cap_of_the_doctor.icon: Cream-coloured tweed newsboy cap, neat eight panels, short brim, small white enamel pin bearing a green tonic bottle at the side.

newsboy_cap_of_the_deacon.name: Newsboy Cap of the Deacon
newsboy_cap_of_the_deacon.description: Smells of hymnals and the long walk to Angelus Temple. A deacon wore it to every Echo Park service and took it off for nobody but the Lord and Sister Aimee.
newsboy_cap_of_the_deacon.icon: Black wool newsboy cap, eight panels, short brim, a narrow purple hymnal ribbon tucked into the band and trailing a little.

patched_newsboy_cap.name: Patched Newsboy Cap
patched_newsboy_cap.description: Mended at the crown with a square of flour sacking. Somebody's mother took her time over it.
patched_newsboy_cap.icon: Grey-brown tweed newsboy cap with a mismatched pale flour-sack patch on the crown, coarse visible white stitching, slightly limp brim.

plain_newsboy_cap.name: Plain Newsboy Cap
plain_newsboy_cap.description: Thirty-five cents at a Boulevard haberdasher, and it looks it. Respectable enough to get a man served at the Musso & Frank counter.
plain_newsboy_cap.icon: Clean mid-brown wool newsboy cap, eight even panels, neat cloth button, short tidy brim, no ornament.

sturdy_newsboy_cap.name: Sturdy Newsboy Cap
sturdy_newsboy_cap.description: Double-stitched wool with a stiffened brim that holds its shape in a Santa Ana wind. Good for leaning out of a red car.
sturdy_newsboy_cap.icon: Thick dark olive wool newsboy cap, prominent double-stitched seams, stiff squared brim, solid cloth-covered button on top.

worn_leather_flying_cap.name: Worn Leather Flying Cap
worn_leather_flying_cap.description: Cracked along every seam where a motorcycle courier's goggles used to sit. The ear flaps no longer agree with each other.
worn_leather_flying_cap.icon: Close-fitting leather aviator cap with ear flaps, scuffed dull brown leather cracked at the seams, one flap curled, chin strap missing its buckle.

leather_flying_cap_of_agility.name: Leather Flying Cap of Agility
leather_flying_cap_of_agility.description: Made for a Hell's Angels stunt flier who could roll a Fokker under a telegraph wire. The picture still plays nightly at Grauman's; his name was in very small type near the end.
leather_flying_cap_of_agility.icon: Glossy chestnut leather aviator cap with ear flaps and buckled chin strap, thin yellow piping along every seam, goggle-strap loop at the back.

leather_flying_cap_of_stamina.name: Leather Flying Cap of Stamina
leather_flying_cap_of_stamina.description: Lined with sheepskin thick enough for an open cockpit at ten thousand feet. Nowhere under the Dome gets that cold, but the padding has taken plenty of knocks on its owner's behalf.
leather_flying_cap_of_stamina.icon: Dark brown leather aviator cap with thick cream sheepskin lining rolling out at the edges, heavy ear flaps, broad chin strap with iron buckle.

leather_flying_cap_of_spirit.name: Leather Flying Cap of Spirit
leather_flying_cap_of_spirit.description: Traded at United Airport by an air-mail pilot for a cup of coffee and a cigarette. He says he will fly again when the Dome comes down, and he says it cheerfully every morning.
leather_flying_cap_of_spirit.icon: Tan leather aviator cap with ear flaps, a strip of pale blue silk scarf knotted through the chin strap.

leather_flying_cap_of_the_acrobat.name: Leather Flying Cap of the Acrobat
leather_flying_cap_of_the_acrobat.description: Wing-walkers wore these at county fairs, where a quarter bought the sight of a man strolling along a biplane at sixty miles an hour. The stitching was done by someone who expected to be looked up at.
leather_flying_cap_of_the_acrobat.icon: Red-brown leather aviator cap with bright white decorative stitching, snug ear flaps, a small silver trapeze charm hanging from the chin strap.

leather_flying_cap_of_the_stevedore.name: Leather Flying Cap of the Stevedore
leather_flying_cap_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a San Pedro crane man who wore it against the wharf wind and the swinging cargo nets. He walked to Hollywood for picture work the week before the Dome went up.
leather_flying_cap_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered dark-brown leather aviator cap, salt-stained, a twist of hemp rope tied round the crown, small brass anchor stud on one ear flap.

leather_flying_cap_of_the_deacon.name: Leather Flying Cap of the Deacon
leather_flying_cap_of_the_deacon.description: Ridden through a hundred sick calls across Echo Park on a Temple deacon's motorcycle, it kept the dust off him and the cold out. The ear flaps came in handy during rival sermons.
leather_flying_cap_of_the_deacon.icon: Black leather aviator cap with ear flaps, purple ribbon threaded through the chin strap, small brass cross-shaped rivet at the temple.

patched_leather_flying_cap.name: Patched Leather Flying Cap
patched_leather_flying_cap.description: Someone sewed a piece of saddle leather over the torn crown. It does not match, and it does not leak.
patched_leather_flying_cap.icon: Brown leather aviator cap with a lighter tan saddle-leather patch on the crown, thick coarse stitching, worn but intact ear flaps.

plain_leather_flying_cap.name: Plain Leather Flying Cap
plain_leather_flying_cap.description: Sold by the dozen to motorcycle cops and delivery riders. Nobody ever looked twice at one, which suited the cops fine.
plain_leather_flying_cap.icon: Clean plain medium-brown leather aviator cap, smooth ear flaps, simple steel buckle chin strap, no goggles or decoration.

sturdy_leather_flying_cap.name: Sturdy Leather Flying Cap
sturdy_leather_flying_cap.description: Heavy horsehide, riveted at the strap and cut for someone who expects to be thrown off something. Gower Gulch stuntmen buy them by the pair.
sturdy_leather_flying_cap.icon: Thick dark horsehide aviator cap, double-stitched seams, steel rivets at the chin-strap joints, reinforced padded ear flaps.

good_leather_flying_cap.name: Good Leather Flying Cap
good_leather_flying_cap.description: Supple calfskin with a silk lining and a buckle that closes properly every time. Lockheed's test pilots in Burbank favoured this cut, back before the plant went quiet.
good_leather_flying_cap.icon: Polished rich brown calfskin aviator cap, ivory silk lining showing at the edges, bright brass buckle, neatly shaped ear flaps.

worn_canvas_work_cap.name: Worn Canvas Work Cap
worn_canvas_work_cap.description: Somebody's sweat is still in the band, and somebody's name was once inked inside before the rain took it. A grip from the Christie lot, most likely.
worn_canvas_work_cap.icon: Shabby faded khaki canvas work cap with a short stiff bill, frayed edges, grease smudges and a sweat-darkened band, seen in slight three-quarter view.

canvas_work_cap_of_agility.name: Canvas Work Cap of Agility
canvas_work_cap_of_agility.description: Belonged to a rigger who ran the catwalks above the Columbia stages without a rope. He hung it on a nail the day the hive moved in, and nobody has seen him come down.
canvas_work_cap_of_agility.icon: Tan canvas work cap with a short bill, light blue stitching around the crown and a small brass feather pin on the band.

canvas_work_cap_of_strength.name: Canvas Work Cap of Strength
canvas_work_cap_of_strength.description: Stagehands who shifted flats single-handed wore caps like this, mostly so the foreman could spot them across the lot and hand them the heavier flat.
canvas_work_cap_of_strength.icon: Dark brown canvas work cap with a short bill, a red stitched band and a small iron anvil pin on the side.

canvas_work_cap_of_stamina.name: Canvas Work Cap of Stamina
canvas_work_cap_of_stamina.description: Through three double shifts and a studio fire, its owner never once took it off. His wife claims it is the only thing holding his head together.
canvas_work_cap_of_stamina.icon: Olive canvas work cap with a thick quilted band, green stitching along the bill and a tiny tin canteen charm hanging from the side.

canvas_work_cap_of_the_boxer.name: Canvas Work Cap of the Boxer
canvas_work_cap_of_the_boxer.description: Ringside at the Legion Stadium every Friday night, worn by a cut man who stayed for every bout. It smells of liniment, cheap cigars and a three-dollar bet on the wrong welterweight.
canvas_work_cap_of_the_boxer.icon: Sand-coloured canvas work cap with a bright red band and a small enamel boxing glove pin above the short bill.

canvas_work_cap_of_the_marksman.name: Canvas Work Cap of the Marksman
canvas_work_cap_of_the_marksman.description: A pencil stub is still tucked behind the band, beside a row of tally marks. The camera assistant who wore it judged focus distances by eye, and later judged range on Invader Spitters the same way.
canvas_work_cap_of_the_marksman.icon: Slate grey canvas work cap with a yellow pencil stub tucked into the band and a small brass pin notched with a cross-hair.

canvas_work_cap_of_the_acrobat.name: Canvas Work Cap of the Acrobat
canvas_work_cap_of_the_acrobat.description: Fairbanks's stunt doubles favoured these for rooftop chases: snug enough to stay on through a somersault, cheap enough to lose off a ledge without telling wardrobe.
canvas_work_cap_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light khaki canvas work cap with a yellow-striped band and a small silver tumbling-star pin beside the short curved bill.

canvas_work_cap_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Work Cap of the Engineer
canvas_work_cap_of_the_engineer.description: Inside the crown, a wiring diagram for a ten-kilowatt arc lamp has been sketched in indelible pencil. The electrician who drew it kept his notes where producers would never think to look.
canvas_work_cap_of_the_engineer.icon: Blue-grey canvas work cap with a coil of copper wire wrapped around the band and a small brass wrench charm on the side.

patched_canvas_work_cap.name: Patched Canvas Work Cap
patched_canvas_work_cap.description: Three different shades of canvas, and the bill has been resewn with fishing line. Careful hands, short money.
patched_canvas_work_cap.icon: Canvas work cap covered in mismatched brown, grey and khaki patches, with a crookedly resewn bill and dull, faded colours.

plain_canvas_work_cap.name: Plain Canvas Work Cap
plain_canvas_work_cap.description: Exactly what the Gower Street hardware stores sold by the dozen to men queueing for day work. Keeps the sun off. Promises nothing else.
plain_canvas_work_cap.icon: Clean plain khaki canvas work cap with straight even stitching, a flat short bill and no markings.

sturdy_canvas_work_cap.name: Sturdy Canvas Work Cap
sturdy_canvas_work_cap.description: Double-stitched and lined with ticking, this is the cap a studio carpenter buys after the last one went under a falling flat.
sturdy_canvas_work_cap.icon: Heavy tan canvas work cap with bold double stitching and a blue-and-white striped ticking lining showing under the firm bill.

good_canvas_work_cap.name: Good Canvas Work Cap
good_canvas_work_cap.description: Proper duck canvas, a stiffened bill and a leather sweatband. The kind of cap a foreman wears into the union hall, and keeps on.
good_canvas_work_cap.icon: Crisp brown duck canvas work cap with a stiffened bill, a dark leather sweatband and small brass ventilation eyelets on the crown.

worn_m1917_helmet.name: Worn M1917 Helmet
worn_m1917_helmet.description: Shipped home from France in 1919 and hung in a garage ever since. The dent was there when the Legion handed it over.
worn_m1917_helmet.icon: Wide flat-brimmed steel soup-bowl helmet with flaking dull olive paint, rust patches, a deep dent in the crown and a frayed canvas chinstrap.

m1917_helmet_of_strength.name: M1917 Helmet of Strength
m1917_helmet_of_strength.description: Its last owner swung a sledge on the Mulholland Dam pours and dug trenches at Saint-Mihiel before that. He reckons digging under shellfire was the lighter job.
m1917_helmet_of_strength.icon: Olive drab wide-brimmed steel helmet with a red painted stripe around the brim and a small stencilled hammer emblem on the front.

m1917_helmet_of_stamina.name: M1917 Helmet of Stamina
m1917_helmet_of_stamina.description: Post 43 men say this one took a German rifle round in the Argonne and a falling arc lamp at Warner Bros., and its owner walked away from both.
m1917_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Olive wide-brimmed steel helmet with a long bright bullet crease across the crown, a thick padded liner showing and a green-painted rim.

m1917_helmet_of_the_boxer.name: M1917 Helmet of the Boxer
m1917_helmet_of_the_boxer.description: Hung on a hook in the dressing room under the Legion Stadium, where a heavyweight from the 40th Division wore it to sparring as a joke. The joke wore off; the dent did not.
m1917_helmet_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive wide-brimmed steel helmet with a red leather chinstrap, a shallow dent and a small boxing glove insignia painted on the front.

m1917_helmet_of_the_stevedore.name: M1917 Helmet of the Stevedore
m1917_helmet_of_the_stevedore.description: Longshoremen at San Pedro took to army surplus after one too many cargo nets came loose overhead. Salt has eaten at the rim.
m1917_helmet_of_the_stevedore.icon: Olive wide-brimmed steel helmet with a pale salt-stained rim, a coil of hemp rope tied around the crown and a small painted anchor emblem.

patched_m1917_helmet.name: Patched M1917 Helmet
patched_m1917_helmet.description: Rust spots daubed over with house paint in a green that does not quite match. The liner is a folded flour sack.
patched_m1917_helmet.icon: Wide-brimmed steel helmet blotched with mismatched green paint over rust, a folded white flour-sack liner and a knotted rope chinstrap.

plain_m1917_helmet.name: Plain M1917 Helmet
plain_m1917_helmet.description: Bought off a Main Street surplus table for less than a ticket to Grauman's. It stops a thrown bottle. Larger objects remain an open question.
plain_m1917_helmet.icon: Clean olive drab wide-brimmed steel helmet with intact matte paint and a plain tan canvas chinstrap.

sturdy_m1917_helmet.name: Sturdy M1917 Helmet
sturdy_m1917_helmet.description: Freshly repainted, with a new liner and a riveted chinstrap. A Legion quartermaster checked it twice and signed for it once.
sturdy_m1917_helmet.icon: Glossy olive wide-brimmed steel helmet with a new brown leather liner and a sturdy chinstrap fixed with bright steel rivets.

good_m1917_helmet.name: Good M1917 Helmet
good_m1917_helmet.description: Kept pristine since the last Armistice Day parade, the brim polished by a sergeant with nothing else left to polish. It has finally been called back to duty.
good_m1917_helmet.icon: Deep olive wide-brimmed steel helmet with smooth even paint, a polished bare-steel brim edge and a brown leather chinstrap with a brass buckle.

worn_hobnail_boots.name: Worn Hobnail Boots
worn_hobnail_boots.description: Resoled twice by a cobbler on Cahuenga and abandoned once by a carpenter who ran faster barefoot. The nails still bite the pavement.
worn_hobnail_boots.icon: Pair of scuffed brown ankle boots, cracked dull leather, iron hobnails missing in patches on the visible sole, frayed grey laces, one heel worn down at an angle.

hobnail_boots_of_agility.name: Hobnail Boots of Agility
hobnail_boots_of_agility.description: A Christie lot grip wore these up and down catwalks forty feet above the stage floor and never once dropped a lamp on a director. He considered that restraint.
hobnail_boots_of_agility.icon: Pair of brown lace-up hobnail boots, bright iron nails on the sole, thin yellow-green welt stitching, a small grey feather charm tied to the laces.

hobnail_boots_of_strength.name: Hobnail Boots of Strength
hobnail_boots_of_strength.description: Hobnails were made for men who push things: wagons, pianos, scenery flats, the occasional drone back through a doorway. These have pushed all four.
hobnail_boots_of_strength.icon: Pair of dark brown thick-soled boots, heavy rows of iron hobnails, bold red laces and red welt stitching, broad squared toes.

hobnail_boots_of_stamina.name: Hobnail Boots of Stamina
hobnail_boots_of_stamina.description: Broken in on a long walk from Glendale after the red car stalled at Edendale. The owner arrived with blisters, a sunburn and both feet, which he counted as a win.
hobnail_boots_of_stamina.icon: Pair of tall brown lace-up boots, extra row of hobnails, grey wool sock cuffs folded over the tops, dark green laces.

hobnail_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Hobnail Boots of the Boxer
hobnail_boots_of_the_boxer.description: Bought from a heavyweight who fought Friday nights at the Legion Stadium and walked home along Selma afterward. He claimed the boots never once went down.
hobnail_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Pair of brown hobnail boots with red laces, scuffed toes, a tiny brass boxing-glove pin fastened to one tongue.

hobnail_boots_of_the_marksman.name: Hobnail Boots of the Marksman
hobnail_boots_of_the_marksman.description: The nails were filed flat at the heel so the owner could stand on a rooftop without a sound. A Brute in the Hollywood Hotel learned this, briefly.
hobnail_boots_of_the_marksman.icon: Pair of brown hobnail boots, heel nails filed flat and shiny, black laces, a small brass cross-hair notch stamped on the ankle.

hobnail_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Hobnail Boots of the Acrobat
hobnail_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen on Poverty Row swore by hobnails for roof jumps, mostly because the studio would not pay for anything better. This pair has landed off three balconies and one moving truck.
hobnail_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pair of light tan hobnail boots, scuffed toes, bright blue laces, a small red-and-white striped circus patch sewn on the ankle.

hobnail_boots_of_the_engineer.name: Hobnail Boots of the Engineer
hobnail_boots_of_the_engineer.description: Somebody in the Columbia electrical department pencilled amperages on the tongue and then wore the numbers off. Rubber heels, sensible around live cable.
hobnail_boots_of_the_engineer.icon: Pair of brown hobnail boots with black rubber heel plates, copper wire wound around one ankle, a tiny brass wrench charm on the laces.

patched_hobnail_boots.name: Patched Hobnail Boots
patched_hobnail_boots.description: Two colours of leather and one hopeful cobbler. Water gets in at the left toe.
patched_hobnail_boots.icon: Pair of boots made of mismatched black and brown leather patches, crude thick stitching, several hobnails missing from the sole.

plain_hobnail_boots.name: Plain Hobnail Boots
plain_hobnail_boots.description: Nothing to recommend them but a full set of nails and an honest pair of laces.
plain_hobnail_boots.icon: Pair of plain mid-brown ankle boots, complete rows of iron hobnails, tan laces, clean but unpolished leather.

sturdy_hobnail_boots.name: Sturdy Hobnail Boots
sturdy_hobnail_boots.description: Double-stitched at a Gower Gulch saddlery, where the leatherworkers make boots between saddles and grumble about it.
sturdy_hobnail_boots.icon: Pair of thick dark-brown boots, visible white double welt stitching, dense hobnails, rawhide laces knotted at the top.

good_hobnail_boots.name: Good Hobnail Boots
good_hobnail_boots.description: Oiled, resoled and nailed fresh. On the Boulevard they ring like a cavalry troop, which reassures some neighbours and annoys the rest.
good_hobnail_boots.icon: Pair of polished chestnut boots, gleaming steel hobnails, crisp black laces, a soft sheen on the toes.

worn_steel_toed_boots.name: Worn Steel-toed Boots
worn_steel_toed_boots.description: Rust has eaten through the toe caps' paint, and the last owner's luck went the same way.
worn_steel_toed_boots.icon: Pair of scuffed black work boots, torn leather exposing rusty steel toe caps, limp grey laces, cracked soles.

steel_toed_boots_of_strength.name: Steel-toed Boots of Strength
steel_toed_boots_of_strength.description: Issued to a Burbank riveter before the Dome came down. He kicked a stuck hangar door open with them every morning, and lately he has found other things to kick.
steel_toed_boots_of_strength.icon: Pair of black work boots with polished steel toe caps, red laces, heavy cleated soles.

steel_toed_boots_of_stamina.name: Steel-toed Boots of Stamina
steel_toed_boots_of_stamina.description: Heavy enough to anchor a man in a Santa Ana wind and slow enough to get him noticed. Union men call lifting them a day's work.
steel_toed_boots_of_stamina.icon: Pair of tall black lace-up boots, thick riveted steel toe caps, dark green laces, wide square heels.

steel_toed_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Steel-toed Boots of the Boxer
steel_toed_boots_of_the_boxer.description: Legion men say a fighter who trains in steel toes has nothing to fear in the ring at El Centro and Selma, except the bill for the canvas.
steel_toed_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Pair of black steel-toed boots, red laces, a small brass boxing-glove pin on one ankle, dented toe caps.

steel_toed_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Steel-toed Boots of the Stevedore
steel_toed_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: Off a San Pedro longshoreman who came up to Hollywood chasing studio wages. The toes have caught more dropped crates than he cared to count.
steel_toed_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pair of oil-stained brown boots, scratched steel toe caps, a coil of hemp rope tied round one ankle, blue laces.

patched_steel_toed_boots.name: Patched Steel-toed Boots
patched_steel_toed_boots.description: Fresh leather sewn over an old steel cap that refuses to quit.
patched_steel_toed_boots.icon: Pair of black boots with a lighter leather patch over each toe, crude stitching, dented grey steel edge showing beneath.

plain_steel_toed_boots.name: Plain Steel-toed Boots
plain_steel_toed_boots.description: Standard studio-shop issue, the kind every carpenter on the Paramount lot wore before the hive moved in.
plain_steel_toed_boots.icon: Pair of plain black work boots, dull grey steel toe caps, brown laces, simple flat soles.

sturdy_steel_toed_boots.name: Sturdy Steel-toed Boots
sturdy_steel_toed_boots.description: Machine-shop men add a steel shank under the arch and swear they could stand on a dropped girder all day.
sturdy_steel_toed_boots.icon: Pair of thick black boots, riveted steel toe caps, steel heel plates, heavy black laces.

good_steel_toed_boots.name: Good Steel-toed Boots
good_steel_toed_boots.description: Polished to a shine that would pass inspection at Post 43, with toe caps that would pass clean through a drone's leg.
good_steel_toed_boots.icon: Pair of glossy black boots, bright buffed steel toe caps, crisp black laces, neat welt stitching.

fine_lineman_s_boots.name: Fine Lineman's Boots
fine_lineman_s_boots.description: Bought new for a telephone crew that never got its first call after the Dome came down. The laces still hold their store crease.
fine_lineman_s_boots.icon: Tall lace-up work boot, tan canvas shaft with quilted padded ankle, clean brown leather toe, steel climbing spur strapped along the inner calf, crisp new cream laces.

lineman_s_boots_of_agility.name: Lineman's Boots of Agility
lineman_s_boots_of_agility.description: Pacific Telephone linemen could go up a forty-foot pole in under a minute. The man who wore these did it with a Spitter at the bottom and still reached the crossarm first.
lineman_s_boots_of_agility.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft, brown leather toe, steel climbing spur, bright green stitching along the quilting and a small brass rabbit charm tied to the laces.

lineman_s_boots_of_strength.name: Lineman's Boots of Strength
lineman_s_boots_of_strength.description: Hauling cable reels up Vermont Canyon was a two-man job until the fellow in these started doing it alone. His foreman put in for a raise on his behalf, which tells you what kind of year it was.
lineman_s_boots_of_strength.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft, brown leather toe, heavy steel climbing spur, deep red stitching on the quilting and an iron ring charm hanging from the top eyelet.

lineman_s_boots_of_stamina.name: Lineman's Boots of Stamina
lineman_s_boots_of_stamina.description: Eleven straight days restringing wire along the red-car route, sleeping in the work truck, and the soles never split. The owner gave out first; the boots went to the next man on the crew.
lineman_s_boots_of_stamina.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft with a navy blue padded ankle collar, double-stitched thick sole, steel climbing spur, scuffed brown leather toe.

lineman_s_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Lineman's Boots of the Boxer
lineman_s_boots_of_the_boxer.description: On Friday nights the owner came straight off shift to sit ringside at the Legion Stadium, spurs and all. He swore he went three rounds with a heckler once and never untied them.
lineman_s_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft, brown leather toe, steel climbing spur, red and white striped cuff and a tiny red boxing glove pin clipped to the laces.

lineman_s_boots_of_the_marksman.name: Lineman's Boots of the Marksman
lineman_s_boots_of_the_marksman.description: A lineman learns to judge distance by eye, wire to wire. This one carried a Winchester up the poles as well and settled matters with drones from the crossarm.
lineman_s_boots_of_the_marksman.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft, brown leather toe, steel climbing spur with a small cross-hair notch filed into its brass buckle, grey-green stitching.

lineman_s_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Lineman's Boots of the Acrobat
lineman_s_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen at the Christie lot borrowed these for a rooftop chase and returned them only under protest. One fell off a two-storey set wearing them and walked away, which the studio logged as a rehearsal.
lineman_s_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft, brown leather toe, steel climbing spur wrapped with a frayed red ribbon, orange stitched stripe around the ankle.

lineman_s_boots_of_the_engineer.name: Lineman's Boots of the Engineer
lineman_s_boots_of_the_engineer.description: Owned by a union electrician who sketched wiring diagrams inside the shaft in carpenter's pencil. Half of them make sense. The other half describe something the hive left humming on Western Avenue.
lineman_s_boots_of_the_engineer.icon: Tall lace-up padded lineman's boot, tan canvas shaft covered in faint grey pencil circuit lines, brown leather toe, steel climbing spur, small brass wrench charm on the laces.

pressed_lineman_s_boots.name: Pressed Lineman's Boots
pressed_lineman_s_boots.description: Freshly blacked and creased by a valet at the Roosevelt Hotel, who did not ask why a lineman was staying there.
pressed_lineman_s_boots.icon: Tall lace-up lineman's boot, polished dark brown leather toe, crisp black quilted canvas shaft, gleaming nickel climbing spur, neat waxed black laces.

tailored_lineman_s_boots.name: Tailored Lineman's Boots
tailored_lineman_s_boots.description: Cut to measure by a wardrobe man for an actor playing a lineman. The actor never climbed anything, but the boots can.
tailored_lineman_s_boots.icon: Slim fitted lace-up lineman's boot, oxblood leather toe, close-quilted charcoal canvas shaft, brass eyelets, slender polished nickel climbing spur.

heavy_lineman_s_boots.name: Heavy Lineman's Boots
heavy_lineman_s_boots.description: Double-quilted, with a steel shank and a spur long enough to bite through hive resin. Line crews took to them once the poles started growing things.
heavy_lineman_s_boots.icon: Bulky lace-up lineman's boot, thick layered grey canvas quilting, dark heavy leather toe and heel, long iron climbing spur with a riveted strap, thick lugged sole.

fine_trench_boots.name: Fine Trench Boots
fine_trench_boots.description: Army surplus that somehow never saw France. Hobnails bright, uppers supple, sold off a cart outside Post 43 for a dollar less than the man wanted.
fine_trench_boots.icon: Ankle-high brown leather trench boot, rows of bright hobnails on the sole, small steel toecap, clean khaki wool puttee strap wrapped above it.

trench_boots_of_strength.name: Trench Boots of Strength
trench_boots_of_strength.description: Kicked in the doors of three hive-choked bungalows on Selma Avenue. The steel toes are dented. The doors fared worse.
trench_boots_of_strength.icon: Ankle-high brown trench boot, dented steel toecap, hobnailed sole, khaki puttee wrapped with a deep red band, small iron ring on the strap.

trench_boots_of_stamina.name: Trench Boots of Stamina
trench_boots_of_stamina.description: Marched in by a sergeant who walked from Saint-Mihiel to the Rhine in a pair just like them. Now he patrols the Cahuenga Pass road twice a night and claims it feels shorter.
trench_boots_of_stamina.icon: Ankle-high brown trench boot, steel toecap, thick hobnailed double sole, long blue-grey wool puttee wrapped neatly around the shaft.

trench_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Trench Boots of the Boxer
trench_boots_of_the_boxer.description: Post 43 built its stadium on fight money, and a doorman wore these working the Friday crowd for years. He maintains he never threw a punch, only a shoulder.
trench_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Ankle-high brown trench boot, steel toecap, hobnailed sole, khaki puttee with a small brass boxing glove pin fastened to its strap.

trench_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Trench Boots of the Stevedore
trench_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro on a fruit truck, salt-stained to the ankle, with a cargo hook's scar across one toecap. They still smell faintly of oranges and bilge.
trench_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: Ankle-high brown trench boot, white salt stains on the leather, deep scratch across the steel toecap, hobnailed sole, laces replaced with tarred rope.

pressed_trench_boots.name: Pressed Trench Boots
pressed_trench_boots.description: Polished for the Armistice Day parade down Hollywood Boulevard. The parade is still on the calendar; nobody has consulted the Dome.
pressed_trench_boots.icon: Ankle-high trench boot in mirror-black leather, gleaming steel toecap, neat hobnailed sole, crisp pressed khaki puttee with a bright brass buckle.

tailored_trench_boots.name: Tailored Trench Boots
tailored_trench_boots.description: Colonel's property, refitted by a Wilshire bootmaker, steel plates and all, so they would not spoil the line of his jodhpurs.
tailored_trench_boots.icon: Slim tall cordovan trench boot, fitted polished steel shin plate, brass buckles up the side, steel toecap, fine hobnailed sole.

heavy_trench_boots.name: Heavy Trench Boots
heavy_trench_boots.description: Riveted steel over the instep and shin, enough to turn a Soldier's mandible. Men who wear them do not get knocked down, only slowed.
heavy_trench_boots.icon: Massive trench boot with riveted dark steel plates over shin and instep, scarred brown leather beneath, oversized steel toecap, thick hobnailed sole.

fine_silk_sash.name: Fine Silk Sash
fine_silk_sash.description: Cut from a bolt of wardrobe silk meant for a pirate picture that never got past the second reel. The pirates were let go; the sash stayed on.
fine_silk_sash.icon: A folded crimson silk sash with tasselled ends, clean and glossy, tied in a neat centre knot, edged with plain gold thread.

silk_sash_of_intellect.name: Silk Sash of Intellect
silk_sash_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a scenario writer on the Pickford-Fairbanks lot who wore it to think. He claimed it kept the blood near his brain, and nobody in the story department could prove otherwise.
silk_sash_of_intellect.icon: A deep blue silk sash knotted at the centre, with a small brass fountain-pen clip pinned through the knot and dark blue tassels.

silk_sash_of_spirit.name: Silk Sash of Spirit
silk_sash_of_spirit.description: Smells faintly of jasmine and incense from the Krotona buildings in Beachwood Canyon, where the old Theosophists held that a calm middle makes a calm soul. The invaders have not tested the theory.
silk_sash_of_spirit.icon: A pale lavender silk sash with soft sheen, a small embroidered white lotus near one tasselled end, loosely knotted.

silk_sash_of_stamina.name: Silk Sash of Stamina
silk_sash_of_stamina.description: An extra wore this through fourteen hours of a harem scene at Universal and asked for overtime. He got a sandwich, and the sash.
silk_sash_of_stamina.icon: A wide emerald silk sash in thick wrapped folds, heavy gold-fringed ends and a sturdy double knot.

silk_sash_of_the_engineer.name: Silk Sash of the Engineer
silk_sash_of_the_engineer.description: Lifted from a dance director's costume trunk by a studio electrician who needed something to hang his circuit tester from. The silk has held up better than the dance director.
silk_sash_of_the_engineer.icon: A charcoal grey silk sash with copper wire wrapped around the knot and a small brass wrench charm dangling from one end.

silk_sash_of_the_doctor.name: Silk Sash of the Doctor
silk_sash_of_the_doctor.description: During the first week of the Dome, a nurse at the Highland aid station tied her bandage scissors to it and never untied them. The left end is still stiff with iodine.
silk_sash_of_the_doctor.icon: A white silk sash with faded orange iodine stains, small steel bandage scissors tied to the knot with red thread.

silk_sash_of_the_deacon.name: Silk Sash of the Deacon
silk_sash_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday it walked in the choir procession at Angelus Temple, then all the way home to Edendale. The fringe has been mended with hymnal ribbon more than once.
silk_sash_of_the_deacon.icon: A royal blue silk sash, fringe mended with a gold ribbon bookmark, a small white cross embroidered near one end.

pressed_silk_sash.name: Pressed Silk Sash
pressed_silk_sash.description: Steamed flat by the wardrobe girls at Chaplin Studios, who press everything twice whether it needs it or not. Word on La Brea is that Mr. Chaplin's own costumes get three.
pressed_silk_sash.icon: A crisp burgundy silk sash folded flat with sharp creases, neatly pressed tassels and a smooth satin sheen.

tailored_silk_sash.name: Tailored Silk Sash
tailored_silk_sash.description: Sewn to measure for a leading man at Universal who insisted his waist was two inches less than it is. The tailor put in a hidden gusset and kept his opinion.
tailored_silk_sash.icon: A tailored black silk sash with hidden pleats, a polished silver clasp at the front and fine silver-thread edging.

heavy_silk_sash.name: Heavy Silk Sash
heavy_silk_sash.description: Two layers of upholstery silk from a Universal parlour set, quilted together after a Spitter's acid ate through its owner's first sash. Not handsome, but the drips stop at the lining.
heavy_silk_sash.icon: A thick double-layered olive silk sash with quilted stitching, scorched pocks on the outer layer and a heavy brass ring clasp.

fine_gun_belt.name: Fine Gun Belt
fine_gun_belt.description: Hand-tooled in a Gower Gulch saddlery for a cowboy extra who never once fired the six-gun it carried. The holster still smells of saddle soap rather than powder.
fine_gun_belt.icon: A coiled brown leather gun belt with an empty holster, clean tooled leaf pattern, a row of empty cartridge loops and a nickel buckle.

gun_belt_of_agility.name: Gun Belt of Agility
gun_belt_of_agility.description: Its last owner could clear leather faster than the cameraman could crank, which is why none of his fight scenes cut together. The studio let him go for ruining takes.
gun_belt_of_agility.icon: A slim tan leather gun belt with a low-slung holster and tie-down thong, cartridge loops and a small silver star concho.

gun_belt_of_stamina.name: Gun Belt of Stamina
gun_belt_of_stamina.description: Took a stray round from a Dragna gunman on the Strip and kept its wearer upright long enough to reach a doctor. The bullet is still lodged in the third cartridge loop, where it belongs.
gun_belt_of_stamina.icon: A thick dark brown leather gun belt with a wide holster, a flattened bullet lodged in one cartridge loop and a scuffed brass buckle.

gun_belt_of_spirit.name: Gun Belt of Spirit
gun_belt_of_spirit.description: A Temple usher wore his revolver on the right and a pocket Testament on the left, and never had to explain which came out first.
gun_belt_of_spirit.icon: A black leather gun belt with a holster on one side and a small leather pouch on the other, pale stitching, a tiny brass cross on the pouch flap.

gun_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Gun Belt of the Acrobat
gun_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Built for a stunt rider who rolled off horses at a gallop for five dollars a fall. The buckle sits flat so it never caught a stirrup, and the holster snaps shut against tumbling.
gun_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: A lightweight russet leather gun belt with a snap-flap holster, a flat low-profile buckle and red-and-white diamond stitching along the edge.

gun_belt_of_the_stevedore.name: Gun Belt of the Stevedore
gun_belt_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks around the waist of a longshoreman who unloaded crates of 'machine parts' for Tony Cornero and asked no questions. The holster fits a flask as well as a revolver.
gun_belt_of_the_stevedore.icon: A heavy weathered black leather gun belt with salt stains, a rope-wrapped buckle, a deep holster and a small iron cargo hook charm.

gun_belt_of_the_deacon.name: Gun Belt of the Deacon
gun_belt_of_the_deacon.description: Prayed over at Angelus Temple and loaded at the Legion clubhouse, in that order. Its owner walked Echo Park after dark handing out tracts and putting down whatever would not take one.
gun_belt_of_the_deacon.icon: An oxblood leather gun belt with cartridge loops, a holster flap stitched with a white dove and a purple ribbon tied at the buckle.

pressed_gun_belt.name: Pressed Gun Belt
pressed_gun_belt.description: Leather does not press, but the boys at the Stembridge gun room oiled and blocked this one until it stood up by itself. Marathon Street takes its belts personally.
pressed_gun_belt.icon: A glossy polished chestnut leather gun belt with crisp edges, a gleaming holster, brass buckle and cartridge loops filled with bright brass casings.

tailored_gun_belt.name: Tailored Gun Belt
tailored_gun_belt.description: Made to order on the Strip for a man who wanted his pistol to sit exactly where his jacket would hide it. His tailor and his gunsmith shared an invoice.
tailored_gun_belt.icon: A slim black calfskin gun belt with a cross-draw holster, silver belt tip and buckle, and fine white stitching.

heavy_gun_belt.name: Heavy Gun Belt
heavy_gun_belt.description: Double-stitched harness leather with a steel plate riveted behind the holster, added after the Cahuenga Pass patrols learned that Burrowers come up from underneath. Weighs nearly as much as the gun.
heavy_gun_belt.icon: A thick dark harness-leather gun belt with a riveted steel plate behind the holster, double rows of heavy stitching, an iron buckle and full loops of brass cartridges.

reinforced_stunt_rider_s_helmet.name: Reinforced Stunt Rider's Helmet
reinforced_stunt_rider_s_helmet.description: Extra leather straps are riveted across the crown by a Studio City saddler who charged by the rivet and was not shy about it.
reinforced_stunt_rider_s_helmet.icon: Round brown leather crash helmet with ear flaps, three thick crossing straps riveted over the crown, dull steel rivets, worn buckled chin strap.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_agility.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of Agility
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_agility.description: Belonged to a motorcycle man who jumped the canal on Universal's European street twice a day for the camera and once for a bet. The bet paid better.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_agility.icon: Round tan leather crash helmet with ear flaps and chin strap, a narrow yellow racing stripe down the crown, small brass lightning-bolt pin at the brow.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_stamina.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of Stamina
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_stamina.description: Dented in eleven places, each one a fall the wearer got up from. The studio paid him for nine of them.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Round dark brown leather crash helmet with ear flaps, crown scuffed and visibly dented, thick red stitched seam band, heavy padded chin strap.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_spirit.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of Spirit
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_spirit.description: Stitched inside the lining is a St. Christopher medal, put there by a rider's mother. He never once wrote home about the work, and she never once asked.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_spirit.icon: Round chestnut leather crash helmet with ear flaps, pale blue stitching along the seams, a small silver saint's medal dangling from the chin strap.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_acrobat.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of the Acrobat
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_acrobat.description: Tumbling from a galloping horse onto a moving red car made its owner famous on Poverty Row, at seven-fifty a day plus bruises.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_acrobat.icon: Round tan leather crash helmet with ear flaps, green and white checked band around the brim, small brass star-shaped tumbler pin on the side.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_stevedore.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of the Stevedore
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who took up stunt riding because it paid better and the bosses shouted less. Both claims proved half true.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_stevedore.icon: Round oil-stained brown leather crash helmet with ear flaps, coarse rope-braid band around the crown, tiny iron cargo-hook charm on the chin strap.

stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_deacon.name: Stunt Rider's Helmet of the Deacon
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_deacon.description: Smells faintly of hymnal paper and motor oil. Its owner rode a sidecar rig to Angelus Temple every Sunday and claimed the Lord did the steering on the hairpins.
stunt_rider_s_helmet_of_the_deacon.icon: Round black leather crash helmet with ear flaps, white piped seams, a short purple ribbon bookmark tucked under the chin strap buckle.

superior_stunt_rider_s_helmet.name: Superior Stunt Rider's Helmet
superior_stunt_rider_s_helmet.description: Cut from a single saddle-leather hide and lined in lamb's wool, the sort of helmet a stuntman buys after his first raise and before his second wife.
superior_stunt_rider_s_helmet.icon: Polished glossy oxblood leather crash helmet, smooth seamless crown, cream wool lining showing at the ear flaps, bright brass buckle and rivets.

chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_helmet.name: Chitin-lined Stunt Rider's Helmet
chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_helmet.description: Under the leather sits a curved plate of Drone shell, boiled soft and pressed to shape. Riders swear it rings like a bell when a branch catches it, and stops the branch cold.
chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_helmet.icon: Dark brown leather crash helmet with ear flaps, edges of iridescent green-black insect shell peeking out beneath the leather seams, steel rivets.

chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_helmet.name: Chitin-plated Stunt Rider's Helmet
chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_helmet.description: Green-black plates ride over the crown where riveted leather used to be. Riders on the Mount Lee road say Fliers dive at it less often, as if they recognise a relative.
chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_helmet.icon: Crash helmet armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black insect shell plates over the crown, black leather ear flaps, a ridged chitin crest running front to back.

reinforced_quilted_aviator_helmet.name: Reinforced Quilted Aviator Helmet
reinforced_quilted_aviator_helmet.description: Fresh canvas quilting is stitched over the old at the Lockheed plant, where nobody has flown since the Dome came down but everybody still keeps a helmet.
reinforced_quilted_aviator_helmet.icon: Close-fitting quilted khaki canvas flying cap with long ear flaps, extra quilted panel sewn over the crown, plain round goggles with scratched lenses on the brow.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_agility.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of Agility
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_agility.description: A wing-walker wore this crossing from one biplane to another over Burbank for a newsreel. She kept the fee in coins so she could hear it.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_agility.icon: Quilted sand-coloured canvas flying cap with ear flaps, round goggles with yellow-tinted lenses on the brow, small brass wing pin at the temple.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_strength.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of Strength
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_strength.description: Hand-cranking aero engines at United Airport builds the shoulders of a blacksmith. The mechanic who owned this one could swing a propeller and a grudge with equal ease.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_strength.icon: Thick quilted olive canvas flying cap with ear flaps, oil-smudged crown, round goggles on the brow, small iron propeller charm hanging from the chin strap.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_stamina.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of Stamina
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_stamina.description: Recovered from a Fokker that came down hard during the Hell's Angels shoot. The pilot recovered too, eventually, and still will not discuss the dailies.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Heavily quilted brown canvas flying cap with deep padded ear flaps, a scorched patch on one side, round goggles with one cracked lens on the brow.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_boxer.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of the Boxer
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium and mail runs on weekdays: its owner reasoned a man used to being hit could survive a bad landing. He had a point, briefly.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_boxer.icon: Quilted khaki canvas flying cap with ear flaps, red leather band around the brow, round goggles, a tiny red boxing glove pin on the side.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_marksman.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of the Marksman
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_marksman.description: Goggle straps are cut to sit clear of a rifle stock. Its owner rode the rear cockpit over Burbank and could put a camera, or a bullet, exactly where the director pointed.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_marksman.icon: Quilted grey-green canvas flying cap with ear flaps, round goggles with one lens fitted with a brass crosshair ring, narrow black band at the brow.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_acrobat.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of the Acrobat
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_acrobat.description: Padded thickly at the temples for a barnstormer who hung by his knees from a landing gear over Glendale, smiling for the photographers upside down.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_acrobat.icon: Quilted cream canvas flying cap with thick padded temple rolls and ear flaps, round goggles with green frames, a small striped circus-tent pin on the side.

quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_engineer.name: Quilted Aviator Helmet of the Engineer
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_engineer.description: Pencil stubs and a feeler gauge rattle in the ear-flap pocket. It belonged to a Lockheed draughtsman who test-flew his own designs on the theory that it kept him honest.
quilted_aviator_helmet_of_the_engineer.icon: Quilted tan canvas flying cap with ear flaps, a small buttoned pocket holding pencil stubs, round goggles on the brow, tiny steel wrench charm on the strap.

superior_quilted_aviator_helmet.name: Superior Quilted Aviator Helmet
superior_quilted_aviator_helmet.description: United Airport issued these to its pilots the week the terminal opened, with brass buckles and a lining that still smells of new money and aviation fuel.
superior_quilted_aviator_helmet.icon: Crisp navy-blue quilted canvas flying cap with sheepskin-trimmed ear flaps, polished brass buckles, bright chrome-rimmed round goggles with clear lenses.

chitin_lined_quilted_aviator_helmet.name: Chitin-lined Quilted Aviator Helmet
chitin_lined_quilted_aviator_helmet.description: Between the quilting layers someone slipped thin panes of Flier wing, which turn a Spitter's acid and hum faintly in a crosswind. The hum takes getting used to.
chitin_lined_quilted_aviator_helmet.icon: Quilted dark khaki canvas flying cap with ear flaps, translucent iridescent green-black insect wing membrane showing through split seams, round smoked-lens goggles on the brow.

chitin_plated_quilted_aviator_helmet.name: Chitin-plated Quilted Aviator Helmet
chitin_plated_quilted_aviator_helmet.description: Overlapping shell plates now cover the canvas, cut from Elder Fliers brought down over the hangars. Pilots who wear one over Mount Lee do not say much about what they saw below.
chitin_plated_quilted_aviator_helmet.icon: Flying cap armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black insect shell plates over quilted black canvas, ear flaps, round goggles with faintly amber resin-tinted lenses.

tailored_cartridge_belt.name: Tailored Cartridge Belt
tailored_cartridge_belt.description: Cut to a wardrobe man's measurements for a picture about Pancho Villa, then requisitioned when the real shooting started. The stitching is still better than the script was.
tailored_cartridge_belt.icon: Crisp khaki canvas cartridge belt with neat squared pouches, polished steel buckle plate, clean tan stitching, a row of bright brass cartridge tips peeking from the loops.

cartridge_belt_of_strength.name: Cartridge Belt of Strength
cartridge_belt_of_strength.description: Loaded, it weighs about as much as a sack of cement, which was the point. A Post 43 sergeant wore it on route marches up Highland Avenue to keep his legs honest and his recruits quiet.
cartridge_belt_of_strength.icon: Olive drab web cartridge belt with riveted steel pouch plates, heavy steel buckle, bold red stitching along the edges, full row of brass cartridges.

cartridge_belt_of_stamina.name: Cartridge Belt of Stamina
cartridge_belt_of_stamina.description: Its last owner held the Cahuenga Pass road for two days and three nights with this buckled on. He slept in it too, judging by the smell, and nobody had the heart to tell him.
cartridge_belt_of_stamina.icon: Olive drab web cartridge belt with steel pouch plates, worn steel buckle, a stitched navy blue patch on one pouch, brass cartridges in the loops.

cartridge_belt_of_the_boxer.name: Cartridge Belt of the Boxer
cartridge_belt_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a heavyweight from Pasadena hung this on his corner post between rounds. He lost on points every time and liked to say it was the only belt he ever won.
cartridge_belt_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive drab cartridge belt with steel pouch plates, red and white braided stitching, a small brass boxing glove pin fixed beside the steel buckle.

cartridge_belt_of_the_stevedore.name: Cartridge Belt of the Stevedore
cartridge_belt_of_the_stevedore.description: Came ashore at San Pedro in a crate stencilled as machine parts, alongside a good deal of Canadian whisky that was not. The longshoreman who kept it could sling a hundredweight one-handed.
cartridge_belt_of_the_stevedore.icon: Olive drab cartridge belt with steel pouch plates, a coil of tarred rope lashed around one loop, small iron cargo hook charm hanging from the buckle.

heavy_cartridge_belt.name: Heavy Cartridge Belt
heavy_cartridge_belt.description: Steel loops, doubled canvas and a buckle that could stop a truck. Quartermasters issue it to men who complain about the weight only once.
heavy_cartridge_belt.icon: Thick doubled canvas cartridge belt in dark olive, wide blackened steel buckle, chunky steel-framed pouches, heavy brass cartridges packed tight.

reinforced_cartridge_belt.name: Reinforced Cartridge Belt
reinforced_cartridge_belt.description: Riveted plates now cover every pouch, after a Spitter's acid ate through the old canvas and set off half a clip of .30-06.
reinforced_cartridge_belt.icon: Dark olive cartridge belt with every pouch covered by riveted grey steel plates, reinforced steel corner caps, broad gunmetal buckle, faint acid scorch on one edge.

superior_cartridge_belt.name: Superior Cartridge Belt
superior_cartridge_belt.description: A Burbank machinist turned out a dozen of these before the hangars went quiet. The loops hold a cartridge as snug as a seven-year studio contract.
superior_cartridge_belt.icon: Precise machined cartridge belt of dark grey steel plates on charcoal webbing, blued steel buckle with neat rivet rows, gleaming brass cartridges evenly spaced.

chitin_lined_cartridge_belt.name: Chitin-lined Cartridge Belt
chitin_lined_cartridge_belt.description: Lined with shell scraped from a dead Soldier, which keeps the brass dry and the wearer awake. The lining hums faintly when the nights turn cold.
chitin_lined_cartridge_belt.icon: Steel-plated cartridge belt on dark webbing, pouches lined with iridescent green-black insect shell showing at the edges, gunmetal buckle, brass cartridges.

chitin_plated_cartridge_belt.name: Chitin-plated Cartridge Belt
chitin_plated_cartridge_belt.description: Every plate was once part of something that walked. Men on the ridge below the HOLLYWOODLAND sign wear these and try not to wonder which part.
chitin_plated_cartridge_belt.icon: Cartridge belt armoured with overlapping curved plates of iridescent green-black insect chitin, steel rivets and buckle, brass cartridges set between the shell segments.

fine_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.name: Fine Stetson Boss of the Plains
fine_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.description: Brushed every morning by a Gower Gulch extra who never got closer to a horse than the hitching rail outside Columbia.
fine_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim, clean sand-tan felt, plain narrow brown leather band, crisp unbent brim edge.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_agility.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of Agility
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_agility.description: Tom Mix's stable boys say a good hat stays on through a fall from the saddle. This one stayed on through three, and its rider walked away from all of them.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_agility.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in pale tan felt, band of braided yellow horsehair with a small silver spur-rowel charm at the side.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_stamina.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of Stamina
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_stamina.description: Twenty summers of Valley sun bleached the crown and never once got through it. The man underneath outlasted two horses, a wife and a bank.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_stamina.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in sun-bleached buff felt, wide dark red leather band fastened with a small brass buckle.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_spirit.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of Spirit
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_spirit.description: Sweatband smells faintly of pipe smoke and pine. Its last owner sat out evenings on the Krotona steps in Beachwood Canyon and claimed the hills told him things.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_spirit.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in soft dove-grey felt, pale blue ribbon band with a green sprig of pine tucked into it.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_acroba.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of the Acrobat
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_acroba.description: Caught in mid-air by its owner during a running mount at a Gower Gulch rodeo. The crowd cheered; the assistant director docked him a day for showing off.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_acroba.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in warm tan felt, orange-and-black woven band, small brass horseshoe pin on the side.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_steved.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of the Stevedore
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_steved.description: Off a cattle boat at San Pedro, by way of a longshoreman who won it at cards and wore it hauling bales just to annoy the foreman.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_steved.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in dusty brown felt, band of knotted hemp rope with a tiny iron cargo-hook charm.

stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_deacon.name: Stetson Boss of the Plains of the Deacon
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_deacon.description: Doffed so often at church doors between Edendale and Angelus Temple that one side of the brim has gone soft. A folded hymn sheet still rides behind the band.
stetson_boss_of_the_plains_of_the_deacon.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in charcoal felt, black grosgrain band with a folded white paper sheet tucked in and a short purple ribbon tail.

pressed_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.name: Pressed Stetson Boss of the Plains
pressed_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.description: Steamed and blocked by a Boulevard hatter who charged a quarter and promised the crease would outlast its owner. Under the Dome, that is no longer much of a boast.
pressed_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.icon: High rounded crown with a sharp fresh crease, wide flat brim, crisp cream felt, glossy chestnut leather band.

tailored_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.name: Tailored Stetson Boss of the Plains
tailored_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.description: Made to measure for a picture cowboy whose head, wardrobe noted, grew a size after each premiere.
tailored_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.icon: High rounded crown and wide flat brim in pale silver-grey felt, ivory satin lining showing at the rim, tooled leather band set with small silver conchos.

heavy_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.name: Heavy Stetson Boss of the Plains
heavy_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.description: Stiffened with doubled felt and a steel hoop under the sweatband by a Universal wardrobe man who had watched a Flier dive. It no longer folds, and neither does its owner.
heavy_stetson_boss_of_the_plains.icon: Thick dark brown felt hat, high rounded crown, stiff wide brim with heavy stitched binding, dull steel hoop and rivets showing beneath the band.

fine_football_helmet.name: Fine Football Helmet
fine_football_helmet.description: Leather, sound, and unclaimed from a Hollywood High locker since the Dome came down. The boy's name has been scratched off the inside.
fine_football_helmet.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with segmented padded ridges over the crown, ear flaps with holes, clean tan leather, brown chin strap, no face guard.

football_helmet_of_agility.name: Football Helmet of Agility
football_helmet_of_agility.description: Belonged to a halfback who could find a gap in any line on Bovard Field, and once, on the Pass road, in a ring of Drones.
football_helmet_of_agility.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, light honey-brown leather, single bright yellow stripe down the crown.

football_helmet_of_strength.name: Football Helmet of Strength
football_helmet_of_strength.description: Nobody at Post 43 has managed to dent it with a fist. A Brute managed it once, and the lineman inside got up anyway, which is the whole point of linemen.
football_helmet_of_strength.icon: Thick padded leather football helmet with heavy ridges and ear flaps, dark oxblood leather, broad red stripe over the crown, small dent at the temple.

football_helmet_of_stamina.name: Football Helmet of Stamina
football_helmet_of_stamina.description: Sixty minutes a Saturday, no substitutions, and the scuffs to prove every one of them. Its owner played both ways and complained about neither.
football_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, heavily scuffed mid-brown leather, grass stains, dark green stripe down the crown.

football_helmet_of_the_boxer.name: Football Helmet of the Boxer
football_helmet_of_the_boxer.description: Fight night at the Legion Stadium drags between bouts, so a heavyweight took to wearing it for the walk to the ring. The promoter said it lacked dignity. The crowd disagreed.
football_helmet_of_the_boxer.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, tan leather, crimson crown stripe, small red boxing-glove pin on one side.

football_helmet_of_the_marksman.name: Football Helmet of the Marksman
football_helmet_of_the_marksman.description: Cut away at the right ear so a rifle stock would sit flush against the cheek. Its owner hit what he aimed at and saw no reason to hear the shot as well.
football_helmet_of_the_marksman.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges, one ear flap trimmed short, tan leather, slate-blue stripe, small brass cross-hair notch stamped on the side.

football_helmet_of_the_acrobat.name: Football Helmet of the Acrobat
football_helmet_of_the_acrobat.description: Rolled down three flights of Hollywood Bowl seating with its owner still inside, both arriving at the bottom in good order. The usher was less composed.
football_helmet_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, pale buckskin leather, bright orange stripe down the crown.

football_helmet_of_the_engineer.name: Football Helmet of the Engineer
football_helmet_of_the_engineer.description: Fitted with a cut-down lamp bracket by a studio electrician who wanted his hands free and his skull intact. The wiring runs down the back like a pigtail.
football_helmet_of_the_engineer.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, brown leather, small brass lamp bracket on the brow, black cord trailing down the back, tiny wrench charm on the chin strap.

pressed_football_helmet.name: Pressed Football Helmet
pressed_football_helmet.description: Oiled and buffed by an equipment manager who kept the varsity's helmets nicer than the varsity. The chin strap still squeaks.
pressed_football_helmet.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with neat padded ridges and ear flaps, polished glossy chestnut leather, crisp white chin strap.

tailored_football_helmet.name: Tailored Football Helmet
tailored_football_helmet.description: Commissioned for a studio football picture whose star refused to muss his hair, so the lining is quilted satin. The picture was shelved; the helmet was not.
tailored_football_helmet.icon: Rounded leather football helmet with padded ridges and ear flaps, cream leather with thin gold piping, quilted ivory satin lining visible at the rim.

heavy_football_helmet.name: Heavy Football Helmet
heavy_football_helmet.description: Riveted over with steel ribs in a Universal prop shop, which means the rivets are real and the steel is mostly real. It has stopped a mandible, and that review is the only one that matters.
heavy_football_helmet.icon: Bulky rounded leather football helmet, dark brown leather crossed by riveted grey steel ribs over the crown, thick ear flaps, heavy buckled chin strap.

worn_pocketknife.name: Worn Pocketknife
worn_pocketknife.description: Found in the gutter outside a Cahuenga Boulevard pawnshop, which says most of what the pawnbroker thought of it. The blade still folds, mostly.
worn_pocketknife.icon: Small folding pocketknife, blade half open, dull nicked steel, cracked brown bone handle scales, tarnished brass bolsters, a chip missing from the tip.

pocketknife_of_agility.name: Pocketknife of Agility
pocketknife_of_agility.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch extra who could whittle a clothes-peg between takes and still beat the assistant director to the lunch wagon.
pocketknife_of_agility.icon: Slim folding pocketknife with blade open, bright polished steel, pale yellow celluloid handle with a small feather-shaped silver inlay.

pocketknife_of_stamina.name: Pocketknife of Stamina
pocketknife_of_stamina.description: Its owner sat out three days on a stalled Pacific Electric car with nothing but this, a wedge of cheese and patience. Two of those ran out.
pocketknife_of_stamina.icon: Stout two-blade pocketknife, main blade open, thick mottled stag-horn handle, steel bail ring with a short loop of red cord.

pocketknife_of_the_acrobat.name: Pocketknife of the Acrobat
pocketknife_of_the_acrobat.description: Carried by a high-wire girl from a stranded circus troupe, tucked in her stocking where the ringmaster could not find it. She trusted it more than the net.
pocketknife_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slender pocketknife, blade open, shimmering mother-of-pearl handle, a narrow blue silk ribbon tied through the steel bail.

pocketknife_of_the_marksman.name: Pocketknife of the Marksman
pocketknife_of_the_marksman.description: A Legion rifleman used it to scrape fouling from his Springfield and notch a tally into the stock. He stopped notching when the insects got too numerous to count.
pocketknife_of_the_marksman.icon: Pocketknife with gunmetal-blue blade open, black hard-rubber handle, a small cross-hair notch filed into the steel bolster.

pocketknife_of_the_stevedore.name: Pocketknife of the Stevedore
pocketknife_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks in a longshoreman's back pocket, good for cutting twine, prising crates and settling disputes over whose crate it was.
pocketknife_of_the_stevedore.icon: Heavy pocketknife with a wide hooked hawkbill blade open, scuffed walnut handle, short tarred rope lanyard knotted through the bail.

patched_pocketknife.name: Patched Pocketknife
patched_pocketknife.description: Someone wound friction tape round the cracked handle and called it mended. The tape is holding up better than the rest.
patched_pocketknife.icon: Pocketknife with blade open, black friction tape wrapped around the split handle, dull grey steel blade with rust spots.

plain_pocketknife.name: Plain Pocketknife
plain_pocketknife.description: Sold by the gross at a Boulevard drugstore, between the shoelaces and the aspirin. Nobody remembers buying one; everybody owns one.
plain_pocketknife.icon: Simple clean pocketknife, blade open, smooth brown wooden handle, polished steel blade, plain brass bolsters.

worn_taped_knuckles.name: Worn Taped Knuckles
worn_taped_knuckles.description: Grimy boxing tape, still shaped round somebody else's fist. Smells of liniment and losing.
worn_taped_knuckles.icon: Hollow coiled knuckle wrap of grubby off-white cotton tape holding a fist shape, frayed loose ends, faint brown stains.

taped_knuckles_of_agility.name: Taped Knuckles of Agility
taped_knuckles_of_agility.description: Wrapped by a flyweight from the Legion Stadium undercard who won on points by never being where the other fellow swung.
taped_knuckles_of_agility.icon: Neat hollow knuckle wrap of white tape with a thin green stripe, small brass studs set across the knuckle line.

taped_knuckles_of_stamina.name: Taped Knuckles of Stamina
taped_knuckles_of_stamina.description: Worn by a sparring partner who took punches for a living at two dollars a session. He never won a round and never once went down.
taped_knuckles_of_stamina.icon: Thick layered knuckle wrap of grey tape over padding, a wide band of red tape around the wrist cuff.

taped_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.name: Taped Knuckles of the Acrobat
taped_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.description: Christie lot stuntmen taped these for a saloon brawl, then went out a second-storey window in the same take. Retakes cost money.
taped_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.icon: Knuckle wrap of tan tape in a crisscross pattern, small blue star patch stitched on the back, loose tail of tape.

taped_knuckles_of_the_marksman.name: Taped Knuckles of the Marksman
taped_knuckles_of_the_marksman.description: Their last owner rode shotgun on a bootleg truck and preferred to settle matters at forty yards. These were for when the matter came closer.
taped_knuckles_of_the_marksman.icon: Knuckle wrap of black tape, a slim steel plate over the knuckles with a filed cross-hair notch at its centre.

taped_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.name: Taped Knuckles of the Stevedore
taped_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.description: Dockside tape, tarred against salt spray. A San Pedro gang boss wore them to the hiring hall, where nobody argued with his choice of men.
taped_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.icon: Knuckle wrap of dark tarred tape bound with hemp twine, a heavy iron ring sewn across the knuckles.

patched_taped_knuckles.name: Patched Taped Knuckles
patched_taped_knuckles.description: Layers of new tape over old, like a studio script after the fifth rewrite.
patched_taped_knuckles.icon: Lumpy knuckle wrap of mismatched patches of grey, white and black tape, frayed edges, one loose strip hanging.

plain_taped_knuckles.name: Plain Taped Knuckles
plain_taped_knuckles.description: Clean tape, nothing hidden underneath. The Legion referee checks for horseshoes either way.
plain_taped_knuckles.icon: Tidy hollow knuckle wrap of clean white cotton tape, crisp even layers, neatly tucked end.

sturdy_taped_knuckles.name: Sturdy Taped Knuckles
sturdy_taped_knuckles.description: Double-wound over a strip of harness leather from the Gower Gulch saddlery. Good for doors, jaws and anything with too many legs.
sturdy_taped_knuckles.icon: Thick knuckle wrap of heavy cream tape over a strip of brown harness leather, visible stitched seams at the edges.

good_taped_knuckles.name: Good Taped Knuckles
good_taped_knuckles.description: Taped by a trainer who once worked corners at the Olympic Auditorium and still talks about it to anyone holding still. His wraps never slip.
good_taped_knuckles.icon: Firm knuckle wrap of bright white tape, a row of brass rivets across the knuckles, neat red stitching at the cuff.

fine_carbide_lamp.name: Fine Carbide Lamp
fine_carbide_lamp.description: Polished brass, a clean reflector and a water valve that drips when told to. Dam crews at Mulholland swear by them for the tunnels under the spillway.
fine_carbide_lamp.icon: Brass miner's carbide lamp, two stacked cylindrical chambers, round silver reflector dish at the front around a small burner tip, wire hook handle, clean polished brass with a crisp shine.

carbide_lamp_of_intellect.name: Carbide Lamp of Intellect
carbide_lamp_of_intellect.description: Its last owner read blueprints by this flame during the blackouts on the Paramount lot and could recite the wiring for a whole sound stage from memory. The light holds steady enough for fine print.
carbide_lamp_of_intellect.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp with round silver reflector, a deep blue enamel band around the lower chamber, a short pencil clipped to the wire hook.

carbide_lamp_of_spirit.name: Carbide Lamp of Spirit
carbide_lamp_of_spirit.description: Carried by a Krotona night watchman who walked the Beachwood terraces each evening and claimed the hiss of the flame kept his thoughts unhurried. He slept soundly, which in 1930 counts as a talent.
carbide_lamp_of_spirit.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp with round silver reflector, a pale lavender silk ribbon tied in a loose bow around the wire hook handle, soft warm flame at the burner.

carbide_lamp_of_the_engineer.name: Carbide Lamp of the Engineer
carbide_lamp_of_the_engineer.description: Scratched into the base is a tally of every Mulholland Dam valve its owner checked after the invaders came through. The count stops at forty-one. The lamp kept going without him.
carbide_lamp_of_the_engineer.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp, oil-smudged body with scratch marks on the base, round silver reflector, a small steel wrench charm hanging from the wire hook.

carbide_lamp_of_the_doctor.name: Carbide Lamp of the Doctor
carbide_lamp_of_the_doctor.description: Clipped beside the burner is a dental mirror, left by an aid-station doctor who stitched by acetylene whenever the city power failed. He said the light was honest, if not flattering.
carbide_lamp_of_the_doctor.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp with round silver reflector, a white enamel disc with a red cross on the lower chamber, small round dental mirror clipped beside the burner.

carbide_lamp_of_the_deacon.name: Carbide Lamp of the Deacon
carbide_lamp_of_the_deacon.description: Smells of hymnals and wet carbide. A deacon carried it ahead of the Thursday prayer walk to Angelus Temple, and the faithful followed the garlic reek of acetylene as much as the glow.
carbide_lamp_of_the_deacon.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp with round silver reflector, a long white hymnal ribbon tied to the wire hook, dark navy cord wrapped around the handle.

pressed_carbide_lamp.name: Pressed Carbide Lamp
pressed_carbide_lamp.description: Someone in a studio prop department buffed this to a camera-ready gleam for a mining picture that never left the stage. It has never seen a real mine and would prefer to keep it that way.
pressed_carbide_lamp.icon: Gleaming mirror-bright brass two-chamber carbide lamp, spotless polished reflector dish, neat burner tip, straight unbent wire hook, flawless finish with no scratches.

tailored_carbide_lamp.name: Tailored Carbide Lamp
tailored_carbide_lamp.description: Fitted with a felt-lined leather sleeve stitched by a Gower Gulch saddler, so the brass never knocks against a good coat. Wardrobe insists it is an accessory.
tailored_carbide_lamp.icon: Brass two-chamber carbide lamp in a fitted tan leather sleeve with fine brown stitching and a small buckle strap, polished silver reflector dish, brass hook handle.

heavy_carbide_lamp.name: Heavy Carbide Lamp
heavy_carbide_lamp.description: Steel-banded and thick in the walls, built for the shafts on the Cahuenga side where a dropped lamp falls a long way. The reflector bears a dent shaped exactly like a spitter's jaw.
heavy_carbide_lamp.icon: Squat heavy carbide lamp, dark gunmetal steel body with thick riveted bands and brass fittings, wide dented silver reflector, short heavy chain looped through the handle.

reinforced_chitin_plated_cuirass.name: Reinforced Chitin-plated Cuirass
reinforced_chitin_plated_cuirass.description: Burbank machinists riveted strap iron across the shell plates after the first batch split along the seams. Heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.
reinforced_chitin_plated_cuirass.icon: Sleeveless breastplate of overlapping green-black chitin plates crossed by grey riveted strap-iron bands, worn brown leather side buckles, dull iridescent sheen on the shell.

chitin_plated_cuirass_of_strength.name: Chitin-plated Cuirass of Strength
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_strength.description: Taken off a Legion man at the Lockheed plant who could lift a crated propeller without help. The plates are dented inward in two places, and he walked away from both.
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_strength.icon: Chitin-plated steel cuirass, glossy green-black shell plates on a gunmetal frame, a bold red enamel stripe across the chest, brass rivets along the shoulders.

chitin_plated_cuirass_of_stamina.name: Chitin-plated Cuirass of Stamina
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_stamina.description: Its first owner wore it through a three-day siege of Burbank town centre, slept in it, and refused to take it off for the doctor. The lining still smells of coffee and Lysol.
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_stamina.icon: Bulky chitin-plated cuirass with thick grey wool padding bulging at the armholes and collar, green-black plates, a small tin canteen cap hung on a chain at the side.

chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_boxer.name: Chitin-plated Cuirass of the Boxer
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_boxer.description: A Legion Stadium trainer laced it together from salvaged shell and the canvas of a burst heavy bag. On Friday nights he still offers to tape the wearer's knuckles, out of habit.
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_boxer.icon: Chitin-plated cuirass edged with faded red canvas trim and white lacing at the sides, green-black shell plates, a small brass boxing glove pin on the left breast.

chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_stevedore.name: Chitin-plated Cuirass of the Stevedore
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_stevedore.description: Belonged to a San Pedro longshoreman who came up to Studio City for a funeral and stayed for the Dome. He fitted cargo-hook loops under both arms, and nobody has worked out why.
chitin_plated_cuirass_of_the_stevedore.icon: Chitin-plated cuirass with tarred rope lashing along its edges, a steel cargo hook dangling from a side loop, green-black plates with a slate-blue cloth collar.

superior_chitin_plated_cuirass.name: Superior Chitin-plated Cuirass
superior_chitin_plated_cuirass.description: Fitted in a First National machine shop by a wardrobe man who once built armour for costume pictures. This time the dents are real, and nobody is paying for retakes.
superior_chitin_plated_cuirass.icon: Polished gunmetal steel cuirass with neatly bevelled, tightly fitted chitin plates in glossy iridescent green-black, gilt rivets, clean black leather straps.

chitin_lined_chitin_plated_cuirass.name: Chitin-lined Chitin-plated Cuirass
chitin_lined_chitin_plated_cuirass.description: Shell outside, shell inside. The armourers at the forward camp ran out of horsehair padding and concluded the invaders had already solved the problem.
chitin_lined_chitin_plated_cuirass.icon: Thick cuirass of overlapping green-black plates, the inner lining also visible as smooth iridescent carapace with an amber tinge, a raised steel ridge down the spine.

chitin_plated_chitin_plated_cuirass.name: Chitin-plated Chitin-plated Cuirass
chitin_plated_chitin_plated_cuirass.description: Plated twice over, as the requisition clerk insisted on writing it. Little of the original steel remains, and the men camped below the sign have begun to wonder whose armour this is now.
chitin_plated_chitin_plated_cuirass.icon: Cuirass almost wholly of layered insect carapace, doubled green-black plates with a violet sheen, faint glowing amber hive resin in the seams, scraps of steel only at the buckles.

worn_cotton_gloves.name: Worn Cotton Gloves
worn_cotton_gloves.description: Somebody wore these through a whole season of handing out programmes at the Egyptian. The fingertips went first. Nobody has said what became of the somebody.
