worn_cotton_gloves.icon: A pair of thin white cotton gloves gone grey with grime, fingertips worn through, one cuff frayed and limp, laid loosely one atop the other.

cotton_gloves_of_intellect.name: Cotton Gloves of Intellect
cotton_gloves_of_intellect.description: Issued to a script girl at Columbia who caught every continuity error on the lot, including two in her own contract. She left them on a Gower Street lunch counter and never came back for them.
cotton_gloves_of_intellect.icon: White cotton gloves with a blue ink stain on the index fingertip, fine blue stitching along the cuff, and a tiny silver paper clip fastened at one wrist.

cotton_gloves_of_spirit.name: Cotton Gloves of Spirit
cotton_gloves_of_spirit.description: Thin cotton that smells faintly of Echo Park Lake at dawn. The last owner fed the ducks every morning, Dome or no Dome, and claimed it was the only thing keeping him sane.
cotton_gloves_of_spirit.icon: Pale cream cotton gloves with soft green stitching at the cuffs and a small pressed white flower tucked into one wrist.

cotton_gloves_of_stamina.name: Cotton Gloves of Stamina
cotton_gloves_of_stamina.description: A Pacific Electric conductor wore these through double shifts on the Hollywood line, taking nickels from people with nowhere left to ride. They held up longer than the timetable did.
cotton_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy off-white cotton gloves with thick red-stitched cuffs, a small brass button at each wrist, palms lightly greyed from use.

cotton_gloves_of_the_engineer.name: Cotton Gloves of the Engineer
cotton_gloves_of_the_engineer.description: Pulled off a studio electrician at the Christie lot who was rewiring a stage when the hive came through the wall. He finished the job first. The scorch marks on the thumbs suggest he finished it in a hurry.
cotton_gloves_of_the_engineer.icon: White cotton gloves with scorched brown fingertips, a black rubberised patch on each palm, and a small brass wrench charm hanging from one cuff.

cotton_gloves_of_the_doctor.name: Cotton Gloves of the Doctor
cotton_gloves_of_the_doctor.description: Folded into the bottom of a nurse's bag at the Hollywood aid station, smelling of carbolic and cold coffee. She swears by them for stitching, and at them for everything else.
cotton_gloves_of_the_doctor.icon: Crisp white cotton gloves with a small red cross stitched at the cuff and a faint orange iodine stain on one fingertip.

cotton_gloves_of_the_deacon.name: Cotton Gloves of the Deacon
cotton_gloves_of_the_deacon.description: These went to every Sunday service at Angelus Temple for six years and passed the collection plate down a great many rows. The palms shine where the brass rested.
cotton_gloves_of_the_deacon.icon: White cotton gloves with a narrow purple hymnal ribbon tied at the wrist, glossy worn palms, and a small gold cross button.

patched_cotton_gloves.name: Patched Cotton Gloves
patched_cotton_gloves.description: Mended with thread from three different spools, none of them white. Wardrobe would call it a costume choice.
patched_cotton_gloves.icon: Grubby white cotton gloves patched on palm and knuckles with mismatched blue and brown thread, one thumb heavily darned.

plain_cotton_gloves.name: Plain Cotton Gloves
plain_cotton_gloves.description: Ordinary white gloves of the sort every usher and doorman on the Boulevard owns two pairs of. Nobody looks twice at them, which is half the point.
plain_cotton_gloves.icon: Clean plain white cotton gloves with simple seams and a small pearl button at each wrist, neatly paired.

sturdy_cotton_gloves.name: Sturdy Cotton Gloves
sturdy_cotton_gloves.description: Double-stitched heavy cotton from a studio grip department, made for men who haul cable all day and expect the cable to give up first.
sturdy_cotton_gloves.icon: Thick off-white cotton gloves with heavy double-stitched seams, reinforced tan palm patches and snug ribbed knit cuffs.

good_cotton_gloves.name: Good Cotton Gloves
good_cotton_gloves.description: Fit for the Brown Derby, provided the maître d' squints a little at the knuckles, where the invader dust never quite brushes out.
good_cotton_gloves.icon: Crisp bright white cotton gloves with neat pintuck lines on the back, mother-of-pearl wrist buttons and a faint greenish dust across the knuckles.

worn_leather_gloves.name: Worn Leather Gloves
worn_leather_gloves.description: Cracked brown leather that has been rained on, sat on and, judging by the left one, chewed by a dog with opinions.
worn_leather_gloves.icon: Scuffed dull brown leather work gloves cracked across the knuckles, one with a ragged bite-torn cuff, stiff and curled at the fingers.

leather_gloves_of_agility.name: Leather Gloves of Agility
leather_gloves_of_agility.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch trick rider who could have his rope off the saddle horn before the director finished shouting. Then the pictures started talking and wanted fewer horses. The gloves stayed behind.
leather_gloves_of_agility.icon: Supple tan riding gloves with fringed gauntlet cuffs, a looped rope pattern stitched on the back and small silver conchos at the wrist.

leather_gloves_of_stamina.name: Leather Gloves of Stamina
leather_gloves_of_stamina.description: Lineman's leather, oiled until it stopped caring about the weather. A Bureau of Power and Light crew wore them up poles along Sunset long after anyone stopped sending their pay.
leather_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown leather lineman's gloves with deep gauntlet cuffs, an oiled sheen and double rows of green stitching.

leather_gloves_of_spirit.name: Leather Gloves of Spirit
leather_gloves_of_spirit.description: Soft kid leather that once belonged to a choir soloist at a Hollywood Methodist church. She sang straight through a hive surge without missing a note, and has been humming ever since.
leather_gloves_of_spirit.icon: Soft dove-grey kid leather gloves with a small white daisy embroidered at the wrist and slim pale blue piping.

leather_gloves_of_the_acrobat.name: Leather Gloves of the Acrobat
leather_gloves_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntman's gloves with the fingertips cut away for grip. The man who wore them fell off the Pantages roof eleven times for one picture and was paid for four.
leather_gloves_of_the_acrobat.icon: Black leather fingerless gloves with padded palms, a small red harlequin diamond patch on the back and a worn snap strap at the wrist.

leather_gloves_of_the_stevedore.name: Leather Gloves of the Stevedore
leather_gloves_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where a man in these could swing a cargo hook and a bad temper with equal ease. They came up to Hollywood in a crate of bananas, which is how most things from San Pedro arrive.
leather_gloves_of_the_stevedore.icon: Rugged tan leather docker's gloves with scarred palms, salt-stained cuffs and a small iron cargo hook charm tied on with rawhide.

leather_gloves_of_the_deacon.name: Leather Gloves of the Deacon
leather_gloves_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday they made the long walk from Hollywood to Angelus Temple and back, a hymnal tucked under one arm. They smell of saddle soap and old pages.
leather_gloves_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark chestnut leather gloves with a burgundy hymnal ribbon looped at the cuff, a small brass cross snap and soft creased palms.

patched_leather_gloves.name: Patched Leather Gloves
patched_leather_gloves.description: The left glove has been patched, more or less, with a scrap of old saddle. The right one is still waiting its turn.
patched_leather_gloves.icon: Brown leather gloves with mismatched darker leather patches sewn on in coarse twine, frayed cuffs and scuffed knuckles.

plain_leather_gloves.name: Plain Leather Gloves
plain_leather_gloves.description: Sold from a barrel by the door of a hardware store on Cahuenga, two pairs for a dollar before the Dome. Prices have since gone the way of the view.
plain_leather_gloves.icon: Plain medium-brown leather work gloves with simple seams and short cuffs, slightly stiff and new.

sturdy_leather_gloves.name: Sturdy Leather Gloves
sturdy_leather_gloves.description: Thick saddle leather cut and sewn at the Gower Gulch saddlery, where the cowboys hold that a good glove should outlast the horse. It usually does.
sturdy_leather_gloves.icon: Thick russet saddle-leather gloves with heavy white whipstitching along the seams, a riveted thumb joint and broad flared cuffs.

good_leather_gloves.name: Good Leather Gloves
good_leather_gloves.description: Polished enough to shake hands with a studio head, tough enough to grip a nightstick afterwards. Most men in Hollywood find they need both.
good_leather_gloves.icon: Glossy dark oxblood leather gloves with tight neat stitching, snap wrist straps set with brass studs and smooth unscuffed knuckles.

fine_french_cuffs.name: Fine French Cuffs
fine_french_cuffs.description: Folded back and fastened with plain links, the way a junior assistant director wears them on his first day with an office of his own.
fine_french_cuffs.icon: A pair of white linen French cuffs folded double, crisp starched edges, faint blue pinstripe, fastened with plain round silver cufflinks.

french_cuffs_of_intellect.name: French Cuffs of Intellect
french_cuffs_of_intellect.description: Taken from a Universal script reader who kept notes in pencil on the inside of each cuff. The notes are still there, and most of them say no.
french_cuffs_of_intellect.icon: A pair of pale grey linen French cuffs with faint pencil smudges inside the fold, black onyx cufflinks each bearing a tiny gold fountain-pen charm.

french_cuffs_of_spirit.name: French Cuffs of Spirit
french_cuffs_of_spirit.description: Laundered so often at a Cahuenga Avenue laundry that the linen has gone soft as an old prayer. Their last owner slept soundly every night, which under the Dome counts as a talent.
french_cuffs_of_spirit.icon: A pair of soft ivory French cuffs, slightly rumpled and well washed, fastened with pale blue mother-of-pearl cufflinks that shimmer softly.

french_cuffs_of_stamina.name: French Cuffs of Stamina
french_cuffs_of_stamina.description: Double-thickness linen, starched hard enough to turn a letter opener. A Hollywood Bowl stage manager wore them through three hive surges and one complete rehearsal of Aida.
french_cuffs_of_stamina.icon: A pair of thick heavy-starched white French cuffs with stiff squared edges, fastened with chunky deep red enamel cufflinks.

french_cuffs_of_the_engineer.name: French Cuffs of the Engineer
french_cuffs_of_the_engineer.description: Rolled up more often than worn down. Their owner kept the arc lamps burning on the Universal backlot and never once let a cuff near a live terminal, which is why there are still two of them.
french_cuffs_of_the_engineer.icon: A pair of white French cuffs with a dark grease smudge on one fold, fastened with brass cufflinks shaped like tiny wrenches.

french_cuffs_of_the_doctor.name: French Cuffs of the Doctor
french_cuffs_of_the_doctor.description: A surgeon at the Hollywood Receiving Hospital buttoned these on before rounds and off before scrubbing. A faint smell of iodine survives every wash.
french_cuffs_of_the_doctor.icon: A pair of bright white French cuffs with a small faded brown iodine stain, fastened with green enamel cufflinks bearing a tiny silver caduceus.

french_cuffs_of_the_deacon.name: French Cuffs of the Deacon
french_cuffs_of_the_deacon.description: Sunday best for an usher at Angelus Temple, worn on the long walk up from the red-car stop. Sister Aimee is said to have admired the links once, in passing, between sermons.
french_cuffs_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of white French cuffs tied with a thin purple hymnal ribbon, fastened with plain gold cufflinks shaped like small crosses.

pressed_french_cuffs.name: Pressed French Cuffs
pressed_french_cuffs.description: Sharp enough at the fold to cut a contract, which is more or less what the Paramount legal department uses them for.
pressed_french_cuffs.icon: A pair of gleaming white French cuffs with razor-sharp pressed creases, fastened with polished gold oval cufflinks.

tailored_french_cuffs.name: Tailored French Cuffs
tailored_french_cuffs.description: Cut to measure for a fellow who meant to be seen at the Brown Derby. The booth he reserved is still waiting for him.
tailored_french_cuffs.icon: A pair of fine ivory French cuffs with a small embroidered blank monogram shield in silver thread, fastened with mother-of-pearl links set in gold.

heavy_french_cuffs.name: Heavy French Cuffs
heavy_french_cuffs.description: Sewn from canvas-backed broadcloth by a wardrobe mistress who had stopped believing in fashion and started believing in mandibles.
heavy_french_cuffs.icon: A pair of thick off-white French cuffs with doubled grey stitching and a reinforced canvas lining, fastened with heavy blackened steel cufflinks.

wedding_band_of_strength.name: Wedding Band of Strength
wedding_band_of_strength.description: Pried off a knuckle the size of a walnut, it belonged to a blacksmith on the Universal backlot who shod horses for Westerns. His widow traded it for a sack of flour and said he would have approved of the bargain.
wedding_band_of_strength.icon: Thick yellow-gold ring, straight on, squashed slightly oval from hard use, deep scratches across the face, one turn of dark iron horseshoe nail wrapped around the band.

wedding_band_of_agility.name: Wedding Band of Agility
wedding_band_of_agility.description: Slipped off its owner's finger halfway up a Burbank water tower, which happens to a man who climbs faster than the hive can follow. He kept climbing. The ring kept falling.
wedding_band_of_agility.icon: Slim rose-gold ring, straight on, smooth and narrow with a fine engraved wave pattern and a tiny inlaid green enamel feather on top.

wedding_band_of_stamina.name: Wedding Band of Stamina
wedding_band_of_stamina.description: Forty-one years of marriage in Studio City, through the 1914 flood, the Depression and now the Dome. The inside is worn nearly through where the engraving used to be, and still it has not cracked.
wedding_band_of_stamina.icon: Very wide heavy dull-gold ring, straight on, polished smooth with age, a faint wear groove around the middle, thin copper-red lining showing at the edge.

wedding_band_of_intellect.name: Wedding Band of Intellect
wedding_band_of_intellect.description: A Lockheed draughtsman designed this himself and had it cast to the thousandth of an inch. His bride complained it pinched. He produced the calculations.
wedding_band_of_intellect.icon: Precise white-gold ring, straight on, crisp bevelled edges, fine engraved grid lines like drafting paper, a small inset sapphire chip.

wedding_band_of_spirit.name: Wedding Band of Spirit
wedding_band_of_spirit.description: Found on the floor of the set chapel on Universal's European street, where a plaster church briefly became a real one. Nobody claimed it, and the extras who prayed there swear it sits warmer than it ought to.
wedding_band_of_spirit.icon: Thin pale-gold ring, straight on, a tiny engraved dove on the face, a small pearl set flush, a faint pale-blue enamel line circling the rim.

wedding_band_of_the_boxer.name: Wedding Band of the Boxer
wedding_band_of_the_boxer.description: The bride made him take it off before every bout at the Legion Stadium, and he made her hold it ringside. Twelve years of Friday nights, no knockouts, one marriage.
wedding_band_of_the_boxer.icon: Chunky brass-toned gold ring, straight on, flattened face with dents along one side, a small red enamel boxing glove pin soldered on top.

wedding_band_of_the_acrobat.name: Wedding Band of the Acrobat
wedding_band_of_the_acrobat.description: Carnival people married under canvas in 1922, and this went up the trapeze rigging tied to a ribbon so the groom could hand it over mid-swing. It has been dropped since. Never by him.
wedding_band_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slender gold ring twisted like rope, straight on, a thin red-and-white striped silk ribbon tied through it, a tiny gold star charm.

wedding_band_of_the_stevedore.name: Wedding Band of the Stevedore
wedding_band_of_the_stevedore.description: Came over the side at San Pedro in a bale of Philippine hemp, or so the longshoreman who wore it liked to say. He married the customs clerk who failed to ask questions.
wedding_band_of_the_stevedore.icon: Thick tarnished-gold ring, straight on, wrapped with a few turns of tan hemp twine, a small brass cargo hook charm, salt-white crust in the grooves.

wedding_band_of_the_marksman.name: Wedding Band of the Marksman
wedding_band_of_the_marksman.description: Engraved inside with two dates eleven years apart: the wedding, and the night a Hardened Spitter took her husband off the Cahuenga Pass road. She has not missed a shot since.
wedding_band_of_the_marksman.icon: Narrow silver-gold ring, straight on, a single small notch filed in the top like a rifle sight, a tiny black onyx inset, faint engraved crosshair lines.

wedding_band_of_the_engineer.name: Wedding Band of the Engineer
wedding_band_of_the_engineer.description: Melted down from a brass generator fitting by a Stage 28 electrician who could not afford gold but could wire anything. The marriage held. So did the fitting.
wedding_band_of_the_engineer.icon: Blocky brass ring with machined flat facets, straight on, two hex-bolt studs on the face, a tiny copper wrench charm hanging from a split ring.

wedding_band_of_the_doctor.name: Wedding Band of the Doctor
wedding_band_of_the_doctor.description: Ward rules forbade jewellery, so the Burbank aid-station nurse wore it on a string under her cap. Spitter burns make for long nights, and she wanted it near.
wedding_band_of_the_doctor.icon: Simple white-gold ring strung on a thin white cotton thread, straight on, a tiny red enamel cross charm, a faint iodine-brown stain on one edge.

wedding_band_of_the_deacon.name: Wedding Band of the Deacon
wedding_band_of_the_deacon.description: Married at Angelus Temple in 1927 with Sister Aimee's blessing, the couple walked home to Studio City afterward out of piety and poverty in equal measure. The ring still smells faintly of hymnals and shoe leather.
wedding_band_of_the_deacon.icon: Modest yellow-gold ring, straight on, slightly scuffed, a small engraved cross on the face, a narrow purple hymnal ribbon tied through the band.

good_wool_sack_suit_coat.name: Good Wool Sack Suit Coat
good_wool_sack_suit_coat.description: Off the rack at a Boulevard haberdasher: two buttons, no darts, and room in the shoulders for a revolver or a sandwich. Nobody looks twice at it, which these days is a kind of armour.
good_wool_sack_suit_coat.icon: Loose single-breasted sack suit coat in medium grey wool, straight unfitted cut, notch lapels, two plain brown horn buttons, clean but ordinary, no pocket square.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_intellect.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of Intellect
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_intellect.description: Bought for a scenario writer at Chaplin's who rewrote the same gag forty times. The inside pocket still holds a pencil stub and the shape of a contract he read twice before signing.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_intellect.icon: Charcoal-blue wool sack suit coat, loose cut, a yellow pencil stub and brass pen clip poking from the breast pocket, small ink blot on the cream lining.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_spirit.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of Spirit
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_spirit.description: Smells faintly of orange blossom and pipe smoke, from a man who sat on his porch in Beachwood Canyon every evening and refused to let the Dome spoil the view. The elbows are worn shiny from the railing.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_spirit.icon: Oatmeal-brown wool sack suit coat, soft rounded shoulders, a small white orange-blossom sprig in the lapel buttonhole, elbows worn slightly shiny.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_stamina.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of Stamina
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_stamina.description: Cut a size large for a Pacific Electric conductor who worked double shifts through the first week of the invasion and never once sat down. The lining has been resewn twice, with thread that does not match.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_stamina.icon: Heavy dark olive-brown wool sack suit coat, broad boxy cut, seams visibly reinforced with mismatched red thread, dull brass buttons.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_engineer.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of the Engineer
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_engineer.description: A sound man wore it on the Warner Bros. stages with a spool of copper wire in each pocket. The cuffs are singed where a microphone boom met a live cable, and he said only that it was his own fault.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_engineer.icon: Slate-grey wool sack suit coat, scorched dark cuffs, coil of copper wire peeking from a side pocket, tiny brass wrench charm pinned to the lapel.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_doctor.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of the Doctor
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_doctor.description: Belonged to a Vine Street physician who made house calls by red car and took eggs when cash ran short. The orange stain on the left cuff is iodine; he called it his diploma.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_doctor.icon: Navy wool sack suit coat, orange iodine stain on one cuff, small red-cross enamel pin on the lapel, rubber stethoscope tube looped from the breast pocket.

wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_deacon.name: Wool Sack Suit Coat of the Deacon
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_deacon.description: Worn every Sunday on the long walk from Edendale to Angelus Temple, it smells of hymnals and Echo Park lake damp. Sister Aimee's ushers can spot one across the sanctuary and usually find it a better seat.
wool_sack_suit_coat_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain black wool sack suit coat, sun-faded shoulders, a narrow purple hymnal ribbon threaded through the lapel buttonhole, simple dark buttons.

fine_wool_sack_suit_coat.name: Fine Wool Sack Suit Coat
fine_wool_sack_suit_coat.description: Somebody's best coat, kept under tissue paper for weddings and court dates. Under the Dome there are fewer of both, so it goes out to fight instead.
fine_wool_sack_suit_coat.icon: Crisp dove-grey wool sack suit coat, sharp clean lapels, polished horn buttons, neatly folded white pocket square, fabric smooth and unworn.

pressed_wool_sack_suit_coat.name: Pressed Wool Sack Suit Coat
pressed_wool_sack_suit_coat.description: The crease down each sleeve could cut a contract. Studio publicity men favour the look, on the theory that nobody shoots a well-dressed man before the second reel.
pressed_wool_sack_suit_coat.icon: Sleek charcoal pinstripe wool sack suit coat, knife-edge pressed sleeves, silk-faced lapels with a slight sheen, three-point ivory pocket square.

tailored_family_bible.name: Tailored Family Bible
tailored_family_bible.description: Rebound by a studio wardrobe man in fitted calfskin, because the original cover did not photograph well. The births and marriages inside were left exactly as they were.
tailored_family_bible.icon: Thick bible in a snug tan calfskin cover with neat white stitching, crisp gilt page edges, a red satin ribbon marker trailing from the bottom.

family_bible_of_intellect.name: Family Bible of Intellect
family_bible_of_intellect.description: The margins are crowded with pencilled cross-references in a schoolteacher's hand, Leviticus argued against Luke. Whoever owned it read the whole thing twice and the concordance three times.
family_bible_of_intellect.icon: Thick black leather bible with gilt edges, many small paper slips with pencil marks poking from the pages, a stub of pencil tucked in the spine, blue ribbon marker.

family_bible_of_spirit.name: Family Bible of Spirit
family_bible_of_spirit.description: Pressed between the pages are a dried orange blossom from a 1903 wedding and a lock of baby hair folded in wax paper. It is calmer to hold than it has any right to be.
family_bible_of_spirit.icon: Worn brown leather bible, soft rounded corners, a pressed white orange blossom peeking from the pages, a pale gold ribbon marker.

family_bible_of_the_engineer.name: Family Bible of the Engineer
family_bible_of_the_engineer.description: A Lockheed riveter carried it in his lunch pail for eleven years. The cover is dented where a falling bucking bar found it instead of him, which he took as a plain answer to prayer.
family_bible_of_the_engineer.icon: Black bible with a deep dent in the front cover, small steel corner caps, a tiny brass wrench charm hanging from a grey ribbon marker.

family_bible_of_the_doctor.name: Family Bible of the Doctor
family_bible_of_the_doctor.description: Kept in the waiting room of a Vermont Avenue physician, who wrote dosages on the flyleaf whenever his prescription pad ran out. Half his patients came for the doctor and half for Ecclesiastes.
family_bible_of_the_doctor.icon: Dark green cloth-bound bible with gilt page edges, a small red-cross enamel pin set on the cover, a white ribbon marker.

family_bible_of_the_deacon.name: Family Bible of the Deacon
family_bible_of_the_deacon.description: Carried on foot from Edendale to Angelus Temple every Sunday for nine years, and it smells of hymnals and wet wool. Sister Aimee is said to have signed the flyleaf; the deacon never let anyone check.
family_bible_of_the_deacon.icon: Thick black bible with scuffed corners, a purple hymnal ribbon tied around it in a bow, a small brass cross fixed to the cover.

heavy_family_bible.name: Heavy Family Bible
heavy_family_bible.description: Weighs about as much as a sack of flour and holds eight generations of names. More than one looter has been converted by it on the spot, briefly and with a headache.
heavy_family_bible.icon: Massive oversized bible in thick oxblood leather, raised bands across the spine, a heavy brass clasp, dull gilt page edges.

reinforced_family_bible.name: Reinforced Family Bible
reinforced_family_bible.description: Somebody bolted steel corners to it and riveted a strap across the front. The family record now carries one new line in a shaky hand: stopped a drone, Cahuenga Pass.
reinforced_family_bible.icon: Black bible with riveted steel corner plates, a leather strap and iron buckle across the cover, worn gilt page edges.

superior_family_bible.name: Superior Family Bible
superior_family_bible.description: Printed in Philadelphia in 1871 and carried west by a family that later settled in Los Feliz, with an engraved plate for every chapter of Exodus. The plague of locusts reads differently these days.
superior_family_bible.icon: Grand maroon morocco leather bible with an ornate tooled gilt border, brass corner bosses and twin brass clasps, gleaming gilt page edges.

chitin_lined_family_bible.name: Chitin-lined Family Bible
chitin_lined_family_bible.description: Lined inside the boards with a curl of drone shell, thin as a fingernail and harder than oak. The pages still turn easily. Nobody likes the sound the cover makes when knocked.
chitin_lined_family_bible.icon: Black leather bible whose cover edges reveal an iridescent green-black insect shell lining, gilt page edges, a plain brass clasp.

chitin_plated_family_bible.name: Chitin-plated Family Bible
chitin_plated_family_bible.description: Plated front and back in soldier chitin, the family record copied onto fresh paper because the old pages smelled of the hive. The last entry lists three names taken to Burbank, with no date beside them.
chitin_plated_family_bible.icon: Thick bible armoured in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates fixed with brass rivets, gilt page edges, a dark crimson ribbon marker trailing.

worn_canvas_plimsolls.name: Worn Canvas Plimsolls
worn_canvas_plimsolls.description: Rubber worn thin at the heel and a toe poking through. Somebody walked a long way in these before the Dome came down.
worn_canvas_plimsolls.icon: A pair of low canvas plimsolls in dingy grey-white canvas, frayed laces, thin cracked rubber soles, a hole worn through at one toe.

canvas_plimsolls_of_intellect.name: Canvas Plimsolls of Intellect
canvas_plimsolls_of_intellect.description: Bought for tennis at the Hollywood Athletic Club, then worn to the library on Ivar instead, where their owner read everything on radio valves twice.
canvas_plimsolls_of_intellect.icon: A pair of clean white canvas plimsolls with blue laces, cream rubber toe caps, and a small brass reading-lamp charm tied into the lacing.

canvas_plimsolls_of_spirit.name: Canvas Plimsolls of Spirit
canvas_plimsolls_of_spirit.description: Quiet soles for early mornings. Their last owner walked around Echo Park Lake at dawn, fed the ducks, and claimed it did more for him than any doctor.
canvas_plimsolls_of_spirit.icon: A pair of white canvas plimsolls with pale sky-blue laces, soft gum-rubber soles, and a small white feather tucked under the lacing.

canvas_plimsolls_of_stamina.name: Canvas Plimsolls of Stamina
canvas_plimsolls_of_stamina.description: Laced up every afternoon by a newsboy who ran the late edition from Vine to La Brea for three years and never once paid a streetcar fare.
canvas_plimsolls_of_stamina.icon: A pair of off-white canvas plimsolls with thick reinforced rubber soles, red laces, double-stitched seams, and road dust on the toes.

canvas_plimsolls_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Plimsolls of the Engineer
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_engineer.description: Studio electricians at Warner's swore by rubber soles and no nails. One of them learned why in hobnails, on a wet stage, in front of the whole crew.
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_engineer.icon: A pair of grey canvas plimsolls with thick black rubber soles, black laces, a smear of machine grease on one side, and a small brass wrench charm.

canvas_plimsolls_of_the_doctor.name: Canvas Plimsolls of the Doctor
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_doctor.description: Night nurses at Hollywood Hospital wore these because they made no sound on the linoleum. Patients woke up anyway, mostly to complain about the food.
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_doctor.icon: A pair of crisp white canvas plimsolls with white laces, spotless pale rubber soles, and a small red cross pin at the ankle.

canvas_plimsolls_of_the_deacon.name: Canvas Plimsolls of the Deacon
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday they made the long walk to Angelus Temple and back for three services and a hymn sing. The canvas still smells faintly of hymnals and orange peel.
canvas_plimsolls_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of white canvas plimsolls with purple laces, scuffed but clean rubber soles, and a short purple hymnal ribbon tied at one ankle.

patched_canvas_plimsolls.name: Patched Canvas Plimsolls
patched_canvas_plimsolls.description: Mended at the toes with bicycle-tyre rubber and a good deal of hope.
patched_canvas_plimsolls.icon: A pair of dull grey canvas plimsolls with dark rubber patches glued over both toes and mismatched laces, one brown, one white.

plain_canvas_plimsolls.name: Plain Canvas Plimsolls
plain_canvas_plimsolls.description: Sold from a bin at a Boulevard five-and-dime, one pair to a customer, no exchanges.
plain_canvas_plimsolls.icon: A pair of plain white canvas plimsolls with white laces and simple gum-coloured rubber soles, no ornament.

sturdy_canvas_plimsolls.name: Sturdy Canvas Plimsolls
sturdy_canvas_plimsolls.description: Heavier duck canvas and a sole thick enough for the broken glass on Cahuenga, which these days is most of Cahuenga.
sturdy_canvas_plimsolls.icon: A pair of thick tan duck-canvas plimsolls with stout dark-brown rubber soles, deep tread, reinforced toe caps, and heavy waxed laces.

good_canvas_plimsolls.name: Good Canvas Plimsolls
good_canvas_plimsolls.description: Properly stitched, with an arch somebody actually thought about. The kind of shoe a script girl buys after her first raise and keeps for ten years.
good_canvas_plimsolls.icon: A pair of crisp white canvas plimsolls with navy trim around the collar, navy laces, cushioned cream rubber soles, and neat stitching.

worn_work_boots.name: Worn Work Boots
worn_work_boots.description: Resoled twice and given up on the third time. The laces are kitchen string.
worn_work_boots.icon: A pair of scuffed brown leather lace-up work boots, cracked and curled at the toes, one sole peeling from the heel, laced with frayed string.

work_boots_of_agility.name: Work Boots of Agility
work_boots_of_agility.description: A rigger at Columbia wore these along the catwalks forty feet above the stage. He never fell, though he did once drop a sandbag beside a director, who never forgot it.
work_boots_of_agility.icon: A pair of slim tan leather ankle work boots with thin flexible soles, green laces, and a small coil-of-rope charm tied at the lacing.

work_boots_of_stamina.name: Work Boots of Stamina
work_boots_of_stamina.description: Built for twelve-hour days laying track for the Pacific Electric. Their owner outlasted three foremen and one strike.
work_boots_of_stamina.icon: A pair of dark brown leather work boots with a thick stitched welt, heavy double soles, steel hook eyelets, black laces, and a scuff of rail grease.

work_boots_of_spirit.name: Work Boots of Spirit
work_boots_of_spirit.description: Owned by a Griffith Park groundskeeper who liked the hills better than people. They still carry the smell of sage and wet oak leaves.
work_boots_of_spirit.icon: A pair of light brown leather work boots with soft creased ankles, pale blue laces, and a sprig of grey-green sage tucked into the lacing.

work_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Work Boots of the Acrobat
work_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: Gower Gulch stuntmen favoured these for rooftop chases, since the soles grip tar paper. The studio paid for the fall and docked the boots from the man's wages.
work_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: A pair of supple russet leather work boots with thin gripping crepe soles, yellow laces, and a small stitched star emblem on the ankle.

work_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Work Boots of the Stevedore
work_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: Salt rings climb to the ankle from years on the San Pedro docks. Their owner could run a sack of coffee up a wet gangplank and be back for another before the foreman finished swearing.
work_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: A pair of dark oiled leather work boots with white salt-stain rings, heavy hobnailed soles, brown laces, and a small iron cargo-hook charm.

work_boots_of_the_deacon.name: Work Boots of the Deacon
work_boots_of_the_deacon.description: Polished every Saturday night for an usher at Angelus Temple who stood through all three Sunday services and never once sat down. He blamed his feet on the Lord and his knees on the Argonne.
work_boots_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of black leather work boots polished to a shine, sensible low heels, purple laces, and a small brass cross pinned at the ankle.

patched_work_boots.name: Patched Work Boots
patched_work_boots.description: Stitched back together by a cobbler on Cahuenga who charged a dime and an opinion.
patched_work_boots.icon: A pair of brown leather work boots with a lighter tan patch sewn over one toe, uneven stitching, worn-down soles, and mismatched laces.

plain_work_boots.name: Plain Work Boots
plain_work_boots.description: Ordinary hide, ordinary nails, ordinary blisters for the first week.
plain_work_boots.icon: A pair of plain mid-brown leather lace-up work boots with flat leather soles, brown laces, and plain round toes.

sturdy_work_boots.name: Sturdy Work Boots
sturdy_work_boots.description: Double-soled, nailed and oiled, the sort of boot a Valley ranch hand expected to be buried in.
sturdy_work_boots.icon: A pair of heavy dark brown leather work boots with double-stitched soles, rows of hobnails on the tread, an oiled sheen, and thick rawhide laces.

good_work_boots.name: Good Work Boots
good_work_boots.description: Steel shanks and a proper welt under good hide. A Paramount carpenter saved two months' pay for these, lost the studio to the invaders a week later, and kept the boots out of spite.
good_work_boots.icon: A pair of well-made chestnut leather work boots with clean welted soles, brass eyelets, tan laces, neat even stitching, and a glossy finish.

fine_canvas_work_trousers.name: Fine Canvas Work Trousers
fine_canvas_work_trousers.description: Cut from the same duck canvas as a grip's tool apron, and only slightly less stained. The knees were double-stitched by someone who knelt a lot.
fine_canvas_work_trousers.icon: Pair of tan duck-canvas work trousers, clean double-stitched knee panels, small brass rivets at the pocket corners, plain brown belt loops, neatly folded hems.

canvas_work_trousers_of_agility.name: Canvas Work Trousers of Agility
canvas_work_trousers_of_agility.description: Rolled at the cuff and soft at the seat from years on the catwalks above the Warner stages, where a rigger learns to move quickly or learns to fall.
canvas_work_trousers_of_agility.icon: Tan canvas work trousers with cuffs rolled high, light blue stitching along the outer seams, brass rivets, a small silver feather charm hanging from one belt loop.

canvas_work_trousers_of_strength.name: Canvas Work Trousers of Strength
canvas_work_trousers_of_strength.description: Property of a Universal set carpenter who carried flats two at a time because the foreman was timing him. The back pockets are torn where the hammers lived.
canvas_work_trousers_of_strength.icon: Heavy tan canvas trousers with a hammer loop on the thigh, red bar-tack stitching at stress points, torn back pocket, small iron anvil charm on a belt loop.

canvas_work_trousers_of_stamina.name: Canvas Work Trousers of Stamina
canvas_work_trousers_of_stamina.description: Twelve-hour shifts at the Mulholland Dam pumps wore the shine off these and none of the seams. The previous owner came home every night, which up there counts as a recommendation.
canvas_work_trousers_of_stamina.icon: Dusty grey-tan canvas trousers with thick green triple-stitched seams, dried mud on the cuffs, a small square green cloth patch on one knee.

canvas_work_trousers_of_the_boxer.name: Canvas Work Trousers of the Boxer
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_boxer.description: A stagehand fought four rounds at the Legion Stadium as Kid Gower and wore these to the bout and home again. He lost the fight and kept the trousers.
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_boxer.icon: Tan canvas trousers with a crimson stripe down the outer seam, red cloth tape around the knees, a small brass boxing-glove pin on a belt loop.

canvas_work_trousers_of_the_marksman.name: Canvas Work Trousers of the Marksman
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_marksman.description: Knees worn flat from lying prone on the Hollywoodland ridges, where a patient rifleman could drop a Spitter long before it found its range.
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_marksman.icon: Khaki canvas trousers with darkened flattened knees, olive drab stitching, a small cartridge pocket on the thigh, brass cross-hair notch charm on the belt loop.

canvas_work_trousers_of_the_acrobat.name: Canvas Work Trousers of the Acrobat
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen on the Pickford-Fairbanks lot swore by canvas that gives at the crotch instead of tearing. These were tested off a balcony, a rooftop and once, by accident, a moving red car.
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tan canvas trousers with a yellow gusseted crotch panel, reinforced seat, frayed hems, a small yellow star-shaped cloth tag on a belt loop.

canvas_work_trousers_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Work Trousers of the Engineer
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_engineer.description: Every pocket holds a different gauge of wire, and one holds a slide rule. They belonged to a Universal electrician who rewired a generator by lamplight the night the hive took the backlot.
canvas_work_trousers_of_the_engineer.icon: Tan canvas trousers with many narrow tool pockets, a coil of copper wire tucked into one, orange stitching, a small steel wrench charm on the belt loop.

pressed_canvas_work_trousers.name: Pressed Canvas Work Trousers
pressed_canvas_work_trousers.description: Someone took an iron to work canvas, which tells you all you need to know about the wardrobe department's priorities. The crease could almost cut chitin.
pressed_canvas_work_trousers.icon: Crisp pale tan canvas trousers with a sharp front crease, polished brass rivets, neatly turned cuffs, clean and unstained fabric.

tailored_canvas_work_trousers.name: Tailored Canvas Work Trousers
tailored_canvas_work_trousers.description: Fitted at the waist by a Boulevard tailor who normally cut tuxedos and wished it known. He charged tuxedo prices, too.
tailored_canvas_work_trousers.icon: Slim-cut light tan canvas trousers with a fitted waist and side buckle tabs, neat cream stitching, small brass buttons, pressed hems.

heavy_canvas_work_trousers.name: Heavy Canvas Work Trousers
heavy_canvas_work_trousers.description: Double-thick canvas, quilted through the thigh against anything with mandibles. Built for the river camps in Studio City, where the mud is only the second worst thing grabbing at a man's legs.
heavy_canvas_work_trousers.icon: Bulky dark brown quilted canvas trousers, diamond-stitched padding on the thighs, thick leather knee patches, heavy brass buckles at the waist.

fine_plate_insert_trousers.name: Fine Plate-insert Trousers
fine_plate_insert_trousers.description: Thin steel plates ride in stitched pockets down each thigh, sized by a quartermaster who measured nobody. They clank on stairs, a fair price for keeping a Drone off the femur.
fine_plate_insert_trousers.icon: Olive drab wool trousers with grey steel plates visible in stitched thigh pockets, rivets at the plate corners, clean khaki belt loops.

plate_insert_trousers_of_strength.name: Plate-insert Trousers of Strength
plate_insert_trousers_of_strength.description: Worn by a Post 43 man who swung a trench shovel in the Argonne and swung it again at Cahuenga Pass, leaving the plates to worry about what swung back.
plate_insert_trousers_of_strength.icon: Olive drab trousers with grey steel thigh plates, red-painted plate edges, a small brass trench-shovel charm on one belt loop.

plate_insert_trousers_of_stamina.name: Plate-insert Trousers of Stamina
plate_insert_trousers_of_stamina.description: Dents in both thigh plates, each hammered roughly flat again with a pistol butt. The owner walked out of the Hollywoodland hills on his own feet, which is the whole review.
plate_insert_trousers_of_stamina.icon: Olive drab trousers with steel thigh plates covered in hammered-flat dents, dark green reinforced stitching, a small green cloth patch at the hip.

plate_insert_trousers_of_the_boxer.name: Plate-insert Trousers of the Boxer
plate_insert_trousers_of_the_boxer.description: Legion boxers trained in these for the stadium on El Centro, on the theory that a man who can dance in steel can dance in anything. Most danced like a filing cabinet.
plate_insert_trousers_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive drab trousers with steel thigh plates, a crimson stripe down the outer seam, a brass boxing-glove pin on the belt loop.

plate_insert_trousers_of_the_stevedore.name: Plate-insert Trousers of the Stevedore
plate_insert_trousers_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who came to Hollywood for picture work and got the Dome instead. The plates were cut from a hatch cover and still smell of salt and tar.
plate_insert_trousers_of_the_stevedore.icon: Dark navy canvas trousers with rough-cut grey steel thigh plates, a tarred rope belt, a small brass cargo-hook charm on one loop.

pressed_plate_insert_trousers.name: Pressed Plate-insert Trousers
pressed_plate_insert_trousers.description: Creased fore and aft like parade dress, plates and all. The Legion still holds inspection under the Dome, and the sergeant notices.
pressed_plate_insert_trousers.icon: Crisp olive drab trousers with a sharp front crease, polished bright steel thigh plates, gleaming brass buttons, spotless hems.

tailored_plate_insert_trousers.name: Tailored Plate-insert Trousers
tailored_plate_insert_trousers.description: Made in the Universal costume shop for a war picture and pressed into actual service. The plates are real steel; the gold regimental piping is pure studio invention.
tailored_plate_insert_trousers.icon: Slim-cut olive drab trousers with gold piping down the outer seams, neatly fitted bright steel thigh plates, brass buttons.

heavy_plate_insert_trousers.name: Heavy Plate-insert Trousers
heavy_plate_insert_trousers.description: Overlapping plates from hip to knee, laced on with rawhide so a Brute's blow bends them before it bends the man inside. They weigh about as much as a small child and complain less.
heavy_plate_insert_trousers.icon: Bulky dark grey trousers with overlapping steel plates from hip to knee, rawhide lacing, a heavy riveted knee cop, scuffed brown leather straps.

bathing_beauty_s_slippers.name: Bathing Beauty's Slippers
bathing_beauty_s_slippers.description: Sennett's girls never got these wet; the studio paid for sunshine, not seawater. Found on a dressing-room floor at the Studio City lot, still dusted with talc and pointed toward the door.
bathing_beauty_s_slippers.icon: Pair of satin beach slippers in pale coral, white ribbon ties, thin cork soles, a glittering rhinestone buckle on each toe.

lockheed_riveter_s_gauntlets.name: Lockheed Riveter's Gauntlets
lockheed_riveter_s_gauntlets.description: Built to hold a bucking bar against a wing spar for a ten-hour shift. The plant's new owners work the line with mandibles now, and the old crew's gloves turned up stacked by the time clock, untouched.
lockheed_riveter_s_gauntlets.icon: Heavy steel-plated gauntlets with riveted knuckle plates, scorched brown leather cuffs, rows of brass rivets, dull grey-blue steel.

test_pilot_s_goggles.name: Test Pilot's Goggles
test_pilot_s_goggles.description: Every test pilot at United swore these lenses were lucky, which is what test pilots say about anything they come home wearing. A film of amber resin clouds one rim, where something flew alongside a little too long.
test_pilot_s_goggles.icon: Brown leather flying helmet with oval goggles pushed up on the brow, sheepskin lining, brass lens rims, one rim smeared with glowing amber resin.

vega_mechanic_s_coveralls.name: Vega Mechanic's Coveralls
vega_mechanic_s_coveralls.description: Oil-black at the knees and pocketed for every wrench in the Burbank shop. The man who wore them knew a Vega's engine by its sound alone, which is exactly why the hive decided to keep him.
vega_mechanic_s_coveralls.icon: One-piece khaki coveralls, oil-stained knees, many patch pockets, a brass wrench clipped at the hip, blank oval name patch on the breast.

hive_queen_s_chitin_crown.name: Hive Queen's Chitin Crown
hive_queen_s_chitin_crown.description: Not a crown, strictly, but the hard ridge of the Mount Lee queen's brow, cut free and lined with felt by a Legion armourer who will not discuss it. It still hums when the hills go quiet.
hive_queen_s_chitin_crown.icon: Jagged helm of iridescent green-black chitin, tall spiked ridge crest, steel band at the rim, amber resin glowing in the seams.

mantle_of_the_thirteen_letters.name: Mantle of the Thirteen Letters
mantle_of_the_thirteen_letters.description: Woven on the ridge behind the sign from hive silk and sheet metal stripped off all thirteen letters. The realtors paid a fortune to light HOLLYWOODLAND at night; the mantle still flickers faintly, as if remembering the bill.
mantle_of_the_thirteen_letters.icon: Draped cloak of pale shimmering hive silk stitched with white sheet-metal scales, tiny bulbs glowing along the hem, collar clasped with amber resin.

aviatrix_s_flight_jacket.name: Aviatrix's Flight Jacket
aviatrix_s_flight_jacket.description: Women flew out of United farther and faster than the newsreels admitted. This jacket came back from the hangars with a torn sleeve and a cracked compass in the pocket, and the women at the field still keep its owner's seat.
aviatrix_s_flight_jacket.icon: Brown horsehide flight jacket, wide fleece collar, zip front, small brass compass pinned at the breast, one sleeve torn and resin-stained.

hangar_mother_s_carapace.name: Hangar Mother's Carapace
hangar_mother_s_carapace.description: Something in the United hangars laid its brood in the cabins of grounded airliners. Its back plate, riveted to a steel vest by men who had flown with nothing beneath them but air, turns a bullet the way a hangar door turns rain.
hangar_mother_s_carapace.icon: Massive chest plate of curved green-black chitin bolted onto a steel vest, corrugated aluminium side panels, brood pores glowing amber.

architect_s_drafting_gloves.name: Architect's Drafting Gloves
architect_s_drafting_gloves.description: Fine kid gloves smudged with graphite, recovered from the hangar office where the hive laid out its tunnels in pencil on real blueprints. Someone up there taught them to draw. Nobody wants to learn who.
architect_s_drafting_gloves.icon: Pair of slim grey kid gloves, graphite-smudged fingertips, a brass drafting compass tucked in one cuff, faint amber resin lines traced across the palm.

king_consort_s_greaves.name: King Consort's Greaves
king_consort_s_greaves.description: Her Majesty's consort guarded the chamber for years and was never once asked his opinion, a position familiar to several husbands on the Boulevard. His leg shells, strapped over steel, hold firm when the mountain shakes.
king_consort_s_greaves.icon: Steel leg greaves overlaid with long ribbed chitin plates, iridescent green-black, jointed knee caps, worn leather straps and brass buckles.

trimotor_pilot_s_boots.name: Trimotor Pilot's Boots
trimotor_pilot_s_boots.description: Fleece-lined for the cold over the Tehachapis, back when there was somewhere to fly. The pilot left them on the rudder pedals of a Ford Trimotor in the end hangar; the plane is still there, full of eggs.
trimotor_pilot_s_boots.icon: Tall padded flying boots with quilted canvas uppers, sheepskin cuffs folded down, thick rubber soles, one heel crusted with amber egg resin.

heart_chamber_signet.name: Heart Chamber Signet
heart_chamber_signet.description: Pried from the wall of the innermost chamber on Mount Lee, where the resin pulses slowly like a sleeper breathing. Preachers wear it and swear the ring prays along with them. Nobody has asked to whom.
heart_chamber_signet.icon: Heavy gold signet ring set with a domed oval of glowing amber resin, a dark insect shape suspended inside, chitin shoulders on the band.

beery_s_barnstormer_scarf.name: Beery's Barnstormer Scarf
beery_s_barnstormer_scarf.description: Wallace Beery flew his own plane and described it at length to anyone at the airport lunch counter. He gave this scarf to the first crew back from the hangars, asked for it back, then thought better of it.
beery_s_barnstormer_scarf.icon: Long white silk aviator scarf with fringed ends, light oil smudges, a small gilt propeller pin fastened near one end.

runway_queen_s_sash.name: Runway Queen's Sash
runway_queen_s_sash.description: Its first owner won the airport's opening-day pageant and wore it for one afternoon. The hive moved into the hangars soon after, and the sash went to work; backed in tooled leather, it holds a holster better than it ever held a title.
runway_queen_s_sash.icon: Wide royal-blue satin pageant sash backed with tooled tan leather, brass buckle, gilt winged emblem, small holster loop at the side.

deacon_s_revival_vestments.name: Deacon's Revival Vestments
deacon_s_revival_vestments.description: Stitched for the tent revivals Angelus Temple carried into the hills, heavy enough to stop a spitter's acid and plain enough to satisfy the deacons. The collar still smells of lamp oil and five thousand hymnals.
deacon_s_revival_vestments.icon: Long dark leather preacher's coat, white satin lapels, gilt cross embroidered on the breast, brass buttons, frayed red hymnal ribbon hanging from a pocket.

chorus_conductor_s_cuffs.name: Chorus Conductor's Cuffs
chorus_conductor_s_cuffs.description: Starched linen worn by the choirmaster at the Hollywood Bowl's Easter sunrise service. He kept conducting the night the swarm came over the Pass, and the hymn held just long enough for the crowd to reach the road.
chorus_conductor_s_cuffs.icon: Pair of starched white linen cuffs, gilt lyre-shaped cufflinks, silver thread trim, a faint amber resin smear on one edge.

worn_colt_m1911.name: Worn Colt M1911
worn_colt_m1911.description: Pawned twice on Cahuenga and redeemed once, which is about the usual ratio. The slide rattles like loose change.
worn_colt_m1911.icon: Battered Colt M1911 pistol, worn blued steel faded to grey and freckled with rust, chipped brown wooden grips, scratched slide, small dull lanyard ring at the butt.

colt_m1911_of_agility.name: Colt M1911 of Agility
colt_m1911_of_agility.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch stunt rider who could draw, fire and fall off a horse in the same second. Only the falling ever made the picture.
colt_m1911_of_agility.icon: Colt M1911 pistol in deep blued steel with smooth walnut grips, a thin yellow silk cord tied through the lanyard ring, clean sharp slide edges.

colt_m1911_of_stamina.name: Colt M1911 of Stamina
colt_m1911_of_stamina.description: Carried through the Argonne by a corporal who outlasted his regiment, his marriage and two landlords. The grips are worn smooth where he held on.
colt_m1911_of_stamina.icon: Blued Colt M1911 with dark checkered grips worn smooth at the centre, an olive-drab canvas lanyard looped through the butt ring, faint scuffs along the frame.

colt_m1911_of_the_acrobat.name: Colt M1911 of the Acrobat
colt_m1911_of_the_acrobat.description: Tucked into the waistband of a wire-walker from the Christie lot, it has spent more time upside down than right side up. It fires either way.
colt_m1911_of_the_acrobat.icon: Polished blued Colt M1911 with mother-of-pearl grips, a short red and white striped circus ribbon tied at the lanyard ring.

colt_m1911_of_the_marksman.name: Colt M1911 of the Marksman
colt_m1911_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner, a Legion range officer, hit what he aimed at and nothing else, a rarer gift on the Boulevard than a good speaking voice. A small notch is filed beside the rear sight.
colt_m1911_of_the_marksman.icon: Blued Colt M1911 with a tiny brass cross-hair notch inlaid beside the rear sight, dark walnut grips set with a small green enamel dot.

colt_m1911_of_the_stevedore.name: Colt M1911 of the Stevedore
colt_m1911_of_the_stevedore.description: Shipped north from the San Pedro docks in a crate marked machine parts, by a longshoreman who thought the label accurate enough. Faint tar still darkens the grips.
colt_m1911_of_the_stevedore.icon: Colt M1911 with tar-darkened wooden grips, a short coil of hemp rope knotted at the lanyard ring, blued steel spotted with white salt bloom.

patched_colt_m1911.name: Patched Colt M1911
patched_colt_m1911.description: Somebody mended the cracked grip with friction tape and optimism. The tape, at least, is holding.
patched_colt_m1911.icon: Colt M1911 with one grip panel wrapped in black friction tape, dull grey-blue steel with rust spots, a mismatched lighter-coloured magazine base.

plain_colt_m1911.name: Plain Colt M1911
plain_colt_m1911.description: Standard Army surplus, sold off with no story attached, which in Hollywood makes it something of a novelty.
plain_colt_m1911.icon: Plain Colt M1911 in even matte blued steel, brown checkered wooden grips, clean but unremarkable, lanyard ring at the butt.

sturdy_colt_m1911.name: Sturdy Colt M1911
sturdy_colt_m1911.description: Dropped from a second-storey window on Gower during a hive surge and fished out of a rain barrel the next morning. It needed oil and nothing else.
sturdy_colt_m1911.icon: Solid Colt M1911 in dark blued steel with thick checkered walnut grips, faint pale water marks on the frame, heavy lanyard ring.

good_colt_m1911.name: Good Colt M1911
good_colt_m1911.description: Rented out from the gun room on Marathon Street for gangster pictures, until the gangsters started renting it too.
good_colt_m1911.icon: Well-kept Colt M1911 in glossy blued steel with chocolate walnut grips, a small blank brass rental tag hanging on a string from the lanyard ring.

fine_colt_m1911.name: Fine Colt M1911
fine_colt_m1911.description: Kept in a velvet-lined drawer in a Los Feliz bungalow and oiled every Sunday, whether it needed it or not.
fine_colt_m1911.icon: Polished Colt M1911 in rich blued steel, crisp checkered rosewood grips, bright clean edges, faint fine scrollwork engraved near the muzzle.

pressed_colt_m1911.name: Pressed Colt M1911
pressed_colt_m1911.description: Fresh off a studio armourer's bench, cleaned, blued and creased as sharp as a matinee idol's trousers.
pressed_colt_m1911.icon: Crisp Colt M1911 with mirror-polished deep blue slide, sharp-edged frame, smooth ivory-white grips, gleaming nickel trigger and hammer.

tailored_colt_m1911.name: Tailored Colt M1911
tailored_colt_m1911.description: Fitted by a Universal City gunsmith to the hand of a leading man who never fired it, then to the bodyguard who did.
tailored_colt_m1911.icon: Elegant Colt M1911 with nickel-plated slide, carved ivory grips, a slim gold inlaid line along the frame, polished trigger and extended grip tang.

heavy_colt_m1911.name: Heavy Colt M1911
heavy_colt_m1911.description: Built up with a thicker slide and a longer barrel for work in the Cahuenga Pass, where the things coming up the road wear armour of their own.
heavy_colt_m1911.icon: Bulky Colt M1911 with oversized squared slide, lengthened barrel, extended magazine jutting below the grip, dark gunmetal steel, chunky black rubber-wrapped grips.

reinforced_colt_m1911.name: Reinforced Colt M1911
reinforced_colt_m1911.description: Steel bands clamp the frame where an ordinary pistol would crack after a week on the Universal backlot. The armourer charged double and called it a bargain.
reinforced_colt_m1911.icon: Colt M1911 with riveted steel bands around frame and slide, heavy slotted compensator at the muzzle, dark gunmetal finish, worn black grips.

superior_colt_m1911.name: Superior Colt M1911
superior_colt_m1911.description: Among Burbank machinists it is said the Lockheed shop turned this one between aircraft parts. Nobody has asked the Lockheed shop, which is now full of insects.
superior_colt_m1911.icon: Refined Colt M1911 with precision-machined slide cut with bright aluminium cooling slots, brass-trimmed sights, dark steel frame, smooth black walnut grips.

chitin_lined_colt_m1911.name: Chitin-lined Colt M1911
chitin_lined_colt_m1911.description: Grips cut from invader shell stay cool even on a Valley afternoon, and the recoil seems to go somewhere the hand never finds. Few owners ask where the shell came from.
chitin_lined_colt_m1911.icon: Gunmetal Colt M1911 with grip panels of iridescent green-black insect chitin, a faint glowing amber resin seam along the frame, extended magazine.

chitin_plated_colt_m1911.name: Chitin-plated Colt M1911
chitin_plated_colt_m1911.description: Every surface the bluing once covered is now shell, peeled off a Soldier on Mount Lee and bolted down with stove screws. Under the Dome, that passes for progress.
chitin_plated_colt_m1911.icon: Colt M1911 sheathed in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates fixed with brass screws, segmented ridges along the slide, dark steel muzzle, small amber resin knots at the joints.

worn_wool_trousers.name: Worn Wool Trousers
worn_wool_trousers.description: Bought off a pawnshop rail on Cahuenga, the knees shiny from someone else's job hunting. The cuffs have been let down twice already.
worn_wool_trousers.icon: Pair of dull charcoal wool trousers, shiny threadbare knees, frayed cuffs, a faded brown button fly, sagging and slightly creased.

wool_trousers_of_intellect.name: Wool Trousers of Intellect
wool_trousers_of_intellect.description: Pressed daily by a Paramount script reader who could spot a third-act problem from the lobby. One pocket still holds a stub of blue pencil and, by all accounts, a strong opinion.
wool_trousers_of_intellect.icon: Crisp navy wool trousers with a sharp crease, brass buttons, a short blue pencil tucked into the hip pocket.

wool_trousers_of_spirit.name: Wool Trousers of Spirit
wool_trousers_of_spirit.description: These spent Sunday mornings in the back pew and Sunday afternoons asleep on the grass in Echo Park. The owner swore both did him equal good.
wool_trousers_of_spirit.icon: Soft dove-grey wool trousers, cream suspender buttons, a small sprig of white sage tied to a belt loop with string.

wool_trousers_of_stamina.name: Wool Trousers of Stamina
wool_trousers_of_stamina.description: Cut for a Pacific Electric conductor who stood eleven hours a day and never once sat down on company time. The seat is practically new.
wool_trousers_of_stamina.icon: Heavy dark-green serge trousers with red piping down the outer seam, thick reinforced knees, plain brass buttons.

wool_trousers_of_the_engineer.name: Wool Trousers of the Engineer
wool_trousers_of_the_engineer.description: Solder burns dot the left shin. A Warner Bros. sound man wore these up rigging ladders and through one fuse-box fire, and came out with both his trousers and his job.
wool_trousers_of_the_engineer.icon: Brown tweed trousers with small black scorch marks on one shin, a tiny brass wrench charm hanging from a belt loop.

wool_trousers_of_the_doctor.name: Wool Trousers of the Doctor
wool_trousers_of_the_doctor.description: Left on a hook at the aid station on Highland by a surgeon who went back in for one more patient. The nurses have not found the heart to throw them out.
wool_trousers_of_the_doctor.icon: Pale charcoal pinstripe trousers with turned-up cuffs, a small red cross enamel pin fixed at the waistband.

wool_trousers_of_the_deacon.name: Wool Trousers of the Deacon
wool_trousers_of_the_deacon.description: They carried an Edendale deacon to Angelus Temple on foot every Wednesday night, a long walk that wore out two pairs of shoes and not a thread of these. Hymnal pages still turn up in the turn-ups.
wool_trousers_of_the_deacon.icon: Black wool trousers with a deep purple satin side stripe, a purple hymnal ribbon tied around one belt loop.

patched_wool_trousers.name: Patched Wool Trousers
patched_wool_trousers.description: Three different wools, none of them on speaking terms. Somebody's mother did her best.
patched_wool_trousers.icon: Grey wool trousers with mismatched brown and blue square patches on the knees and seat, coarse white hand stitching.

plain_wool_trousers.name: Plain Wool Trousers
plain_wool_trousers.description: Off the rack at a Boulevard haberdasher, sold without a word of salesmanship. They do what trousers do.
plain_wool_trousers.icon: Plain mid-grey wool trousers, neat straight crease, simple bone buttons, clean and unremarkable.

sturdy_wool_trousers.name: Sturdy Wool Trousers
sturdy_wool_trousers.description: Double-stitched for a studio carpenter who knelt more often than most parishioners. Sawdust lives in the cuffs for good.
sturdy_wool_trousers.icon: Thick oatmeal-brown wool trousers, double-stitched seams in tan thread, pale sawdust flecks caught in the cuffs.

good_wool_trousers.name: Good Wool Trousers
good_wool_trousers.description: Good enough for dinner at the Brown Derby, provided nobody studies the hem. Most nights nobody does.
good_wool_trousers.icon: Charcoal flannel trousers with a faint blue chalk stripe, sharp crease, cuffed hems, polished black buttons.

worn_leather_chaps.name: Worn Leather Chaps
worn_leather_chaps.description: Abandoned at the Gower Gulch hitching rail by an extra who rode off in his long johns, or so the story goes. The leather has cracked along every bend.
worn_leather_chaps.icon: Pair of batwing leather chaps in dull cracked tan, scuffed and stiff, one buckle missing, frayed rawhide lacing.

leather_chaps_of_agility.name: Leather Chaps of Agility
leather_chaps_of_agility.description: Tom Mix's stunt crew had a trick rider who jumped a fence, a parked Packard and a camera dolly in these. Only the cameraman complained.
leather_chaps_of_agility.icon: Slim shotgun chaps in glossy chestnut leather, a row of small silver conchos down the outer leg, long swinging fringe.

leather_chaps_of_stamina.name: Leather Chaps of Stamina
leather_chaps_of_stamina.description: Thick as a saddle and nearly as heavy. A wrangler wore them through two days of a stampede scene the director kept reshooting for the light.
leather_chaps_of_stamina.icon: Heavy dark-brown shotgun chaps of very thick leather, broad brass-buckled belt, rough-out panels at the knees.

leather_chaps_of_spirit.name: Leather Chaps of Spirit
leather_chaps_of_spirit.description: Sun-faded from long nights in Vermont Canyon, where the coyotes sang and the cowboy who owned these sang back. He claimed it settled his nerves and the horse's.
leather_chaps_of_spirit.icon: Sun-faded rose-tan batwing chaps of soft worn leather, small turquoise stones set along the belt.

leather_chaps_of_the_acrobat.name: Leather Chaps of the Acrobat
leather_chaps_of_the_acrobat.description: Made for a stuntman who fell off horses for Universal at five dollars a fall. He kept the chaps and lost the receipts.
leather_chaps_of_the_acrobat.icon: Lightweight black leather chaps with bright white contrast stitching, padded hip panels, small silver star rivets.

leather_chaps_of_the_stevedore.name: Leather Chaps of the Stevedore
leather_chaps_of_the_stevedore.description: Not every pair came off a horse. These hauled cargo on the San Pedro docks before their owner traded the waterfront for a Western backlot, and they still smell faintly of tar.
leather_chaps_of_the_stevedore.icon: Rough oxblood leather chaps with tar-black stains at the knees, a small iron cargo hook charm hanging from the belt.

leather_chaps_of_the_deacon.name: Leather Chaps of the Deacon
leather_chaps_of_the_deacon.description: Before the Dome came down, a cowboy preacher rode these out to tent meetings in the Valley. The left thigh is worn smooth where his Bible rode in its holster.
leather_chaps_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark walnut leather chaps with a stitched leather pouch on one thigh, a faded purple ribbon tied to the belt buckle.

patched_leather_chaps.name: Patched Leather Chaps
patched_leather_chaps.description: Mended with harness leather and stubbornness. The stitching would never pass the Gower Gulch saddlery, but it holds.
patched_leather_chaps.icon: Tan leather chaps with mismatched darker leather patches, crude heavy stitching, a knotted rope tie replacing one buckle.

plain_leather_chaps.name: Plain Leather Chaps
plain_leather_chaps.description: Wardrobe issued these to forty extras for a cattle-drive picture. Thirty-nine came back.
plain_leather_chaps.icon: Plain medium-brown shotgun chaps, a simple steel buckle, clean unadorned leather with straight seams.

sturdy_leather_chaps.name: Sturdy Leather Chaps
sturdy_leather_chaps.description: Saddle leather thick enough to change a rattlesnake's mind. A Griffith Park ranger wore them through two dry summers in the brush.
sturdy_leather_chaps.icon: Thick saddle-brown chaps with a reinforced double layer at the shins, heavy brass buckles, laced side panels.

good_leather_chaps.name: Good Leather Chaps
good_leather_chaps.description: Well-oiled and properly fitted, the sort a leading man wears for the close-up while his double takes the cheaper pair for the hard parts.
good_leather_chaps.icon: Rich glossy chestnut batwing chaps with a tooled floral border, polished nickel conchos, supple oiled leather.

worn_carhartt_chore_coat.name: Worn Carhartt Chore Coat
worn_carhartt_chore_coat.description: Brown duck canvas gone white at the elbows, with a stranger's name inked inside the collar. Its last owner left it on a Gower Street fence and never came back for it.
worn_carhartt_chore_coat.icon: Boxy hip-length chore coat in faded tan-brown duck canvas, frayed cuffs, threadbare elbows, dull brown corduroy collar, one missing button, four sagging patch pockets.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_agility.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of Agility
carhartt_chore_coat_of_agility.description: A set dresser at Columbia wore this up and down scaffold ladders forty times a day. The left pocket still holds a pencil stub and a list of chairs nobody delivered.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_agility.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat with dark corduroy collar and four patch pockets, bright yellow pencil poking from breast pocket, light blue stitching along the seams.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_strength.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of Strength
carhartt_chore_coat_of_strength.description: Hauled flats on the Christie lot for six seasons. The shoulders are stretched to the shape of a man who carried a fireplace mantel alone rather than wait for the union second.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_strength.icon: Broad-shouldered brown duck canvas chore coat, dark corduroy collar, four patch pockets, red stitching on the shoulders, a coil of hemp rope looped over one pocket.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_stamina.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of Stamina
carhartt_chore_coat_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched seams, a blanket lining and a smell of wet horse from the Gower Gulch stables. It has outlasted two owners and one stampede staged for a picture never released.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_stamina.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat hanging open to show a red-and-black plaid blanket lining, corduroy collar, thick doubled seams in green thread.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_boxer.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of the Boxer
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_boxer.description: Folded on a ringside bench at the Legion Stadium every Friday night, it caught more spilled ginger ale than punches. Its owner swore the ginger ale was all it ever was.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_boxer.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat with corduroy collar and patch pockets, a small red enamel boxing-glove pin on the lapel, a faint amber stain on one cuff.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_marksman.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of the Marksman
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_marksman.description: Stembridge's man on Marathon Street wore it when testing rentals out back. The cuff is singed where a hot casing landed, and a small cross-hair is scratched into the top button.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_marksman.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat with corduroy collar, a scorched black mark on one cuff, brass top button with a cross-hair notch, a single brass casing in the breast pocket.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_acrobat.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of the Acrobat
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen on Poverty Row favoured it because it tears instead of catching when a fall goes wrong. This one has torn twice and been sewn back by somebody's mother.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_acrobat.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat with corduroy collar, two long mended tears closed with neat white zigzag stitching, a small blue patch on one elbow.

carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_engineer.name: Carhartt Chore Coat of the Engineer
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_engineer.description: Grease handprints, a slide rule in the inside pocket and a generator wiring diagram pencilled on the lining. Its electrician kept his notes where nobody could borrow them.
carhartt_chore_coat_of_the_engineer.icon: Brown duck canvas chore coat with black grease smudges, corduroy collar, wooden slide rule jutting from a pocket, a small steel wrench charm on the zipper pull.

patched_carhartt_chore_coat.name: Patched Carhartt Chore Coat
patched_carhartt_chore_coat.description: Three different canvases now, and one of them used to be a tent at the Vermont Canyon camp.
patched_carhartt_chore_coat.icon: Shabby chore coat in mismatched patches of brown duck, olive tent canvas and grey ticking, crooked heavy stitching, flattened corduroy collar.

plain_carhartt_chore_coat.name: Plain Carhartt Chore Coat
plain_carhartt_chore_coat.description: Bought new off a hardware store shelf on Cahuenga, worn once, and traded for a sandwich the week the Dome came down.
plain_carhartt_chore_coat.icon: Plain clean brown duck canvas chore coat, unworn creases, dark brown corduroy collar, four flat patch pockets, plain metal buttons.

sturdy_carhartt_chore_coat.name: Sturdy Carhartt Chore Coat
sturdy_carhartt_chore_coat.description: Stiff enough to stand up by itself in a corner, which in a boarding house saves on hangers.
sturdy_carhartt_chore_coat.icon: Heavy rigid brown duck canvas chore coat standing upright on its own, thick triple-stitched seams, dark corduroy collar, sturdy riveted pockets.

good_carhartt_chore_coat.name: Good Carhartt Chore Coat
good_carhartt_chore_coat.description: Clean canvas, brass rivets and a corduroy collar. Carpenters at Warner Bros. kept their good one for payday and wore it home past the gate guards like a suit.
good_carhartt_chore_coat.icon: Crisp rich-brown duck canvas chore coat, polished brass rivets at pocket corners, deep chocolate corduroy collar, neat tan topstitching, gleaming brass buttons.

worn_steel_vest.name: Worn Steel Vest
worn_steel_vest.description: Dented over the heart and quite proud of it. Whoever wore it last had friends in the Crawford outfit, or enemies.
worn_steel_vest.icon: Battered sleeveless vest of dull grey steel plates under scuffed black canvas, a deep dent on the left chest, rusty buckles, frayed leather straps.

steel_vest_of_strength.name: Steel Vest of Strength
steel_vest_of_strength.description: Heavy as a sack of cement and twice as cheerful. Only the Legion's bigger men buckle it on without asking for help with the straps.
steel_vest_of_strength.icon: Thick steel-plated vest under black canvas, extra-wide shoulder straps, broad iron buckles, red leather trim along the edges.

steel_vest_of_stamina.name: Steel Vest of Stamina
steel_vest_of_stamina.description: Police property once, signed out at the Hollywood station and never signed back in. The desk sergeant still brings it up.
steel_vest_of_stamina.icon: Steel-plated vest in navy blue canvas, quilted padding at the hem, brass buckles, a small blank brass property tag hanging from one strap.

steel_vest_of_the_boxer.name: Steel Vest of the Boxer
steel_vest_of_the_boxer.description: Post 43's heavyweight wore it under his sweater on the walk home from Selma Avenue, reasoning that a man who wins on Friday has made enemies by Saturday.
steel_vest_of_the_boxer.icon: Steel-plated vest under black canvas, polished buckles, a small red enamel boxing-glove pin on the chest plate, white tape wrapped around one strap.

steel_vest_of_the_stevedore.name: Steel Vest of the Stevedore
steel_vest_of_the_stevedore.description: Off a San Pedro freighter, where it was declared as plumbing fittings along with the forty cases of Canadian rye stacked beneath it.
steel_vest_of_the_stevedore.icon: Steel-plated vest in salt-stained brown canvas, a cargo hook clipped to one strap, coarse rope lacing at the sides, small anchor stamped on the plate.

patched_steel_vest.name: Patched Steel Vest
patched_steel_vest.description: Riveted together from two vests that had each failed at something, in the hope they would not fail at the same thing.
patched_steel_vest.icon: Crude vest of two mismatched steel plates riveted together, one grey and one rust-brown, patched canvas cover, knotted leather straps.

plain_steel_vest.name: Plain Steel Vest
plain_steel_vest.description: Grey plate under black canvas, issued to a bank guard at Hollywood and Highland who preferred to keep wearing it after closing time.
plain_steel_vest.icon: Plain sleeveless vest of smooth grey steel plate covered in clean black canvas, simple steel buckles, flat brown leather straps.

sturdy_steel_vest.name: Sturdy Steel Vest
sturdy_steel_vest.description: Quilted padding, thick buckles and a plate that rings like a dinner gong when struck. Invader drones seem to find the sound discouraging.
sturdy_steel_vest.icon: Sturdy steel-plated vest with thick quilted khaki padding at collar and hem, heavy black iron buckles, bolted chest plate.

good_steel_vest.name: Good Steel Vest
good_steel_vest.description: Every studio armourer in town claimed to have designed this pattern. None of them would say so out loud near a lawyer.
good_steel_vest.icon: Crisp polished steel-plated vest under fresh dark olive canvas, bright nickel buckles, neat stitched leather straps, smooth curved chest plate with clean rivet rows.

fine_florsheim_oxfords.name: Fine Florsheim Oxfords
fine_florsheim_oxfords.description: Bought on the Boulevard before the Dome and resoled twice since. Still good enough for a wake or a job interview, which these days are much the same occasion.
fine_florsheim_oxfords.icon: Pair of brown leather cap-toe oxfords, neatly polished, tan waxed laces tied in bows, clean light leather soles, modest even shine.

florsheim_oxfords_of_intellect.name: Florsheim Oxfords of Intellect
florsheim_oxfords_of_intellect.description: A script reader at the Pickford-Fairbanks studio wore these to the story department every morning. He claimed he did his best thinking with his feet up on the desk, and his producer never once caught him at it.
florsheim_oxfords_of_intellect.icon: Dark brown oxfords with slate-blue laces and a tiny brass pencil charm hanging from the lacing, smooth polished toes.

florsheim_oxfords_of_spirit.name: Florsheim Oxfords of Spirit
florsheim_oxfords_of_spirit.description: Their last owner walked from Los Feliz to the Greek Theatre most nights the autumn it opened, just to sit in the empty seats after the crowds left. He said the quiet did him more good than the program.
florsheim_oxfords_of_spirit.icon: Light tan oxfords with pale green laces, a single orange poppy tucked beneath the laces, soft creased leather.

florsheim_oxfords_of_stamina.name: Florsheim Oxfords of Stamina
florsheim_oxfords_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched welts and a heel that outlasted three night shifts on the Hollywoodland barricades. The man on the fourth shift fared worse, but the shoes came back.
florsheim_oxfords_of_stamina.icon: Chunky black oxfords with a thick welt double-stitched in red thread, scuffed toes, sturdy squared heels.

florsheim_oxfords_of_the_engineer.name: Florsheim Oxfords of the Engineer
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_engineer.description: Rubber-heeled, so a man can stand near live cables on a stage floor without praying about it. Recovered from the electrical department at Chaplin Studios, along with a lingering smell of hot carbon.
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_engineer.icon: Brown oxfords on thick black rubber heels, small brass wrench charm on the laces, dark oil spot on one toe.

florsheim_oxfords_of_the_doctor.name: Florsheim Oxfords of the Doctor
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_doctor.description: Soft-soled for ward rounds and faintly spattered with iodine at the left toe. The aid station on Sunset swears it sterilised them, and nobody has asked how.
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_doctor.icon: Oxblood oxfords with white laces, faint orange-brown iodine speckles on one toe, small white enamel caduceus pin on the tongue.

florsheim_oxfords_of_the_deacon.name: Florsheim Oxfords of the Deacon
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_deacon.description: Scuffed at the toes from kneeling and smelling of hymnal paper, these made the long walk to Angelus Temple every Sunday until the Echo Park road turned dangerous. Now they make it on someone else's feet.
florsheim_oxfords_of_the_deacon.icon: Black oxfords with worn scuffed toes, a purple silk ribbon threaded through the laces like a hymnal bookmark.

pressed_florsheim_oxfords.name: Pressed Florsheim Oxfords
pressed_florsheim_oxfords.description: Polished to a shine so hard that the shoeshine boy at the Roosevelt charges extra just to look at them.
pressed_florsheim_oxfords.icon: Glossy black cap-toe oxfords with a mirror shine, crisp bright white laces, sharp clean welts.
