tailored_florsheim_oxfords.name: Tailored Florsheim Oxfords
tailored_florsheim_oxfords.description: Made to the measure of a studio executive who insisted his feet were a size smaller than the evidence suggested. The cobbler compromised, and the left shoe still pinches about it.
tailored_florsheim_oxfords.icon: Two-tone spectator oxfords in white and tan, decorative brogue perforations, slim elegant toe, cream laces.

heavy_florsheim_oxfords.name: Heavy Florsheim Oxfords
heavy_florsheim_oxfords.description: Steel shanks and thick soles, laced tight for walking over broken glass and whatever the Spitters leave on the pavement. Sunday best is a distant memory for this pair.
heavy_florsheim_oxfords.icon: Thick-soled dark brown oxfords with heavy treaded soles, a dull steel toe cap showing through worn leather, rawhide laces.

fine_riding_boots.name: Fine Riding Boots
fine_riding_boots.description: Tall, honest boots from the Gower Gulch saddlery, made for extras who rode in posses at five dollars a day and walked home.
fine_riding_boots.icon: Pair of knee-high brown leather riding boots, plain smooth shafts, leather pull loops at the top, clean even polish.

riding_boots_of_agility.name: Riding Boots of Agility
riding_boots_of_agility.description: One trick rider in Tom Mix's outfit broke these in leaping between galloping horses. The boots survived the stunt; the rider's collarbone is still filing a grievance.
riding_boots_of_agility.icon: Slim black riding boots with thin silver spurs, pale yellow pull loops, narrow tapered shafts.

riding_boots_of_stamina.name: Riding Boots of Stamina
riding_boots_of_stamina.description: Thick calfskin and a heel built for a full day in the stirrups, chasing strays up Beachwood Canyon. The strays these days include things with six legs.
riding_boots_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy dark brown riding boots with thick stacked heels and a stitched reinforcing band at the ankle in green thread.

riding_boots_of_spirit.name: Riding Boots of Spirit
riding_boots_of_spirit.description: Night rides along the Griffith Park trails put the creases in this pair. Their owner said the hills settled him better than any sermon, which got him asked to leave two churches.
riding_boots_of_spirit.icon: Weathered tan riding boots with soft creases, a sprig of grey-green white sage tucked into one boot top.

riding_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Riding Boots of the Acrobat
riding_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: Bootheels reinforced after a fall from the second-storey balcony on the Christie lot, taken on purpose for twelve dollars and a close-up that ended up on the cutting-room floor.
riding_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: Lean chestnut riding boots with flexible ankles, reinforced heels, small brass tumbling-star pin on the shaft.

riding_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Riding Boots of the Stevedore
riding_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: San Pedro dockhands do not ride, but one bought these after a cargo hook tore through his work shoes. He came inland for picture work in '29 and stayed for the fighting.
riding_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: Rugged brown riding boots with rope-burn scuffs, a dark tar stain, coiled hemp lanyard knotted through one pull loop.

riding_boots_of_the_deacon.name: Riding Boots of the Deacon
riding_boots_of_the_deacon.description: Mud from Echo Park still clings to the heels, gathered on the walk to Sunday service. A folded tract sits in the left boot, worn soft from being read standing up.
riding_boots_of_the_deacon.icon: Black riding boots with mud-caked heels, purple stitching, a folded cream paper tract peeking from one boot top.

pressed_riding_boots.name: Pressed Riding Boots
pressed_riding_boots.description: Shined nightly by a hotel valet on the Strip, who considers mud a personal insult and the invasion a laundry problem.
pressed_riding_boots.icon: Glossy oxblood riding boots with crisp edges, gleaming brass buckles on the ankle straps, high bright polish.

tailored_riding_boots.name: Tailored Riding Boots
tailored_riding_boots.description: Cut for a director who wore jodhpurs on set and had never sat a horse, on the theory that it frightened the actors. It did.
tailored_riding_boots.icon: Elegant tall black boots with tapered shafts, laced insteps, slim heels and a deep lacquered polish.

heavy_riding_boots.name: Heavy Riding Boots
heavy_riding_boots.description: Riveted calf guards and a doubled sole, refitted at the Gower Gulch saddlery for kicking through brush where rattlesnakes are no longer the worst thing waiting.
heavy_riding_boots.icon: Heavy brown riding boots with riveted leather shin guards, thick doubled soles, dark iron buckles, scarred leather.

reinforced_quilted_leggings.name: Reinforced Quilted Leggings
reinforced_quilted_leggings.description: Double-stitched at the knee by a First National wardrobe seamstress who swore she had never sewn for a war. She has since stopped swearing it.
reinforced_quilted_leggings.icon: Pair of thick khaki canvas trousers with diamond quilting, brown leather knee patches and copper rivets along the seams, cuffs bound in tan webbing.

quilted_leggings_of_agility.name: Quilted Leggings of Agility
quilted_leggings_of_agility.description: Stuntmen at the Sennett lot wore these for pratfalls off rooftops, back when the worst thing on a roof was a custard pie. The padding has learned a few new falls since.
quilted_leggings_of_agility.icon: Pair of diamond-quilted grey canvas trousers, slim cut, with bright blue stitching and a small blue feather tag sewn at the hip.

quilted_leggings_of_strength.name: Quilted Leggings of Strength
quilted_leggings_of_strength.description: Cut for a Lockheed riveter with thighs like bridge pilings. The tailor took the measurements twice and still had to let the seams out.
quilted_leggings_of_strength.icon: Pair of broad diamond-quilted brown canvas trousers with heavy red stitching and a single iron rivet badge at the waistband.

quilted_leggings_of_stamina.name: Quilted Leggings of Stamina
quilted_leggings_of_stamina.description: The previous owner walked from Burbank to the river camp in these with a Spitter on his heels, then sat down on a crate and ate his lunch.
quilted_leggings_of_stamina.icon: Pair of thickly padded olive canvas trousers with dense diamond quilting, green stitching and a green cloth patch over one knee.

quilted_leggings_of_the_boxer.name: Quilted Leggings of the Boxer
quilted_leggings_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a heavyweight's cornerman wore these and took more punishment from the cheap seats than his fighter ever took in the ring.
quilted_leggings_of_the_boxer.icon: Pair of diamond-quilted tan canvas trousers with crimson piping down the sides and a small enamel boxing-glove pin at the hip.

quilted_leggings_of_the_marksman.name: Quilted Leggings of the Marksman
quilted_leggings_of_the_marksman.description: Belonged to a Stembridge armourer who hit what he aimed at and did his windage sums in pencil on the left thigh. The kneeling knee is worn nearly through.
quilted_leggings_of_the_marksman.icon: Pair of diamond-quilted slate canvas trousers, left knee scuffed pale, with a brass button bearing a cross-hair notch and faint pencil marks on one thigh.

quilted_leggings_of_the_acrobat.name: Quilted Leggings of the Acrobat
quilted_leggings_of_the_acrobat.description: Quilting this loose was meant for circus pictures at Universal, where a trapeze man had to fold in half and land standing. The circus folded first.
quilted_leggings_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pair of loose diamond-quilted cream canvas trousers with gold stitching, a small red star patch at the hip and elastic gathered cuffs.

quilted_leggings_of_the_engineer.name: Quilted Leggings of the Engineer
quilted_leggings_of_the_engineer.description: Pockets on both thighs hold a slide rule, a test lamp and three spare fuses. A Lockheed draughtsman designed them on company time and filed it as research.
quilted_leggings_of_the_engineer.icon: Pair of diamond-quilted navy canvas trousers with deep thigh cargo pockets, white stitching and a small brass wrench charm hanging from a belt loop.

superior_quilted_leggings.name: Superior Quilted Leggings
superior_quilted_leggings.description: Canvas from a studio tent loft, quilted over horsehair batting. Wardrobe wanted it back for a desert picture and was told no.
superior_quilted_leggings.icon: Pair of crisp dark charcoal canvas trousers with tight diamond quilting, brass buckle straps below each knee and reinforced leather seat panel.

chitin_lined_quilted_leggings.name: Chitin-lined Quilted Leggings
chitin_lined_quilted_leggings.description: Between canvas and batting runs a layer of Drone wing, thin as cellophane and twice as stubborn. It rustles whenever the wearer sits down.
chitin_lined_quilted_leggings.icon: Pair of heavy dark canvas trousers with diamond quilting, iridescent green-black insect shell visible at the turned-back cuffs and torn seams.

chitin_plated_quilted_leggings.name: Chitin-plated Quilted Leggings
chitin_plated_quilted_leggings.description: Shell plates the size of supper plates are stitched over each knee and thigh. Somewhere up on Mount Lee, the creature that grew them has not yet noticed they are gone.
chitin_plated_quilted_leggings.icon: Pair of thick black quilted canvas trousers with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates stitched over thighs and knees, leather lacing between plates.

reinforced_chitin_greaves.name: Reinforced Chitin Greaves
reinforced_chitin_greaves.description: Salvage crews in Burbank bolt Soldier carapace to old Army leg plate and sell the result by the pound, bolts included.
reinforced_chitin_greaves.icon: Pair of dull grey steel leg plates with dark green-black chitin panels bolted over the shins, brown leather straps and square iron bolts.

chitin_greaves_of_strength.name: Chitin Greaves of Strength
chitin_greaves_of_strength.description: A Post 43 machine-gunner had these made to carry a Browning up the Pass without stopping. He stopped once, to argue about the route.
chitin_greaves_of_strength.icon: Pair of broad steel and chitin leg greaves, green-black shell over grey steel, fastened with red leather straps and a heavy iron knee boss.

chitin_greaves_of_stamina.name: Chitin Greaves of Stamina
chitin_greaves_of_stamina.description: Elder Brute knockbacks dent the shell but seldom the man inside. The smith who forged them charges extra for that sentence alone.
chitin_greaves_of_stamina.icon: Pair of thick layered steel and chitin leg greaves, dark iridescent shell with green leather straps and a padded olive lining at the top edge.

chitin_greaves_of_the_boxer.name: Chitin Greaves of the Boxer
chitin_greaves_of_the_boxer.description: Rumour at the Legion Stadium holds that a middleweight once wore these into the ring on a bet. He was disqualified for having knees harder than the other fellow's jaw.
chitin_greaves_of_the_boxer.icon: Pair of steel and green-black chitin leg greaves with crimson leather straps and a small enamel boxing-glove pin riveted at the knee.

chitin_greaves_of_the_stevedore.name: Chitin Greaves of the Stevedore
chitin_greaves_of_the_stevedore.description: Hauled cargo at San Pedro for ten years, the owner said, and nothing down there ever bit back. He wore these on the river camp's loading line and said it less often.
chitin_greaves_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pair of steel and chitin leg greaves with rope-wrapped straps, a small iron cargo-hook charm at the hip and salt-stained grey steel edges.

superior_chitin_greaves.name: Superior Chitin Greaves
superior_chitin_greaves.description: Machine-shop work from the Lockheed plant: shell riveted to steel with aircraft rivets, which the foreman considers a promotion for both.
superior_chitin_greaves.icon: Pair of polished steel leg greaves with neatly fitted green-black chitin plates, rows of bright domed aluminium rivets and black leather straps.

chitin_lined_chitin_greaves.name: Chitin-lined Chitin Greaves
chitin_lined_chitin_greaves.description: Armourers ran short of steel somewhere around Burbank and began lining shell with more shell. It works, which annoys them considerably.
chitin_lined_chitin_greaves.icon: Pair of leg greaves made entirely of layered iridescent green-black chitin, the inner shell showing at the edges, held by riveted steel bands.

chitin_plated_chitin_greaves.name: Chitin-plated Chitin Greaves
chitin_plated_chitin_greaves.description: Hive resin still weeps amber from the seams on warm afternoons. Whatever wore this shell first stood taller than a Model A and did not part with it quietly.
chitin_plated_chitin_greaves.icon: Pair of massive overlapping chitin leg greaves, deep green-black and iridescent, with glowing amber hive resin seeping along the plate seams and a spiked knee plate.

worn_canvas_work_gloves.name: Worn Canvas Work Gloves
worn_canvas_work_gloves.description: Left on a stage-door railing at Grauman's by a grip who never came back for them. The fingertips are worn through, which is how most of the grips left.
worn_canvas_work_gloves.icon: Pair of dull grey-tan canvas work gloves, frayed cuffs, fingertips worn through, faded brown leather palm patches, grimy oil stains.

canvas_work_gloves_of_agility.name: Canvas Work Gloves of Agility
canvas_work_gloves_of_agility.description: Cut thin at the knuckles so a rigger could feel the rope before he trusted it. The owner went up the Egyptian's fly loft faster than anything came down it.
canvas_work_gloves_of_agility.icon: Slim-fingered tan canvas work gloves with thin leather knuckle strips and bright green stitching running along the cuffs.

canvas_work_gloves_of_strength.name: Canvas Work Gloves of Strength
canvas_work_gloves_of_strength.description: Belonged to a Columbia set carpenter who hauled flats two at a time and complained that the studio only paid him for one.
canvas_work_gloves_of_strength.icon: Heavy tan canvas work gloves with thick red leather palm reinforcement and red-stitched cuffs, broad and blocky.

canvas_work_gloves_of_stamina.name: Canvas Work Gloves of Stamina
canvas_work_gloves_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched for a labourer on the Hollywood Reservoir job, who wore them through two summers and one foreman. The canvas outlasted both.
canvas_work_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Tan canvas work gloves with dense double rows of dark brown stitching, quilted padded backs and thick rolled cuffs.

canvas_work_gloves_of_the_boxer.name: Canvas Work Gloves of the Boxer
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_boxer.description: Somebody's cornerman wore these to tape hands at the Legion Stadium on Friday nights, then to stack the folding chairs after. They still smell of liniment and cigar.
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_boxer.icon: Tan canvas work gloves with red cloth tape wrapped around the knuckles and a small brass boxing-glove pin on one cuff.

canvas_work_gloves_of_the_marksman.name: Canvas Work Gloves of the Marksman
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_marksman.description: Stembridge's armourers wore pairs like this to clean the rental rifles without fingerprinting the bluing. The trigger finger on this one was trimmed short by someone who meant business.
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_marksman.icon: Tan canvas gloves, right trigger finger cut open at the tip, faint dark gun-oil stains, small brass cross-hair notch stud on the cuff.

canvas_work_gloves_of_the_acrobat.name: Canvas Work Gloves of the Acrobat
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_acrobat.description: Taken off a stuntman who swung from the Pantages marquee for a two-reeler and landed in a pie cart. Grip palms, light cuffs, and one cream stain that will not wash out.
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light tan canvas gloves with dark rubbery grip patches on the palms, elastic cuffs with a blue stripe, a small cream smear on the back.

canvas_work_gloves_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Work Gloves of the Engineer
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_engineer.description: Pockets for a pencil and a fuse are sewn into the cuff, the sort of improvement studio electricians design on their lunch hour. A scorched thumb records the one time the theory was wrong.
canvas_work_gloves_of_the_engineer.icon: Tan canvas gloves with a slim pencil pocket stitched to the cuff, a tiny brass wrench charm, and a blackened scorch mark on one thumb.

patched_canvas_work_gloves.name: Patched Canvas Work Gloves
patched_canvas_work_gloves.description: Mended with squares of mattress ticking and the faith of a man who could not afford new ones.
patched_canvas_work_gloves.icon: Tan canvas work gloves patched with blue-and-white striped ticking squares, uneven black thread, frayed dirty cuffs.

plain_canvas_work_gloves.name: Plain Canvas Work Gloves
plain_canvas_work_gloves.description: Issued by the dozen from a Gower Gulch supply tent, no questions asked and no sizes either.
plain_canvas_work_gloves.icon: Clean plain tan canvas work gloves with simple brown leather palms and straight unadorned cuffs, unworn.

sturdy_canvas_work_gloves.name: Sturdy Canvas Work Gloves
sturdy_canvas_work_gloves.description: Heavy duck canvas with a leather palm, the pair the prop department hands to men it expects to see again.
sturdy_canvas_work_gloves.icon: Thick off-white duck canvas gloves with broad brown leather palms riveted at the base and stiff gauntlet cuffs.

good_canvas_work_gloves.name: Good Canvas Work Gloves
good_canvas_work_gloves.description: Quartermasters at the Vermont Canyon camp make men sign for these, then sign again when they come back with spitter acid on the cuffs.
good_canvas_work_gloves.icon: Crisp cream canvas gloves with tan leather palms and fingertips, a neat cuff strap fastened by a brass snap button.

worn_mail_backed_gloves.name: Worn Mail-backed Gloves
worn_mail_backed_gloves.description: Rust has eaten half the rings on the back, and the rest jingle like loose change. Some doughboy brought them home from France and forgot why.
worn_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Cracked grey leather gloves with a dull rusty chainmail panel over the backs, several broken rings dangling loose.

mail_backed_gloves_of_strength.name: Mail-backed Gloves of Strength
mail_backed_gloves_of_strength.description: A Post 43 man wore these to drag the captured German field gun back into place after every Fourth of July parade. The knuckle rings are hammered flat from the effort.
mail_backed_gloves_of_strength.icon: Brown leather gloves with steel mail backs, knuckle rings flattened and heavy, red leather trim around the cuffs.

mail_backed_gloves_of_stamina.name: Mail-backed Gloves of Stamina
mail_backed_gloves_of_stamina.description: Knitted steel over horsehide, heavy enough that wearing them all day counts as exercise. The last owner held a barricade on Highland for eleven hours and said his hands were the only part of him not tired.
mail_backed_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Thick horsehide gloves with dense steel mail backs and padded quilted cuffs trimmed in dark green, solid and blocky.

mail_backed_gloves_of_the_boxer.name: Mail-backed Gloves of the Boxer
mail_backed_gloves_of_the_boxer.description: Legion Stadium promoters swore nobody ever fought in these. Nobody believed them, least of all the sparring partner with a ring pattern on his cheek.
mail_backed_gloves_of_the_boxer.icon: Dark leather gloves with steel mail backs, red laces at the cuffs and a small brass boxing-glove pin at the wrist.

mail_backed_gloves_of_the_stevedore.name: Mail-backed Gloves of the Stevedore
mail_backed_gloves_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where a longshoreman had the mail sewn on to keep cargo hooks out of his knuckles. Salt still crusts the seams.
mail_backed_gloves_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered brown leather gloves with steel mail backs, a tiny iron cargo-hook charm on the cuff, white salt crust along the seams.

patched_mail_backed_gloves.name: Patched Mail-backed Gloves
patched_mail_backed_gloves.description: Every third ring is a washer from a hardware store on Cahuenga, wired in where the originals gave out.
patched_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Scuffed grey leather gloves with mail backs patched with mismatched steel washers bound in twists of copper wire.

plain_mail_backed_gloves.name: Plain Mail-backed Gloves
plain_mail_backed_gloves.description: Studio armourers made these by the gross for crusade pictures. The mail is real; the crusade was not.
plain_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Plain grey leather gloves with clean, even steel mail backs in dull silver rings and simple straight cuffs.

sturdy_mail_backed_gloves.name: Sturdy Mail-backed Gloves
sturdy_mail_backed_gloves.description: Riveted mail over doubled leather, made for police riot details and kept for things that bite harder than strikers.
sturdy_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Thick black leather gloves with riveted steel mail backs and reinforced wrist straps closed by steel buckles.

good_mail_backed_gloves.name: Good Mail-backed Gloves
good_mail_backed_gloves.description: Oiled every Sunday by a Legion sergeant who regards rust as a moral failing and invaders as a scheduling problem.
good_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Polished brown leather gloves with bright, oiled steel mail backs gleaming silver and brass buckles at the cuffs.

fine_mail_backed_gloves.name: Fine Mail-backed Gloves
fine_mail_backed_gloves.description: Sized for a leading man in a Paramount knight picture, and reissued after the leading man was carried off the lot by something with six legs.
fine_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Fitted dark leather gloves with fine bright silver mail backs, gilt-edged cuffs and neat white stitching.

pressed_mail_backed_gloves.name: Pressed Mail-backed Gloves
pressed_mail_backed_gloves.description: The leather is pressed flat and blacked, the mail hammered tight as a vault hinge. Men on the Cahuenga Pass line wear these when they expect to shake hands with an invader Soldier.
pressed_mail_backed_gloves.icon: Sleek blacked leather gloves with tightly hammered steel mail backs, small steel knuckle plates and crisp flared cuffs.

worn_braces.name: Worn Braces
worn_braces.description: Stretched past any memory of elastic, they hold up trousers mostly out of habit. The last owner left them on a bench at the Hollywood & Vine car stop.
worn_braces.icon: Limp pair of button-on braces, faded grey elastic straps sagging and frayed, dull tarnished brass adjusters, cracked brown leather button tabs.

braces_of_intellect.name: Braces of Intellect
braces_of_intellect.description: A script reader at Paramount wore these through four thousand pages of rejected scenarios. He claimed snug trousers kept the mind sharp, and nobody in the department cared to argue.
braces_of_intellect.icon: Navy blue braces with thin white pinstripe, polished brass clips, a small brass fountain-pen-nib charm pinned to the front strap.

braces_of_spirit.name: Braces of Spirit
braces_of_spirit.description: Sunday braces, worn under a good jacket to Hollywood Presbyterian and taken off again before supper. A certain calm settles on whoever snaps them into place.
braces_of_spirit.icon: Soft sky-blue braces with silver buckles, pale cream leather tabs, a small white enamel dove pin on one strap.

braces_of_stamina.name: Braces of Stamina
braces_of_stamina.description: Heavy webbing cut for a red-car motorman, who stood ten hours a day on the Hollywood Boulevard line and never once sat down on the company's time.
braces_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark-green webbing braces with wide straps, chunky nickel adjusters, a bold red stripe running down the centre of each strap.

braces_of_the_engineer.name: Braces of the Engineer
braces_of_the_engineer.description: Grease on one strap, solder burns on the other. They came off a sound man at the Christie lot who held that a proper engineer keeps his trousers up and his wiring down.
braces_of_the_engineer.icon: Khaki canvas braces with dark oil stains, steel clips, black rubberised tabs, a small brass wrench charm hanging from the crossing.

braces_of_the_doctor.name: Braces of the Doctor
braces_of_the_doctor.description: Left on a coat hook at Hollywood Receiving Hospital by a house surgeon. A faint smell of iodine survives every washing, and so does a habit of noticing what ails the people nearby.
braces_of_the_doctor.icon: Crisp white braces with a thin red stripe, bright silver clips, white leather tabs, a small red-cross enamel pin on one strap.

braces_of_the_deacon.name: Braces of the Deacon
braces_of_the_deacon.description: Two long walks a day to Angelus Temple, rain or shine, and the straps have the patient stretch to show for it. Hymnal dust has settled deep into the weave.
braces_of_the_deacon.icon: Black braces with gold edging, brass buttons, worn leather tabs, a little purple hymnal ribbon tied where the straps cross.

patched_braces.name: Patched Braces
patched_braces.description: Someone's wife darned the left strap with yellow thread because yellow was what she had. It holds.
patched_braces.icon: Brown braces with a bright yellow darned patch on the left strap, mismatched buttons, scuffed brass clips.

plain_braces.name: Plain Braces
plain_braces.description: Dime-store braces from the Boulevard, the kind every clerk in town wears and nobody in town notices.
plain_braces.icon: Plain medium-grey braces, simple steel clips, unadorned tan leather tabs, clean and unremarkable.

sturdy_braces.name: Sturdy Braces
sturdy_braces.description: Cut from horse-blanket webbing at a Gower Gulch saddlery for a cowboy extra who kept splitting his trousers on horseback.
sturdy_braces.icon: Thick brown woven braces with double-stitched seams, heavy iron buckles, rawhide button loops.

good_braces.name: Good Braces
good_braces.description: Proper braces with proper buttonholes, the sort a man buys once he has stopped expecting the bank to fail. In 1930 that makes them an optimist's purchase.
good_braces.icon: Burgundy silk-faced braces, polished brass adjusters, crisp white kid-leather tabs, neat and glossy.

worn_leather_belt.name: Worn Leather Belt
worn_leather_belt.description: Notched well past the original holes by a man who was getting thinner, then cut short by one who wasn't.
worn_leather_belt.icon: Cracked dark brown leather belt coiled loosely, extra knife-punched holes, dull pitted iron buckle.

leather_belt_of_agility.name: Leather Belt of Agility
leather_belt_of_agility.description: Mack Sennett's stunt department wore this one through a decade of pratfalls off moving streetcars. The leather bends like willow and the buckle has never let go mid-tumble.
leather_belt_of_agility.icon: Supple tan leather belt with green stitching, slim silver buckle, a small silver star rivet near the tip.

leather_belt_of_stamina.name: Leather Belt of Stamina
leather_belt_of_stamina.description: Oil-field leather from Signal Hill, made for twelve-hour shifts and a man who ate his lunch standing up.
leather_belt_of_stamina.icon: Wide thick dark chestnut belt, heavy square iron buckle, double row of stitching, faint black oil stain along one edge.

leather_belt_of_spirit.name: Leather Belt of Spirit
leather_belt_of_spirit.description: Whoever tooled the little wild roses along this belt did it slowly, on porch evenings, for no reason but the pleasure of it. Some of that patience still clings to the leather.
leather_belt_of_spirit.icon: Honey-brown belt tooled with a wild-rose pattern, small oval silver buckle, soft pale blue stitching.

leather_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Leather Belt of the Acrobat
leather_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Traded for a sandwich behind a circus wagon parked in Edendale by a wire walker between engagements. She swore it had saved her twice when the net was only a rumour.
leather_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: Narrow black leather belt with bright red stitching, small brass safety ring, a tiny brass trapeze-bar charm.

leather_belt_of_the_stevedore.name: Leather Belt of the Stevedore
leather_belt_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, salted stiff and smelling of tar and coffee sacks. The buckle carries a dent where a cargo hook found it instead of its owner.
leather_belt_of_the_stevedore.icon: Salt-stained grey-brown leather belt, heavy brass buckle with a deep dent, tar-black edges, small steel cargo-hook charm.

leather_belt_of_the_deacon.name: Leather Belt of the Deacon
leather_belt_of_the_deacon.description: Belted on each morning beneath a black coat for street-corner preaching at Hollywood and Cahuenga. The fourth hole is worn smooth; the fifth, reserved for church suppers, hardly at all.
leather_belt_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain black leather belt, small brass buckle stamped with a simple cross, thin purple ribbon looped through the keeper.

patched_leather_belt.name: Patched Leather Belt
patched_leather_belt.description: Split once at the buckle and riveted back together by a cobbler on Cahuenga for a nickel.
patched_leather_belt.icon: Brown belt with a copper-riveted repair patch near the buckle, mismatched leather segment, scuffed brass buckle.

plain_leather_belt.name: Plain Leather Belt
plain_leather_belt.description: Brown cowhide, brass buckle, five holes. Nothing about it would interest a costume designer, which is a mercy.
plain_leather_belt.icon: Plain brown cowhide belt neatly coiled, simple brass roller buckle, clean cut edges.

sturdy_leather_belt.name: Sturdy Leather Belt
sturdy_leather_belt.description: Harness leather from the Gower Gulch saddlery, stitched to hold a holster and a man's dignity on a rearing horse.
sturdy_leather_belt.icon: Thick dark brown harness-leather belt, wide stitched edges, heavy nickel buckle, two steel loops for a holster.

good_leather_belt.name: Good Leather Belt
good_leather_belt.description: Oiled, polished and pressed flat under a stack of old Variety issues, it would pass muster at the Brown Derby so long as nobody looks at the shoes.
good_leather_belt.icon: Glossy oxblood leather belt, polished gold-tone buckle, neat cream edge stitching.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.description: Fender, bedspring and somebody's Model T door, beaten flat enough to carry. Every machine shop on the lot will take it, no questions about where it came from.
scrap_metal.icon: Small jumbled pile of scrap: a bent dull grey steel bracket, a rusty orange bolt and a twisted strip of dented sheet metal, edges jagged

chitin_shard.name: Chitin Shard
chitin_shard.description: Lighter than tin and harder than a landlord's heart. It still rattles faintly when the wind comes off the hills.
chitin_shard.icon: Single curved shard of insect shell, iridescent green-black on top, pale dull underside, one broken jagged edge and a faint oily sheen

coyote_pelt.name: Coyote Pelt
coyote_pelt.description: Burrs in the fur and a smell of chaparral. The Gower Gulch saddlery pays fair, and the coyotes have stopped complaining.
coyote_pelt.icon: Folded tawny-grey coyote hide with a bushy black-tipped tail hanging off one side, rough pale leather underside showing at the fold

invader_gland.name: Invader Gland
invader_gland.description: Wrap it twice and keep it upright. The Boulevard druggists swear it is medicine once boiled, and nobody has asked them to swear twice.
invader_gland.icon: Bulbous translucent sickly yellow-green gland sac, veined, tied off at one end with brown string, a single drip of acid at the bottom

brass_casings.name: Brass Casings
brass_casings.description: Swept from the Legion firing line and the gutters of Hollywood and Vine alike. Brass is brass, and Stembridge reloads anything.
brass_casings.icon: Small stack of spent brass cartridge casings, bright yellow metal with darkened open mouths and dull primer ends, one lying on its side

wool_cloth.name: Wool Cloth
wool_cloth.description: Cut from a bolt the wardrobe department never got to bill anyone for. Plain charcoal, the colour of half the extras' suits in town.
wool_cloth.icon: Neatly folded bolt of charcoal grey wool cloth, frayed cut edge, tied with a thin length of white cotton tape

white_sage.name: White Sage
white_sage.description: Picked on the dry slopes above the Vermont Canyon camp. Burn a sprig and the hut smells like church; boil it and the nurses have their uses.
white_sage.icon: Bundle of silvery pale green white sage leaves tied tightly with coarse brown string, stems trimmed square at the base

hive_resin.name: Hive Resin
hive_resin.description: Warm to the touch long after it should have cooled, and something small is set inside it like a fly in amber. Men who dig it out of the Tunnels do not talk much afterward.
hive_resin.icon: Irregular lump of glowing amber hive resin, honey-orange and translucent, a dark tiny insect shape suspended inside, sticky drips along the base

elder_chitin_plate.name: Elder Chitin Plate
elder_chitin_plate.description: Thick as a church door and twice as stubborn. It took a crowbar, a hacksaw and a bad afternoon on Mount Lee to pry this one loose.
elder_chitin_plate.icon: Broad heavy curved plate of insect armour, deep green-black with violet iridescence, ridged surface, chipped thick edges and old scratch marks

tailored_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.name: Tailored Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat
tailored_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.description: Let out at the shoulders by a Universal wardrobe girl for a leading man who never came back from the backlot. It still hangs as if waiting for applause.
tailored_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.icon: Crisp charcoal single-breasted suit coat with sharp peaked lapels, a folded white pocket square and clean pressed wool, buttons polished black horn.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_intelle.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of Intellect
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_intelle.description: The inside pocket held a fountain pen and a studio contract annotated in three inks. Its owner read every clause twice, which is how he noticed the studio had quietly stopped hiring people.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_intelle.icon: Navy wool suit coat with notched lapels, a black fountain pen clipped in the breast pocket and a glimpse of pale blue silk lining.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_spirit.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of Spirit
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_spirit.description: Smells faintly of orange blossom and pipe tobacco. Somebody wore it to sit on a Studio City porch every evening, invasion or no invasion, and slept soundly afterward.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_spirit.icon: Soft brown tweed suit coat with a cream pocket square and a small sprig of white orange blossom tucked in the lapel buttonhole.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_stamina.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of Stamina
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_stamina.description: Worn by a stunt double through three falls, two fires and one Hardened Drone on the Pass road. The lining was replaced twice. The man inside it, never.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_stamina.icon: Thick grey worsted suit coat with doubled stitching across the shoulders, a dark red lining showing at the open front, slightly scuffed elbows.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_eng.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of the Engineer
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_eng.description: Solder burns on the left cuff and a slide rule's ghost worn into the breast pocket. The sound man who owned it lived on coffee and would not take it off, even down in the cable vaults.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_eng.icon: Dark olive suit coat with a wooden slide rule poking from the breast pocket, a tiny brass wrench pin on the lapel and a scorched cuff.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_doc.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of the Doctor
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_doc.description: Taken off a hook after a house call in Toluca Lake, iodine on the sleeve and a stethoscope still curled in the side pocket. The doctor charged two dollars a visit and has not been seen since the hive reached the Valley.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_doc.icon: Charcoal suit coat with a black rubber stethoscope coiled out of the side pocket, a brown iodine stain on one sleeve and a small white enamel cross pin.

hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_dea.name: Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat of the Deacon
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_dea.description: Sunday best for a deacon who walked to Angelus Temple from the Pass each week rather than pay the fare. Hymnal dust lives in the pockets, along with a collection envelope, still sealed.
hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat_of_the_dea.icon: Sober black suit coat with a purple ribbon bookmark trailing from the breast pocket and a small brass cross pinned to the lapel.

heavy_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.name: Heavy Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat
heavy_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.description: Winter weight, which in Los Angeles means a man sweated through it in October and called it armour. Lately nobody laughs at that.
heavy_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.icon: Bulky dark brown heavyweight wool suit coat with broad lapels, thick felt-like cloth and large horn buttons, sitting stiff and square.

reinforced_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.name: Reinforced Hart Schaffner & Marx Suit Coat
reinforced_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.description: Canvas sewn behind the lapels and leather riveted over the shoulders by a Burbank tailor. The client insisted on looking presentable for whatever came for him next.
reinforced_hart_schaffner_marx_suit_coat.icon: Grey suit coat with tan canvas panels stitched inside the lapels, riveted dark leather shoulder patches and heavy steel-grey seam stitching.

superior_silk_top_hat.name: Superior Silk Top Hat
superior_silk_top_hat.description: Blocked by a Vine Street hatter who swore it would outlast the man beneath it. So far he has been right about every customer.
superior_silk_top_hat.icon: Tall black silk top hat with glossy nap, crisp curled brim, wide black grosgrain band, pristine and sharply blocked, faint satin sheen on the crown.

silk_top_hat_of_intellect.name: Silk Top Hat of Intellect
silk_top_hat_of_intellect.description: Left on a hook at the Writers' table in Musso & Frank's. The lining holds four pencil stubs and a contract with every clause underlined twice.
silk_top_hat_of_intellect.icon: Black silk top hat, upright crown, curled brim, slate-blue band with a small brass pencil-shaped pin tucked into it, folded paper peeking from the band.

silk_top_hat_of_spirit.name: Silk Top Hat of Spirit
silk_top_hat_of_spirit.description: A retired tenor wore it to every Greek Theatre concert that first summer and hummed all the way home. Something of the humming seems to have stayed in the crown.
silk_top_hat_of_spirit.icon: Black silk top hat, slightly taller crown, soft curled brim, pale gold band with a tiny white carnation tucked at the side, warm gentle sheen.

silk_top_hat_of_stamina.name: Silk Top Hat of Stamina
silk_top_hat_of_stamina.description: Its last owner stood through a six-hour premiere line at Grauman's, a three-reel speech and a hive surge on the forecourt. The hat was the only one who complained less.
silk_top_hat_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy black silk top hat, thick reinforced brim with stitched edge, deep oxblood red band, slightly dented crown that has been punched back into shape.

silk_top_hat_of_the_engineer.name: Silk Top Hat of the Engineer
silk_top_hat_of_the_engineer.description: Belonged to a Lockheed draughtsman who wore it to the office on principle. A slide rule fits the crown exactly, which he claimed was the whole point.
silk_top_hat_of_the_engineer.icon: Black silk top hat, flat-topped crown, curled brim, steel-grey band with a small brass gear-and-wrench charm, thin slide rule tucked under the band.

silk_top_hat_of_the_doctor.name: Silk Top Hat of the Doctor
silk_top_hat_of_the_doctor.description: House calls on the Hollywood Hills meant a hat that commanded the door. The doctor kept a tongue depressor in the band and a calm voice for frightened maids.
silk_top_hat_of_the_doctor.icon: Black silk top hat, polished crown, curled brim, white band with a small red cross enamel pin, wooden tongue depressor slipped beside it.

silk_top_hat_of_the_deacon.name: Silk Top Hat of the Deacon
silk_top_hat_of_the_deacon.description: Worn every Sunday on the long walk to Angelus Temple and lifted to every widow along the way. The brim still smells faintly of hymnals and lilies.
silk_top_hat_of_the_deacon.icon: Black silk top hat, modest crown, softly worn curled brim, deep purple band with a short ribbon bookmark trailing from it, small lily sprig tucked in.

chitin_lined_silk_top_hat.name: Chitin-lined Silk Top Hat
chitin_lined_silk_top_hat.description: A Burbank milliner stitched shell into the crown after a Flier took the hat off a banker, and the top of the banker with it. Opening nights now come with precautions.
chitin_lined_silk_top_hat.icon: Black silk top hat with crisp brim, crown edge split slightly to show iridescent green-black chitin lining inside, dark band stitched with coarse thread.

chitin_plated_silk_top_hat.name: Chitin-plated Silk Top Hat
chitin_plated_silk_top_hat.description: The silk is mostly ceremony now, stretched over plates prised from a Soldier's back. Formal wear for the end of the world, or at least the end of Mount Lee.
chitin_plated_silk_top_hat.icon: Tall top hat armoured in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, scraps of black silk at the seams, rigid shell brim, riveted brass band.

brass_ring_of_strength.name: Brass Ring of Strength
brass_ring_of_strength.description: Pried from the finger of a Pacific Electric brakeman who could lift a stalled red car's coupling by himself. The brass has gone a little oval from the strain.
brass_ring_of_strength.icon: Thick plain brass band seen straight on, slightly oval and dented, heavy flat face stamped with a small anvil emblem, dull yellow metal with brown tarnish in the grooves.

brass_ring_of_agility.name: Brass Ring of Agility
brass_ring_of_agility.description: Won at a Venice pier ring-toss, or so its last owner said, a pickpocket who worked Grauman's forecourt. He was quick enough to lift a wallet and not quite quick enough to outrun a Drone.
brass_ring_of_agility.icon: Slim brass ring seen straight on, narrow polished band with a tiny winged-foot emblem engraved on the face, bright yellow brass with a thin green enamel line.

brass_ring_of_stamina.name: Brass Ring of Stamina
brass_ring_of_stamina.description: Factory brass, worn by a night watchman who climbed the Taft Building's stairs twice a shift for eleven years. Neither he nor the ring ever sat down.
brass_ring_of_stamina.icon: Wide heavy brass band straight on, broad flat profile with rounded edges, inset with a small oxblood-red glass bead, warm brass with darker scuffed patina.

brass_ring_of_intellect.name: Brass Ring of Intellect
brass_ring_of_intellect.description: Its inside is engraved with a crossword answer nobody at the Hollywood Citizen could ever confirm. The previous owner, a proofreader, considered this proof of his own genius.
brass_ring_of_intellect.icon: Brass signet ring straight on, oval face set with a small polished blue glass stone, faint engraved lines around the band, clean bright yellow brass.

brass_ring_of_spirit.name: Brass Ring of Spirit
brass_ring_of_spirit.description: Somebody's grandmother wore it through the San Francisco quake and two husbands. It still carries a calm the Dome has not managed to crack.
brass_ring_of_spirit.icon: Thin worn brass ring straight on, delicate band with a tiny milky-white glass cabochon, soft rubbed brass with a faint pearl sheen.

brass_ring_of_the_boxer.name: Brass Ring of the Boxer
brass_ring_of_the_boxer.description: Ringside at the Legion Stadium, a middleweight hung this on a nail before every Friday bout and swore it was why he never went down. He went down eventually. The ring held up fine.
brass_ring_of_the_boxer.icon: Chunky brass ring straight on, squared knuckle-heavy band with a small red enamel boxing-glove charm soldered to the face, bright brass with small dents.

brass_ring_of_the_acrobat.name: Brass Ring of the Acrobat
brass_ring_of_the_acrobat.description: Bent from a trapeze swivel on a Christie comedy set by a stuntwoman who did her own falls and billed the studio for none of them.
brass_ring_of_the_acrobat.icon: Twisted brass ring straight on, band formed from a spiral of brass wire with a small swivel loop on top, polished yellow brass with a sky-blue thread wrapped once.

brass_ring_of_the_stevedore.name: Brass Ring of the Stevedore
brass_ring_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro in a longshoreman's pocket, along with a cargo hook and a grudge against the shipping line. The salt is still in the grooves.
brass_ring_of_the_stevedore.icon: Heavy brass ring straight on, rope-twist pattern band with a tiny anchor emblem on the face, brass dulled by white salt crust and a green verdigris spot.

brass_ring_of_the_marksman.name: Brass Ring of the Marksman
brass_ring_of_the_marksman.description: Filed with a fine cross-hair by a Griffith Park ranger who hit what he aimed at and liked a reminder close to hand. He traded it for a box of .30-06 the week the Dome came down.
brass_ring_of_the_marksman.icon: Slim brass ring straight on, flat round face engraved with a fine cross-hair notch, polished yellow brass with a black enamel circle around the sight mark.

brass_ring_of_the_engineer.name: Brass Ring of the Engineer
brass_ring_of_the_engineer.description: Machined from a stage-light housing in the Warner Bros. electrical shop by a juicer with time to kill during a twelve-day retake. It runs slightly warm, which he swore was a design feature.
brass_ring_of_the_engineer.icon: Machined brass ring straight on, faceted hexagonal band shaped like a nut, a tiny steel wrench charm hanging from it, brass with grey steel accents.

brass_ring_of_the_doctor.name: Brass Ring of the Doctor
brass_ring_of_the_doctor.description: A Hollywood Presbyterian nurse turned it on her finger while she counted pulses, and one side is rubbed bright from the habit. It smells faintly of carbolic.
brass_ring_of_the_doctor.icon: Smooth brass ring straight on, one side rubbed bright, small white enamel disc with a red cross emblem on the face, clean yellow brass.

brass_ring_of_the_deacon.name: Brass Ring of the Deacon
brass_ring_of_the_deacon.description: Handed out at an Angelus Temple altar call, it still smells of hymnals and the long walk up from the red-car stop. Sister Aimee's people insist it has never once been near a hip flask.
brass_ring_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain brass ring straight on, simple rounded band with a short purple hymnal ribbon tied through it, warm brass with faint scratches.

fine_tool_belt.name: Fine Tool Belt
fine_tool_belt.description: Canvas stitched tight, and loops that still hold a hammer upright. A grip on the Mulholland Dam crew bought it new in August and has not been seen since the Dome came down.
fine_tool_belt.icon: Coiled padded tool belt in clean khaki duck canvas, neat tan leather tool loops, two square pouches with crisp stitching, bright steel buckle.

tool_belt_of_agility.name: Tool Belt of Agility
tool_belt_of_agility.description: Belonged to a rigger who worked the catwalks at Universal, forty feet up with nothing under him but a painted set. The loops sit flat, so nothing snags on the way down a rope.
tool_belt_of_agility.icon: Slim canvas tool belt with flat low-profile loops, green-dyed stitching along the edge, a coil of thin manila rope clipped at one hip, small steel buckle.

tool_belt_of_strength.name: Tool Belt of Strength
tool_belt_of_strength.description: Built to carry a sledge, two crowbars and a lunch pail without complaint. The carpenter who wore it on the Paramount lot could lift a flat by himself, and charged the union rate for two.
tool_belt_of_strength.icon: Heavy brown canvas tool belt with one wide iron hammer loop, broad blackened iron buckle, red-stitched edging, a single deep pouch.

tool_belt_of_stamina.name: Tool Belt of Stamina
tool_belt_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched along every seam by a wife who expected her husband home for supper. He kept coming home, through three studio fires and one invader on the Cahuenga Pass road.
tool_belt_of_stamina.icon: Thick quilted canvas tool belt with a padded back panel, doubled seams in navy thread, plain brass buckle, worn but sound leather loops.

tool_belt_of_the_boxer.name: Tool Belt of the Boxer
tool_belt_of_the_boxer.description: A grip from Poverty Row wore it to the Legion Stadium every Friday night, and once into the ring by mistake. He went two rounds before anyone noticed, and won on points.
tool_belt_of_the_boxer.icon: Sturdy canvas tool belt with oxblood leather loops, a small red boxing-glove pin fixed to one pouch flap, dull steel buckle.

tool_belt_of_the_marksman.name: Tool Belt of the Marksman
tool_belt_of_the_marksman.description: Stembridge armourers fitted a row of cartridge loops beside the screwdriver pocket. Its last owner kept a running count in pencil inside the strap and was never once off by a round.
tool_belt_of_the_marksman.icon: Khaki canvas tool belt with a row of brass cartridge loops between tool pockets, a small cross-hair notch stamped into the steel buckle.

tool_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Tool Belt of the Acrobat
tool_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen borrowed it off the Sennett crew for fall work, since a belt that stays shut through a forty-foot tumble is worth more than the man inside it, according to the accounts department.
tool_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slim fitted tool belt with elastic side straps, yellow stitching, a quick-release lever buckle, a small brass ring charm swinging from one loop.

tool_belt_of_the_engineer.name: Tool Belt of the Engineer
tool_belt_of_the_engineer.description: Pockets for pliers, fuse wire, a slide rule and the spare lamp bulbs nobody else remembered. The electrician who owned it rewired half the Hollywood Bowl by flashlight and kept every receipt.
tool_belt_of_the_engineer.icon: Canvas tool belt crowded with pouches, a coil of copper wire tucked in one loop, blue-thread stitching, a small brass wrench charm on the buckle.

pressed_tool_belt.name: Pressed Tool Belt
pressed_tool_belt.description: Starched canvas is a peculiar studio vanity, but the Universal wardrobe department pressed everything that came through its door, this included. The crease on the pouch flaps survived a week on the backlot.
pressed_tool_belt.icon: Crisp off-white canvas tool belt with sharply creased pouch flaps, pale tan leather loops, polished nickel buckle.

tailored_tool_belt.name: Tailored Tool Belt
tailored_tool_belt.description: Cut to measure for a set dresser who wanted his hammer to hang at the exact angle of a gentleman's walking stick. He billed the studio for the fitting under props.
tailored_tool_belt.icon: Curved, shaped tool belt in slate-grey canvas with fine cream contrast stitching, slim fitted loops, bevelled polished brass buckle.

heavy_tool_belt.name: Heavy Tool Belt
heavy_tool_belt.description: Riveted at every stress point and lined with a second layer of duck, it was made for men prying hive spires off the Universal backlot with crowbars. The weight settles on the hips like a mortgage.
heavy_tool_belt.icon: Thick dark olive canvas tool belt reinforced with copper rivets, steel-capped pouch corners, double-layered strap, broad iron roller buckle.

reinforced_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.name: Reinforced Pendleton-lined Riding Coat
reinforced_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.description: Saddle-stitched twice over by the Gower Gulch saddlery, who charge for the second row and mean it. The blanket lining still remembers a horse.
reinforced_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.icon: Long brown leather riding coat with split tail, heavy double stitching along seams, red-and-black plaid wool lining showing at turned-back lapels, thick leather shoulder patches.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_agility.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of Agility
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_agility.description: Rode with a trick rider from the Tom Mix outfit, a man who could drop off one side of a galloping horse and come up the other with his hat still on.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_agility.icon: Tan leather riding coat with deep split tail flaring outward, navy-and-cream plaid wool lining at lapels, small silver spur charm hanging from the top buttonhole.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_stamina.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of Stamina
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_stamina.description: Built for night herding across the Burbank flats, where the wind comes cold off the Dome and the coyotes sing until dawn. The lining is thick enough to sleep in, and someone did.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_stamina.icon: Dark chestnut leather riding coat, long and heavy, buttoned high with a tall collar, thick green-and-black plaid wool lining, fleece-rolled cuffs.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_spirit.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of Spirit
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_spirit.description: A circuit rider's coat, worn through three revivals and one flood. The inside pocket holds the shape of a small Testament, and the lining smells faintly of woodsmoke and patience.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_spirit.icon: Weathered brown leather riding coat with split tail, soft blue-and-white plaid wool lining, small worn black book shape pressing through the breast pocket.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_acrob.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of the Acrobat
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_acrob.description: Stuntmen at the Mack Sennett lot favoured it for falls off moving buckboards: the wool lining eats the landing and the leather shrugs off the gravel.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_acrob.icon: Light tan leather riding coat with split tail mid-swing, orange-and-brown plaid lining, scuffed elbows, a small brass tumbling-figure pin on the lapel.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_steve.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of the Stevedore
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_steve.description: Came up from San Pedro on a lumber truck, its owner hired to wrangle horses and paid to unload hay. He said the horses were easier to talk to.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_steve.icon: Broad-shouldered dark brown leather riding coat, rope-burn scuffs on the sleeves, grey-and-red plaid lining, small iron cargo hook charm at the collar.

pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_deaco.name: Pendleton-lined Riding Coat of the Deacon
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_deaco.description: Every Sunday its owner rode from Studio City to Angelus Temple on a slow mare, rehearsing hymns the whole way. The mare learned the tunes first.
pendleton_lined_riding_coat_of_the_deaco.icon: Long black-brown leather riding coat with split tail, cream-and-burgundy plaid lining, a thin purple hymnal ribbon tied through the top buttonhole.

superior_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.name: Superior Pendleton-lined Riding Coat
superior_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.description: Cut by a Burbank tailor who once dressed a Western star and never let anyone forget it. The leather is supple, the lining is the good plaid.
superior_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.icon: Crisp glossy cognac leather riding coat with sharp lapels, polished brass buttons, bright red-and-gold plaid wool lining, clean even stitching, split tail neatly pressed.

chitin_lined_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.name: Chitin-lined Pendleton-lined Riding Coat
chitin_lined_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.description: Somewhere under the plaid, a sheet of invader shell rides against the ribs. It creaks in cold weather, and horses do not care for the smell.
chitin_lined_pendleton_lined_riding_coat.icon: Dark brown leather riding coat with plaid wool lining, iridescent green-black insect shell panel peeking from inside the opened front, shell-edged cuffs.

chitin_plated_pendleton_lined_riding_coa.name: Chitin-plated Pendleton-lined Riding Coat
chitin_plated_pendleton_lined_riding_coa.description: Plates of drone shell are riveted across the shoulders now, green-black and faintly warm. The blanket lining is the only part still from before the Dome.
chitin_plated_pendleton_lined_riding_coa.icon: Heavy leather riding coat with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates riveted across shoulders and chest, brass rivets, red-and-black plaid lining visible at split tail.

reinforced_football_shoulder_pads.name: Reinforced Football Shoulder Pads
reinforced_football_shoulder_pads.description: Extra canvas and a second layer of felt, stitched on after a Brute treated the first set like a tackling dummy.
reinforced_football_shoulder_pads.icon: Bulky tan leather football shoulder pads with rounded caps, extra canvas strips riveted over the arches, brown rawhide laces down the chest.

football_shoulder_pads_of_agility.name: Football Shoulder Pads of Agility
football_shoulder_pads_of_agility.description: Off a USC halfback who ran the Coliseum sideline like it owed him money. Howard Jones would have liked him faster; the invaders would have liked him slower.
football_shoulder_pads_of_agility.icon: Slim light-tan leather football shoulder pads with small rounded caps, cardinal red laces, a tiny gold winged-foot pin on one cap.

football_shoulder_pads_of_strength.name: Football Shoulder Pads of Strength
football_shoulder_pads_of_strength.description: Lineman's pads, broad as a door and nearly as heavy. The previous owner pushed a stalled red car half a block in these, then complained about his lunch.
football_shoulder_pads_of_strength.icon: Very wide dark brown leather football shoulder pads with massive domed caps, thick felt edging, heavy iron buckles, black rawhide laces.

football_shoulder_pads_of_stamina.name: Football Shoulder Pads of Stamina
football_shoulder_pads_of_stamina.description: Sixty minutes both ways was the rule, and these pads played every one of them. The leather is cracked at the seams from a season that never quite ended.
football_shoulder_pads_of_stamina.icon: Thick worn brown leather football shoulder pads, cracked seams, deep quilted felt underlayer, green laces, a stitched patch over one cap.

football_shoulder_pads_of_the_boxer.name: Football Shoulder Pads of the Boxer
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_boxer.description: Under a sweater at Legion Stadium, a heavyweight wore these and claimed it was for his posture. The referee let it go, having seen him punch.
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_boxer.icon: Compact tan leather football shoulder pads with rounded caps, white laces, a small red boxing glove pin fixed to the chest strap.

football_shoulder_pads_of_the_marksman.name: Football Shoulder Pads of the Marksman
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_marksman.description: Its quarterback could hit a receiver's hands at forty yards in a crosswind. Now he hits spitters at the same range with a Springfield and says the spiral matters less.
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_marksman.icon: Tan leather football shoulder pads with neat caps, navy laces, a small brass cross-hair notch disc stitched onto the left cap.

football_shoulder_pads_of_the_acrobat.name: Football Shoulder Pads of the Acrobat
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_acrobat.description: Taken off a stunt double who stood in for players because nobody else would tumble on frozen sod for scale. Flexible at the shoulder, forgiving at the landing.
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_acrobat.icon: Lightweight tan leather football shoulder pads with hinged split caps, yellow laces, grass-stained felt, a tiny brass tumbler charm on the strap.

football_shoulder_pads_of_the_engineer.name: Football Shoulder Pads of the Engineer
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_engineer.description: Lockheed draughtsmen played Saturday ball against the Burbank firemen, and one reworked the hinge on these with a slide rule. He lost the game but won the argument.
football_shoulder_pads_of_the_engineer.icon: Tan leather football shoulder pads with a visible brass hinge mechanism at each cap, grey laces, a small steel wrench charm hanging from the chest strap.

superior_football_shoulder_pads.name: Superior Football Shoulder Pads
superior_football_shoulder_pads.description: Fresh from a sporting goods store on Hollywood Boulevard that will never see its rent paid. The felt is new and the leather has not yet heard a whistle.
superior_football_shoulder_pads.icon: Pristine glossy honey-brown leather football shoulder pads, clean white felt edging, bright new white laces, polished nickel buckles, crisp even stitching.

chitin_lined_football_shoulder_pads.name: Chitin-lined Football Shoulder Pads
chitin_lined_football_shoulder_pads.description: Behind the felt sits a curved slab of soldier shell, cut to fit the collarbone. The equipment manager who made them still will not say where he got the template.
chitin_lined_football_shoulder_pads.icon: Brown leather football shoulder pads with rounded caps, iridescent green-black insect shell visible beneath the lifted felt edge, dark laces.

chitin_plated_football_shoulder_pads.name: Chitin-plated Football Shoulder Pads
chitin_plated_football_shoulder_pads.description: Overlapping shell plates turn a quarterback into something closer to the enemy than anyone at USC intended. Men on Mount Lee swear the pads hum when the hive is near.
chitin_plated_football_shoulder_pads.icon: Massive football shoulder pads armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates over each cap, brass rivets, scraps of brown leather and laces beneath.

worn_steel_bracers.name: Worn Steel Bracers
worn_steel_bracers.description: Somebody's arms were in these when the Dome came down. The rust says he never bothered to oil them, and the dent says he should have ducked.
worn_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of curved steel wrist guards, dull grey with orange rust blooms, frayed brown leather straps, one deep dent across the face of the nearer plate.

steel_bracers_of_strength.name: Steel Bracers of Strength
steel_bracers_of_strength.description: Hammered out in a Paramount machine shop by a blacksmith who swore he had shod every horse in every Western since 1914. He bent the second plate cold, just to make a point.
steel_bracers_of_strength.icon: Pair of polished steel bracers, wide and thick-edged, black leather straps, a small red enamel anvil stud riveted near each buckle.

steel_bracers_of_stamina.name: Steel Bracers of Stamina
steel_bracers_of_stamina.description: Lined with felt cut from an old billiard table at the Hollywood Hotel. The plates take the beating, the felt takes the sweat, and the wearer takes the rest of the night shift.
steel_bracers_of_stamina.icon: Pair of steel bracers with rounded edges, green felt lining showing at the cuffs, tan leather straps, small brass buckles shaped like padlocks.

steel_bracers_of_the_boxer.name: Steel Bracers of the Boxer
steel_bracers_of_the_boxer.description: Taped over at the Legion Stadium by a corner man who wanted his heavyweight to block with his forearms instead of his chin. The heavyweight lost on points but kept every tooth.
steel_bracers_of_the_boxer.icon: Pair of steel bracers partly wrapped in off-white boxing tape, red leather straps, a tiny brass boxing-glove pin fixed at the wrist.

steel_bracers_of_the_stevedore.name: Steel Bracers of the Stevedore
steel_bracers_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks with salt in the rivets and a longshoreman's habit of catching cargo hooks before they caught him. Still smells faintly of tar and banana boats.
steel_bracers_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pair of weathered blue-grey steel bracers, white salt crust around the rivets, hemp rope lacing instead of straps, a small iron cargo-hook charm.

patched_steel_bracers.name: Patched Steel Bracers
patched_steel_bracers.description: Mended with a stove bolt and a strip of harness leather. Cheaper than new, and the bolt only falls out on Tuesdays.
patched_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of scuffed steel bracers, one plate split and joined with a crude bolt, mismatched brown and black leather patch straps.

plain_steel_bracers.name: Plain Steel Bracers
plain_steel_bracers.description: Standard issue from a Legion supply locker, stencilled once and painted over twice. Nobody will look at them, which is rather the idea.
plain_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of simple steel bracers, flat olive-drab paint chipped at the edges, plain tan canvas straps, plain steel buckles.

sturdy_steel_bracers.name: Sturdy Steel Bracers
sturdy_steel_bracers.description: Riveted from boiler plate at a Gower Gulch smithy that usually did horseshoes. The smith charged extra for the left one, citing artistic difficulty.
sturdy_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of thick steel bracers with a row of heavy dome rivets, dark gunmetal grey, wide brown saddle-leather straps, iron buckles.

good_steel_bracers.name: Good Steel Bracers
good_steel_bracers.description: Proper work, with a rolled edge that will not bite the inside of the elbow. Studio grips bought them by the dozen once a Drone got into the scenery dock.
good_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of clean steel bracers with neatly rolled edges, bright grey metal, oiled dark-brown straps, small brass rivets.

fine_steel_bracers.name: Fine Steel Bracers
fine_steel_bracers.description: Polished bright enough for a costume picture, then pressed into service for real. The wardrobe tag was snipped off, though a fitter's chalk mark lingers inside.
fine_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of gleaming mirror-bright steel bracers, black calfskin straps, nickel buckles, a faint white chalk mark on the inner edge.

pressed_steel_bracers.name: Pressed Steel Bracers
pressed_steel_bracers.description: Stamped in one piece on a Lockheed press before the Burbank shop went quiet. Light, tight and uniform like everything the aeroplane men made, and harder to dent than they look.
pressed_steel_bracers.icon: Pair of seamless pressed steel bracers with a raised stamped ridge down the centre, satin silver finish, crisp black straps, square chrome buckles.

cracked_chitin_plate.name: Cracked Chitin Plate
cracked_chitin_plate.description: A shard of invader shell, green-black and lighter than it looks. The crack runs clean through, which is the only reason anyone got it off the original owner.
cracked_chitin_plate.icon: A single curved shard of green-black iridescent insect shell, a jagged crack running across its middle, chipped pale edges and a faint oily rainbow sheen.

newsreel_film_can.name: Newsreel Film Can
newsreel_film_can.description: Somebody's cameraman got the first week of the Dome on film and never made it back to the lab. The lid is dented, and the tape still holds.
newsreel_film_can.icon: A flat round film tin in dull silver, its lid dented on one side, sealed around the rim with yellowed tape, a small blank paper label.

spitter_gland.name: Spitter Gland
spitter_gland.description: Warm, swollen and faintly sloshing. The druggist on Highland wants it intact, and the acid inside has firm opinions about gloves.
spitter_gland.icon: A swollen translucent amber-green gland sac laced with dark veins, a bead of glowing yellow acid hanging from its torn stalk.

brown_derby_coffee_tin.name: Brown Derby Coffee Tin
brown_derby_coffee_tin.description: The Derby brewed coffee strong enough to wake a director before noon. This tin came through the siege half full, which on Vine Street now counts as a fortune.
brown_derby_coffee_tin.icon: A round coffee tin in brown enamel with a small cream derby-hat shape painted on its side, pry lid slightly ajar, a few dark beans spilling.

call_box_key.name: Call-box Key
call_box_key.description: Opens the iron police box on the corner, the one with a line straight to the station. Patrolmen guard these closer than their pensions.
call_box_key.icon: A heavy brass key with a stubby triangular bit and round ring bow, tied with a scrap of navy blue cord to a small blank brass tag.

reel_of_robin_hood.name: Reel of Robin Hood
reel_of_robin_hood.description: Fairbanks leapt across this one at the Egyptian's grand opening in 1922. Sid Grauman would like it back on the projector, with every leap intact.
reel_of_robin_hood.icon: A large steel film reel wound thick with dark film, a loose strip curling off the edge, a band of forest green ribbon tied round the hub.

grauman_s_note.name: Grauman's Note
grauman_s_note.description: Hotel stationery, a showman's flourishing hand, and a postscript twice the length of the note. Grauman never wrote a short anything in his life.
grauman_s_note.icon: A folded cream letter sheet covered in illegible looping ink strokes, a red wax seal smudged at the fold, one corner dog-eared.

superior_louisville_slugger.name: Superior Louisville Slugger
superior_louisville_slugger.description: Seasoned ash, turned true and oiled by a sporting-goods clerk on the Boulevard who swore it was game-ready. The game has changed somewhat since.
superior_louisville_slugger.icon: Full-length baseball bat, clean pale honey ash with a glossy finish, a blank dark burned oval on the barrel, neat black friction tape on the handle.

louisville_slugger_of_strength.name: Louisville Slugger of Strength
louisville_slugger_of_strength.description: Taken from a batboy's rack at Wrigley Field after the Hollywood Stars' last home game. It has since sent a Drone's head farther than any ball that season, though the scorekeepers declined to count it.
louisville_slugger_of_strength.icon: Baseball bat in deep amber ash, red tape wrapped on the grip, a small polished brass cap on the knob, a scuff mark across the barrel.

louisville_slugger_of_stamina.name: Louisville Slugger of Stamina
louisville_slugger_of_stamina.description: Its owner caught for eleven seasons in the Pacific Coast League and claimed nothing could hurt him after that many foul tips. He still sleeps with it under the cot.
louisville_slugger_of_stamina.icon: Baseball bat in scuffed light ash, navy blue tape on the handle, a short braided leather lanyard looped through a hole in the knob.

louisville_slugger_of_the_boxer.name: Louisville Slugger of the Boxer
louisville_slugger_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a heavyweight from Pasadena carried this into the ring as a gimmick. The referee never let him use it. The invaders have no referee.
louisville_slugger_of_the_boxer.icon: Baseball bat in reddish-brown ash, white tape on the grip, a tiny red boxing-glove pin tacked just above the knob.

louisville_slugger_of_the_stevedore.name: Louisville Slugger of the Stevedore
louisville_slugger_of_the_stevedore.description: Longshoremen played pepper with it on the San Pedro wharf at lunch, and the bat picked up the habit of swinging at anything thrown its way. Drones count.
louisville_slugger_of_the_stevedore.icon: Baseball bat in weathered grey-brown ash, handle wrapped in tarred hemp twine, a small iron anchor tag hanging from the knob.

chitin_lined_louisville_slugger.name: Chitin-lined Louisville Slugger
chitin_lined_louisville_slugger.description: Hollowed down the barrel and packed with invader shell, it swings heavier than regulation. No umpire under the Dome has lodged a complaint.
chitin_lined_louisville_slugger.icon: Baseball bat in dark ash, iridescent green-black chitin strips inlaid along the barrel, two brass bands holding them, black tape grip.

chitin_plated_louisville_slugger.name: Chitin-plated Louisville Slugger
chitin_plated_louisville_slugger.description: Every inch of the ash is sheathed in plates cut from a Soldier's back. The league would have suspended it. The man who carried it into the Hive Tunnels never came out to argue the point.
chitin_plated_louisville_slugger.icon: Baseball bat entirely sheathed in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, riveted with brass, a thick bulbous barrel and a dark leather grip.

superior_lineman_s_wrench.name: Superior Lineman's Wrench
superior_lineman_s_wrench.description: Drop-forged and heavy for its size, the kind the Bureau of Power and Light issued to men who climbed poles in the rain.
superior_lineman_s_wrench.icon: Long steel lineman's wrench with a ring socket head and a tapered spud end, clean bright grey steel, red-painted grip.

lineman_s_wrench_of_intellect.name: Lineman's Wrench of Intellect
lineman_s_wrench_of_intellect.description: A Warner Bros. electrician scratched wiring diagrams into the handle from memory, the night before the lot fell. Nobody else has been able to make sense of them.
lineman_s_wrench_of_intellect.icon: Steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, fine scratched line patterns covering the handle, yellow-painted grip.

lineman_s_wrench_of_spirit.name: Lineman's Wrench of Spirit
lineman_s_wrench_of_spirit.description: Kept in a toolbox beside a pocket Testament by a lineman who said a man forty feet up a pole needs a calm heart more than a good grip.
lineman_s_wrench_of_spirit.icon: Steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, green cloth-wrapped grip, a small brass medallion on a cord tied at the handle.

lineman_s_wrench_of_the_engineer.name: Lineman's Wrench of the Engineer
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_engineer.description: Union men at the IATSE hall called it the long argument, because it settled most of them. It has tightened a junction box on Stage 28 and loosened a Drone's jaw the same afternoon.
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_engineer.icon: Heavy steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, blue-painted grip, a tiny brass gear charm hanging from a ring.

lineman_s_wrench_of_the_doctor.name: Lineman's Wrench of the Doctor
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_doctor.description: Borrowed from a lineman to open a jammed oxygen valve at an aid station, it was never returned. The handle still smells faintly of iodine and carbolic.
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_doctor.icon: Steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, grip wrapped in white cotton tape with a small stitched red cross patch.

lineman_s_wrench_of_the_deacon.name: Lineman's Wrench of the Deacon
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_deacon.description: Carried on the long walk to Angelus Temple every Sunday, where its owner kept the KFSG transmitter humming between hymns. Sister Aimee was said to approve of practical faith.
lineman_s_wrench_of_the_deacon.icon: Steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, dark brown grip, a purple hymnal ribbon tied in a bow near the head.

chitin_lined_lineman_s_wrench.name: Chitin-lined Lineman's Wrench
chitin_lined_lineman_s_wrench.description: Spitter acid ate the grips off the old model, so somebody in Burbank lined them with shell instead. The acid has not yet found a way through.
chitin_lined_lineman_s_wrench.icon: Steel lineman's wrench with socket head and spud end, handle wrapped in iridescent green-black chitin bands, slightly pitted grey head.

chitin_plated_lineman_s_wrench.name: Chitin-plated Lineman's Wrench
chitin_plated_lineman_s_wrench.description: Pried from the Lockheed plant after the hive moved in, it now wears scales the colour of an oil slick. It hums against live wire in a way no lineman can explain.
chitin_plated_lineman_s_wrench.icon: Massive lineman's wrench fully plated in overlapping green-black chitin scales with an oily sheen, steel socket head edged in brass.

superior_sledgehammer.name: Superior Sledgehammer
superior_sledgehammer.description: Studio carpenters can strike a whole Western town with one of these between lunch and quitting time. Hickory handle, an honest steel head, no pretensions.
superior_sledgehammer.icon: Long-handled sledgehammer, straight pale hickory haft, blocky polished steel head with crisp chamfered faces.

sledgehammer_of_strength.name: Sledgehammer of Strength
sledgehammer_of_strength.description: Swung on a Pacific Electric track gang laying rail toward Burbank, it drove spikes in two blows where other men needed five. The foreman docked its owner for showing off.
sledgehammer_of_strength.icon: Sledgehammer with a worn dark hickory haft, steel head with a red-painted band around its middle, chipped striking faces.

sledgehammer_of_stamina.name: Sledgehammer of Stamina
sledgehammer_of_stamina.description: Nobody at the old Mulholland Dam quarry remembers the owner's name, only that he worked double shifts and never once sat down.
sledgehammer_of_stamina.icon: Sledgehammer with a dusty grey steel head, hickory haft, a thick leather wrist strap looped at the butt end.

sledgehammer_of_the_boxer.name: Sledgehammer of the Boxer
sledgehammer_of_the_boxer.description: Ringside at the Legion Stadium, a trainer kept it to ring the bell when the regular hammer went missing. Rumour holds his fighter did roadwork with it slung over one shoulder.
sledgehammer_of_the_boxer.icon: Sledgehammer with a black steel head, rope-wrapped hickory haft, a tiny red boxing-glove pin tacked below the head.

sledgehammer_of_the_stevedore.name: Sledgehammer of the Stevedore
sledgehammer_of_the_stevedore.description: Dockside at San Pedro it knocked wedges loose for a gang that unloaded Tony Cornero's fish by moonlight. The fish never once needed ice.
sledgehammer_of_the_stevedore.icon: Sledgehammer with a blue-painted steel head, salt-stained hickory haft, a small iron cargo hook charm tied on with tarred twine.

chitin_lined_sledgehammer.name: Chitin-lined Sledgehammer
chitin_lined_sledgehammer.description: The head was cored and packed with crushed shell, which lands harder than lead and does not ring. The carpenters who did the work stopped joking about striking sets.
chitin_lined_sledgehammer.icon: Sledgehammer with a heavy steel head showing iridescent green-black chitin lining at the cored faces, reinforced iron collar, dark hickory haft.

chitin_plated_sledgehammer.name: Chitin-plated Sledgehammer
chitin_plated_sledgehammer.description: Plated head to haft in Brute carapace, it weighs more than the smith who made it would admit. It was last seen going up the Mount Lee ridge toward the sign.
chitin_plated_sledgehammer.icon: Huge two-handed sledgehammer plated head to haft in overlapping green-black iridescent chitin, a jagged shell-edged head bound with brass bands.

hot_dog.name: Hot Dog
hot_dog.description: Bought from a cart at Hollywood and Highland whose owner refused to close for the end of the world. Mustard, onions and no questions.
hot_dog.icon: A boiled frankfurter in a soft white bun with a bright yellow stripe of mustard and chopped onions, wrapped halfway in crinkled waxed paper.

ham_sandwich.name: Ham Sandwich
ham_sandwich.description: Rye bread, mustard and ham sliced thin enough to read a contract through. The studio commissary wraps them for extras who were told lunch was an hour ago.
ham_sandwich.icon: A thick ham sandwich on brown rye cut diagonally, pink ham and green lettuce showing at the edge, one bite missing from a corner, resting on waxed paper.

blue_plate_special.name: Blue Plate Special
blue_plate_special.description: Meat loaf, mashed potatoes and peas sharing a divided plate at a Cahuenga lunch counter. The waitress calls everyone honey, the Legion sergeant included.
blue_plate_special.icon: A blue-patterned divided china plate holding a slice of meat loaf under brown gravy, a scoop of mashed potatoes and a heap of green peas.

chili_size.name: Chili Size
chili_size.description: An open hamburger drowned in chili beans and onions, the house dish of every all-night stand south of Sunset. Eaten with a fork, a spoon and some resolve.
chili_size.icon: An oval white plate with a hamburger patty on an open bun buried under dark red chili beans, chopped white onions and grated orange cheese.

cobb_salad.name: Cobb Salad
cobb_salad.description: Chopped bacon, avocado, egg and chicken lined up in rows like a chorus line. A kitchen trick for clearing out the icebox, which under the Dome describes most of the menu.
