cobb_salad.icon: A wide white bowl of chopped salad in neat stripes: green lettuce, yellow egg, red tomato, pale green avocado, crumbled bacon and blue cheese.

musso_frank_steak_dinner.name: Musso & Frank Steak Dinner
musso_frank_steak_dinner.description: Grilled over open flame on the Boulevard since 1919 and carried out by waiters who have outlasted three studio heads. They see no reason the insects should rate a hurry. Charge it to the picture.
musso_frank_steak_dinner.icon: A thick charred steak on a heavy white oval plate beside a split baked potato with a melting pat of butter and a sprig of green parsley.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.description: Black, hot and boiling since dawn in an aid-station pot. Nobody drinks it for the taste.
coffee.icon: A thick white enamel mug with a chipped dark blue rim, filled with steaming black coffee.

coca_cola.name: Coca-Cola
coca_cola.description: Ice cold from the drugstore cooler on Highland, where the soda jerk still counts the empties. No trucks get through the Dome, so every bottle opened is one fewer.
coca_cola.icon: A curved pale green glass soda bottle holding dark brown cola, beaded with condensation, topped with a red crimped cap.

hires_root_beer.name: Hires Root Beer
hires_root_beer.description: Sassafras, sarsaparilla and a foam head a temperance lady can admire in public. The Legion keeps a crate behind the bar it officially does not have.
hires_root_beer.icon: A frosted heavy glass mug of dark root beer with a thick tan foam head spilling over the rim.

egg_cream.name: Egg Cream
egg_cream.description: A New York soda-fountain drink with neither egg nor cream in it, brought west by a Brooklyn screenwriter who complains about the coast in every letter home.
egg_cream.icon: A tall fluted soda glass of chocolate milk and seltzer under a frothy white head, a long steel spoon standing in it.

orange_julep.name: Orange Julep
orange_julep.description: Valley oranges whipped frothy with ice at a stand on the road to Studio City. The groves beyond it are going to seed under the Dome, so the stand squeezes while the fruit lasts.
orange_julep.icon: A tall paper cup of pale frothy orange drink with a red-striped straw and a bright orange wedge perched on the rim.

brown_derby_coffee.name: Brown Derby Coffee
brown_derby_coffee.description: Poured at the Brown Derby on Vine, where the cream comes in silver and the booths face the door so nobody misses an entrance. Agents drink it by the gallon and bill the client.
brown_derby_coffee.icon: A fine white china cup and saucer with a thin brown rim stripe, steaming coffee inside, a small silver cream pitcher beside it.

linen_bandage.name: Linen Bandage
linen_bandage.description: Torn from bedsheets donated to the aid station by a Whitley Heights landlady who would like them back.
linen_bandage.icon: A loosely rolled strip of off-white torn linen with frayed edges, one end trailing free, a faint pink stain on the outer turn.

johnson_johnson_gauze_roll.name: Johnson & Johnson Gauze Roll
johnson_johnson_gauze_roll.description: Sterile, wrapped and sealed, shipped from New Jersey before the Dome came down and rationed ever since. Nurses count the rolls twice a shift.
johnson_johnson_gauze_roll.icon: A tight roll of white surgical gauze sliding half out of a blue-and-white paper wrapper marked with a plain red cross-shaped emblem.

bootleg_gin.name: Bootleg Gin
bootleg_gin.description: Cut in an Edendale bathtub and bottled in whatever the drugstores threw out. Crawford's men swear it is genuine; the label swears it is hair tonic.
bootleg_gin.icon: A clear medicine bottle of cloudy gin with a cork stopper, a twist of wire at the neck and a peeling blank paper label.

usher_s_flashlight_baton.name: Usher's Flashlight Baton
usher_s_flashlight_baton.description: Grauman's ushers were drilled like Marines, and this one cleared a Drone from the Egyptian's forecourt with the same nickel-plated torch he used to find patrons their seats. The bulb still works, which is more than the Drone can say.
usher_s_flashlight_baton.icon: Long nickel-plated flashlight baton, ribbed black rubber grip, red velvet wrist cord with a gold tassel, glowing amber lens at the tip, small dent near the head.

hive_warden_s_mandible.name: Hive Warden's Mandible
hive_warden_s_mandible.description: Pried from the thing that guarded the hive chamber under the Egyptian. The jaw is serrated like a bread knife and twice as hungry, and somebody has wrapped the hinge in friction tape and called it a handle.
hive_warden_s_mandible.icon: Curved serrated insect mandible used as a knife, glossy green-black chitin blade with jagged teeth, hinge end wrapped in black friction tape, faint amber resin at the base.

egyptian_prop_khopesh.name: Egyptian Prop Khopesh
egyptian_prop_khopesh.description: Carved for a stage prologue in 1922 and sharpened for the first time in 1930. The gilt paint flakes off in the scabbard; the edge, somebody discovered the hard way, does not.
egyptian_prop_khopesh.icon: Sickle-curved khopesh sword, flaking gold-painted blade showing bare grey steel along the honed edge, turquoise and lapis painted hilt, small scarab pommel.

projection_booth_arc_lamp.name: Projection Booth Arc Lamp
projection_booth_arc_lamp.description: Carbon rods hiss inside the housing the way they did through every reel of the opening run. The projectionist claimed it could throw a picture through cigar smoke and a bad review.
projection_booth_arc_lamp.icon: Compact black iron projector arc lamp housing with a round brass-ringed lens, cooling fins on top, carry handle, intense white-violet glow leaking from vent slots.

matriarch_s_spitting_gland_sprayer.name: Matriarch's Spitting Gland Sprayer
matriarch_s_spitting_gland_sprayer.description: A Colt frame married to an invader gland by a stagehand with steady nerves and no medical training. It fires what the Matriarch used to spit, and it smells exactly like it.
matriarch_s_spitting_gland_sprayer.icon: Blued revolver frame with a bulbous translucent green gland strapped above the barrel by copper wire, rubber tube feeding the muzzle, dripping acid-green bead at the tip.

stage_brace.name: Stage Brace
stage_brace.description: Every flat on the Egyptian's stage leaned on a few of these hardwood braces. Unbolted from the scenery, it props up a fight just as well, though the set has never quite stood straight since.
stage_brace.icon: Long hardwood stage brace pole, pale oak with an iron hook at one end and a heavy cast-iron foot plate at the other, splashes of painted-flat blue.

lighting_rigger_s_wrench.name: Lighting Rigger's Wrench
lighting_rigger_s_wrench.description: Its owner tightened clamps forty feet above the stage and never once dropped a tool on an actor, a record he considered the finest achievement in pictures.
lighting_rigger_s_wrench.icon: Heavy adjustable spanner wrench, dark steel with worn red-enamel handle, coil of safety cord tied through the grip hole, small brass lamp-clamp charm dangling.

robin_hood_s_prop_quarterstaff.name: Robin Hood's Prop Quarterstaff
robin_hood_s_prop_quarterstaff.description: Douglas Fairbanks's Robin Hood opened the Egyptian in 1922, and this staff came out of the storage room still waiting for its cue. Light enough to vault with, which the stuntmen did, and heavy enough to matter.
robin_hood_s_prop_quarterstaff.icon: Tall straight ash quarterstaff, honey-brown wood, green leather grip wrapping in the middle, iron-capped ends, a single small feather tied below one cap.

sexton_s_spade.name: Sexton's Spade
sexton_s_spade.description: Hollywood Cemetery's old sexton kept the edge keen and the handle oiled through forty years of quiet work. Since the crypts went bad the work has been noisier, and the spade has had to dig faster.
sexton_s_spade.icon: Long-handled gravedigger's spade, worn dark ash handle with a D-grip, broad iron blade crusted with dry grey earth, small tarnished brass ring on the shaft.

stembridge_rental_thompson.name: Stembridge Rental Thompson
stembridge_rental_thompson.description: Checked out of the gun room at 5451 Marathon for a gangster picture and never returned. The rental slip is still tucked under the stock, and the late fee now exceeds the picture's budget.
stembridge_rental_thompson.icon: Thompson submachine gun with round drum magazine, walnut forward grip and stock, blued steel, folded blank paper tag tied to the trigger guard with string.

tom_mix_s_peacemaker.name: Tom Mix's Peacemaker
tom_mix_s_peacemaker.description: Tom Mix swears he only fired it for the cameras, the crowds at the Gower stables and one very insistent rattlesnake. The ivory grips have picked up a few new scratches he would rather not explain.
tom_mix_s_peacemaker.icon: Long-barrelled single-action revolver, polished nickel finish with engraved scrollwork, carved white ivory grips, small silver star inlay, gleaming gold trigger.

chandelier_chain.name: Chandelier Chain
chandelier_chain.description: Links of a lobby chandelier's brass chain, wound around a lead counterweight. The hive had nested in the crystal; the chandelier came down, and the chain stayed on to be useful.
chandelier_chain.icon: Heavy coil of ornate brass chain wrapped around a dull lead counterweight, one dangling cut-crystal prism, faint green-black chitin flecks caught in the links.

post_43_springfield.name: Post 43 Springfield
post_43_springfield.description: The men at Post 43 hand this rifle only to someone they would share a foxhole with, and they are particular. Its stock is scored with a tally that began in the Argonne and continues on Mount Lee.
post_43_springfield.icon: Bolt-action service rifle, long dark walnut stock with rows of carved notches, blued barrel, olive canvas sling, small enamel blue-and-gold Legion star set into the butt.

crawford_s_thompson.name: Crawford's Thompson
crawford_s_thompson.description: Charlie Crawford keeps a violin case in his Sunset office that has never held a violin. When he opens it for someone, it means the syndicate trusts them, or wants them where the trouble is.
crawford_s_thompson.icon: Thompson submachine gun with a gleaming round drum, gold-plated receiver, glossy rosewood grips, resting on an open black violin case lined with crimson velvet.

letter_h_girder.name: Letter H Girder
letter_h_girder.description: Torn from the HOLLYWOODLAND sign when the hive climbed Mount Lee, the steel still carries a strip of white sheet metal and a few dead bulbs. The realtors would like it back. The hive would like whoever is holding it.
letter_h_girder.icon: Massive riveted steel girder used as a two-handed club, white-painted sheet metal panel bolted along one side, row of broken light bulbs, amber hive resin seeping from joints.

hive_queen_s_stinger.name: Hive Queen's Stinger
hive_queen_s_stinger.description: Taken from the queen of the Mount Lee Hive, who used it to decide which of the taken stayed awake for the cameras. Amber venom still beads at the tip, slow as honey and nowhere near as kind.
hive_queen_s_stinger.icon: Long tapering stinger dagger, iridescent green-black chitin shaft, needle tip glowing with a bead of amber venom, base bound in pale silk-like hive fibre.

tower_beacon.name: Tower Beacon
tower_beacon.description: Pulled from United Airport's control tower and rewired to run off a battery pack and sheer spite. It once guided mail planes over the Valley; now it guides the living out of the hangars.
tower_beacon.icon: Squat rotating aviation beacon lamp, red and clear glass halves in a brass cage, black iron base with heavy battery box, bright sweeping beam.

architect_s_t_square.name: Architect's T-Square
architect_s_t_square.description: Belonged to the draughtsman who laid out the Lockheed plant, and later to the hive, which studied his plans with alarming interest. One edge is ruled in inches; the other in something no surveyor recognises.
architect_s_t_square.icon: Large steel T-square with polished walnut head, one edge etched with fine marks, opposite edge grown over with glossy green-black chitin ridges and faint amber veins.

sister_aimee_s_pulpit_bible.name: Sister Aimee's Pulpit Bible
sister_aimee_s_pulpit_bible.description: Sister Aimee preached from this Bible to five thousand at Angelus Temple and to every radio in the basin over KFSG. The margins are crowded with her notes; the cover is scorched where it stopped something with too many legs.
sister_aimee_s_pulpit_bible.icon: Thick white leather Bible with gilt page edges, gold cross on the cover, scorched black patch on one corner, long blue silk ribbon marker hanging down.

kop_captain_s_nightstick.name: Kop Captain's Nightstick
kop_captain_s_nightstick.description: Mack Sennett's Keystone captain waved it through two hundred chases and never hit anybody on purpose. The hive took over the studio and missed the joke entirely, so the stick has had a busier year.
kop_captain_s_nightstick.icon: Black lacquered police nightstick with a turned grip and leather wrist thong, small brass star-shaped shield badge nailed near the handle, scuffed chitin scratches along the shaft.

st_christopher_medal_of_strength.name: St. Christopher Medal of Strength
st_christopher_medal_of_strength.description: Pried off the neck of a red-car motorman who swore it had carried him through the Cahuenga Pass forty times. The forty-first trip carried him nowhere, but the medal held up fine.
st_christopher_medal_of_strength.icon: Oval silver medal on a steel ball chain, embossed relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small dark iron dumbbell charm hanging beside it.

st_christopher_medal_of_agility.name: St. Christopher Medal of Agility
st_christopher_medal_of_agility.description: Saint Christopher carried a child across a river without slipping once. A Gower Gulch trick rider wore this one through three saddle falls and a runaway buckboard, and she claims the saint did most of the work.
st_christopher_medal_of_agility.icon: Oval bright nickel medal on a thin chain, embossed relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a tiny blue enamel horseshoe charm at the clasp.

st_christopher_medal_of_stamina.name: St. Christopher Medal of Stamina
st_christopher_medal_of_stamina.description: Worn by a red-car conductor who walked the Hollywood line end to end the night the Dome came down, then turned round and walked it back. He never said what he was looking for.
st_christopher_medal_of_stamina.icon: Thick oval pewter medal rubbed smooth at the edges, faint relief of a staff above wavy river lines, hung on a heavy brown leather cord.

st_christopher_medal_of_intellect.name: St. Christopher Medal of Intellect
st_christopher_medal_of_intellect.description: The Krotona people up Beachwood Canyon insisted the saint was really an astral symbol of the higher planes. The Catholic who owned it let them talk and kept it on anyway.
st_christopher_medal_of_intellect.icon: Oval polished silver medal on a fine chain, embossed relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small violet glass bead set into the top bail.

st_christopher_medal_of_spirit.name: St. Christopher Medal of Spirit
st_christopher_medal_of_spirit.description: Twice blessed: once by a priest at Blessed Sacrament on Sunset, and once by a stagehand who had played a bishop in two reels for Universal. The owner trusted both blessings equally.
st_christopher_medal_of_spirit.icon: Gold-washed oval medal, embossed relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a pale white silk ribbon tied in a small bow at the bail.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_boxer.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Boxer
st_christopher_medal_of_the_boxer.description: A welterweight kissed it before every Friday bout at the Legion Stadium and lost eleven of fourteen. He maintained the saint looked after travellers, not fighters, and that the referee was Presbyterian.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_boxer.icon: Oval brass medal on a short chain, embossed relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a tiny red boxing-glove pin clipped to the links.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_acrobat.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Acrobat
st_christopher_medal_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen at Gower Gulch pass these around like cigarettes. This one went off a two-storey saloon set, through a sugar-glass window and into a hay wagon, still on its chain.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_acrobat.icon: Oval silver medal with a small chip in the rim, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, chain wrapped with a strip of green cloth tape.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_stevedore.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Stevedore
st_christopher_medal_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro on a longshoreman's neck, back when the studios paid better for lifting than the docks did. The salt never quite rubbed out of the links.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_stevedore.icon: Tarnished oval brass medal on a heavy anchor-link chain, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small bronze cargo hook charm with white salt crust.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_marksman.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Marksman
st_christopher_medal_of_the_marksman.description: Its owner, a Legion sharpshooter, wore it tucked under his shirt so the glint would not give him away on the Beachwood ridge. He hit what he aimed at and was home by supper.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_marksman.icon: Matte blackened silver oval medal on a dark cord, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small cross-hair notch filed into the rim.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_engineer.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Engineer
st_christopher_medal_of_the_engineer.description: Hung for a year on a nail above the switchboard at Mulholland Dam, where the keeper said it watched the water better than the gauges did. He took it down the week the hive moved into the spillway.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_engineer.icon: Oval brushed steel medal, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small copper wrench charm, the chain spliced with a twist of copper wire.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_doctor.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Doctor
st_christopher_medal_of_the_doctor.description: Pinned inside the lid of an aid-station nurse's bag, beside the iodine and a list of names she meant to write to. It still smells faintly of carbolic.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_doctor.icon: Oval silver medal on a fine chain, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small red-cross enamel tab at the bail and a faint brown iodine stain.

st_christopher_medal_of_the_deacon.name: St. Christopher Medal of the Deacon
st_christopher_medal_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday its owner walked from Edendale to Angelus Temple with a hymnal under one arm, and the saint went with him both ways. Sister Aimee would have preferred a plain cross, but she never turned away a traveller.
st_christopher_medal_of_the_deacon.icon: Oval silver medal threaded on a faded blue hymnal ribbon, relief of a staff above wavy river lines, a small gilt cross charm hanging beside it.

worn_trash_can_lid.name: Worn Trash Can Lid
worn_trash_can_lid.description: Pried off a can behind the Hollywood Hotel kitchen. It still remembers Tuesday's fish, and so will anyone standing downwind.
worn_trash_can_lid.icon: Round galvanised steel trash can lid, warped and badly dented, dull grey with rust freckles, crimped rim bent out of true, small loop handle in the centre.

trash_can_lid_of_strength.name: Trash Can Lid of Strength
trash_can_lid_of_strength.description: Lifted from an alley off Cahuenga by a teamster who used it to stop a Drone's charge, then the next one, then one more for good measure.
trash_can_lid_of_strength.icon: Round galvanised trash can lid with a deep fist-sized dent in the centre, handle wrapped in red tape, tiny iron dumbbell charm tied to the handle.

trash_can_lid_of_stamina.name: Trash Can Lid of Stamina
trash_can_lid_of_stamina.description: Each dent is a story, and this lid holds enough of them to fill a Sunday supplement. Its owner walked home from Gower Gulch behind it, slowly but in one piece.
trash_can_lid_of_stamina.icon: Heavily pocked round galvanised lid, rim patched with a riveted steel strip, handle wrapped in faded green cloth, grey metal with darker scuffs.

trash_can_lid_of_the_boxer.name: Trash Can Lid of the Boxer
trash_can_lid_of_the_boxer.description: Somebody swiped it from the bins outside the Legion Stadium on a Friday night, still ringing from the crowd. It holds a guard the way a good welterweight does, chin down and patient.
trash_can_lid_of_the_boxer.icon: Round galvanised lid with handle wrapped in cracked brown boxing-glove leather, small red boxing glove pin fixed to the rim, scuffed grey metal.

trash_can_lid_of_the_stevedore.name: Trash Can Lid of the Stevedore
trash_can_lid_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks lashed to a fish truck, back when trucks still came up from anywhere. The longshoreman who carried it knew when to shove and when to sidestep.
trash_can_lid_of_the_stevedore.icon: Round galvanised lid streaked with white salt stains, coil of tan hemp rope knotted through the handle, small black iron cargo hook charm hanging from it.

patched_trash_can_lid.name: Patched Trash Can Lid
patched_trash_can_lid.description: Three bottle caps and a dab of solder hold the hole shut. The landlord wants it back; the landlord can wait.
patched_trash_can_lid.icon: Round grey trash can lid with a ragged hole patched by silver solder and three flattened bottle caps, uneven dull metal, twisted wire handle.

plain_trash_can_lid.name: Plain Trash Can Lid
plain_trash_can_lid.description: A trash can lid and nothing else, which is more than can be said for most of the Boulevard's leading men.
plain_trash_can_lid.icon: Clean round galvanised trash can lid, even grey concentric ridges, simple bent steel handle in the centre, tidy unrolled rim.

sturdy_trash_can_lid.name: Sturdy Trash Can Lid
sturdy_trash_can_lid.description: Heavy-gauge city issue, the kind the sanitation department bolted down after the first riot. Somebody unbolted it.
sturdy_trash_can_lid.icon: Thick round galvanised lid with a double-rolled rim, two empty bolt holes at the edge, stout riveted steel handle, solid grey metal.

good_trash_can_lid.name: Good Trash Can Lid
good_trash_can_lid.description: Hammered flat again after every scrap and still sound. It beats anything the Christie prop shop could knock together out of pasteboard.
good_trash_can_lid.icon: Round steel lid with a smooth hammered surface showing faint peen marks, bright clean metal, handle wrapped in dark brown leather.

fine_trash_can_lid.name: Fine Trash Can Lid
fine_trash_can_lid.description: Polished by a Roosevelt Hotel porter who could not bear to see anything leave the building looking shabby, the garbage included.
fine_trash_can_lid.icon: Gleaming polished steel trash can lid with mirror-bright concentric rings, brass handle with a black leather grip, crisp rolled rim.

pressed_trash_can_lid.name: Pressed Trash Can Lid
pressed_trash_can_lid.description: Stamped from a single sheet on a Burbank press and sold door to door as the sanitary cover of tomorrow. Tomorrow turned out to involve spitter acid, which it also turns.
pressed_trash_can_lid.icon: Crisp machine-pressed steel lid with sharp deep concentric ridges, blue-grey finish, reinforced thick rim, leather arm strap riveted beneath the edge.

worn_work_lamp.name: Worn Work Lamp
worn_work_lamp.description: The bulb flickers if you breathe on it, and the cord has been taped by at least three electricians, none of them sober.
worn_work_lamp.icon: Battered caged work lamp, dented tin reflector, bent wire cage, dim yellow bulb, frayed black cord bound with mismatched tape.

work_lamp_of_intellect.name: Work Lamp of Intellect
work_lamp_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a Paramount gaffer who read the union contract by its light, cover to cover, twice. Nobody ever caught him on a technicality.
work_lamp_of_intellect.icon: Caged work lamp with a clean brass reflector, bright white bulb, neat black cord, small blue enamel tag clipped to the wire cage.

work_lamp_of_spirit.name: Work Lamp of Spirit
work_lamp_of_spirit.description: Its glow is warm and steady, the sort that keeps a night watchman calm through the small hours while the hive hums beyond the fence.
work_lamp_of_spirit.icon: Caged work lamp with an amber-tinted glowing bulb, copper reflector, small white feather tied to the handle with string.

work_lamp_of_the_engineer.name: Work Lamp of the Engineer
work_lamp_of_the_engineer.description: Rewired from a Lockheed hangar inspection light by a man who refused to let anything stop working, himself included.
work_lamp_of_the_engineer.icon: Heavy caged work lamp with thick steel guard, extra black junction box on the handle, red rubber cord, small brass wrench charm dangling.

work_lamp_of_the_doctor.name: Work Lamp of the Doctor
work_lamp_of_the_doctor.description: Hung over an aid-station cot on Vine through more long nights than the nurse cares to count. It smells faintly of iodine and carbolic.
work_lamp_of_the_doctor.icon: Caged work lamp with a white enamel reflector, soft clean bulb, small red cross enamel badge on the cage, strip of gauze tied round the handle.

work_lamp_of_the_deacon.name: Work Lamp of the Deacon
work_lamp_of_the_deacon.description: Lit the long walk to Angelus Temple for a deacon who would not miss a service for any bug the hive could send. The handle smells of hymnals and Echo Park fog.
work_lamp_of_the_deacon.icon: Caged work lamp with a warm glowing bulb, brass reflector, purple hymnal ribbon tied to the handle, small brass cross hanging from the cage.

patched_work_lamp.name: Patched Work Lamp
patched_work_lamp.description: Wound with friction tape where the cord split and wired to a bent coat hanger for a handle. It works, mostly.
patched_work_lamp.icon: Shabby work lamp with a bent coat-hanger wire handle, cracked tin reflector, cord wound thick with black friction tape, weak yellow bulb.

plain_work_lamp.name: Plain Work Lamp
plain_work_lamp.description: Standard studio issue, the same one hanging over every workbench from Gower to Western. Nobody signs for it and nobody returns it.
plain_work_lamp.icon: Simple caged work lamp, plain grey tin reflector, clean straight wire cage, black rubber cord, clear white bulb.

sturdy_work_lamp.name: Sturdy Work Lamp
sturdy_work_lamp.description: Made for the crews who poured Mulholland Dam, with a cage a man could stand on. One fellow did, to prove it.
sturdy_work_lamp.icon: Heavy cast-iron work lamp with a thick bar cage, deep green enamel reflector, armoured steel-wrapped cord, bright bulb.

good_work_lamp.name: Good Work Lamp
good_work_lamp.description: Fresh wiring and a buffed reflector throw a beam clear across a soundstage, which is as far as anyone wants to see inside one of those places now.
good_work_lamp.icon: Well-kept caged work lamp, polished nickel reflector, bright white bulb, braided brown cloth cord, ivory bakelite grip.

worn_arrow_shirt_and_vest.name: Worn Arrow Shirt and Vest
worn_arrow_shirt_and_vest.description: Somebody's collar went missing before the Dome came down, and the shirt never found another. The vest still has a red-car transfer in the watch pocket.
worn_arrow_shirt_and_vest.icon: Rumpled off-white shirt under a faded grey wool vest, frayed cuffs, one button missing, yellowed collar band with no collar attached.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_intellect.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of Intellect
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a script reader at Christie who could find the hole in a two-reeler's plot before the coffee cooled. Pencil shavings still turn up in the vest pocket.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_intellect.icon: Crisp white shirt under a charcoal wool vest, starched collar, a blue pencil clipped in the vest pocket, tortoiseshell buttons.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_spirit.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of Spirit
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_spirit.description: Laundered so often by a Selma Avenue widow that it smells of bluing and patience. She ironed it every Sunday and said the creases were a kind of prayer.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_spirit.icon: Soft white shirt under a dove-grey vest, gentle folds, a sprig of pale green dried sage tucked into one buttonhole.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_stamina.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of Stamina
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_stamina.description: A night watchman at the Hollywood Hotel wore this through three double shifts and a hive surge. The vest held its buttons. The watchman held the lobby.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_stamina.icon: White shirt under a sturdy brown tweed vest, thick brass buttons, a darned elbow, red thread accent stitched along the vest hem.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_engineer.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of the Engineer
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_engineer.description: Pulled off a sound-stage electrician who still owes the union three weeks' dues. Burn marks on the left cuff trace the exact route of a live cable.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_engineer.icon: White shirt with a scorched left cuff under a navy wool vest, a small brass wrench charm hanging from a watch chain.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_doctor.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of the Doctor
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_doctor.description: Starched stiff enough to stand on its own, the way the house physician at the Roosevelt liked it. A faint smell of iodine never quite washed out.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_doctor.icon: Very crisp white shirt under a slate-blue vest, small red cross pin on the vest, a glass thermometer peeking from the pocket.

arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_deacon.name: Arrow Shirt and Vest of the Deacon
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_deacon.description: Walked to Angelus Temple and back every Sunday, rain or shine, which in Los Angeles means shine. The watch pocket holds a folded hymn sheet and a nickel for the plate.
arrow_shirt_and_vest_of_the_deacon.icon: White shirt under a plain black vest, a purple hymnal ribbon threaded through a buttonhole, modest bone buttons.

patched_arrow_shirt_and_vest.name: Patched Arrow Shirt and Vest
patched_arrow_shirt_and_vest.description: Mended at the elbows with flour-sack cotton by someone who could not afford a new one and would not admit it. The patches are the best-made part.
patched_arrow_shirt_and_vest.icon: Dull white shirt with mismatched calico patches on the elbows under a faded olive vest, uneven hand stitching.

plain_arrow_shirt_and_vest.name: Plain Arrow Shirt and Vest
plain_arrow_shirt_and_vest.description: Nothing to remark upon, which in a town full of extras in borrowed tuxedos is its own kind of distinction.
plain_arrow_shirt_and_vest.icon: Clean plain white shirt under a simple mid-grey vest, plain bone buttons, soft turned-down collar.

sturdy_arrow_shirt_and_vest.name: Sturdy Arrow Shirt and Vest
sturdy_arrow_shirt_and_vest.description: Double-stitched cotton and a thick wool vest that could stop a pencil, if not a mandible. Clerks at Hollywood and Vine have taken to buying them a size large for the extra padding.
sturdy_arrow_shirt_and_vest.icon: Heavy cream shirt with reinforced seams under a thick dark-brown wool vest, sturdy horn buttons, crisp pointed collar.

worn_work_jacket.name: Worn Work Jacket
worn_work_jacket.description: Left hanging on a nail in a wrecked Gower Street garage. The owner will not be coming back for it.
worn_work_jacket.icon: Shabby brown leather work jacket, cracked and scuffed, a torn pocket flap hanging loose, dull faded finish.

work_jacket_of_agility.name: Work Jacket of Agility
work_jacket_of_agility.description: Cut short at the waist for a Columbia stunt rider who liked to vault onto a moving horse without snagging the saddle horn. He snagged a fence instead, but the jacket came through fine.
work_jacket_of_agility.icon: Short tan leather work jacket with a cropped waist, bright yellow piping running down both sleeves.

work_jacket_of_stamina.name: Work Jacket of Stamina
work_jacket_of_stamina.description: The hide is thick enough to turn a coyote's teeth, as a Vermont Canyon teamster proved twice. The third coyote was a bigger one.
work_jacket_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown leather jacket with a heavy upturned collar, rough red wool lining showing at the cuffs.

work_jacket_of_spirit.name: Work Jacket of Spirit
work_jacket_of_spirit.description: Its last owner rode the Pacific Electric every morning and whistled the whole way, to the despair of the other passengers. The jacket seems to have kept the good cheer.
work_jacket_of_spirit.icon: Worn-soft chestnut leather jacket with light green stitching, a small enamel songbird pin on the collar.

work_jacket_of_the_acrobat.name: Work Jacket of the Acrobat
work_jacket_of_the_acrobat.description: Flexible at the shoulders from years of tumbling off Poverty Row rooftops at three dollars a fall. Stuntmen swear by it, mostly while landing.
work_jacket_of_the_acrobat.icon: Supple light brown leather jacket with gusseted shoulders, orange diamond-shaped patches on the elbows.

work_jacket_of_the_stevedore.name: Work Jacket of the Stevedore
work_jacket_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who traded hauling banana crates for hauling film cans. Salt stains still map the shoulders.
work_jacket_of_the_stevedore.icon: Rugged dark leather jacket with white salt stains across the shoulders, a coil of hemp rope hooked on the belt, anchor-shaped button.

work_jacket_of_the_deacon.name: Work Jacket of the Deacon
work_jacket_of_the_deacon.description: Outside the Boulevard speakeasies, a street preacher wore this while calling the customers to repent. Several did, briefly, between drinks.
work_jacket_of_the_deacon.icon: Black leather work jacket with a small white stitched cross on the breast pocket, a purple ribbon bookmark trailing from the pocket.

patched_work_jacket.name: Patched Work Jacket
patched_work_jacket.description: Harness thread holds the sleeves on, and a scrap of saddle skirt from a Gower Gulch tack room covers the worst of the elbows.
patched_work_jacket.icon: Brown leather jacket with mismatched darker leather patches at the elbows, coarse thick thread stitches, dull scuffed finish.

plain_work_jacket.name: Plain Work Jacket
plain_work_jacket.description: Standard issue for studio grips: four pockets, no opinions. Nobody on a set looks twice at it, which is the point.
plain_work_jacket.icon: Clean medium-brown leather work jacket with four flap pockets, plain brass snaps and a straight collar.

sturdy_work_jacket.name: Sturdy Work Jacket
sturdy_work_jacket.description: Riveted at the stress points like a pair of Levi's. A carpenter on the Christie lot says it survived a falling flat and a tumble off the catwalk in the same week.
sturdy_work_jacket.icon: Stiff dark-brown leather jacket with copper rivets at the pocket corners and reinforced double-layer shoulders.

good_work_jacket.name: Good Work Jacket
good_work_jacket.description: Oiled, broken in and kept that way by a Burbank foreman who believed a man is judged by his boots and his coat. Fair odds it outlasts the invasion.
good_work_jacket.icon: Glossy well-oiled rich brown leather jacket with neat even stitching, polished brass buttons and a cream sheepskin collar.

tailored_riot_shield.name: Tailored Riot Shield
tailored_riot_shield.description: Cut down by a Paramount prop shop so it would photograph nicely in a strike picture. The real thing turned out to need it more than the picture did.
tailored_riot_shield.icon: Oval steel riot shield, clean polished face, neat leather-wrapped hand grip, thin dark blue painted rim, crisp and unscuffed

riot_shield_of_strength.name: Riot Shield of Strength
riot_shield_of_strength.description: Hynes's Red Squad carried this one through a Plaza meeting last March. The dents along the rim are the only minutes anyone kept.
riot_shield_of_strength.icon: Oval steel riot shield with several deep dents along the edge, bold red painted rim band, small stamped iron dumbbell emblem near the grip

riot_shield_of_stamina.name: Riot Shield of Stamina
riot_shield_of_stamina.description: Patrolmen on the Boulevard beat swear it has outlasted three sergeants, two chiefs' speeches and a pension board.
riot_shield_of_stamina.icon: Oval steel riot shield, extra rows of rivets around the face, forest green painted rim band, worn brown leather grip strap

riot_shield_of_the_boxer.name: Riot Shield of the Boxer
riot_shield_of_the_boxer.description: Hung for a season behind the ring at the Legion Stadium, where it caught a flying stool most Friday nights and never once complained to the referee.
riot_shield_of_the_boxer.icon: Oval steel riot shield, red leather grip, small enamel boxing glove pin fixed near the top rim, faint scuffs across the face

riot_shield_of_the_stevedore.name: Riot Shield of the Stevedore
riot_shield_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks after the '23 strike, still smelling of tarred rope and other men's opinions.
riot_shield_of_the_stevedore.icon: Oval steel riot shield, rim wrapped in tarred brown rope, small brass cargo hook charm hanging from the grip, salt-stained grey face

heavy_riot_shield.name: Heavy Riot Shield
heavy_riot_shield.description: Weighs about the same as a studio contract and is considerably harder to break.
heavy_riot_shield.icon: Thick slab-like oval steel shield, dull gunmetal grey, heavy square bolts around the edge, broad canvas arm strap

reinforced_riot_shield.name: Reinforced Riot Shield
reinforced_riot_shield.description: Spare boiler plate from a Burbank machine shop was riveted on after the first Soldier walked straight through the old one.
reinforced_riot_shield.icon: Oval steel shield crossed by two riveted boiler plate strips, mismatched grey and rust-brown patches, heavy rivet heads

superior_riot_shield.name: Superior Riot Shield
superior_riot_shield.description: Legion armourers at Post 43 built a handful of these for the Pass road, each scratched with a mark by someone who expected to count them all back in.
superior_riot_shield.icon: Polished oval steel shield with brass trim around the rim, olive drab webbing grip, small scratched tally notch near the edge

chitin_lined_riot_shield.name: Chitin-lined Riot Shield
chitin_lined_riot_shield.description: Behind the steel sits a layer of Drone carapace, cured in a Studio City yard. Spitter acid beads off it like rain off a Stetson.
chitin_lined_riot_shield.icon: Oval steel riot shield, its edge revealing a thick lining of iridescent green-black insect shell, dark leather grip

chitin_plated_riot_shield.name: Chitin-plated Riot Shield
chitin_plated_riot_shield.description: Faced entirely in shell taken off Elder Soldiers below Mount Lee. The hive seems to recognise its own and strikes it twice as hard out of spite.
chitin_plated_riot_shield.icon: Oval shield faced in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin scales, narrow steel rim, rivets of dark iron, faint oily sheen

tailored_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.name: Tailored Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
tailored_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.description: A Warner Bros. wardrobe girl sewed it a fitted cover with piping, so the iodine now travels better dressed than most of the cast.
tailored_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.icon: Rectangular tin first aid box in a fitted cream canvas cover with navy piping, red cross emblem on the lid, neat carry handle

johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_intelle.name: Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit of Intellect
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_intelle.description: Its owner pencilled dosage tables inside the lid in a hand so small and so correct that the drugstore on Highland tried to hire her.
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_intelle.icon: Open tin first aid box, tidy rows of gauze and bottles, faint pencil scribbles inside the lid, blue ribbon tag, stub of pencil clipped to the edge

johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_spirit.name: Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit of Spirit
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_spirit.description: Found on the Echo Park boathouse dock beside a thermos and a note promising back in ten minutes. Whoever left it never hurried, and it shows.
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_spirit.icon: White tin first aid box with red cross emblem, pale yellow shoulder strap, small dented thermos charm tied to the handle

johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_eng.name: Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit of the Engineer
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_eng.description: Rebuilt by a Lockheed fitter with a hinged tray and a socket wrench under the splints, since wounds and engines tend to fail at the same hour.
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_eng.icon: Tin first aid box with lid open on a hinged tray, socket wrench tucked among bandages, small brass wrench charm on the handle

johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_doc.name: Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit of the Doctor
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_doc.description: Lifted from a house-call bag on Los Feliz Boulevard, its stethoscope still coiled under the cotton wool. The physician got out. His Packard did not.
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_doc.icon: Tin first aid box with black leather corners, rubber stethoscope tubing coiled out from under the lid, red cross emblem, silver clasp

johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_dea.name: Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit of the Deacon
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_dea.description: Smells of hymnals, liniment and the long walk to Angelus Temple. Somebody pressed a poppy between the bandage rolls and nobody has had the heart to remove it.
johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit_of_the_dea.icon: Tin first aid box with red cross emblem, purple hymnal ribbon tied around it, pressed orange poppy tucked under the ribbon

heavy_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.name: Heavy Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
heavy_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.description: Packed for Legion field work: twice the gauze, a tourniquet strap and enough adhesive tape to hold a stuntman's career together.
heavy_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.icon: Large deep steel first aid case, olive drab paint, two thick webbing straps, red cross emblem, bulging with bandage rolls

reinforced_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.name: Reinforced Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
reinforced_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.description: Steel corners and a padlocked hasp went on once looters learned that a first-aid tin usually hides the medicinal whiskey.
reinforced_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.icon: Grey tin first aid box with heavy riveted steel corner caps, iron hasp and small padlock, red cross emblem slightly chipped

superior_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.name: Superior Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
superior_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.description: Stocked at the Burbank aid station from the last good shipment before the Dome closed. Nurses sign it out by name and count the safety pins when it comes back.
superior_johnson_johnson_first_aid_kit.icon: Gleaming white enamel first aid case, chrome clasps and handle, crisp red cross emblem, spotless and squared-off

chitin_lined_johnson_johnson_first_aid_k.name: Chitin-lined Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
chitin_lined_johnson_johnson_first_aid_k.description: Inside, the tin is lined with thin shell that keeps out the damp and, oddly, the Spitter acid that eats ordinary gauze to lace.
chitin_lined_johnson_johnson_first_aid_k.icon: Open tin first aid box with an iridescent green-black insect shell lining, white bandage rolls inside, red cross emblem on the lid

chitin_plated_johnson_johnson_first_aid_.name: Chitin-plated Johnson & Johnson First Aid Kit
chitin_plated_johnson_johnson_first_aid_.description: Plated in carapace from the Hive Tunnels, it has been dropped off a ridge, stepped on by a Brute and slept on as a pillow. The splints inside are cut from the same shell, which nobody likes to mention.
chitin_plated_johnson_johnson_first_aid_.icon: Box-shaped first aid case clad in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, dark iron clasps, small faded red cross emblem on the lid

lodge_ring_of_strength.name: Lodge Ring of Strength
lodge_ring_of_strength.description: Its last owner bent horseshoes at the Elks picnic every Fourth of July and never once paid for his own beer. The other brothers called that a fair trade, and so did his knuckles.
lodge_ring_of_strength.icon: Heavy gold signet ring with a broad square face, deep red enamel inlay and a small stamped anvil emblem, thick shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_agility.name: Lodge Ring of Agility
lodge_ring_of_agility.description: Brothers of the lodge swore it never left the owner's finger, though it left plenty of card tables in a hurry. Found in a hedge below Beachwood Canyon, still warm from somebody's pocket.
lodge_ring_of_agility.icon: Slim gold signet ring with a narrow oval face, bright green enamel inlay and a tiny winged-foot emblem, delicate polished shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_stamina.name: Lodge Ring of Stamina
lodge_ring_of_stamina.description: Fifty years' membership, says the engraving inside, and not a meeting missed. The old man outlived three Grand Exalted Somethings and, by the look of the scratches, most of an invader drone.
lodge_ring_of_stamina.icon: Thick worn gold band with a broad flat face, deep blue enamel inlay and a small oak-leaf emblem, heavy scratches across the shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_intellect.name: Lodge Ring of Intellect
lodge_ring_of_intellect.description: Someone at the Krotona colony traded it for a book on astral bodies, then regretted the bargain. The original wearer kept the lodge minutes in shorthand for nineteen years and could recite any of them.
lodge_ring_of_intellect.icon: Gold signet ring with an octagonal face, violet enamel inlay and a tiny open-book emblem, fine engraved lines on the shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_spirit.name: Lodge Ring of Spirit
lodge_ring_of_spirit.description: Kept polished by the brother who read the eulogies. He read a great many this autumn, and still found the heart to hum on the walk home.
lodge_ring_of_spirit.icon: Pale gold ring with a round face, milk-white enamel inlay and a small dove emblem, softly polished shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_the_boxer.name: Lodge Ring of the Boxer
lodge_ring_of_the_boxer.description: Swung at the Legion Stadium on Friday nights, third row, while its owner shouted advice nobody in the ring had asked for. The dent came from a seat back, not a jaw.
lodge_ring_of_the_boxer.icon: Chunky gold ring with a square face, red and white enamel inlay and a tiny boxing-glove pin, small dent in the shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_the_acrobat.name: Lodge Ring of the Acrobat
lodge_ring_of_the_acrobat.description: A trapeze man from the Shrine circus wore this on a ribbon round his neck during performances, which the lodge considered disrespectful and the ringmaster considered sensible.
lodge_ring_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slender gold ring with an oval face, turquoise enamel inlay and a small starburst emblem, a frayed scrap of yellow ribbon looped through the band

lodge_ring_of_the_stevedore.name: Lodge Ring of the Stevedore
lodge_ring_of_the_stevedore.description: Came ashore at San Pedro in a longshoreman's pocket and went inland the week before the Dome came down. Tar still sits in the grooves of the crest, and no amount of soap will shift it.
lodge_ring_of_the_stevedore.icon: Heavy brass ring with a square face, black enamel inlay and a small anchor emblem, dark tar stains in the grooves of the crest, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_the_marksman.name: Lodge Ring of the Marksman
lodge_ring_of_the_marksman.description: Three years running, its owner won the Burbank lodge turkey shoot and gave every bird to the widows' fund. The brothers stopped entering out of pure embarrassment.
lodge_ring_of_the_marksman.icon: Gold signet ring with a round face, dark forest-green enamel inlay and a small cross-hair notch cut into the crest, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_the_engineer.name: Lodge Ring of the Engineer
lodge_ring_of_the_engineer.description: Recovered from a toolbox at Mulholland Dam, beside a slide rule and a ham sandwich of uncertain age. The dam keeper says its owner knew every valve in the place by its first name.
lodge_ring_of_the_engineer.icon: Pale gold ring with a hexagonal face, burnt-orange enamel inlay and a tiny wrench charm hanging from the shank, seen straight on

lodge_ring_of_the_doctor.name: Lodge Ring of the Doctor
lodge_ring_of_the_doctor.description: Under the hinged bezel sits a folded prescription for something the druggist would only fill with a wink. Prohibition made physicians very popular lodge members.
lodge_ring_of_the_doctor.icon: Rose-gold signet ring with an oval face, crimson enamel inlay and a small caduceus emblem, hinged bezel lifted slightly open on a folded slip of paper

lodge_ring_of_the_deacon.name: Lodge Ring of the Deacon
lodge_ring_of_the_deacon.description: Smells faintly of hymnals and shoe polish from Sunday walks to Angelus Temple. Its owner joined the lodge for the fellowship and the Temple for everything else, and saw no conflict.
lodge_ring_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain gold ring with a round face, white enamel inlay and a small cross emblem, a thin blue hymnal ribbon tied through the band

fine_lineman_s_gloves.name: Fine Lineman's Gloves
fine_lineman_s_gloves.description: Issued to a Power and Light crew in Beachwood Canyon and handed back nearly new, once the poles up there began sprouting hive resin instead of wire.
fine_lineman_s_gloves.icon: Single padded lineman's gauntlet glove with a wide flared cuff, clean tan canvas back, smooth brown leather palm, neat even stitching.

lineman_s_gloves_of_agility.name: Lineman's Gloves of Agility
lineman_s_gloves_of_agility.description: A Pacific Electric trouble-shooter wore these along the overhead wire above the Pass. He could get down a pole faster than most men fall off one.
lineman_s_gloves_of_agility.icon: Padded lineman's gauntlet glove, tan canvas with brown leather palm, bright green stitching along the fingers, small steel climbing-spur charm dangling from the cuff.

lineman_s_gloves_of_strength.name: Lineman's Gloves of Strength
lineman_s_gloves_of_strength.description: Hauled copper up the Hollywoodland slopes by hand, a full reel at a time. The palm leather is cracked white, and the wrist strap has been let out two notches.
lineman_s_gloves_of_strength.icon: Padded lineman's gauntlet glove with thick reinforced knuckle ridge, tan canvas and scuffed brown palm leather, red stitching, wrist strap with worn buckle.

lineman_s_gloves_of_stamina.name: Lineman's Gloves of Stamina
lineman_s_gloves_of_stamina.description: The fellow who owned these spent nine hours up a pole by Lake Hollywood during a hive surge, splicing the dam keeper's telephone line while Fliers circled. He came down hungry and in no mood for questions.
lineman_s_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Double-quilted padded lineman's gauntlet glove, tan canvas back with diamond quilting, brown leather palm, broad blue band around the cuff.

lineman_s_gloves_of_the_boxer.name: Lineman's Gloves of the Boxer
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_boxer.description: Left on a bench at the Legion Stadium after a Friday card. One cuff smells of liniment, the other of cheap cigars, and somebody has sewn a horseshoe nail into the lining for luck.
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_boxer.icon: Padded lineman's gauntlet glove, tan canvas with brown palm, red-and-white stitching, tiny brass boxing-glove pin fixed to the flared cuff.

lineman_s_gloves_of_the_marksman.name: Lineman's Gloves of the Marksman
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_marksman.description: Judging a hundred-foot span by eye is a lineman's trade. Their last owner judged the range to a diving Flier just as well and kept a carbine strapped beside his climbing belt.
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_marksman.icon: Olive-drab padded lineman's gauntlet glove with a thin leather trigger finger, brown palm, small cross-hair notch tooled into the cuff.

lineman_s_gloves_of_the_acrobat.name: Lineman's Gloves of the Acrobat
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_acrobat.description: Borrowed by a stunt double who had to dangle from a telephone wire for a Universal two-reeler. The wire held, the double held, and the studio still billed the phone company for the pole.
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_acrobat.icon: Padded lineman's gauntlet glove, tan canvas with chalk-dusted brown leather palm, yellow stitching, short knotted length of rope tied through the cuff.

lineman_s_gloves_of_the_engineer.name: Lineman's Gloves of the Engineer
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_engineer.description: Rubber-lined at the fingertips by a studio electrician who knew exactly how much current a man can carry before the man becomes the circuit. He inked the figure inside the cuff and underlined it twice.
lineman_s_gloves_of_the_engineer.icon: Padded lineman's gauntlet glove with black rubber-dipped fingertips, tan canvas back, brown palm, tiny brass wrench charm hanging from the cuff.

pressed_lineman_s_gloves.name: Pressed Lineman's Gloves
pressed_lineman_s_gloves.description: Steamed flat in a Paramount wardrobe press so a featured player could look like a working man in close-up. Nobody on the lot ever saw him climb anything but a contract.
pressed_lineman_s_gloves.icon: Crisp pale khaki padded lineman's gauntlet glove with sharp pressed creases, spotless tan leather palm, tidy white stitching.

tailored_lineman_s_gloves.name: Tailored Lineman's Gloves
tailored_lineman_s_gloves.description: Cut to measure for a Universal electrical foreman who held that a man should look respectable even forty feet up. The fit is snug; the bill was not.
tailored_lineman_s_gloves.icon: Close-fitting padded lineman's gauntlet glove, dark navy canvas back, tan calfskin palm, neat tapered cuff closed with a polished brass snap.

heavy_lineman_s_gloves.name: Heavy Lineman's Gloves
heavy_lineman_s_gloves.description: Double-thickness hide over quilted canvas, made after an Invader Soldier bit clean through a line crew's ordinary pair. The river crews wear them everywhere now, supper included.
heavy_lineman_s_gloves.icon: Bulky lineman's gauntlet glove, thick dark brown hide over grey quilted canvas, riveted steel strip across the knuckles, long stiff cuff.

reinforced_welder_s_gauntlets.name: Reinforced Welder's Gauntlets
reinforced_welder_s_gauntlets.description: Double-stitched at the cuff after a Lockheed riveter lost a sleeve to a stray spark. The plant foreman called it a waste of canvas until the second fire.
reinforced_welder_s_gauntlets.icon: Heavy tan canvas welding gauntlet with long flared cuff, thick brown leather patches over palm and knuckles, double rows of stitching, a few dark scorch marks.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_agility.name: Welder's Gauntlets of Agility
welder_s_gauntlets_of_agility.description: Cut a size under regulation for a Burbank welder who liked working high on ladders and coming down from them in a hurry.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_agility.icon: Slim tan canvas welding gauntlet with a narrow fitted cuff, bright green stitching along the fingers and a small green cloth tag at the wrist.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_strength.name: Welder's Gauntlets of Strength
welder_s_gauntlets_of_strength.description: Their last owner straightened a bent red-car rail on Ventura Boulevard by himself, or so the river camp tells it. The story grows a foot every time the coffee runs out.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_strength.icon: Bulky tan canvas welding gauntlet with a thick red-orange leather plate across the knuckles, studded with heavy steel rivets, wide stiff cuff.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_stamina.name: Welder's Gauntlets of Stamina
welder_s_gauntlets_of_stamina.description: Found on a bench in the First National machine shop, beside a thermos and a lunch pail nobody came back for.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_stamina.icon: Dark brown canvas welding gauntlet with a deep quilted cuff, padded diamond stitching on the back, a navy blue band around the wrist.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.name: Welder's Gauntlets of the Boxer
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.description: A Legion Stadium heavyweight wore these welding bleacher brackets on Saturday mornings to pay for his Friday-night losses. The left one still throws a fair uppercut.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.icon: Tan canvas welding gauntlet with rounded padded knuckles, red stitching, and a small brass boxing-glove pin fixed to the flared cuff.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_marksman.name: Welder's Gauntlets of the Marksman
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_marksman.description: Sewn with a thin trigger finger for a Lockheed inspector who spent his breaks shooting tin cans off the United Airport fence. He rarely missed and never let anyone forget it.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_marksman.icon: Tan canvas welding gauntlet with a cut-down slim index finger, grey leather palm, and a small brass disc with a notched cross-hair riveted to the cuff.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.name: Welder's Gauntlets of the Acrobat
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.description: Borrowed from the Sennett prop shop by a stuntman who welded his own wire rigs and trusted nobody else's seams. He fell off three roofs in them and kept both hands.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.icon: Supple grey-tan canvas welding gauntlet, flexible pleated knuckles, yellow stitched band at the wrist and a tiny steel trapeze-ring charm on the cuff.

welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_engineer.name: Welder's Gauntlets of the Engineer
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_engineer.description: Pencil sums are scorched into the cuff, where an airframe man worked out load figures between welds. Most of them check out; the one that does not has been circled twice.
welder_s_gauntlets_of_the_engineer.icon: Tan canvas welding gauntlet with faint grey smudged markings on the cuff, sky-blue stitching and a small brass wrench charm hanging from the wrist strap.

superior_welder_s_gauntlets.name: Superior Welder's Gauntlets
superior_welder_s_gauntlets.description: Lined in good chrome leather the studios once kept for star wardrobe. Wardrobe objected to the transfer in writing; the welders used the memo to light a torch.
superior_welder_s_gauntlets.icon: Crisp clean pale tan welding gauntlet with a glossy black leather cuff, neat even stitching and a polished steel buckle strap at the wrist.

chitin_lined_welder_s_gauntlets.name: Chitin-lined Welder's Gauntlets
chitin_lined_welder_s_gauntlets.description: Invader shell sewn inside the palm turns heat better than asbestos and smells faintly of the hive on a warm afternoon. The Burbank shops stopped asking where the scraps came from.
chitin_lined_welder_s_gauntlets.icon: Sturdy tan canvas welding gauntlet with an iridescent green-black chitin lining showing at the open flared cuff and along the palm seam.

chitin_plated_welder_s_gauntlets.name: Chitin-plated Welder's Gauntlets
chitin_plated_welder_s_gauntlets.description: Overlapping plates of soldier shell guard the backs, fitted by men below the HOLLYWOODLAND sign who weld hive doors shut now instead of airframes. The plates creak when the wind comes off Mount Lee.
chitin_plated_welder_s_gauntlets.icon: Heavy canvas welding gauntlet armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates over the back and fingers, fixed with brass rivets, scorched dark cuff.

reinforced_sleeve_garters.name: Reinforced Sleeve Garters
reinforced_sleeve_garters.description: Doubled elastic and a riveted clasp, built for a bartender who expected the stools to start flying. Under the Dome they mostly keep a cuff clear of the trigger guard.
reinforced_sleeve_garters.icon: Pair of thick elastic armbands in dark charcoal grey, double-stitched bands with heavy brass riveted clasps, slightly scuffed but solid

sleeve_garters_of_intellect.name: Sleeve Garters of Intellect
sleeve_garters_of_intellect.description: A bookkeeper on the First National lot in Burbank wore these through three audits and one invasion. He still balances the commissary ledger by candlelight and has yet to be off by a cent.
sleeve_garters_of_intellect.icon: Pair of crisp navy elastic armbands with polished silver buckles, a small green-enamelled fountain-pen nib charm dangling from one clasp

sleeve_garters_of_spirit.name: Sleeve Garters of Spirit
sleeve_garters_of_spirit.description: Found folded neatly on a pew in a boarded-up Burbank chapel. Whoever left them never came back, and the ladies who sweep the aisle insist that is a sign of peace rather than the other thing.
sleeve_garters_of_spirit.icon: Pair of pale cream elastic armbands with a sky-blue centre stripe, small silver dove-shaped clasps

sleeve_garters_of_stamina.name: Sleeve Garters of Stamina
sleeve_garters_of_stamina.description: Speakeasy barmen on the Strip worked double shifts in garters like these, pouring what the law said did not exist. The elastic outlasted the barmen, the raids and most of the clientele.
sleeve_garters_of_stamina.icon: Pair of thick oxblood-red elastic armbands with wide gunmetal buckles, sturdy and slightly stretched from long wear

sleeve_garters_of_the_engineer.name: Sleeve Garters of the Engineer
sleeve_garters_of_the_engineer.description: Lockheed riveters used them to keep sleeves out of the drill press, and one foreman swore they steadied his slide-rule hand. The grease stains came standard.
sleeve_garters_of_the_engineer.icon: Pair of charcoal elastic armbands with bright orange stitching, smudged with black grease, a tiny brass wrench charm on one clasp

sleeve_garters_of_the_doctor.name: Sleeve Garters of the Doctor
sleeve_garters_of_the_doctor.description: Rolled sleeves are the first thing a surgeon learns. A Studio City doctor kept these on through a long night of acid burns at the river camp and asked only that they be laundered before being passed along.
sleeve_garters_of_the_doctor.icon: Pair of clean white elastic armbands with red cross-stitched seams, a tiny silver stethoscope charm hanging from one clasp

sleeve_garters_of_the_deacon.name: Sleeve Garters of the Deacon
sleeve_garters_of_the_deacon.description: Choir directors favour them for keeping cuffs off the hymnal. These made the long walk to Angelus Temple and back more Sundays than anyone counted, and still smell faintly of lilies and lamp oil.
sleeve_garters_of_the_deacon.icon: Pair of black elastic armbands trimmed with purple hymnal ribbon, a small brass cross charm on one buckle

superior_sleeve_garters.name: Superior Sleeve Garters
superior_sleeve_garters.description: Silk-faced, with German-silver clasps, the sort a Roosevelt Hotel cashier wore to look honest. Bought at a Burbank haberdasher's closing-out sale, the closing having been arranged by the hive.
superior_sleeve_garters.icon: Pair of glossy burgundy silk-faced armbands with polished nickel-silver clasps, neat and gleaming, perfectly pressed

chitin_lined_sleeve_garters.name: Chitin-lined Sleeve Garters
chitin_lined_sleeve_garters.description: Stitched inside the elastic, slivers of invader shell keep the band from ever slipping. They grip like a nervous chorus girl and creak softly whenever the wearer reaches for coffee.
chitin_lined_sleeve_garters.icon: Pair of grey elastic armbands with thin iridescent green-black shell strips peeking from the inner edges, plain steel clasps

chitin_plated_sleeve_garters.name: Chitin-plated Sleeve Garters
chitin_plated_sleeve_garters.description: Overlapping scales cover the band, cut from Soldiers felled below the HOLLYWOODLAND sign. Nobody at the Mount Lee forward camp asks whose sleeves they kept dry, or how long ago.
chitin_plated_sleeve_garters.icon: Pair of armbands faced with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin scales over dark leather backing, blackened iron buckles

diamond_pinky_ring_of_strength.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of Strength
diamond_pinky_ring_of_strength.description: Pried off a Dragna enforcer who used it to settle arguments in Studio City. One claw of the setting is bent where it lost an argument with a Brute.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_strength.icon: Heavy yellow-gold pinky ring, square diamond in a raised four-claw setting, thick shank with a red enamel stripe, one claw slightly bent.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_agility.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of Agility
diamond_pinky_ring_of_agility.description: This one belonged to a dealer at a card room on the Strip who could cut a deck one-handed and leave by the kitchen door before the second police whistle.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_agility.icon: Slim yellow-gold ring with a marquise-cut diamond set lengthwise, thin band inlaid with a line of green enamel.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_stamina.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of Stamina
diamond_pinky_ring_of_stamina.description: Three winters running Cornero's liquor through cold Pacific swells, and the boatman who wore it outlasted the boat. The ring outlasted the boatman, which says something about diamonds.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_stamina.icon: Chunky white-gold ring, round diamond sunk in a heavy bezel, wide band with a blue enamel stripe, scuffed and salt-dulled shoulders.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_intellect.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of Intellect
diamond_pinky_ring_of_intellect.description: Crawford's bookkeeper wore it on his pen hand, so every ledger page caught a little sparkle. He kept two sets of books for eleven years and never once confused them.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_intellect.icon: Platinum ring with an emerald-cut diamond, narrow band engraved with fine parallel lines, small yellow enamel dot on each shoulder.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_spirit.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of Spirit
diamond_pinky_ring_of_spirit.description: Found in a collection plate at a Burbank church with no note and no name. The pastor declined to ask questions, and the congregation still prays for whoever dropped it.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_spirit.icon: Modest silver ring with a small round diamond, plain polished band with a thin white enamel band around the middle.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_boxer.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Boxer
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_boxer.description: Ringside at the Legion Stadium every Friday, a promoter flashed it so the crowd knew who was paying. It went into the third row during a disagreement over a split decision.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_boxer.icon: Thick yellow-gold ring, square diamond solitaire, tiny red enamel boxing-glove charm soldered to the side of the band.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_acrobat.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Acrobat
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_acrobat.description: Kept on a string around a trapeze flyer's neck during a Universal circus picture, then slipped back on to collect her pay. The knotted string is still tied to the shank.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slender rose-gold ring with a pear-shaped diamond, short length of knotted red string tied around the band.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_stevedore.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Stevedore
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where a foreman wore it to remind the gang who signed the timesheets. It supervised a good many crates of machine parts that sloshed when dropped.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_stevedore.icon: Thick yellow-gold ring with a square diamond, rope-twist band, small stamped brass anchor plate on one shoulder.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_marksman.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Marksman
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_marksman.description: Its owner shot trap at the gun clubs out past the Pass and wore it on the off hand so it would not spoil the aim. The Elder Fliers over Mount Lee never saw the glint until too late.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_marksman.icon: Platinum ring with a round diamond, small cross-hair notch engraved on top of the setting, band lined with black enamel.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_engineer.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Engineer
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_engineer.description: Bought after a Lockheed draughtsman's first patent and worn while drawing wing ribs. Diamond scratches glass, so when paper ran short he marked measurements on the plant windows.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_engineer.icon: White-gold ring, cushion-cut diamond, tiny steel wrench charm hanging from the band, faint grey pencil smudge on the shank.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_doctor.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Doctor
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_doctor.description: House calls on Whitley Heights were its old beat, worn by a physician who considered it part of the bedside manner. Since the Dome he has worked a Burbank aid station, and the stone has seen more stitches than champagne.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_doctor.icon: Platinum ring with a round diamond, small red cross in enamel on the band shoulder, a twist of white gauze thread caught in the setting.

diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_deacon.name: Diamond Pinky Ring of the Deacon
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_deacon.description: Pledged at Angelus Temple during a Sunday offering and never redeemed. The deacon who carried it up to the camp below the sign walks the long way round, and says the walk is the point.
diamond_pinky_ring_of_the_deacon.icon: Silver ring with a small round diamond, narrow blue hymnal ribbon tied around the band in a neat bow.

reinforced_patent_leather_pumps.name: Reinforced Patent Leather Pumps
reinforced_patent_leather_pumps.description: A cobbler on Cahuenga put steel shanks in the heels, which ruins the line and saves the ankle. Dancers complain until the first hive surge.
reinforced_patent_leather_pumps.icon: Pair of glossy black patent leather pumps, low heels capped in dull steel, a riveted steel shank visible along the instep, sensible rubber sole edge.

patent_leather_pumps_of_intellect.name: Patent Leather Pumps of Intellect
patent_leather_pumps_of_intellect.description: Last worn by a script girl at First National who kept continuity on eleven pictures at once and never lost a cigarette between takes. The heels are scuffed from pacing.
patent_leather_pumps_of_intellect.icon: Pair of glossy black patent pumps with a small ivory bow at each toe, a tiny brass pencil charm clipped to one strap, scuffed heels.

patent_leather_pumps_of_spirit.name: Patent Leather Pumps of Spirit
patent_leather_pumps_of_spirit.description: Somebody danced till dawn in these in the Roosevelt's Blossom Room the night before the Dome came down. They still carry the tune, if not the partner.
patent_leather_pumps_of_spirit.icon: Pair of glossy black patent pumps with pale blue satin rosettes on the toes, slender curved heels, faint dance scuffs on the soles.

patent_leather_pumps_of_stamina.name: Patent Leather Pumps of Stamina
patent_leather_pumps_of_stamina.description: Built for a chorus line that did four shows a day at the Pantages and never once sat down. The soles have walked the Boulevard more often than the red car.
patent_leather_pumps_of_stamina.icon: Pair of thick-soled black patent pumps with sturdy block heels, double-stitched red leather heel counters, deep creases at the toe.

patent_leather_pumps_of_the_engineer.name: Patent Leather Pumps of the Engineer
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_engineer.description: Salvaged from a Lockheed draughtswoman's locker, along with a slide rule and a ham sandwich of uncertain age. The heels were filed square so they would not catch on catwalk grating.
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_engineer.icon: Pair of black patent pumps with squared low heels, a small steel wrench charm hanging from a buckle strap, grey grease smudge on one toe.

patent_leather_pumps_of_the_doctor.name: Patent Leather Pumps of the Doctor
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_doctor.description: An aid-station nurse in Burbank swears by them: quiet on linoleum, quick on stairs and easy to wipe clean. She did not say clean of what.
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_doctor.icon: Pair of glossy black pumps with crisp white piping around the collar, a tiny red cross enamel button on each ankle strap.

patent_leather_pumps_of_the_deacon.name: Patent Leather Pumps of the Deacon
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday for nine years these walked a widow from Edendale to Angelus Temple and back, rain or none. They smell faintly of hymnals and shoe polish, and they do not hurry.
patent_leather_pumps_of_the_deacon.icon: Pair of modest black patent pumps with low heels, slim purple ribbon bows, soft worn creases across the toes.

superior_patent_leather_pumps.name: Superior Patent Leather Pumps
superior_patent_leather_pumps.description: Wardrobe at First National stopped ordering these for the stars once they proved too sensible. The stand-ins kept them.
superior_patent_leather_pumps.icon: Pair of deep black patent pumps with mirror shine, steel-tipped heels, grey reinforced toe caps and neatly welted soles.

chitin_lined_patent_leather_pumps.name: Chitin-lined Patent Leather Pumps
chitin_lined_patent_leather_pumps.description: Under the patent shine, a lining of pared Spitter shell keeps the acid off the stockings. Fashion columnists have been asked not to look too closely.
chitin_lined_patent_leather_pumps.icon: Pair of black patent pumps with iridescent green-black chitin lining showing above the collar and inside the heel, dull steel heel caps.

chitin_plated_patent_leather_pumps.name: Chitin-plated Patent Leather Pumps
chitin_plated_patent_leather_pumps.description: Toe caps cut from a Soldier's carapace, polished until nobody can say where the leather stops. They click on pavement like something that would rather not be worn.
chitin_plated_patent_leather_pumps.icon: Pair of pumps with toe caps and heel plates of glossy green-black iridescent chitin, black patent body between, small rivets along the seams.

reinforced_cavalry_boots.name: Reinforced Cavalry Boots
reinforced_cavalry_boots.description: Army issue from the Post 43 stores, resoled twice and given a steel plate in the heel. The spur straps came off after one too many caught on a hive spire.
reinforced_cavalry_boots.icon: Pair of tall brown cavalry riding boots to the knee, steel heel plates, extra stitched leather patches at the ankles, empty spur rests.

cavalry_boots_of_agility.name: Cavalry Boots of Agility
cavalry_boots_of_agility.description: Tom Mix's stable hands say the man who broke these in could mount from a standing start and dismount at a gallop. Nobody has asked the horse.
cavalry_boots_of_agility.icon: Pair of tall supple tan riding boots with slim calves, small silver spurs, bright green leather pull tabs at the tops.

cavalry_boots_of_stamina.name: Cavalry Boots of Stamina
cavalry_boots_of_stamina.description: Thirty miles a day along the border in 1916, if the tag stitched inside is honest. The leather has gone hard as a fence post and about as tired.
cavalry_boots_of_stamina.icon: Pair of tall dark brown cavalry boots, heavily creased thick leather, deep soles, a faded khaki tag stitched inside one top.

cavalry_boots_of_spirit.name: Cavalry Boots of Spirit
cavalry_boots_of_spirit.description: Kept on a closet shelf in Los Feliz by a retired major who polished them every evening and never rode again. There is something calming in the shine.
cavalry_boots_of_spirit.icon: Pair of knee-high cavalry boots in rich oxblood leather with mirror polish, a folded soft cloth tucked into one boot top.

cavalry_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Cavalry Boots of the Acrobat
cavalry_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: One Gower Gulch extra did his own falls from the saddle in these for five dollars a day and a box lunch. He took the boots when the picture wrapped; the star took the credit.
cavalry_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pair of tan cavalry boots with dusty scuffed knees, bright yellow stitching running up the shafts, small brass ankle buckles.

cavalry_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Cavalry Boots of the Stevedore
cavalry_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: Off a San Pedro cargo foreman who wore riding boots for reasons he never explained and kicked crates about like they owed him money. The toes are flattened from it.
cavalry_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pair of heavy brown cavalry boots with flattened scarred toes, tarred rope wrapped round one ankle, iron hobnails studding the soles.

cavalry_boots_of_the_deacon.name: Cavalry Boots of the Deacon
cavalry_boots_of_the_deacon.description: Mud from three counties and a dozen camp meetings is worked into the welts. The circuit preacher who owned them held that a horse is the only congregation that never leaves early.
cavalry_boots_of_the_deacon.icon: Pair of worn black cavalry boots with dried reddish mud caked at the welts, a short violet ribbon tied through one pull loop.

superior_cavalry_boots.name: Superior Cavalry Boots
superior_cavalry_boots.description: Made to measure for a Universal cavalry picture that was shelved after the horses unionised. That last part is a rumour put about by the wranglers.
superior_cavalry_boots.icon: Pair of tall polished chestnut cavalry boots, crisp stitched shafts, steel-reinforced heels and toes, gleaming brass buckles at the ankles.

chitin_lined_cavalry_boots.name: Chitin-lined Cavalry Boots
chitin_lined_cavalry_boots.description: Burrowers strike from below, so a Burbank saddler started stitching shell between sole and insole. Riders are scarce now; the boots get walked into the ground instead.
chitin_lined_cavalry_boots.icon: Pair of tall brown cavalry boots, thick sole edges showing a layer of iridescent green-black chitin, chitin trim lining the boot tops.

chitin_plated_cavalry_boots.name: Chitin-plated Cavalry Boots
chitin_plated_cavalry_boots.description: Greaves of Brute shell strapped over the shafts turn a riding boot into something nearer armour. Below the Mount Lee forward camp, men sleep in them.
chitin_plated_cavalry_boots.icon: Pair of knee-high dark leather boots with overlapping green-black iridescent chitin plates strapped down the shins, heavy steel buckles.

silver_chain_of_strength.name: Silver Chain of Strength
silver_chain_of_strength.description: Pawned on Cahuenga by a piano mover who swore he would be back for it Tuesday. The ticket lapsed, the movers were taken, and the chain stayed, heavy enough to suit a man who lifts things for a living.
silver_chain_of_strength.icon: Thick curb-link silver chain coiled in a loose loop, hung with a small blocky iron anvil charm, dark grey metal against bright polished silver, a scuffed brass pawn tag tied on with red string.

silver_chain_of_agility.name: Silver Chain of Agility
silver_chain_of_agility.description: Slipped off the neck of a Keystone tumbler mid-somersault in 1924 and turned up two years later under a Gower Gulch boardwalk. Its owner never broke stride, or anything else.
silver_chain_of_agility.icon: Fine delicate silver rope chain curling in a graceful S-curve, a tiny silver feather pendant at the end, light blue enamel inlay on the feather, gleaming thin links.

silver_chain_of_stamina.name: Silver Chain of Stamina
silver_chain_of_stamina.description: Night watchmen on the Vitagraph lot wore these through twelve-hour shifts, a saint's medal on one end and a time-clock key on the other. The medal wore smooth long before the watchmen did.
silver_chain_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy silver box chain coiled in a circle, a worn round saint's medal and a small brass time-clock key hanging together, dull green patina on the medal edge.

silver_chain_of_intellect.name: Silver Chain of Intellect
silver_chain_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a Warner Bros. script reader who could find the hole in any plot by page nine. The studio kept her on for that talent and paid her for about half of it.
silver_chain_of_intellect.icon: Slim silver chain draped in an oval, a small hinged silver locket shaped like a closed book, deep violet enamel cover, tiny pencil charm beside it.

silver_chain_of_spirit.name: Silver Chain of Spirit
