silver_chain_of_spirit.description: Hung for years on a nail by the Echo Park boathouse, where fishermen touched it for luck before casting. Nobody claimed it and nobody caught much, but they went home calm.
silver_chain_of_spirit.icon: Silver chain looped over itself with a small silver fish-shaped pendant, pale sea-green enamel scales, a bent rusty nail threaded through one link.

silver_chain_of_the_boxer.name: Silver Chain of the Boxer
silver_chain_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a welterweight from Boyle Heights handed this to his corner man before every bout. He lost eleven of fourteen and kept every tooth, which he counted as the better record.
silver_chain_of_the_boxer.icon: Heavy silver curb chain in a coil, a tiny red enamel boxing glove charm hanging from it, white lace detail on the glove, a short frayed strip of tape tied to one link.

silver_chain_of_the_acrobat.name: Silver Chain of the Acrobat
silver_chain_of_the_acrobat.description: Circus people wintering in Los Angeles swore by these: light enough to forget on the high wire, strong enough to hold a medal through a fall into the net.
silver_chain_of_the_acrobat.icon: Thin silver chain stretched in a gentle arc like a tightrope, a small silver trapeze bar pendant with gold-striped ends, tiny star charm dangling below.

silver_chain_of_the_stevedore.name: Silver Chain of the Stevedore
silver_chain_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro in a longshoreman's pocket, along with a cargo hook and a grudge against the shipping company. The other two are gone.
silver_chain_of_the_stevedore.icon: Chunky silver anchor-link chain coiled loosely, a small steel cargo hook charm hanging from it, a knot of tarred brown rope fibre wound around one link.

silver_chain_of_the_marksman.name: Silver Chain of the Marksman
silver_chain_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner hunted deer in Griffith Park and never fired twice at anything. Each clean shot earned a tiny notch on the clasp, and there is very little clasp left.
silver_chain_of_the_marksman.icon: Slender silver chain in a tidy coil, a round silver pendant engraved with a crosshair, a dark green enamel ring around it, clasp lined with tiny notches.

silver_chain_of_the_engineer.name: Silver Chain of the Engineer
silver_chain_of_the_engineer.description: Wrapped twice round the wrist of a Chaplin lot electrician while he rewired a hive-eaten switchboard, so it would not swing into the live bus bar. He lived to complain about the overtime.
silver_chain_of_the_engineer.icon: Silver chain twisted in a double loop, a small silver wrench charm and a copper wire coil hanging from it, a faint scorch mark darkening one section of links.

silver_chain_of_the_doctor.name: Silver Chain of the Doctor
silver_chain_of_the_doctor.description: From the estate of a Los Feliz physician who made house calls at any hour and billed for few of them. A small silver caduceus still hangs from it, polished by worried thumbs.
silver_chain_of_the_doctor.icon: Fine silver chain draped in an oval, a bright polished silver caduceus pendant with two entwined snakes, a small white enamel cross charm beside it.

silver_chain_of_the_deacon.name: Silver Chain of the Deacon
silver_chain_of_the_deacon.description: Smells faintly of hymnal paper and the long walk up Glendale Boulevard to Angelus Temple. A deacon wore it to every service for six years, and to the first night of the invasion, when the singing did not stop.
silver_chain_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain silver chain coiled neatly, a simple silver cross pendant, a short length of faded crimson hymnal ribbon tied through the top link.

reinforced_colt_single_action_army.name: Reinforced Colt Single Action Army
reinforced_colt_single_action_army.description: Somebody at the Universal prop shop strapped the frame with steel after a Brute stepped on the original. Still single action, still six shots, still slower than anything with mandibles.
reinforced_colt_single_action_army.icon: Long-barrelled single action revolver with curved plough-handle grip, dark blued frame wrapped by a riveted steel reinforcing strap, worn brown walnut grips.

colt_single_action_army_of_agility.name: Colt Single Action Army of Agility
colt_single_action_army_of_agility.description: Fanned from the hip in forty-one Westerns by a Gower Gulch extra who never once got a screen credit. The hammer moves before the thought does.
colt_single_action_army_of_agility.icon: Slim single action revolver with mottled case-hardened frame, blued barrel, ivory grips inlaid with a small green feather, hammer cocked back.

colt_single_action_army_of_stamina.name: Colt Single Action Army of Stamina
colt_single_action_army_of_stamina.description: Heavier than it looks, and carried by a Burbank night watchman who walked the First National lot eleven hours a shift without sitting down. The holster wore through twice. He never did.
colt_single_action_army_of_stamina.icon: Nickel-plated single action revolver with thick barrel, black hard-rubber grips, a looped brown leather lanyard tied through the butt ring.

colt_single_action_army_of_the_acrobat.name: Colt Single Action Army of the Acrobat
colt_single_action_army_of_the_acrobat.description: Twirled, tossed and caught behind the back at every rodeo matinee Tom Mix ever played, though never by Tom Mix. His stunt double kept it when the show folded.
colt_single_action_army_of_the_acrobat.icon: Polished blued single action revolver with silver-engraved cylinder, white mother-of-pearl grips, a small red tassel hanging from the lanyard ring.

colt_single_action_army_of_the_marksman.name: Colt Single Action Army of the Marksman
colt_single_action_army_of_the_marksman.description: Its owner split playing cards edgewise in the Hollywood Hotel bar for drinks that did not legally exist. The front sight has been filed to a needle by a patient thumb.
colt_single_action_army_of_the_marksman.icon: Single action revolver with extra-long blued barrel, needle-fine front sight tipped with a brass bead, walnut grips with a carved cross-hair notch.

colt_single_action_army_of_the_stevedore.name: Colt Single Action Army of the Stevedore
colt_single_action_army_of_the_stevedore.description: Came ashore at San Pedro in a crate stencilled as machine parts, and the longshoreman who pried it open decided he had found the best part. It settles cargo disputes quickly.
colt_single_action_army_of_the_stevedore.icon: Scuffed blued single action revolver with oak grips bound in tarred hemp twine, a small iron cargo-hook charm dangling from the butt ring.

superior_colt_single_action_army.name: Superior Colt Single Action Army
superior_colt_single_action_army.description: Hand-fitted by the gunsmith at Stembridge's on Marathon Street, who swears the cylinder locks up tighter than the studio payroll.
superior_colt_single_action_army.icon: Crisp bright-blued single action revolver with gilt-edged trigger guard, glossy rosewood grips, clean sharp lines and a gleaming fluted cylinder.

chitin_lined_colt_single_action_army.name: Chitin-lined Colt Single Action Army
chitin_lined_colt_single_action_army.description: Under the grips sits a strip of Soldier shell scraped off near the Lockheed plant, and it keeps the recoil polite. The barrel smells faintly of formic acid and burnt cordite.
chitin_lined_colt_single_action_army.icon: Dark steel single action revolver with grips of iridescent green-black chitin, blued barrel, thin shell lining visible along the grip frame.

chitin_plated_colt_single_action_army.name: Chitin-plated Colt Single Action Army
chitin_plated_colt_single_action_army.description: Mount Lee's forward camp plates the frames now, since steel ran short and dead invaders did not. Fifty-seven years after it first came out of Hartford, the Peacemaker is earning the name the hard way.
chitin_plated_colt_single_action_army.icon: Single action revolver with frame and cylinder sheathed in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, bare steel muzzle, faint glowing amber resin seams.

reinforced_springfield_m1903.name: Reinforced Springfield M1903
reinforced_springfield_m1903.description: Dug out of a Post 43 footlocker, where it had waited since the Argonne beside a cleaning rod and a letter nobody mailed. The new steel bands round the stock are the Legion armourer's work.
reinforced_springfield_m1903.icon: Long bolt-action military rifle with full-length walnut stock, extra riveted steel bands clamped around the forestock, dull grey parkerized metal.

springfield_m1903_of_agility.name: Springfield M1903 of Agility
springfield_m1903_of_agility.description: Quick on the bolt. A Lockheed rigger could work it four times before a Flier finished its dive, and said so at the Brown Derby until somebody paid for his coffee.
springfield_m1903_of_agility.icon: Slim bolt-action rifle with polished steel bolt handle raised, light honey walnut stock, a green ribbon tied at the front sling swivel.

springfield_m1903_of_stamina.name: Springfield M1903 of Stamina
springfield_m1903_of_stamina.description: This one survived the Meuse-Argonne, a Mojave summer and a sergeant who used it as a tent pole. It still shoots straight, which is more than anyone said of the sergeant.
springfield_m1903_of_stamina.icon: Battered heavy bolt-action rifle with dark oiled walnut stock, thick olive canvas sling wound around it, dented brass buttplate.

springfield_m1903_of_the_acrobat.name: Springfield M1903 of the Acrobat
springfield_m1903_of_the_acrobat.description: A Mack Sennett stuntman slung it across his back for rooftop chase gags and once fired it upside down from a swinging ladder, mostly for the cameraman. The sling is sewn from old trapeze webbing.
springfield_m1903_of_the_acrobat.icon: Bolt-action rifle with light walnut stock and a bright red-and-white striped webbing sling, small brass buckle, polished blued barrel.

springfield_m1903_of_the_marksman.name: Springfield M1903 of the Marksman
springfield_m1903_of_the_marksman.description: Brought home from France with its telescopic sight still mounted and a notebook of ranges tucked in the butt trap. Its owner dropped a Spitter across Lake Hollywood and wrote down the yardage before he celebrated.
springfield_m1903_of_the_marksman.icon: Bolt-action rifle with a long slender brass telescopic sight mounted offset on the receiver, dark walnut stock bearing a small carved cross-hair notch.

springfield_m1903_of_the_stevedore.name: Springfield M1903 of the Stevedore
springfield_m1903_of_the_stevedore.description: Longshoremen carried it on the San Pedro night shift to keep Cornero's boats honest, or at least punctual. Shoulders built on sugar sacks take the kick without comment.
springfield_m1903_of_the_stevedore.icon: Bolt-action rifle with tar-stained walnut stock, a coil of hemp rope lashed round the wrist of the stock, iron cargo-hook charm on the sling.

superior_springfield_m1903.name: Superior Springfield M1903
superior_springfield_m1903.description: Every screw indexed, every part hand-lapped, the work of a Paramount machinist with no sets left to build. He lends it out on one condition: it comes back clean.
superior_springfield_m1903.icon: Pristine bolt-action rifle with glossy dark walnut stock, bright blued barrel, mirror-polished bolt, new tan leather sling.

chitin_lined_springfield_m1903.name: Chitin-lined Springfield M1903
chitin_lined_springfield_m1903.description: Behind the buttplate a pad of Brute shell swallows the .30-06 kick like a sigh. Burbank gunsmiths say chitin never swells or splits, unlike walnut and unlike the men who carry it.
chitin_lined_springfield_m1903.icon: Bolt-action rifle with walnut stock fitted with a buttpad and cheekpiece of iridescent green-black chitin, blued barrel, steel bolt.

chitin_plated_springfield_m1903.name: Chitin-plated Springfield M1903
chitin_plated_springfield_m1903.description: Wartime issue, refitted for a stranger war. The stock is sheathed in plates from the Hive Tunnels, and the rifleman who finished it swears it hums near the queen's chambers, as if it remembers where it came from.
chitin_plated_springfield_m1903.icon: Bolt-action rifle with stock fully sheathed in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, glowing amber resin seams, steel barrel, dark sinewy webbing sling.

worn_cane.name: Worn Cane
worn_cane.description: The varnish gave out years before its owner did. Found hooked over a bench at the Highland red-car stop, waiting for a train nobody was taking.
worn_cane.icon: A plain hooked walking cane of dull brown wood, varnish worn to bare grey grain at the crook, scuffed black rubber ferrule at the tip.

cane_of_strength.name: Cane of Strength
cane_of_strength.description: Topped with a blackthorn knob the size of a fist, it belonged to a Gower Gulch heavy who played villains on camera and collected debts between pictures. He found the second job steadier.
cane_of_strength.icon: A dark knotted blackthorn cane with a heavy round knob handle, iron ferrule, and a red cord wrist loop dangling below the knob.

cane_of_stamina.name: Cane of Stamina
cane_of_stamina.description: Its owner walked to Central Casting and back every morning for eleven years without once getting a close-up. The cane did most of the standing around for him.
cane_of_stamina.icon: A straight pale ash cane with a tan leather-wrapped grip, brass ferrule, and a small green cord tassel tied below the handle.

cane_of_the_boxer.name: Cane of the Boxer
cane_of_the_boxer.description: A cut man at the Legion Stadium rapped it on the ring apron whenever his fighter dropped his left. On Friday nights it landed more often than the fighter did.
cane_of_the_boxer.icon: A stout hickory cane with a curved crook, red cloth tape wrapped below the handle, and a tiny brass boxing-glove pin fixed to the collar.

cane_of_the_stevedore.name: Cane of the Stevedore
cane_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who swore it was cut from a cargo boom. The crook still catches on crates out of habit.
cane_of_the_stevedore.icon: A thick tarred oak cane with an iron handle bent like a cargo hook, coarse hemp twine wound near the grip, blue-grey salt stains.

patched_cane.name: Patched Cane
patched_cane.description: Splinted with friction tape and optimism. It holds weight if asked politely.
patched_cane.icon: A wooden crook-handled cane with black friction tape binding a crack mid-shaft and a mismatched pale ferrule.

plain_cane.name: Plain Cane
plain_cane.description: Bought by the gross for the wardrobe department, which lends them to extras playing bankers. Nobody has asked for one back.
plain_cane.icon: A clean straight walnut cane with a simple crook handle, even brown finish and a bright nickel ferrule.

sturdy_cane.name: Sturdy Cane
sturdy_cane.description: Malacca over a steel core, the sort a careful man carried down Selma Avenue after dark, back when only some avenues were like that.
sturdy_cane.icon: A thick malacca cane with mottled tan bark, a polished silver collar under the crook and a heavy steel ferrule.

worn_pipe_wrench.name: Worn Pipe Wrench
worn_pipe_wrench.description: Teeth rounded smooth on thirty years of Hollywood plumbing. Rust has nearly made up the jaw's mind for it.
worn_pipe_wrench.icon: An old pipe wrench crusted in red-brown rust, dull rounded jaw teeth, a loose pitted adjusting nut.

pipe_wrench_of_intellect.name: Pipe Wrench of Intellect
pipe_wrench_of_intellect.description: A studio electrician's spare, its handle scratched with tidy conduit measurements. He did every sum twice and never once got bitten by a live line.
pipe_wrench_of_intellect.icon: An iron pipe wrench with a red-painted handle covered in faint scratched tally marks and a small blue enamel lightning-bolt tag on a lanyard.

pipe_wrench_of_spirit.name: Pipe Wrench of Spirit
pipe_wrench_of_spirit.description: Kept in the boiler room of a Cahuenga boarding house by a janitor who hummed while he worked and slept like a baby. Nobody else in the building did.
pipe_wrench_of_spirit.icon: A pipe wrench with a sky-blue painted handle, polished jaw, and a white cotton rag knotted around the grip.

pipe_wrench_of_the_engineer.name: Pipe Wrench of the Engineer
pipe_wrench_of_the_engineer.description: Pulled from the Christie machine shop, where it fixed a wind machine, a camera dolly and a producer's Packard in one afternoon. Only the Packard got a screen credit.
pipe_wrench_of_the_engineer.icon: A heavy steel pipe wrench with a black handle and yellow stripe, oiled jaw, and a small brass gear charm hanging from the hook hole.

pipe_wrench_of_the_doctor.name: Pipe Wrench of the Doctor
pipe_wrench_of_the_doctor.description: Spent the spring at an aid station on Highland opening oxygen bottles and stuck medicine cabinets. The grip still smells faintly of iodine.
pipe_wrench_of_the_doctor.icon: A nickel-bright pipe wrench, handle wrapped in white gauze tape, with a small red enamel cross tag tied at the end.

pipe_wrench_of_the_deacon.name: Pipe Wrench of the Deacon
pipe_wrench_of_the_deacon.description: Fixed the radiators at Angelus Temple through a long season of revival meetings. The choir sang loud enough that nobody ever heard the pipes knock.
pipe_wrench_of_the_deacon.icon: A pipe wrench with a dark green handle, a purple hymnal ribbon tied at the grip, and a worn brass adjusting nut.

patched_pipe_wrench.name: Patched Pipe Wrench
patched_pipe_wrench.description: Handle cracked and riveted back together with a strap of tin. The jaw still bites.
patched_pipe_wrench.icon: A pipe wrench with a grey iron handle, a crack bound by a riveted tin strap, and chipped jaw teeth.

plain_pipe_wrench.name: Plain Pipe Wrench
plain_pipe_wrench.description: Standard stock from any hardware counter on Santa Monica Boulevard, at least while there were hardware counters.
plain_pipe_wrench.icon: A clean iron pipe wrench with a plain orange enamel handle and crisp bright steel teeth.

sturdy_pipe_wrench.name: Sturdy Pipe Wrench
sturdy_pipe_wrench.description: Twenty-four inches of drop-forged steel. Union plumbers called it the persuader, and the invaders have so far found it very persuasive.
sturdy_pipe_wrench.icon: A long heavy pipe wrench with a thick blue-enamelled steel handle, broad toothed jaw and knurled brass adjusting nut.

reinforced_arc_lamp.name: Reinforced Arc Lamp
reinforced_arc_lamp.description: Extra bracing on the yoke and a wire cage over the lens, added after a Drone mistook the last one for a rival. Carbons sold separately, as ever.
reinforced_arc_lamp.icon: Compact carbon arc lamp, drum-shaped black-enamelled steel housing wrapped in heavy riveted bracing straps, wire cage over the round glass lens, short iron yoke handle.

arc_lamp_of_intellect.name: Arc Lamp of Intellect
arc_lamp_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a gaffer on the First National lot who could recite the whole stage wiring diagram from memory, and frequently did, uninvited. The carbons still burn a clean, thinking white.
arc_lamp_of_intellect.icon: Drum-shaped carbon arc lamp in dark steel with a cobalt-blue enamel band around the housing, clear bright lens, small brass pencil charm hanging from the yoke handle.

arc_lamp_of_spirit.name: Arc Lamp of Spirit
arc_lamp_of_spirit.description: Kept lit through three nights on the Mount Lee ridge so the forward camp could see one another's faces. The men swear it warms a tent better than any stove, which the quartermaster disputes.
arc_lamp_of_spirit.icon: Drum-shaped carbon arc lamp in dark steel with a pale gold band, warm amber-tinted lens glowing softly, grey wool scarf knotted around the yoke handle.

arc_lamp_of_the_engineer.name: Arc Lamp of the Engineer
arc_lamp_of_the_engineer.description: Rewired at the Lockheed plant by a fellow who swore it could survive a drop from the top of a hangar door. He tested the theory twice and was asked to stop.
arc_lamp_of_the_engineer.icon: Drum-shaped carbon arc lamp in dark steel with an olive-green painted band, exposed copper terminal posts on the back, small steel wrench charm on the yoke.

arc_lamp_of_the_doctor.name: Arc Lamp of the Doctor
arc_lamp_of_the_doctor.description: A surgeon at the river camp clamped it over his table when the generator quit. Steady hands, a steady arc, and only one complaint about the smell of hot carbon.
arc_lamp_of_the_doctor.icon: Drum-shaped carbon arc lamp in dark steel with a glossy white enamel band, clear bright lens, small red-striped linen tag tied to the yoke handle.

arc_lamp_of_the_deacon.name: Arc Lamp of the Deacon
arc_lamp_of_the_deacon.description: Carried at the head of a Sunday procession down Ventura Boulevard, a hymnal in the other hand. It still smells faintly of pew polish, and nobody argued with the deacon while it was lit.
arc_lamp_of_the_deacon.icon: Drum-shaped carbon arc lamp in dark steel with a deep purple ribbon bookmark tied to its dark walnut handle, soft white lens, small brass cross-shaped rivet on the hood.

superior_arc_lamp.name: Superior Arc Lamp
superior_arc_lamp.description: Polished reflector, ground-glass lens and a switch that clicks like a good cigarette case. Mack Sennett's electricians would have traded a custard pie for one.
superior_arc_lamp.icon: Gleaming nickel-plated drum arc lamp, mirror-bright silver reflector visible behind a frosted ground-glass lens, neat black bakelite switch, polished steel yoke.

chitin_lined_arc_lamp.name: Chitin-lined Arc Lamp
chitin_lined_arc_lamp.description: The inside of the hood is laid with thin invader shell, which throws the beam further and hums faintly when a hive is near. Electricians have stopped asking why.
chitin_lined_arc_lamp.icon: Steel drum arc lamp with its open hood lined inside with iridescent green-black chitin, faint greenish sheen in the lens, dull grey steel yoke.

chitin_plated_arc_lamp.name: Chitin-plated Arc Lamp
chitin_plated_arc_lamp.description: Plated in shell cut from a Hive Tunnels soldier, it weighs as much as a newsreel camera and takes a blow better than one. Whatever grew that armour was never meant to carry light.
chitin_plated_arc_lamp.icon: Heavy arc lamp encased in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates bolted with brass rivets, ridged insect-shell hood, bright white lens, thick blackened steel yoke.

sturdy_straight_razor.name: Sturdy Straight Razor
sturdy_straight_razor.description: Barber's razor with a heavy tang, honed on a strop until it could split a hair or an argument. Every shop on Gower kept a spare under the counter.
sturdy_straight_razor.icon: Folding straight razor half open, plain black horn scales, thick steel blade with a dull satin finish and a nicked heel, small brass pivot pin.

straight_razor_of_agility.name: Straight Razor of Agility
straight_razor_of_agility.description: Taken from the chair of a Cahuenga barbershop, where the barber claimed he could shave a man in ninety seconds without waking him. Nobody ever timed it, and nobody ever bled.
straight_razor_of_agility.icon: Open straight razor with a slim tapered blade, polished bright steel, pale ivory celluloid scales inlaid with a thin green stripe, light and elegant silhouette.

straight_razor_of_stamina.name: Straight Razor of Stamina
straight_razor_of_stamina.description: The blade is ordinary. The handle is wrapped in friction tape by somebody who meant to hold on through a long night at the Hollywood Hotel barricade, and apparently did.
straight_razor_of_stamina.icon: Open straight razor, plain steel blade, dark walnut scales wrapped thick with black friction tape, grey-blue thread binding knotted at the pivot.

straight_razor_of_the_acrobat.name: Straight Razor of the Acrobat
straight_razor_of_the_acrobat.description: Belonged to a stunt double on the Christie lot who kept it in his boot for falls that went wrong and parachute lines that tangled. He cut himself free twice and still shaved with it daily.
straight_razor_of_the_acrobat.icon: Straight razor half folded, glossy red celluloid scales, small brass ring through the tang end with a tiny dangling brass trapeze charm, bright steel blade.

straight_razor_of_the_marksman.name: Straight Razor of the Marksman
straight_razor_of_the_marksman.description: A Gower Gulch extra used it to dress his rifle sights and, on Sundays, his whiskers. The edge runs dead straight, which he said was the only thing in pictures that did.
straight_razor_of_the_marksman.icon: Open straight razor, mirror-bright blade, mottled amber-and-brown tortoiseshell scales with a tiny brass crosshair inlay near the pivot.

straight_razor_of_the_stevedore.name: Straight Razor of the Stevedore
straight_razor_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks in a longshoreman's back pocket, good for bale twine, tarpaulin cord and the occasional disagreement over a shift. The salt never quite left the hinge.
straight_razor_of_the_stevedore.icon: Open straight razor, worn yellowed bone scales, faint orange rust bloom at the hinge, coil of rough hemp twine wound around the handle, grey steel blade.

good_straight_razor.name: Good Straight Razor
good_straight_razor.description: Sold on the Boulevard in a velvet-lined case, with a leather strop thrown in and a lecture from the druggist about angles. The case is lost. The lecture took.
good_straight_razor.icon: Open straight razor, clean polished blade with a crisp edge line, glossy black ebony scales, bright nickel pivot pins.

fine_straight_razor.name: Fine Straight Razor
fine_straight_razor.description: Solingen steel with mother-of-pearl scales, bought for a leading man who would not let the studio barber near his profile. His valet did the shaving. Both left the lot in a hurry when the Dome came down.
fine_straight_razor.icon: Open straight razor, mirror-polished blade with a delicate etched scroll pattern, iridescent mother-of-pearl scales, gilt pivot pins and a gilt tang tip.

reinforced_striped_morning_trousers.name: Reinforced Striped Morning Trousers
reinforced_striped_morning_trousers.description: Built for a studio funeral and patched for a longer one. The seat has been doubled with canvas, because nobody at Universal sits still anymore.
reinforced_striped_morning_trousers.icon: Pair of charcoal-and-grey striped formal trousers folded at the knee, seat and knees reinforced with tan canvas patches, heavy black stitching, dull brass suspender buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_intellect.name: Striped Morning Trousers of Intellect
striped_morning_trousers_of_intellect.description: Carl Laemmle's front office kept a rack of these for executives who read a contract twice before signing it. One pair still carries a leaked fountain pen's worth of ink in the watch pocket.
striped_morning_trousers_of_intellect.icon: Crisp grey striped morning trousers with sharp crease, small blue ink stain at the watch pocket, slim silver pen-clip charm on the waistband, silver buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_spirit.name: Striped Morning Trousers of Spirit
striped_morning_trousers_of_spirit.description: Pressed for a church wedding on Highland that was set for the Saturday the Dome came down. The groom gave them away afterward, which seemed the decent thing.
striped_morning_trousers_of_spirit.icon: Pale grey finely striped trousers with neat crease, white satin ribbon and small white carnation tucked at the waistband, pearl buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_stamina.name: Striped Morning Trousers of Stamina
striped_morning_trousers_of_stamina.description: Undertakers at Hollywood Cemetery wear one pair from first service to the last shovel. These have stood through a hard autumn of both and never once sagged at the knee.
striped_morning_trousers_of_stamina.icon: Heavy charcoal striped wool trousers, grey earth dusting the cuffs, black mourning band tied around the waist, thick black buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_the_engineer.name: Striped Morning Trousers of the Engineer
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_engineer.description: A Lockheed draughtsman wore them to the plant daily, on the theory that a man in morning dress looks too important to eat. The theory held until Tuesday.
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_engineer.icon: Grey-blue striped trousers with an oil smudge at one knee, small brass slide-rule clip hooked to the belt loop, steel buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_the_doctor.name: Striped Morning Trousers of the Doctor
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_doctor.description: Smells faintly of ether and carbolic soap. Their owner, a Burbank surgeon, held that formal dress calmed a patient, and swore by it right up to the operating table.
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_doctor.icon: Mid-grey striped trousers with faint white chalk marks on the thigh, small red enamel cross pin on the waistband, polished bone buttons.

striped_morning_trousers_of_the_deacon.name: Striped Morning Trousers of the Deacon
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_deacon.description: Sunday best for the trip from Burbank to Angelus Temple, which these days takes two red cars and one rifle. Folded hymnal pages still sit in the hip pocket.
striped_morning_trousers_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark grey striped trousers with dusty cuffs, purple ribbon bookmark trailing from the hip pocket, polished black buttons.

superior_striped_morning_trousers.name: Superior Striped Morning Trousers
superior_striped_morning_trousers.description: Tailored on the Boulevard for a producer who insisted his stripes run narrower than his rival's. They do, by a sixteenth of an inch.
superior_striped_morning_trousers.icon: Immaculate dark grey trousers with fine pale stripes, knife-edge crease, black satin waistband, bright silver side-adjuster buckles.

chitin_lined_striped_morning_trousers.name: Chitin-lined Striped Morning Trousers
chitin_lined_striped_morning_trousers.description: Between the wool and the silk lining lies a layer of shell, cut thin by a wardrobe girl at First National. The trousers rustle at every step, like someone turning a page behind you.
chitin_lined_striped_morning_trousers.icon: Striped grey trousers with one cuff turned back to reveal iridescent green-black chitin lining, dark heavy stitching along the seams.

chitin_plated_striped_morning_trousers.name: Chitin-plated Striped Morning Trousers
chitin_plated_striped_morning_trousers.description: Overlapping shell plates over thigh and shin make for poor dancing and good survival. The studio men on Mount Lee wear them with spats, since standards matter most when little else is left.
chitin_plated_striped_morning_trousers.icon: Striped grey trousers armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates on thighs and shins, pale grey spats buttoned at the ankles.

reinforced_stunt_rider_s_leggings.name: Reinforced Stunt Rider's Leggings
reinforced_stunt_rider_s_leggings.description: Gower Gulch saddlery stitched a second hide along the inside leg, where saddle and stirrup do their worst. Smells of horse, neatsfoot oil and a long fall off Columbia's back fence.
reinforced_stunt_rider_s_leggings.icon: Tan leather riding leggings laced at the calf, darker doubled leather panels on the inner thighs, brass grommets along the outer seam.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_agility.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of Agility
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_agility.description: Tom Mix's stand-in wore these for the leap across a backlot gully, then wore them again because the director wanted it from a second angle.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_agility.icon: Slim tan leather leggings with scuffed knees, green stitching, small silver horseshoe charm hanging from the calf lacing.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_stamina.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of Stamina
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_stamina.description: Twenty-two falls from a galloping horse and the leather never split. The man inside fared worse, but he signed up for the twenty-third.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_stamina.icon: Thick brown leather leggings with heavy padding at hips and knees, saddle-polished inner panels, rows of brass rivets.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_spirit.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of Spirit
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_spirit.description: An extra from Gower Gulch said his rosary on the long rides between takes. The leather has gone soft and quiet from all that patience.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_spirit.icon: Soft chestnut leather leggings with cream stitching, a small wooden rosary bead looped through the side lacing.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_acrobat.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of the Acrobat
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_acrobat.description: Cut loose at the knee for vaulting from a balcony onto a moving horse, a stunt the Chaplin lot paid five dollars for and filmed nine times.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tan leather leggings with flexible pleated knee gussets, small yellow star patch stitched at the hip, lace-up sides.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_stevedore.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of the Stevedore
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_stevedore.description: Made for riding, but they spent a lean year hauling feed sacks off the San Pedro boats when picture work dried up. The cuffs still hold a dusting of barley and salt.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_stevedore.icon: Dark brown leather leggings with rope-burn scuffs, faded red cargo tag tied at the belt loop, pale grain dust on the cuffs.

stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_deacon.name: Stunt Rider's Leggings of the Deacon
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_deacon.description: Worn by a cowboy preacher who rode the Valley circuit with a sermon in one saddlebag and a Winchester in the other. He held that both were scripture in the right hands.
stunt_rider_s_leggings_of_the_deacon.icon: Black leather leggings with a small brass cross concho at the hip and faded purple lacing down the outer seam.

superior_stunt_rider_s_leggings.name: Superior Stunt Rider's Leggings
superior_stunt_rider_s_leggings.description: Hand-tooled with oak leaves by a saddle-maker on Sunset, they cost more than the horse. The studio billed them to the picture as miscellaneous fencing.
superior_stunt_rider_s_leggings.icon: Rich oxblood leather leggings with tooled oak-leaf pattern, silver conchos running down the outer seam, polished leather laces.

chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_leggings.name: Chitin-lined Stunt Rider's Leggings
chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_leggings.description: Shell from an Elder Spitter backs the leather now, since acid eats hide and slides off chitin. Nobody at the Burbank camp asks where the horse went.
chitin_lined_stunt_rider_s_leggings.icon: Tan leather leggings pitted with small acid scars, an open seam showing iridescent green-black chitin lining beneath.

chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_leggings.name: Chitin-plated Stunt Rider's Leggings
chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_leggings.description: Horses will not stand near the shell anymore, so the last stunt riders on Mount Lee work on foot. Plates from a Soldier's back guard the shins and stay faintly warm on cold nights.
chitin_plated_stunt_rider_s_leggings.icon: Dark leather leggings armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates on thighs and shins, glowing amber resin seams, brass buckles.

reinforced_opera_gloves.name: Reinforced Opera Gloves
reinforced_opera_gloves.description: Elbow-length kid, doubled across the knuckles by a Burbank wardrobe mistress who no longer asks what the customer intends to punch. The pearl buttons survived. The opera season did not.
reinforced_opera_gloves.icon: A pair of elbow-length ivory kid opera gloves laid flat, a darker stitched leather patch over the knuckles, a row of small pearl buttons at each wrist.

opera_gloves_of_intellect.name: Opera Gloves of Intellect
opera_gloves_of_intellect.description: Left on a seat at the Pantages by a lady who did the crossword in ink between acts and never once looked at the stage. The index fingertip is still faintly blue.
opera_gloves_of_intellect.icon: Elbow-length black satin opera gloves, a small silver fountain-pen clip pinned at one cuff, a faint blue ink stain on the right index fingertip.

opera_gloves_of_spirit.name: Opera Gloves of Spirit
opera_gloves_of_spirit.description: Since 1921 they have gone to every Easter sunrise service at the Hollywood Bowl and come home a shade calmer. They still smell of cold morning air and violets.
opera_gloves_of_spirit.icon: Elbow-length dove-grey satin opera gloves, a small sprig of purple violets pinned at the cuff, soft sheen along the fingers.

opera_gloves_of_stamina.name: Opera Gloves of Stamina
opera_gloves_of_stamina.description: Eleven retakes and one hive raid, in that order, on the Sennett lot. The chorus girl who wore them insists the retakes were worse.
opera_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Long white satin opera gloves with heavy doubled seams in oxblood stitching, slightly scuffed at the knuckles, a red silk ribbon tied at one wrist.

opera_gloves_of_the_engineer.name: Opera Gloves of the Engineer
opera_gloves_of_the_engineer.description: Fitted with a brass thimble in each fingertip by a Lockheed draughtswoman who liked to tap every rivet before she trusted it. She trusted very few.
opera_gloves_of_the_engineer.icon: Elbow-length cream satin gloves with small polished brass caps on each fingertip and a tiny brass wrench charm hanging from the cuff.

opera_gloves_of_the_doctor.name: Opera Gloves of the Doctor
opera_gloves_of_the_doctor.description: Their owner ran an aid station out of a Burbank supper club cloakroom and refused to take them off. Scrubbing in, she said, was for people with running water.
opera_gloves_of_the_doctor.icon: Elbow-length off-white satin opera gloves with a small red-cross enamel pin at the cuff and a faint yellowish carbolic stain on one palm.

opera_gloves_of_the_deacon.name: Opera Gloves of the Deacon
opera_gloves_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday the red cars ran, a deaconess carried these tucked in her hymnal from Echo Park to Burbank and back. The pages left a faint gilt line along the left cuff.
opera_gloves_of_the_deacon.icon: Elbow-length navy satin opera gloves, a thin gilt-edged hymnal ribbon tied around one wrist, a faint gold line along the cuff.

superior_opera_gloves.name: Superior Opera Gloves
superior_opera_gloves.description: Cut from the bolt Paramount was saving for a premiere gala that will not happen now. The wardrobe department called this a crime against satin and put it in writing.
superior_opera_gloves.icon: Crisp glossy white satin opera gloves, elbow-length, three pearl buttons at each wrist and fine gold-thread trim around the opening.

chitin_lined_opera_gloves.name: Chitin-lined Opera Gloves
chitin_lined_opera_gloves.description: The satin is genuine. So is the lining, peeled from a dead Spitter's wing case and shaved thin enough to bend, so that acid beads off it like rain on a windshield.
chitin_lined_opera_gloves.icon: White satin elbow-length opera gloves, one cuff turned down to show a thin iridescent green-black chitin lining inside.

chitin_plated_opera_gloves.name: Chitin-plated Opera Gloves
chitin_plated_opera_gloves.description: Small scales of Elder shell ride the back of each hand like sequins on a showgirl's gown. From across a ballroom they pass for evening wear. Up close they look like the war.
chitin_plated_opera_gloves.icon: Elbow-length black satin opera gloves with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin scales riveted across the backs of the hands and knuckles.

reinforced_everlast_bag_gloves.name: Reinforced Everlast Bag Gloves
reinforced_everlast_bag_gloves.description: Riveted steel crosses the knuckles, added by a Legion trainer after the stadium's heavy bag started hitting back. The horsehair padding is original, and so is the smell.
reinforced_everlast_bag_gloves.icon: A pair of short brown leather bag gloves, padded knuckles crossed by a riveted dull steel strap, laced cuffs.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_agility.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of Agility
everlast_bag_gloves_of_agility.description: Light enough for a flyweight who never stood still long enough to be hit. His trainer swore the kid could slip a punch before the other fellow had finished thinking of it.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_agility.icon: Slim tan leather bag gloves with thin padding, bright yellow piping along the cuffs and a small stamped winged-foot crest.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_stamina.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of Stamina
everlast_bag_gloves_of_stamina.description: Twelve rounds a night against a gym sandbag, then forty against a Drone in a Burbank alley. By the owner's reckoning the sandbag put up the better fight.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown leather bag gloves, heavily padded and creased, worn grey tape wrapped around both wrists.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_spirit.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of Spirit
everlast_bag_gloves_of_spirit.description: Saturday sparring and Sunday sermons got the same pair from an Eagle Rock parson, who argued that turning the other cheek came easier with your guard up.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_spirit.icon: Medium brown leather bag gloves with a small white cross stitched on each cuff, laces neatly tied.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_acrobat.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of the Acrobat
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_acrobat.description: Circus tumbler, then stuntman, then this. The previous owner came off the Sennett water tower knuckles-first more often than he cared to count, and the left glove is patched where the mattress wasn't.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tan leather bag gloves, the left one patched at the cuff with red-and-white striped circus canvas.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_stevedore.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of the Stevedore
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where a longshoreman wore them under his cargo hooks to keep the nets from chewing his palms. Weekends he boxed to cover the rent.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered dark leather bag gloves with white salt stains, a short coil of hemp rope tied around one cuff.

everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_deacon.name: Everlast Bag Gloves of the Deacon
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_deacon.description: Kept in the vestry of a Burbank Methodist church for the young men's boxing club. Somebody folded a hymn sheet into the right cuff, and it has stayed through every fight since.
everlast_bag_gloves_of_the_deacon.icon: Brown leather bag gloves, a folded cream hymn sheet tucked into the right cuff, a small purple ribbon tied at the laces.

superior_everlast_bag_gloves.name: Superior Everlast Bag Gloves
superior_everlast_bag_gloves.description: Fresh from a crate the Legion stadium ordered before the Dome came down and never got round to opening. The leather squeaks and the laces are still white.
superior_everlast_bag_gloves.icon: Glossy oxblood leather bag gloves, plump unworn padding, crisp white laces at the cuffs.

chitin_lined_everlast_bag_gloves.name: Chitin-lined Everlast Bag Gloves
chitin_lined_everlast_bag_gloves.description: Inside, a sleeve of thinned Drone shell keeps the knuckles from splitting on harder shell. Burbank fight crowds call that fair play.
chitin_lined_everlast_bag_gloves.icon: Brown leather bag gloves, one cuff turned back to show an iridescent green-black chitin lining inside.

chitin_plated_everlast_bag_gloves.name: Chitin-plated Everlast Bag Gloves
chitin_plated_everlast_bag_gloves.description: Knuckle-plates cut from an Elder Soldier's carapace are laced over the padding like a second fist. Trainers at the Mount Lee camp have stopped teaching footwork, since nobody up there backs away.
chitin_plated_everlast_bag_gloves.icon: Heavy leather bag gloves with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates laced over the knuckles with thick rawhide cord.

tailored_plated_gauntlets.name: Tailored Plated Gauntlets
tailored_plated_gauntlets.description: Measured to the knuckle by a Warner Bros. wardrobe man who had previously fitted only knights for costume pictures. The steel is real. The fleur-de-lis on the cuff is pure vanity.
tailored_plated_gauntlets.icon: A pair of slim steel gauntlets with neatly articulated finger plates, polished bright silver, flared cuffs edged with a fine engraved border, black kid-leather lining showing at the wrist.

plated_gauntlets_of_strength.name: Plated Gauntlets of Strength
plated_gauntlets_of_strength.description: Riveted together in the Columbia machine shop from a boiler hatch and the lining of two catcher's mitts. The carpenter who made them swears he bent a crowbar back straight while wearing them.
plated_gauntlets_of_strength.icon: Thick steel gauntlets with a raised ridge across the knuckles, dull gunmetal plates, broad red leather wrist strap with an iron buckle, small anvil charm on the cuff.

plated_gauntlets_of_stamina.name: Plated Gauntlets of Stamina
plated_gauntlets_of_stamina.description: Built for a Legion sergeant who held the Pass road for two nights without relief. He gave them up only when the nurse at the aid station insisted, and even then he kept the left one.
plated_gauntlets_of_stamina.icon: Steel gauntlets painted olive drab with chipped edges, green canvas wrist band, rows of small brass rivets, a tiny enamel shield pin on the cuff.

plated_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.name: Plated Gauntlets of the Boxer
plated_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.description: A Friday-night regular at the Legion Stadium had these made after the referee barred him from wearing them into the ring. Rosin dust from the canvas still sits in the knuckle seams.
plated_gauntlets_of_the_boxer.icon: Blue-grey steel gauntlets with a rounded, padded knuckle plate shaped like a boxing glove, red laces criss-crossing the cuff, tiny boxing-glove pin at the wrist.

plated_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.name: Plated Gauntlets of the Stevedore
plated_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where a longshoreman wore them hooking banana crates and the occasional case of Canadian whisky that somehow never made the manifest.
plated_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.icon: Rust-flecked steel gauntlets with a curved cargo hook spur on the back plate, tarred rope wrapped around the cuff, small brass anchor charm.

heavy_plated_gauntlets.name: Heavy Plated Gauntlets
heavy_plated_gauntlets.description: Thick enough to turn a Soldier's mandible. Also thick enough that the owner cannot sign for a loan, which some consider the better feature.
heavy_plated_gauntlets.icon: Bulky steel gauntlets with oversized overlapping plates, dark blued steel, heavy brown leather straps fastened with square iron buckles.

reinforced_plated_gauntlets.name: Reinforced Plated Gauntlets
reinforced_plated_gauntlets.description: Second layer of plate bolted over the first after the Universal backlot fighting proved one layer was optimistic.
reinforced_plated_gauntlets.icon: Double-layered steel gauntlets with prominent bolt heads, two mismatched shades of grey steel, a riveted patch plate over the knuckles, scuffed brown strap.

superior_plated_gauntlets.name: Superior Plated Gauntlets
superior_plated_gauntlets.description: The First National machine shop in Burbank turned these out between hive surges, using steel meant for camera cranes. The fit is excellent. The requisition paperwork is missing.
superior_plated_gauntlets.icon: Sleek fluted steel gauntlets, gleaming brushed finish with brass rivets along each finger, deep oxblood leather cuffs with neat white stitching.

chitin_lined_plated_gauntlets.name: Chitin-lined Plated Gauntlets
chitin_lined_plated_gauntlets.description: Lined with shaved invader shell, which turns a sting better than horsehide ever did. Nobody has explained why the lining is warm in the morning.
chitin_lined_plated_gauntlets.icon: Dark steel gauntlets with iridescent green-black chitin lining showing at the flared cuffs and between the finger plates, black leather straps.

chitin_plated_plated_gauntlets.name: Chitin-plated Plated Gauntlets
chitin_plated_plated_gauntlets.description: Halfway through the fighting on Mount Lee the steel ran short and the shell did not. What covers these knuckles once lived on the ridge below the sign.
chitin_plated_plated_gauntlets.icon: Gauntlets plated in overlapping iridescent green-black insect shell segments over a steel frame, short chitin spines along the knuckles, seams sealed with glowing amber resin.

tailored_stetson_fedora.name: Tailored Stetson Fedora
tailored_stetson_fedora.description: Blocked to its owner's head by a Vine Street hatter who charged extra for listening to him talk. The owner is gone; the shape of his opinions remains.
tailored_stetson_fedora.icon: Crisp charcoal-grey felt fedora with a sharp pinched front crown, neat black grosgrain band and a clean, evenly snapped brim, freshly brushed and spotless.

stetson_fedora_of_intellect.name: Stetson Fedora of Intellect
stetson_fedora_of_intellect.description: Lifted from a script reader's desk at Universal, where it sat atop a pile of rejected scenarios. A man who read four hundred plots a year learns to spot an ambush before the second act.
stetson_fedora_of_intellect.icon: Slate-grey felt fedora with a pinched crown and a navy blue band, a short yellow pencil tucked behind the band like a feather.

stetson_fedora_of_spirit.name: Stetson Fedora of Spirit
stetson_fedora_of_spirit.description: Its last owner wore it to every service at Hollywood Cemetery, and lately that has been most days. The felt keeps a patient sort of calm that a new head can borrow.
stetson_fedora_of_spirit.icon: Soft dove-grey felt fedora with a pinched crown, a plain white band and a tiny pressed white lily pinned at the side.

stetson_fedora_of_stamina.name: Stetson Fedora of Stamina
stetson_fedora_of_stamina.description: Rode the open back of a red car through the Cahuenga Pass during a dust storm, a broodling swarm and one marriage proposal. The crown never dented once.
stetson_fedora_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy mid-brown felt fedora with a pinched crown, a deep red band and a faint dusting of road grit along the broad brim.

stetson_fedora_of_the_engineer.name: Stetson Fedora of the Engineer
stetson_fedora_of_the_engineer.description: Smells faintly of solder and machine oil from a studio electrical department, where a gaffer kept spare fuses tucked behind the band and his temper under the brim.
stetson_fedora_of_the_engineer.icon: Tan felt fedora with a pinched crown and an oil-darkened olive band carrying a small brass wrench charm, a smudge of grease on the brim.

stetson_fedora_of_the_doctor.name: Stetson Fedora of the Doctor
stetson_fedora_of_the_doctor.description: A house physician at the Roosevelt Hotel wore this on night calls, brim pulled low so guests could not read his face before he had read theirs.
stetson_fedora_of_the_doctor.icon: Dark charcoal felt fedora with a pinched crown and a bottle-green band, a small white enamel pin with a red cross set at the side.

stetson_fedora_of_the_deacon.name: Stetson Fedora of the Deacon
stetson_fedora_of_the_deacon.description: Walked to Angelus Temple and back every Sunday for six years, gathering hymnal dust in the band and Echo Park rain on the brim. Sister Aimee once admired it, and its owner never let anyone forget.
stetson_fedora_of_the_deacon.icon: Black felt fedora with a pinched crown and a deep purple band, a short purple hymnal ribbon trailing from the bow at the side.

heavy_stetson_fedora.name: Heavy Stetson Fedora
heavy_stetson_fedora.description: Double-felted and stiff enough to shrug off a Spitter's first splash. Fashion took a back seat around the time the Dome came down.
heavy_stetson_fedora.icon: Thick dark-brown double-felt fedora with a tall pinched crown, a wide stitched brim edge and a broad heavy leather band.

reinforced_stetson_fedora.name: Reinforced Stetson Fedora
reinforced_stetson_fedora.description: Under the band runs a steel hoop that a Paramount wardrobe man swore would never show on camera. The cameras still rolling on that lot are not pointed at anyone wearing it.
reinforced_stetson_fedora.icon: Black felt fedora with a pinched crown, a steel hoop riveted beneath a dark band, and a thin gunmetal strip binding the brim edge.

tailored_roping_cuffs.name: Tailored Roping Cuffs
tailored_roping_cuffs.description: Cut to measure for a Western star who never once threw a rope on camera. The saddlery on Gower charged extra for the silver conchos and extra again for keeping quiet about it.
tailored_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of flared tan leather wrist cuffs with crisp tooled scrollwork, a small polished silver concho on each, clean stitched edges and a laced closure.

roping_cuffs_of_agility.name: Roping Cuffs of Agility
roping_cuffs_of_agility.description: Will Rogers could make a lariat spell a girl's name in midair. These belonged to the fellow who practised beside him at the Gower Gulch stables and got as far as the initials.
roping_cuffs_of_agility.icon: Pair of flared brown leather wrist cuffs tooled with a coiled-rope pattern, pale stitching, a small brass spur rowel charm dangling from one buckle.

roping_cuffs_of_stamina.name: Roping Cuffs of Stamina
roping_cuffs_of_stamina.description: Survived nine straight days of the same fall from the same horse for a Columbia serial. The horse quit before the cuffs did.
roping_cuffs_of_stamina.icon: Pair of thick dark brown leather wrist cuffs with double rows of heavy stitching, scuffed edges and a small red leather patch on each.

roping_cuffs_of_spirit.name: Roping Cuffs of Spirit
roping_cuffs_of_spirit.description: Smells faintly of campfire smoke and saddle soap. The last owner sang to the cattle on night watch and claimed it calmed him more than it did them.
roping_cuffs_of_spirit.icon: Pair of soft honey-coloured leather wrist cuffs worn smooth with use, pale blue stitching, a small turquoise stone set into each.

roping_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.name: Roping Cuffs of the Acrobat
roping_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.description: A trick rider in Tom Mix's outfit wore these for every hang off a galloping horse. He retired the afternoon an invader flier took an interest in the horse.
roping_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pair of slim tan leather wrist cuffs with a red and white diamond inlay and a small silver star stud on each.

roping_cuffs_of_the_stevedore.name: Roping Cuffs of the Stevedore
roping_cuffs_of_the_stevedore.description: Brought up from San Pedro by a longshoreman who roped cargo nets before he roped steers for the pictures. The leather still carries a whiff of tar.
roping_cuffs_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pair of broad weathered dark leather wrist cuffs with tar-stained edges, rope-coil tooling and a small brass cargo hook charm.

roping_cuffs_of_the_deacon.name: Roping Cuffs of the Deacon
roping_cuffs_of_the_deacon.description: Folded inside the left cuff was a card from Angelus Temple bearing a verse about the lost sheep. The cowhand who owned them took it as professional advice.
roping_cuffs_of_the_deacon.icon: Pair of oxblood leather wrist cuffs tooled with a small cross motif, a thin purple hymnal ribbon tied around one cuff.

heavy_roping_cuffs.name: Heavy Roping Cuffs
heavy_roping_cuffs.description: Doubled hide, stiff as a studio contract, made for roping things heavier than calves.
heavy_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of thick double-layered dark brown leather wrist cuffs with wide iron buckles and heavy coarse stitching.

reinforced_roping_cuffs.name: Reinforced Roping Cuffs
reinforced_roping_cuffs.description: Riveted steel strips run beneath the leather, added after a Burrower took a roper's lasso, and very nearly the roper, down a hole on Ventura Boulevard.
reinforced_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of dark brown leather wrist cuffs with steel strips riveted along their length, rows of bright rivets and a sturdy iron buckle.

superior_roping_cuffs.name: Superior Roping Cuffs
superior_roping_cuffs.description: Made at the Gower Gulch saddlery from the best hide left under the Dome, which these days is not saying as much as it used to.
superior_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of rich chestnut leather wrist cuffs with a finely tooled floral border, polished nickel buckles and nickel edge trim.

chitin_lined_roping_cuffs.name: Chitin-lined Roping Cuffs
chitin_lined_roping_cuffs.description: Thin shell plates line the inside, so a rope burn now bites the lining instead of the wrist. The cowhands say it feels like wearing a beetle, and they wear them anyway.
chitin_lined_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of brown leather wrist cuffs with an inner lining of iridescent green-black insect shell showing at the edges, brass buckles.

chitin_plated_roping_cuffs.name: Chitin-plated Roping Cuffs
chitin_plated_roping_cuffs.description: Overlapping invader shell rides on the outside now, cut by men who once roped steers and now rope far worse things on the ridge below Mount Lee.
chitin_plated_roping_cuffs.icon: Pair of leather wrist cuffs covered in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, dark leather straps and blackened iron buckles.

fine_plate_insert_trench_coat.name: Fine Plate-insert Trench Coat
fine_plate_insert_trench_coat.description: Sewn by a Beachwood Canyon widow who lined her late husband's coat with stove plates. It hangs straighter than most and rattles only on stairs.
fine_plate_insert_trench_coat.icon: Belted khaki trench coat, clean and neat, faint square outlines of steel plates pressing through the gabardine, dull grey plate edge showing at the open lapel, brass belt buckle.

plate_insert_trench_coat_of_strength.name: Plate-insert Trench Coat of Strength
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_strength.description: Took two men to carry up Cahuenga Pass and one Legion sergeant to wear. He claimed the weight kept him from blowing away in a Santa Ana, and nobody argued with him.
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_strength.icon: Olive drab trench coat with thick riveted steel plates visible across the chest, red cord wound around the belt, small iron dumbbell pin on the lapel.

plate_insert_trench_coat_of_stamina.name: Plate-insert Trench Coat of Stamina
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_stamina.description: Its last owner walked off a Warner Bros. stage with three spitter burns in the gabardine and none in himself. The plates are pitted now. The man, reportedly, is fine.
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_stamina.icon: Tan trench coat with scorched holes revealing dull acid-pitted steel plates, green stitching along the seams, small oak-leaf patch on the shoulder.

plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_boxer.name: Plate-insert Trench Coat of the Boxer
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a heavyweight wore this from the dressing room to the ring. He swore the plates did more for his chin than his trainer ever had, and he paid the plates less.
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_boxer.icon: Dark brown trench coat with heavy steel plates in the chest, red satin piping on the cuffs and lapels, small boxing glove pin on the collar.

plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_stevedor.name: Plate-insert Trench Coat of the Stevedore
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_stevedor.description: The previous owner unloaded freighters at San Pedro and, on certain moonless nights, crates marked as sardines. Neither cargo ever got the better of him.
plate_insert_trench_coat_of_the_stevedor.icon: Weathered navy-grey trench coat with steel plates at the chest, coiled hemp rope threaded through the belt loops, small brass cargo hook charm on the lapel.

pressed_plate_insert_trench_coat.name: Pressed Plate-insert Trench Coat
pressed_plate_insert_trench_coat.description: Somebody in a studio wardrobe department still irons these before handing them out, plates and all. Creases sharp enough to pass inspection, if anyone is left to inspect.
pressed_plate_insert_trench_coat.icon: Crisp stone-coloured trench coat with knife-sharp creases, polished steel plates gleaming at the turned lapels, bright brass buckles and buttons.

tailored_plate_insert_trench_coat.name: Tailored Plate-insert Trench Coat
tailored_plate_insert_trench_coat.description: Cut at Universal for a Western Front picture, then refused by the leading man because the plates added ten pounds on camera. It fits like a contract with no loopholes.
tailored_plate_insert_trench_coat.icon: Slim fitted camel trench coat with sharp shoulders, burgundy satin lining, contoured polished steel plates shaped to the chest, gilt buttons.

heavy_plate_insert_trench_coat.name: Heavy Plate-insert Trench Coat
heavy_plate_insert_trench_coat.description: Doubled plates, doubled seams and a horse-blanket lining for cold nights at the river camps. It stands up on its own when hung, which saves a hanger.
heavy_plate_insert_trench_coat.icon: Bulky dark olive trench coat with overlapping thick steel plates riveted outside the fabric, coarse grey blanket lining at the collar, iron buckles.

tailored_police_nightstick.name: Tailored Police Nightstick
tailored_police_nightstick.description: Turned on a lathe in the Universal prop shop for a picture about honest cops, which the front office filed under fantasy. The varnish is for the camera. The hickory underneath is not.
tailored_police_nightstick.icon: Slim police nightstick in polished hickory with glossy honey-brown varnish, crisp turned grip rings, neat brown leather wrist thong through a bright brass grommet.

police_nightstick_of_strength.name: Police Nightstick of Strength
police_nightstick_of_strength.description: Patrolman Ed Brophy swung it at the Cahuenga Pass roadblock until the grip wore smooth as a church pew. He claimed it never broke anything that did not deserve breaking, invader or otherwise.
police_nightstick_of_strength.icon: Dark walnut police nightstick with a thick striking end, red leather wrist thong, and a small steel band near the tip stamped with a clenched fist emblem.

police_nightstick_of_stamina.name: Police Nightstick of Stamina
police_nightstick_of_stamina.description: Carried on the night beat along Ventura Boulevard, where a shift now runs twelve hours and ends whenever the drones do. The thong is knotted twice, by a man who did not intend to drop it.
police_nightstick_of_stamina.icon: Long black lacquered nightstick with a scuffed tip, green leather wrist thong tied in a double knot, and a dull brass ring at the grip end.

police_nightstick_of_the_boxer.name: Police Nightstick of the Boxer
police_nightstick_of_the_boxer.description: The Legion Stadium's ringside bailiff kept order with this on Friday nights. He never once used it on a fighter, only on gentlemen in row nine who disputed the decision.
police_nightstick_of_the_boxer.icon: Hickory nightstick with its grip wrapped in white boxing tape, a blue leather wrist thong, and a tiny brass boxing-glove pin set near the butt.

police_nightstick_of_the_stevedore.name: Police Nightstick of the Stevedore
police_nightstick_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks in a harbour cop's kit bag, back when the worst thing on the waterfront was a longshoreman with opinions. Salt still whitens the grain near the lanyard.
police_nightstick_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered oak nightstick with salt-whitened grain, a tarred rope lanyard in place of a leather thong, and a small brass anchor stud on the butt.

heavy_police_nightstick.name: Heavy Police Nightstick
heavy_police_nightstick.description: Lead poured into a hollowed core by a desk sergeant who felt standard issue lacked conviction. The Hardened Soldiers on the Universal backlot have come round to his view, briefly.
heavy_police_nightstick.icon: Thick, stubby nightstick of dark stained hardwood with a heavy steel cap on the striking end and a worn black leather thong, visibly weighty.

reinforced_police_nightstick.name: Reinforced Police Nightstick
reinforced_police_nightstick.description: Iron bands every few inches and a steel core, built for a beat that now runs down into the river bottoms. The property clerk signs these out with a sigh and a carbon copy.
reinforced_police_nightstick.icon: Hardwood nightstick ringed with three riveted iron bands, a steel ferrule tip, deeply checkered grip, and a grey leather wrist thong.

tailored_hatchet.name: Tailored Hatchet
tailored_hatchet.description: Bought out of a Boulevard hardware window, where it hung beside a placard about weekend cabins in Laurel Canyon. The cabins have not been heard from since. The hatchet holds an edge.
tailored_hatchet.icon: Neat camp hatchet with a bright polished steel head, varnished ash handle, red-painted cheek band, and a clean leather edge guard hanging from the haft.

hatchet_of_intellect.name: Hatchet of Intellect
hatchet_of_intellect.description: A Universal set carpenter pencilled his measurements on the handle and did his sums on the cheek of the blade. He built three cathedrals and a Transylvanian inn with it, all on schedule and none of them with backs.
hatchet_of_intellect.icon: Slim hatchet with a steel head and pale ash handle covered in faint pencil tick marks, a small folding brass carpenter's rule tied to the haft.

hatchet_of_spirit.name: Hatchet of Spirit
hatchet_of_spirit.description: Hung on a nail by a Beachwood Canyon woodstove and split kindling every morning for a widow who hummed while she worked. Whatever she hummed seems to have stayed in the handle.
hatchet_of_spirit.icon: Old woodstove hatchet with a soot-blackened steel head, handle worn pale and smooth, and a sprig of white sage tucked under a twine wrap at the grip.

hatchet_of_the_engineer.name: Hatchet of the Engineer
hatchet_of_the_engineer.description: Studio electricians carry one to cut cable runs and break through flats when a set goes up in flames. This one has notches filed in the poll for stripping wire, a trick the union only teaches inside the hall.
hatchet_of_the_engineer.icon: Utility hatchet with filed notches on the steel poll, black rubber-wrapped grip, copper wire wound round the haft, and a tiny brass wrench charm.

hatchet_of_the_doctor.name: Hatchet of the Doctor
hatchet_of_the_doctor.description: Taken from the aid station at the Pass summit, where it opened crates of gauze and, on one long night, cut a splint for a Legionnaire's leg. Carbolic soap has not quite washed out the memory of the work.
hatchet_of_the_doctor.icon: Compact hatchet with a scrubbed bright steel head, white-painted handle, a red cross ribbon tied below the head, and cotton gauze wrapped around the grip.

hatchet_of_the_deacon.name: Hatchet of the Deacon
hatchet_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday a Studio City deacon split firewood for the mission stove, then carried the hatchet into the service and laid it beside his hymnal. Nobody asked him to check it at the door.
hatchet_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain hatchet with a dark steel head, oiled hickory handle, purple hymnal ribbon threaded through a hole in the butt, and a small brass cross tack.

heavy_hatchet.name: Heavy Hatchet
heavy_hatchet.description: Forged for the crews who cleared brush along Mulholland for the fire roads. The extra weight in the head does most of the thinking.
heavy_hatchet.icon: Broad-bladed hatchet with a thick dark steel head, wide bearded edge, and a heavy hickory handle wrapped in black friction tape at the grip.

reinforced_hatchet.name: Reinforced Hatchet
reinforced_hatchet.description: Steel langets run halfway down the haft, so the handle survives when the edge finds chitin. Lumber men out by the river swear by them and sharpen them twice a day.
reinforced_hatchet.icon: Hatchet with grey-blue steel head and riveted steel langets down the haft, leather-wrapped grip, and a faint iridescent green-black chitin smear on the cheek.

tailored_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Tailored M1913 Cavalry Sabre
tailored_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Somebody in Wardrobe had the scabbard relined in velvet to match a colonel's dress uniform. The colonel was an extra on six dollars a day. The velvet is real.
tailored_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Straight thrusting cavalry sabre, bright nickel basket hilt, black ribbed grip, dark leather scabbard with burgundy velvet lining showing at the throat.

m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_strength.name: M1913 Cavalry Sabre of Strength
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_strength.description: Lieutenant Patton designed the blade for thrusting at a gallop. Without the horse, the arm has to supply all the momentum, and this one was ground for arms that could.
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_strength.icon: Straight steel cavalry sabre with full basket guard, black grip, bright red cord sword knot looped at the pommel.

m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_stamina.name: M1913 Cavalry Sabre of Stamina
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_stamina.description: Carried on the long road from Fort Riley to a Universal western, then on every retake after. Its owner claimed the horse tired first and the director second.
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_stamina.icon: Straight cavalry sabre, worn brown leather grip, steel basket guard, faded olive canvas scabbard with heavy doubled stitching.

m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_boxer.name: M1913 Cavalry Sabre of the Boxer
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_boxer.description: Hung for years over the bar at the Legion Stadium, where the Friday crowd swore it was kept there to settle decisions the judges got wrong.
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_boxer.icon: Straight cavalry sabre with steel basket guard, grip wound in gold tape, small red boxing-glove charm dangling from the knuckle bow.

m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_stevedore.name: M1913 Cavalry Sabre of the Stevedore
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a freighter at San Pedro in a crate marked as plumbing. The longshoreman who kept it used it on cargo netting first and on invaders later.
m1913_cavalry_sabre_of_the_stevedore.icon: Salt-stained straight cavalry sabre, grip wrapped in tarred rope, small brass cargo-hook charm tied to the steel basket guard.

heavy_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Heavy M1913 Cavalry Sabre
heavy_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Reground with a thicker spine by a Post 43 machinist who felt the Army had been too delicate about the whole business.
heavy_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Broad thick-spined straight sabre in dark blued steel, oversized black iron basket guard, plain leather grip.

reinforced_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Reinforced M1913 Cavalry Sabre
reinforced_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Riveted bands brace the guard, added after the first one folded against a Soldier's carapace like a cheap cigarette case.
reinforced_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Gunmetal straight sabre with riveted steel straps across the basket guard, leather grip bound with twisted wire.

superior_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Superior M1913 Cavalry Sabre
superior_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Forged in a Burbank machine shop that used to turn out aeroplane fittings, to tolerances the cavalry never asked for and the invaders never respect.
superior_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Mirror-bright straight sabre, chromed fluted basket guard, polished walnut grip with a brass ferrule.

chitin_lined_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Chitin-lined M1913 Cavalry Sabre
chitin_lined_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Its grip is wrapped in strips of shed invader shell, which neither sweats nor slips. Old troopers say it hums faintly in the dark, and nobody has asked them to stop saying so.
chitin_lined_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Straight steel sabre, darkened basket guard, grip wrapped in iridescent green-black chitin strips.

chitin_plated_m1913_cavalry_sabre.name: Chitin-plated M1913 Cavalry Sabre
chitin_plated_m1913_cavalry_sabre.description: Guard and spine are clad in plates cut from a Brute's back. It weighs less than it should and bites deeper than it ought to, and the men camped below the sign have stopped wondering why.
chitin_plated_m1913_cavalry_sabre.icon: Straight sabre with iridescent green-black chitin plating along the spine, basket guard of overlapping shell plates with an oily sheen.

tailored_fire_axe.name: Tailored Fire Axe
tailored_fire_axe.description: Nickel-plated for a Warner Bros. fire picture and afterwards displayed in a producer's office, where it was admired, insured and never once swung at anything.
tailored_fire_axe.icon: Long-handled fire axe with gleaming nickel head and pick spike, varnished red handle, polished brass end cap.

fire_axe_of_strength.name: Fire Axe of Strength
fire_axe_of_strength.description: Studio fire crews learned that nitrate film burns hotter than reason, and that a locked vault door gives way on the second or third swing. This one never needed the third.
fire_axe_of_strength.icon: Fire axe with red-painted head and pick back, long hickory handle, black tape grip near the end.

fire_axe_of_stamina.name: Fire Axe of Stamina
fire_axe_of_stamina.description: Pulled from a Hollywood engine house after a long night on Vine Street, its handle worn smooth by the hours rather than the blows.
fire_axe_of_stamina.icon: Fire axe with chipped red head, sweat-darkened hickory handle, frayed blue canvas lanyard loop at the butt.

fire_axe_of_the_boxer.name: Fire Axe of the Boxer
fire_axe_of_the_boxer.description: A heavyweight who fought under three names at the Legion Stadium kept it by his corner stool, on the theory that no referee argues with a fireman's tool.
fire_axe_of_the_boxer.icon: Red fire axe, handle wrapped in white boxing tape, small brass boxing-glove pin fixed below the head.

fire_axe_of_the_stevedore.name: Fire Axe of the Stevedore
fire_axe_of_the_stevedore.description: Dockmen at San Pedro use axes like this to cut hawsers in a hurry. This one reached Hollywood with a load of Cornero's machine parts, a splinter of crate lid still in the blade.
fire_axe_of_the_stevedore.icon: Red fire axe with salt-pitted steel, tarred-rope wrapped handle, pale splinter of crate wood wedged in the edge.

heavy_fire_axe.name: Heavy Fire Axe
heavy_fire_axe.description: Double the iron of a city-issue axe, made for doorways that are no longer doors, only hive resin grown thick across the frame.
heavy_fire_axe.icon: Oversized fire axe with thick dull-red head and heavy pick, stout iron-banded hickory handle.

reinforced_fire_axe.name: Reinforced Fire Axe
reinforced_fire_axe.description: Steel langets run halfway down the haft, put there after an Elder Drone bit clean through the last one. The fireman who carried that one now works the switchboard.
reinforced_fire_axe.icon: Fire axe with scuffed red head and gunmetal pick spike, long steel strips riveted down the hickory handle.

worn_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Worn Canvas Wrist Wraps
worn_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Peeled off a grip who no longer needed them. The canvas still holds the shape of his wrists and the smell of his last cigarette.
worn_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A loose coil of frayed grey-brown canvas wrist wraps, ends unravelling, sweat-stained and dull, a bent brass buckle hanging by a single thread.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_agility.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of Agility
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_agility.description: Taped on by a Christie comedy stuntman before every pratfall. He claimed they saved his wrists through forty takes of slipping on the same banana peel.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_agility.icon: A pair of wrapped tan canvas wrist cuffs with bright green zig-zag stitching and a small silver feather charm dangling from the buckle strap.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_strength.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of Strength
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_strength.description: A Gower Gulch blacksmith wound these on before shoeing horses for the Westerns. The canvas has gone stiff where the hammer handle rubbed, day after day.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_strength.icon: A pair of thick tan canvas wrist wraps with dark red stitching, soot-smudged, a tiny iron anvil charm hanging from the steel buckle.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_stamina.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of Stamina
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_stamina.description: Issued to a Pacific Electric track gang that worked double shifts laying rail. Not one man complained, or at least not one complained twice.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_stamina.icon: A pair of tan canvas wrist wraps with navy blue stitching, grease-darkened at the edges, a small iron rail-spike charm on the strap.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_boxer.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of the Boxer
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_boxer.description: Smelling faintly of liniment and Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, they belonged to a welterweight who never once went down before the eighth round.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_boxer.icon: A pair of red-dyed canvas wrist wraps wound tight, white cotton tape at the ends, a small enamel boxing glove pin fixed to the strap.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_marksman.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of the Marksman
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_marksman.description: Stembridge's range armourer wore these behind Marathon Street, where he split playing cards edgewise for visiting directors. He never missed, and never got a screen credit for it either.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_marksman.icon: A pair of khaki canvas wrist wraps with black stitching and a small brass disc stamped with a cross-hair notch riveted to the strap.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_acrobat.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of the Acrobat
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_acrobat.description: From a trapeze flyer hired for a circus picture that folded after one week. She kept the wraps; the studio kept the net.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_acrobat.icon: A pair of cream canvas wrist wraps trimmed in blue-and-white circus stripes, a tiny silver star charm dangling from the buckle.

canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Wrist Wraps of the Engineer
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_engineer.description: Studio electricians wind canvas over their cuffs to keep sleeves clear of the dynamos. The scorch marks on this pair suggest the advice arrived a little late.
canvas_wrist_wraps_of_the_engineer.icon: A pair of olive canvas wrist wraps with black scorch marks along one edge and a small brass wrench charm hooked to the steel buckle.

patched_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Patched Canvas Wrist Wraps
patched_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Mended so often with sailcloth and flour sacking that barely a thread of the original canvas remains.
patched_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of lumpy wrist wraps sewn from mismatched patches, faded flour-sack print and grey sailcloth, crude black darning, a dull iron buckle.

plain_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Plain Canvas Wrist Wraps
plain_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Bought off a cart on Cahuenga for a dime. They do the job and ask nothing more of anyone.
plain_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of plain undyed beige canvas wrist wraps, clean and neatly rolled, fastened with a simple steel buckle.

sturdy_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Sturdy Canvas Wrist Wraps
sturdy_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Double-stitched by the saddlery on Gower to outlast an extra's working week, which is no great boast when most of those weeks lasted a day.
sturdy_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of heavy tan canvas wrist wraps with double rows of brown stitching and stitched leather edging, a solid square steel buckle.

good_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Good Canvas Wrist Wraps
good_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Riveted canvas of the sort carpenters on the RKO lot favoured, back before the soundstage walls started sprouting hive resin.
good_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of brown canvas wrist wraps studded with copper rivets along the seams, fastened by a bright brass buckle.

fine_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Fine Canvas Wrist Wraps
fine_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Cut to measure for a Warner Bros. grip who liked to look sharp at the gate. The invaders never noticed, but the script girls did.
fine_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of crisp charcoal canvas wrist wraps with neat white stitching and a polished nickel buckle, edges cleanly hemmed.

pressed_canvas_wrist_wraps.name: Pressed Canvas Wrist Wraps
