pressed_canvas_wrist_wraps.description: Starched and creased like a banker's trousers. Somebody in wardrobe decided the war deserved a sharp crease, and nobody had the heart to argue.
pressed_canvas_wrist_wraps.icon: A pair of stiff pressed khaki canvas wrist wraps with a knife-sharp crease, leather backing, and two gleaming brass buckles.

vitaphone_engineer_s_headset.name: Vitaphone Engineer's Headset
vitaphone_engineer_s_headset.description: Built for the Warner sound stages, where a cough in the third row could cost a day's shooting. The engineer who wore it heard everything when the hive came through the soundproofing. He wrote it all down, in a very steady hand.
vitaphone_engineer_s_headset.icon: Pair of heavy black bakelite earphones on a curved steel headband, cups padded with cracked brown leather, a braided cloth cord trailing to a small brass jack, a red enamel dot on one cup.

rin_tin_tin_s_collar.name: Rin Tin Tin's Collar
rin_tin_tin_s_collar.description: Warner Bros. paid the dog better than most of its writers, and nobody on the lot thought that unfair. He wears a spare these days; this one was retired after he took a Drone by the leg on Sunset.
rin_tin_tin_s_collar.icon: Wide brown leather dog collar curled into a loop, polished brass buckle and studs, a small round gilt medallion hanging from a brass ring, stitching worn pale along the edge.

zookeeper_s_bite_sleeve.name: Zookeeper's Bite Sleeve
zookeeper_s_bite_sleeve.description: Thick canvas and horsehair, laced to the elbow, made for the morning feed at the bear grottoes. Since the invasion, the keepers at Griffith Park have learned that the lions were the polite ones.
zookeeper_s_bite_sleeve.icon: Thick quilted forearm sleeve of tan canvas laced with rawhide, deep tooth punctures and a torn flap near the wrist, a faded green keeper's band stitched round the cuff.

greek_theatre_chorus_robe.name: Greek Theatre Chorus Robe
greek_theatre_chorus_robe.description: Sewn for the first season of the new Greek Theatre, when the hills filled with people come to hear tragedy in the open air. The chorus still sings up there some nights, to coyotes and the Dome.
greek_theatre_chorus_robe.icon: Long flowing robe of pale cream linen, a deep gold key-pattern border at hem and sleeves, a twisted gold cord belt, soft folds hanging straight.

the_gag_man_s_derby.name: The Gag Man's Derby
the_gag_man_s_derby.description: Every gag man on the Chaplin lot kept one hat for thinking and one for falling down in. This is the second kind, dented in nine places and blocked back into shape eight times.
the_gag_man_s_derby.icon: Black felt bowler with a rounded crown dented on one side, narrow curled brim, frayed grey grosgrain band, a chalk scuff across the top.

cornero_s_rum_runner_slicker.name: Cornero's Rum-Runner Slicker
cornero_s_rum_runner_slicker.description: Tony Cornero wore it on the deck of a rum boat off Santa Monica Bay, running Canadian whisky past the Coast Guard in the fog. The oiled hide still smells of brine and good rye. Under the Dome there is no sea left to run, which he takes personally.
cornero_s_rum_runner_slicker.icon: Knee-length slicker of glossy black oiled leather, high storm collar turned up, brass toggle fastenings, salt-white crust along the hem and a faint amber sheen across the shoulders.

fairbanks_fencing_jacket.name: Fairbanks' Fencing Jacket
fairbanks_fencing_jacket.description: Cut close for The Black Pirate, so the star could ride a knife down a sail and look good doing it. The lining is padded at the ribs, where the prop sabres landed more often than the publicity department admitted.
fairbanks_fencing_jacket.icon: Fitted fencing jacket of supple white kid leather, high collar, diagonal brass-buttoned flap across the chest, crimson piping, a clean sword slash across one sleeve.

dam_keeper_s_waders.name: Dam Keeper's Waders
dam_keeper_s_waders.description: Since St. Francis went, the keeper has walked the toe of Mulholland Dam each dawn, listening for water where water should not be. He still walks it. Now he listens for chewing.
dam_keeper_s_waders.icon: Chest-high rubberised canvas waders in dark olive, heavy padded knees, black rubber boot feet, wide leather braces with brass clips, dried grey reservoir mud up to the thighs.

krotona_initiate_s_sash.name: Krotona Initiate's Sash
krotona_initiate_s_sash.description: Krotona's Theosophists left Beachwood Canyon for Ojai years ago, but some of their silk stayed behind in a cedar chest. The colours are meant to aid meditation. They also hide resin stains rather well.
krotona_initiate_s_sash.icon: Long silk sash folded once, deep violet shading to saffron at the tasselled ends, a small embroidered silver lotus near the knot, faint cedar-brown fold marks.

stembridge_armourer_s_apron.name: Stembridge Armourer's Apron
stembridge_armourer_s_apron.description: Worn behind the counter at 5451 Marathon, where every Thompson in pictures went out on loan and came back to be cleaned. The canvas is burned in neat rows from hot brass. Armourers count every gun out and every round back.
stembridge_armourer_s_apron.icon: Heavy quilted khaki canvas apron, leather bib reinforced with riveted straps, deep pockets holding a brass cleaning rod and an oily rag, rows of small scorch marks across the front.

bronson_gate_guard_cap.name: Bronson Gate Guard Cap
bronson_gate_guard_cap.description: Nobody passed the Bronson Gate without a name on the list, and the man under this cap once turned away a director's mother on her birthday. When the hive came, he asked for their names too.
bronson_gate_guard_cap.icon: Stiff peaked guard's cap of navy padded wool, glossy black leather visor, brass chin strap, a gilt crest badge on the front, crown slightly crushed on one side.

marathon_street_queen_s_mantle.name: Marathon Street Queen's Mantle
marathon_street_queen_s_mantle.description: Woven by captured wardrobe girls on the Paramount stages, in silk and something the Queen secreted for the purpose. It hums under hot lamps. The women were promised screen credit, which suggests the hive already understands Hollywood.
marathon_street_queen_s_mantle.icon: Sweeping floor-length mantle of iridescent green-black silk shot with chitin scales, a high fanned collar of translucent insect wing, clasps of glowing amber hive resin at the throat.

dragna_lieutenant_s_spats.name: Dragna Lieutenant's Spats
dragna_lieutenant_s_spats.description: Dragna's man in the Paramount gun room kept his spats whiter than the Production Code requires. A dead man's shoes are bad luck, the boys say, but his spats are merely fashionable.
dragna_lieutenant_s_spats.icon: Pair of dove-grey felt spats over polished black leather shoes, pearl buttons down the side, one spat speckled with a fine spray of dark gun oil.

chaney_s_greasepaint_kit.name: Chaney's Greasepaint Kit
chaney_s_greasepaint_kit.description: The Man of a Thousand Faces carries his make-up on a cord round his neck these days, in case he must become somebody else in a hurry. Inside: crepe hair, collodion, fish skin and a little wire for the nose. He does not lend it lightly.
chaney_s_greasepaint_kit.icon: Small battered black tin make-up case on a leather neck cord, lid ajar showing greasepaint sticks in flesh, red and grey, a wisp of crepe hair and a brass clasp.

phantom_s_opera_cloak.name: Phantom's Opera Cloak
phantom_s_opera_cloak.description: Made for the Red Death masquerade in 1925 and kept on Stage 28 ever since, beside the opera house nobody dared strike. Something from the hive has taken to the set. The cloak came off its shoulders.
phantom_s_opera_cloak.icon: Voluminous crimson velvet opera cloak with a high stiff collar, black satin lining, a skull-shaped gilt clasp at the throat, faint threads of glowing amber resin along the hem.

laemmle_s_lucky_watch_chain.name: Laemmle's Lucky Watch Chain
laemmle_s_lucky_watch_chain.description: Uncle Carl kept a horseshoe charm on it and swore the thing had paid for Universal City twice over. He has given it to whoever keeps the backlot standing longest; luck, he says, is wasted on a man indoors.
laemmle_s_lucky_watch_chain.icon: Heavy gold double watch chain draped in a loop, a small gold horseshoe charm and a round gilt fob seal at one end, a slim T-bar at the other.

keystone_kop_helmet.name: Keystone Kop Helmet
keystone_kop_helmet.description: Mack Sennett's Kops mostly wore felt; this one was beaten from steel for a gag that called for a piano to land on it. The stuntman lived. The piano did not. A Brute's blow, it turns out, is easier.
keystone_kop_helmet.icon: Tall domed custodian helmet of dented blackened steel, a ridged crest along the top, brass star badge on the front, cracked leather chin strap, one side riveted with green-black chitin.

pressed_hunting_knife.name: Pressed Hunting Knife
pressed_hunting_knife.description: Sold in a pasteboard box with a fresh oiled shine and a crease in the sheath you could cut bread on. The Hollywoodland hardware man swears it was never used, which is not a selling point any more.
pressed_hunting_knife.icon: Straight clip-point hunting knife with clean polished steel blade, stacked brown leather washer grip, plain brass guard, crisp tan leather sheath with sharp creased edges beside it

hunting_knife_of_agility.name: Hunting Knife of Agility
hunting_knife_of_agility.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch rider who could skin a jackrabbit at a gallop, or so he said in the stable bar. The edge is quicker than the story.
hunting_knife_of_agility.icon: Slim clip-point hunting knife with bright narrow blade, honey leather washer grip, small green-dyed lanyard knot tied through the pommel hole

hunting_knife_of_stamina.name: Hunting Knife of Stamina
hunting_knife_of_stamina.description: A deer camp in Vermont Canyon went three weeks on beans and this blade, and it still holds an edge. The owner held out a week longer, which is the part he tells.
hunting_knife_of_stamina.icon: Thick broad-backed hunting knife with heavy dull steel blade, dark brown stacked leather grip, wide iron guard, sheath wrapped in a band of red wool

hunting_knife_of_the_acrobat.name: Hunting Knife of the Acrobat
hunting_knife_of_the_acrobat.description: Kept in the boot of a circus tumbler who came west for pictures and never left the ground again for less than union scale. Balanced well enough to throw, and twice it has been.
hunting_knife_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light hunting knife with long tapered blade and finger-groove grip of pale leather, tiny brass trapeze-ring charm hanging from the pommel

hunting_knife_of_the_marksman.name: Hunting Knife of the Marksman
hunting_knife_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner carried a Winchester for the shooting and this for everything after. The tally notches along the spine stop at forty, where he ran out of spine.
hunting_knife_of_the_marksman.icon: Clip-point hunting knife with blued steel blade, row of small notches filed along the spine, walnut grip with brass cross-hair inlay on the pommel

hunting_knife_of_the_stevedore.name: Hunting Knife of the Stevedore
hunting_knife_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off the San Pedro docks, where it opened crates, cut hawsers and settled one disagreement about overtime. Salt still lives in the hilt.
hunting_knife_of_the_stevedore.icon: Stout hunting knife with rope-scarred grey steel blade, tarred cord-wrapped grip, small brass cargo-hook charm on a loop of hemp at the pommel

tailored_hunting_knife.name: Tailored Hunting Knife
tailored_hunting_knife.description: A wardrobe man at Universal fitted it with a sheath of matched calfskin and monogrammed nothing, out of tact. Elegant enough for a gentleman sportsman, sharp enough for what the hills hold now.
tailored_hunting_knife.icon: Elegant hunting knife with mirror-polished blade, ivory-coloured grip with nickel bolsters, slim fitted burgundy calfskin sheath with neat white stitching

worn_colt_police_positive.name: Worn Colt Police Positive
worn_colt_police_positive.description: Pawned twice on Cahuenga and redeemed once, which is about its average. The cylinder still turns if asked politely.
worn_colt_police_positive.icon: Small-frame revolver with a short four-inch barrel and round six-shot cylinder, bluing worn to dull grey, freckled with rust, chipped dark wooden grips.

colt_police_positive_of_agility.name: Colt Police Positive of Agility
colt_police_positive_of_agility.description: Carried by a Hollywood Division motorcycle patrolman who could draw, fire and still look good in the newsreel. Someone eased the hammer to a hair trigger, and they never waited for anything either.
colt_police_positive_of_agility.icon: Compact blued-steel revolver with a short barrel and round cylinder, checkered walnut grips, a thin emerald-green braided lanyard looped through the butt ring.

colt_police_positive_of_stamina.name: Colt Police Positive of Stamina
colt_police_positive_of_stamina.description: A night watchman at the Christie lot kept this through eleven years of graveyard shifts and one very long Tuesday. The grips are worn smooth by a man who simply refused to go home.
colt_police_positive_of_stamina.icon: Short-barrelled blued revolver with round cylinder, grip wrapped in thick oxblood leather bound with brass wire, sturdy steel butt ring.

colt_police_positive_of_the_acrobat.name: Colt Police Positive of the Acrobat
colt_police_positive_of_the_acrobat.description: Belonged to a stuntman who fired it upside down from a moving red car for a two-reeler nobody released. The studio kept the footage; he kept the gun and both collarbones, mostly.
colt_police_positive_of_the_acrobat.icon: Small blued revolver with short barrel and round cylinder, light walnut grips, a red-and-white striped circus ribbon lanyard tied to the butt ring.

colt_police_positive_of_the_marksman.name: Colt Police Positive of the Marksman
colt_police_positive_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner shot clay pigeons for money in Griffith Park and ran a respectable book on himself. A neat notch filed in the rear sight never once needed explaining.
colt_police_positive_of_the_marksman.icon: Slim blued revolver with short barrel and round cylinder, a gleaming gold bead front sight and a fine cross-hair notch on the frame, dark walnut grips.

colt_police_positive_of_the_stevedore.name: Colt Police Positive of the Stevedore
colt_police_positive_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro in a longshoreman's coat pocket, alongside a cargo hook and a docked payslip. Heavy hands squeezed this trigger, and the trigger guard has the faint bend to prove it.
colt_police_positive_of_the_stevedore.icon: Short blued revolver with round cylinder, scuffed walnut grips, a coarse hemp rope lanyard with a tiny iron cargo-hook charm hanging from the butt.

patched_colt_police_positive.name: Patched Colt Police Positive
patched_colt_police_positive.description: Electrician's tape holds the left grip on; prayer handles the rest. The precinct sold it surplus for less than the tape cost.
patched_colt_police_positive.icon: Small revolver with short barrel and round cylinder, faded patchy bluing, cracked wooden grip bound with wraps of black friction tape and a twist of copper wire.

plain_colt_police_positive.name: Plain Colt Police Positive
plain_colt_police_positive.description: Blued steel, walnut grips, six chambers of .38. Every desk sergeant in the county has one just like it in a drawer.
plain_colt_police_positive.icon: Plain short-barrelled revolver with round six-shot cylinder, even dark-blue steel finish, simple smooth walnut grips, clean but unadorned.

sturdy_colt_police_positive.name: Sturdy Colt Police Positive
sturdy_colt_police_positive.description: Issued to a Paramount studio guard, who reported it lost the morning the hive came over the Marathon Street gate. Nobody has asked for it back.
sturdy_colt_police_positive.icon: Solid blued revolver with short thick barrel and round cylinder, heavy checkered walnut grips, steel butt ring, a small dent on the frame.

good_colt_police_positive.name: Good Colt Police Positive
good_colt_police_positive.description: Clean bore, tight lockwork and a cylinder that clicks shut like a good contract. Sold across the counter at Stembridge with a box of cartridges and no questions.
good_colt_police_positive.icon: Crisp polished revolver with short barrel and round cylinder, deep glossy blue-black steel, finely checkered rich walnut grips with a small silver medallion inset.

good_felt_fedora.name: Good Felt Fedora
good_felt_fedora.description: A sound hat with a sound crown, bought off a rack on Hollywood Boulevard back when the stores still kept regular hours.
good_felt_fedora.icon: Charcoal grey felt fedora with pinched crown and snap brim, plain black grosgrain band, slightly dusty, modest and serviceable.

felt_fedora_of_intellect.name: Felt Fedora of Intellect
felt_fedora_of_intellect.description: Left on a desk at the Hollywood Citizen-News, its owner having gone out for a story and never filed it. A pencil stub still rides in the band.
felt_fedora_of_intellect.icon: Slate blue felt fedora with sharp centre dent, navy band holding a yellow pencil stub tucked at the side, crisp brim.

felt_fedora_of_spirit.name: Felt Fedora of Spirit
felt_fedora_of_spirit.description: Its owner took it off for every funeral at Hollywood Cemetery this autumn, and there were a good many. The brim has worn soft where his fingers held it.
felt_fedora_of_spirit.icon: Soft dove grey felt fedora, brim edge rubbed pale, thin white band with a small sprig of dried rosemary tucked in.

felt_fedora_of_stamina.name: Felt Fedora of Stamina
felt_fedora_of_stamina.description: Survived a red-car derailment, two hive surges and a landlord. Somebody punched the dent back out each time and kept walking.
felt_fedora_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown felt fedora, heavy wide brim, rust-orange band, crown slightly battered and re-shaped, a small scuff on one side.

felt_fedora_of_the_engineer.name: Felt Fedora of the Engineer
felt_fedora_of_the_engineer.description: The studio electricians at Warner Bros. wore these up the catwalks so the foreman would know who to blame. A singe on the brim marks one arc that got away.
felt_fedora_of_the_engineer.icon: Olive green felt fedora with a black scorch mark on the brim, copper-coloured band with a tiny wrench charm pinned to it.

felt_fedora_of_the_doctor.name: Felt Fedora of the Doctor
felt_fedora_of_the_doctor.description: A house-call physician kept his prescription pad tucked inside the crown. The lining still smells faintly of iodine and boiled coffee.
felt_fedora_of_the_doctor.icon: Deep burgundy felt fedora, neat pinched front, white band stitched with a small red cross pin, clean tidy brim.

felt_fedora_of_the_deacon.name: Felt Fedora of the Deacon
felt_fedora_of_the_deacon.description: Worn on the long walk to Angelus Temple and set carefully on the pew beside a hymnal. It has heard Sister Aimee preach more often than most sinners.
felt_fedora_of_the_deacon.icon: Black felt fedora with modest brim, narrow purple band holding a short ribbon bookmark from a hymnal, softly brushed.

fine_felt_fedora.name: Fine Felt Fedora
fine_felt_fedora.description: Steamed and blocked by a hatter on Vine who swears the invaders cannot take a man's dignity, only his studio.
fine_felt_fedora.icon: Crisp fawn felt fedora, clean sharp creases, glossy dark brown band with a small bow, smooth even brim.

pressed_felt_fedora.name: Pressed Felt Fedora
pressed_felt_fedora.description: Pressed so sharp an assistant director at Paramount once mistook its wearer for the producer. The misunderstanding lasted almost a week.
pressed_felt_fedora.icon: Immaculate pearl grey felt fedora, knife-edged crown pinch, stiff upturned brim, black satin band with a tiny silver feather pin.

pearl_choker_of_strength.name: Pearl Choker of Strength
pearl_choker_of_strength.description: Restrung on piano wire by a Universal grip who said silk kept snapping. The clasp is a cargo shackle filed down to size, and it has never once come undone.
pearl_choker_of_strength.icon: Multi-strand pearl choker with thin steel wire showing between creamy pearls, an oversized dark iron shackle for a clasp, small red enamel dumbbell charm hanging at the front.

pearl_choker_of_agility.name: Pearl Choker of Agility
pearl_choker_of_agility.description: Worn by a backlot dancer who could clear a hive drone's reach with a single high kick. She kept the pearls; the drone kept its distance.
pearl_choker_of_agility.icon: Slender single-strand choker of small cream pearls, delicate silver clasp, a tiny green enamel feather charm dangling from the centre.

pearl_choker_of_stamina.name: Pearl Choker of Stamina
pearl_choker_of_stamina.description: Recovered from a wardrobe trunk that sat nine days under the rubble of a Universal dressing room. The actress who owned it walked out of the same rubble on the tenth, and she credits the pearls.
pearl_choker_of_stamina.icon: Thick triple-strand choker of large creamy pearls, sturdy square gold box clasp, small blue enamel heart charm at the front, a faint dust smudge on one strand.

pearl_choker_of_intellect.name: Pearl Choker of Intellect
pearl_choker_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a First National script girl who carried every continuity note in her head. The pearls are graded so evenly that a Burbank jeweller suspected her of counting them.
pearl_choker_of_intellect.icon: Graduated pearl choker in pale grey-white pearls, fine silver clasp, small violet enamel fountain-pen nib charm hanging at the centre.

pearl_choker_of_spirit.name: Pearl Choker of Spirit
pearl_choker_of_spirit.description: Somebody's grandmother prayed on these when the rosary went missing. Three pearls near the clasp are worn flat and stay warm long after the necklace comes off.
pearl_choker_of_spirit.icon: Choker of warm ivory pearls, three pearls near the clasp visibly worn flat, gold clasp, small pale blue enamel dove charm.

pearl_choker_of_the_boxer.name: Pearl Choker of the Boxer
pearl_choker_of_the_boxer.description: Hocked to a Legion Stadium promoter by a heavyweight's wife the night before he went down in the fourth. She never redeemed it, and the promoter called it the best purse he paid all year.
pearl_choker_of_the_boxer.icon: Chunky pearl choker with large uneven pearls, tarnished brass clasp, small red leather boxing glove charm hanging from the front.

pearl_choker_of_the_acrobat.name: Pearl Choker of the Acrobat
pearl_choker_of_the_acrobat.description: Wire-work girls on the Sennett lot wore these for a circus picture, since a choker stays put upside down. One snapped mid-swing, and the pearls turned up in the sawdust for weeks.
pearl_choker_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tight double-strand choker of small pearls on gold-sequinned ribbon backing, gilt clasp, a tiny gilt trapeze bar charm at the centre.

pearl_choker_of_the_stevedore.name: Pearl Choker of the Stevedore
pearl_choker_of_the_stevedore.description: Came ashore at San Pedro in a crate marked machine parts, off one of Cornero's boats. The longshoreman who lifted it wore it home under his collar and never explained himself.
pearl_choker_of_the_stevedore.icon: Heavy pearl choker strung on dark tarred rope cord, black iron hook-and-eye clasp, small brass anchor charm hanging at the front.

pearl_choker_of_the_marksman.name: Pearl Choker of the Marksman
pearl_choker_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner shot clay pigeons off the United Airport fence and never wasted a shell. Every pearl sits dead level, as if strung along a rifle sight.
pearl_choker_of_the_marksman.icon: Perfectly even single strand of bright white pearls, polished steel clasp, small silver ring charm with a crosshair notch cut across it.

pearl_choker_of_the_engineer.name: Pearl Choker of the Engineer
pearl_choker_of_the_engineer.description: Each knot was tied by a Lockheed draughtsman with the patience he usually saved for wing ribs. The clasp is machined to a thousandth of an inch, which is more than the pearls ever asked for.
pearl_choker_of_the_engineer.icon: Pearl choker with polished aluminium spacer beads between the pearls, precision-machined steel barrel clasp, small bronze wrench charm.

pearl_choker_of_the_doctor.name: Pearl Choker of the Doctor
pearl_choker_of_the_doctor.description: Found in a nurse's apron pocket at the Burbank aid station, wrapped in gauze like a patient. She wore it on night shifts, when the ward was quiet enough to need reminding of dances.
pearl_choker_of_the_doctor.icon: Pearl choker loosely coiled with a strip of white gauze, silver clasp, small white enamel charm bearing a red cross.

pearl_choker_of_the_deacon.name: Pearl Choker of the Deacon
pearl_choker_of_the_deacon.description: Given to the Angelus Temple collection plate by a Glendale widow, then quietly returned by a deacon who thought it deserved another long walk out of Echo Park. It smells faintly of hymnals and lavender.
pearl_choker_of_the_deacon.icon: Modest single-strand pearl choker, plain silver clasp, short purple hymnal ribbon tied at the back, small silver cross charm at the front.

fine_riveted_steel_helmet.name: Fine Riveted Steel Helmet
fine_riveted_steel_helmet.description: A machine-shop job from the Christie lot, riveted where the original seam split. Clean enough to wear to church, if the church allowed hats.
fine_riveted_steel_helmet.icon: Wide-brimmed soup-bowl steel helmet with a neat ring of round rivets around the crown, clean olive-drab paint, tan leather chin strap, rivet heads lightly polished.

riveted_steel_helmet_of_strength.name: Riveted Steel Helmet of Strength
riveted_steel_helmet_of_strength.description: Stamped out on a Universal backlot press and worn by a grip who carried arc lamps up ladders two at a time. The dent on the crown came from a Drone. The Drone came off worse.
riveted_steel_helmet_of_strength.icon: Wide-brimmed riveted steel helmet in olive drab with a bold red painted stripe circling the crown, one deep dent on top, dark iron rivets.

riveted_steel_helmet_of_stamina.name: Riveted Steel Helmet of Stamina
riveted_steel_helmet_of_stamina.description: Taken off a Post 43 sentry who stood the Pass road three nights running without relief. He credits the helmet with half the work and wants it back by Armistice Day.
riveted_steel_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Riveted steel helmet in dull grey-green with a thick quilted khaki canvas liner showing beneath the brim, khaki cloth band around the crown.

riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_boxer.name: Riveted Steel Helmet of the Boxer
riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_boxer.description: Legion Stadium kept a crate of these by the ring for nights when the crowd's opinion of a decision turned physical. Still smells of cigar and liniment.
riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_boxer.icon: Riveted olive-drab steel helmet with a small brass boxing-glove pin fixed to one side and a red leather chin strap, scuffed paint on the brim.

riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_stevedore.name: Riveted Steel Helmet of the Stevedore
riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_stevedore.description: Off a San Pedro longshoreman who rode the last red car north before the Dome came down. He swapped it for a pint of Cornero's best and called it a fair trade.
riveted_steel_helmet_of_the_stevedore.icon: Salt-stained riveted steel helmet with a coil of brown tarred rope wound around the brim and a small iron cargo-hook charm hanging from the strap.

pressed_riveted_steel_helmet.name: Pressed Riveted Steel Helmet
pressed_riveted_steel_helmet.description: Pressed is the wardrobe department's word. The machine shop calls it hammering. Either way the brim comes out true and the rivets sit flush.
pressed_riveted_steel_helmet.icon: Crisp riveted steel helmet with glossy dark green enamel, a perfectly even brim, flush brass rivets in a tidy ring, black leather chin strap.

tailored_riveted_steel_helmet.name: Tailored Riveted Steel Helmet
tailored_riveted_steel_helmet.description: Fitted at Universal for a war picture that will now never wrap, with a chamois liner sized to one actor's head. The actor is missing. His head, according to the studio, was generous.
tailored_riveted_steel_helmet.icon: Gleaming gunmetal-grey riveted helmet with bright nickel rivets, a soft cream chamois liner at the rim, neatly stitched brown leather chin strap with a small buckle.

heavy_riveted_steel_helmet.name: Heavy Riveted Steel Helmet
heavy_riveted_steel_helmet.description: Double-plated at a Studio City shop after a Soldier's mandible went through the first layer. It weighs like a regret and sits low over the eyes, which some men find a comfort.
heavy_riveted_steel_helmet.icon: Thick, bulky steel helmet with a doubled plate seam, two rows of large black iron rivets, scuffed dark gunmetal finish and a broad reinforced rolled rim.

worn_medical_bag.name: Worn Medical Bag
worn_medical_bag.description: Somebody's country doctor carried this through the first winter of the Depression, and it shows. The clasp still closes if asked nicely.
worn_medical_bag.icon: Battered black leather doctor's bag with a hinged split-top frame, scuffed grey corners, dull tarnished brass clasp, one cracked handle wrapped in brown twine.

medical_bag_of_intellect.name: Medical Bag of Intellect
medical_bag_of_intellect.description: Inside the lid, a pencilled dosage table in a careful hand, corrected twice. Its owner trusted arithmetic over bedside manner, and lost fewer patients for it.
medical_bag_of_intellect.icon: Black leather doctor's bag with brass frame clasp, a small blue enamel pin shaped like an open book on the side, a folded paper chart tucked under the handle.

medical_bag_of_spirit.name: Medical Bag of Spirit
medical_bag_of_spirit.description: The nurse who owned it hummed while she worked and slept soundly afterwards, which on a hive-surge night counts as a medical marvel.
medical_bag_of_spirit.icon: Brown leather doctor's bag, slightly open, a sprig of pale white sage tucked under the brass frame, soft green ribbon tied around the handle.

medical_bag_of_the_engineer.name: Medical Bag of the Engineer
medical_bag_of_the_engineer.description: Converted by a studio electrician who reckoned splints and fuses wanted the same tidy compartments. Gauze sits beside spare wire, and nobody has yet confused the two.
medical_bag_of_the_engineer.icon: Black leather doctor's bag with riveted steel corners, a small brass wrench charm hanging from the handle, a coil of copper wire peeking from the clasp.

medical_bag_of_the_doctor.name: Medical Bag of the Doctor
medical_bag_of_the_doctor.description: Bought secondhand from a Highland Avenue physician who left town just before the Dome came down. His prescription pad is still in the side pocket, half used and wholly illegible.
medical_bag_of_the_doctor.icon: Polished oxblood leather doctor's bag with gilt clasp, a small red cross enamel badge on the side, black stethoscope tubing coiled over the top.

medical_bag_of_the_deacon.name: Medical Bag of the Deacon
medical_bag_of_the_deacon.description: Carried door to door in Echo Park by a Temple volunteer who handed out soup, iodine and Scripture in equal measure. The leather smells faintly of hymnals.
medical_bag_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark brown leather doctor's bag with a worn handle, a purple hymnal ribbon tied around the frame, a small brass cross tag dangling from the clasp.

patched_medical_bag.name: Patched Medical Bag
patched_medical_bag.description: Mended with harness leather from the Gower Gulch stables. It carries bandages well and horse liniment better.
patched_medical_bag.icon: Black leather doctor's bag covered in mismatched brown leather patches, thick crude stitching, dulled brass clasp, a buckled strap replacing a lost latch.

plain_medical_bag.name: Plain Medical Bag
plain_medical_bag.description: Standard issue at every aid station on the Boulevard, and unremarkable until the moment someone needs it.
plain_medical_bag.icon: Plain black leather doctor's bag, clean but unpolished, simple steel frame clasp, straight leather handle, smooth unadorned sides.

sturdy_medical_bag.name: Sturdy Medical Bag
sturdy_medical_bag.description: Double-stitched along every seam by a saddler who had seen what a Spitter's acid does to cheap leather.
sturdy_medical_bag.icon: Thick tan leather doctor's bag with heavy double stitching, a reinforced base set with brass studs, a sturdy steel frame clasp.

good_medical_bag.name: Good Medical Bag
good_medical_bag.description: A respectable bag for a respectable practice, back when anyone in Hollywood still kept regular office hours.
good_medical_bag.icon: Neat black pebbled leather doctor's bag with polished brass clasp and hinges, firm rounded handle, crisp clean edges.

fine_medical_bag.name: Fine Medical Bag
fine_medical_bag.description: Kept on retainer by a studio for whichever star fainted on set, it has treated more vapours than wounds. The vapours paid better.
fine_medical_bag.icon: Glossy black calfskin doctor's bag with bright nickel clasp, cream leather trim along the seams, a small blank gilt nameplate on the side.

pressed_medical_bag.name: Pressed Medical Bag
pressed_medical_bag.description: Its leather was steamed and pressed over a form until the sides stand square and proud. Wardrobe departments notice these things.
pressed_medical_bag.icon: Rigid square-sided chestnut leather doctor's bag with sharp creases, polished brass frame and corner caps, stiff leather handle.

worn_pocket_testament.name: Worn Pocket Testament
worn_pocket_testament.description: Thumbed soft by a doughboy who carried it through the Argonne and back. A few verses are underlined, mostly the short ones.
worn_pocket_testament.icon: Small battered brown leather pocket Bible with soft rounded corners, frayed spine, faded gilt page edges, gently curved from years in a breast pocket.

pocket_testament_of_intellect.name: Pocket Testament of Intellect
pocket_testament_of_intellect.description: Margins crowded with cross-references in three colours of ink. Its former owner could argue Leviticus with a Red Squad sergeant and win on points.
pocket_testament_of_intellect.icon: Small black leather pocket Bible bristling with slips of paper bookmarks, a blue silk ribbon marker, bright gilt page edges.

pocket_testament_of_spirit.name: Pocket Testament of Spirit
pocket_testament_of_spirit.description: Opened so often to the Psalms that it now falls there on its own. It sits easier in the hand than most things under the Dome.
pocket_testament_of_spirit.icon: Small black pocket Bible lying half open, pale gold ribbon marker across cream pages, gilt edges, softly worn cover.

pocket_testament_of_the_engineer.name: Pocket Testament of the Engineer
pocket_testament_of_the_engineer.description: Found in the coat of a Lockheed riveter, with a slip of blueprint paper marking Nehemiah, the book about rebuilding walls.
pocket_testament_of_the_engineer.icon: Small dark green cloth-bound pocket Bible with brass corner protectors, a tiny wrench charm on the ribbon, a folded blue paper slip as bookmark.

pocket_testament_of_the_doctor.name: Pocket Testament of the Doctor
pocket_testament_of_the_doctor.description: Belonged to a mission doctor home from China, who kept a pressed poppy in Luke because Luke was a physician too.
pocket_testament_of_the_doctor.icon: Small maroon leather pocket Bible with a gilt cross on the cover, an orange poppy pressed between the pages and peeking out, gilt edges.

pocket_testament_of_the_deacon.name: Pocket Testament of the Deacon
pocket_testament_of_the_deacon.description: Handed out at the Angelus Temple doors by the thousand, this one walked from Echo Park and back every Sunday. Its owner wore out three pairs of shoes before the binding showed a scratch.
pocket_testament_of_the_deacon.icon: Small white leatherette pocket Bible with a purple ribbon marker, a tiny brass cross on the clasp strap, scuffed but clean cover.

patched_pocket_testament.name: Patched Pocket Testament
patched_pocket_testament.description: Rebound in a scrap of tent canvas after a rainy revival meeting out in the Valley. Exodus is slightly water-stained, which seems fitting.
patched_pocket_testament.icon: Small pocket Bible bound in patched tan canvas, crude stitching along the spine, water-stained page edges, string tied around it.

plain_pocket_testament.name: Plain Pocket Testament
plain_pocket_testament.description: Printed by the crate for hotel nightstands, it reached the Roosevelt in time to be ignored by a better class of guest.
plain_pocket_testament.icon: Small plain black pocket Bible with smooth leatherette cover, square corners, red page edges, no ornament.

sturdy_pocket_testament.name: Sturdy Pocket Testament
sturdy_pocket_testament.description: Bound in oilcloth over stiff board, it has stopped a ricochet once and a bad decision twice.
sturdy_pocket_testament.icon: Thick small pocket Bible with stiff dark oilcloth cover, brass reinforced corners, a shallow round dent in the front board.

good_pocket_testament.name: Good Pocket Testament
good_pocket_testament.description: Given at confirmation and actually kept, which puts it ahead of most such gifts in the county.
good_pocket_testament.icon: Small navy leather pocket Bible with a neat gilt cross on the cover, gilt page edges, blue ribbon marker, clean square spine.

fine_pocket_testament.name: Fine Pocket Testament
fine_pocket_testament.description: Morocco leather and India paper, the sort of edition a studio buyer orders for a picture about missionaries and then quietly keeps.
fine_pocket_testament.icon: Slim burgundy morocco leather pocket Bible with very thin gilt-edged pages, raised bands on the spine, a cream satin ribbon.

pressed_pocket_testament.name: Pressed Pocket Testament
pressed_pocket_testament.description: Clamped overnight in a bookbinder's press until the covers lie as flat as a Production Code memo. Not a page out of place.
pressed_pocket_testament.icon: Small crisp black calf pocket Bible with perfectly flat boards, a sharp gilt cross, bright gilt edges, black silk ribbon marker.

reinforced_lineman_s_belt.name: Reinforced Lineman's Belt
reinforced_lineman_s_belt.description: Double-riveted at every D-ring by a Bureau of Power and Light man who once watched a single rivet let go at forty feet.
reinforced_lineman_s_belt.icon: Wide brown leather lineman's body belt over thick tan canvas padding, two heavy steel D-rings at the hips, doubled rows of bright rivets, empty tool loops, square iron buckle

lineman_s_belt_of_agility.name: Lineman's Belt of Agility
lineman_s_belt_of_agility.description: Climbing spurs came with it once, along with a Pacific Electric wireman who went up a pole faster than most men take the stairs. The spurs were lost in Burbank. He was not.
lineman_s_belt_of_agility.icon: Brown leather lineman's belt with tan canvas padding, steel D-rings, green stitching along the edge, a small steel climbing-spur charm dangling from one tool loop

lineman_s_belt_of_strength.name: Lineman's Belt of Strength
lineman_s_belt_of_strength.description: Its owner carried a forty-pound transformer up a ladder on a dare, then charged the foreman a dollar to bring it back down.
lineman_s_belt_of_strength.icon: Heavy dark brown leather lineman's belt, broad canvas padding, oversized iron D-rings, thick riveted strap, a short coil of black cable hanging from the side loop

lineman_s_belt_of_stamina.name: Lineman's Belt of Stamina
lineman_s_belt_of_stamina.description: Worn through a triple shift restringing the Valley lines the week the Dome came down. The padding kept its shape better than the man did.
lineman_s_belt_of_stamina.icon: Brown leather lineman's belt with extra-thick quilted grey canvas padding at the back, steel D-rings, sweat-darkened leather, a spare buckle tongue tucked in a loop

lineman_s_belt_of_the_boxer.name: Lineman's Belt of the Boxer
lineman_s_belt_of_the_boxer.description: Off duty, the owner fought four-rounders at the Legion Stadium on Friday nights. The belt hung on the dressing-room hook and smelled of liniment until Monday.
lineman_s_belt_of_the_boxer.icon: Brown leather lineman's belt with tan canvas padding, steel D-rings, red stitching, a small red enamel boxing-glove pin fixed beside the buckle

lineman_s_belt_of_the_marksman.name: Lineman's Belt of the Marksman
lineman_s_belt_of_the_marksman.description: A Studio City lineman shot spitters off the crossarms with a .30-06 rather than wait for them to leave. His rifle sling clipped neatly to the left D-ring.
lineman_s_belt_of_the_marksman.icon: Brown leather lineman's belt, tan canvas padding, steel D-rings, a narrow olive rifle-sling clip on one ring, small cross-hair notch filed into the brass buckle

lineman_s_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Lineman's Belt of the Acrobat
lineman_s_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Taken from a former circus rigger who switched to telephone work in 1927, citing the steadier pay and the gentler public.
lineman_s_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slim brown leather lineman's belt with tan canvas padding, steel D-rings, red-and-yellow striped trim along the edge, a tiny trapeze-bar charm on a tool loop

lineman_s_belt_of_the_engineer.name: Lineman's Belt of the Engineer
lineman_s_belt_of_the_engineer.description: Pockets cut for a folded wiring diagram, a pencil stub and a pocket voltmeter. The Lockheed electrician who owned it read every specification before arguing with it.
lineman_s_belt_of_the_engineer.icon: Brown leather lineman's belt with tan canvas padding, steel D-rings, a row of narrow pencil pockets, small brass wrench charm hanging beside the buckle

superior_lineman_s_belt.name: Superior Lineman's Belt
superior_lineman_s_belt.description: Pigskin-faced and quilted with good duck canvas, made for the Bureau's foremen, who seldom climbed but liked to look ready.
superior_lineman_s_belt.icon: Polished tan pigskin lineman's belt over crisp cream quilted canvas, nickel-plated D-rings, neat even stitching, clean brass buckle, tidy empty tool loops

chitin_lined_lineman_s_belt.name: Chitin-lined Lineman's Belt
chitin_lined_lineman_s_belt.description: Behind the canvas sits a curve of Drone shell, cut to the hip. Burbank crews swear it turns a mandible; nobody has volunteered to test it twice.
chitin_lined_lineman_s_belt.icon: Dark leather lineman's belt with canvas padding, iridescent green-black insect shell visible along the inner lining, steel D-rings, heavy rivets

chitin_plated_lineman_s_belt.name: Chitin-plated Lineman's Belt
chitin_plated_lineman_s_belt.description: Hive plates are riveted over every loop and buckle, so the wearer clicks faintly on the climb. Line crews below Mount Lee stopped mending the wires months ago. Now they cut them.
chitin_plated_lineman_s_belt.icon: Heavy lineman's belt armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates, blackened steel D-rings, riveted shell over the buckle, worn dark leather beneath

worn_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Worn Prop Fencing Sabre
worn_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Blunted for a swashbuckler who never learned to fence. Its edge has been filed down twice, and its stunt double's patience once.
worn_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Slender straight sabre with dull grey nickel blade full of nicks, cracked black wooden grip, tarnished and dented brass bell guard.

prop_fencing_sabre_of_strength.name: Prop Fencing Sabre of Strength
prop_fencing_sabre_of_strength.description: Studio armourers sharpened it properly after the Dome came down. The prop department still wants it back by Friday.
prop_fencing_sabre_of_strength.icon: Slender straight sabre with freshly honed silver edge, polished brass bell guard, grip bound in bright red cord with a tasselled end.

prop_fencing_sabre_of_stamina.name: Prop Fencing Sabre of Stamina
prop_fencing_sabre_of_stamina.description: Its owner fought eleven takes of a balcony duel on a Gower Street set in July heat, and the sabre held up better than the leading man.
prop_fencing_sabre_of_stamina.icon: Slender straight sabre with clean steel blade, brass bell guard, grip wrapped in deep green leather with tight brass wire binding.

prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_boxer.name: Prop Fencing Sabre of the Boxer
prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_boxer.description: Swapped one Friday night at the Legion Stadium for a ringside seat and a cold hot dog, by a heavyweight who wanted something with more reach than his left.
prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_boxer.icon: Slender straight sabre, brass bell guard with a tiny red boxing glove charm dangling from it, grip wrapped in white athletic tape.

prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_stevedore.name: Prop Fencing Sabre of the Stevedore
prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a San Pedro freighter in a crate stencilled for Paramount. The longshoreman who prised the lid off decided it counted as wages.
prop_fencing_sabre_of_the_stevedore.icon: Slender straight sabre, brass bell guard, tarred hemp rope lanyard looped through the pommel with a small iron cargo hook charm.

patched_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Patched Prop Fencing Sabre
patched_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Tape holds the grip on and hope holds the guard. Extras carried it through a pirate picture nobody has ever seen.
patched_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Slender sabre with dull scratched blade, grip wrapped in grimy frayed cloth tape, bent brass bell guard crimped back into shape.

plain_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Plain Prop Fencing Sabre
plain_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Nobody's name is scratched on the blade, which makes it rarer than most props in Gower Gulch.
plain_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Slender straight sabre with plain unadorned steel blade, simple black grip, clean but unpolished brass bell guard.

sturdy_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Sturdy Prop Fencing Sabre
sturdy_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Rebuilt by a Columbia machinist with a spring-steel blade, since the original bent double on the first invader it met.
sturdy_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Straight sabre with thicker bright spring-steel blade, reinforced brass bell guard fixed with visible rivets, tight black leather grip.

good_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Good Prop Fencing Sabre
good_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Douglas Fairbanks would not have looked at it twice, which is the highest praise a costume department gives a spare.
good_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Elegant straight sabre with gleaming steel blade, shining brass bell guard, oxblood leather grip with neat silver wire wrap.

fine_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Fine Prop Fencing Sabre
fine_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Kept in a felt-lined drawer at the Pickford-Fairbanks studio and balanced by a French fencing master who charged by the hour and complained by the minute.
fine_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Elegant sabre with mirror-bright blade, engraved polished brass bell guard, ivory-white grip bound in fine gold wire.

pressed_prop_fencing_sabre.name: Pressed Prop Fencing Sabre
pressed_prop_fencing_sabre.description: Lacquered guard, nickel pommel, a blade straight enough for a close-up. Wardrobe insists it was only ever meant to be pointed dramatically at a villain in the third reel.
pressed_prop_fencing_sabre.icon: Immaculate straight sabre with flawless polished blade, glossy black-lacquered bell guard edged in nickel, crisp black grip with silver wire.

worn_trench_shovel.name: Worn Trench Shovel
worn_trench_shovel.description: Dug its share of France in 1918 and came home in a Legion man's footlocker, rust and all.
worn_trench_shovel.icon: Short-handled army trench shovel with rusted pointed spade blade, faded olive-drab paint flaking off, split weathered wooden handle.

trench_shovel_of_strength.name: Trench Shovel of Strength
trench_shovel_of_strength.description: Heavy enough to crack a drone's shell at the hinge, according to the Post 43 sergeant who ground its edge sharp on the clubhouse steps.
trench_shovel_of_strength.icon: Short-handled trench shovel with olive-drab blade and bright ground steel edge, wooden handle wrapped in red tape near the grip.

trench_shovel_of_stamina.name: Trench Shovel of Stamina
trench_shovel_of_stamina.description: Belonged to a man who dug latrines at Saint-Mihiel for a week straight, then dug house foundations in Beachwood Canyon for considerably better pay.
trench_shovel_of_stamina.icon: Short-handled trench shovel, olive-drab blade, sturdy oak handle, green canvas carrying cover strapped around the shaft with brass buckles.

trench_shovel_of_the_boxer.name: Trench Shovel of the Boxer
trench_shovel_of_the_boxer.description: Leaned against the Legion Stadium ropes for years, scraping up sawdust after the Friday card. A middleweight borrowed it the night the Dome came down and never brought it back.
trench_shovel_of_the_boxer.icon: Short-handled trench shovel, olive-drab blade, wooden handle with a tiny red boxing glove charm tied to the grip with twine.

trench_shovel_of_the_stevedore.name: Trench Shovel of the Stevedore
trench_shovel_of_the_stevedore.description: Shovelled coal into San Pedro freighters before a dock hand brought it north for picture work, back when Hollywood still paid by the day.
trench_shovel_of_the_stevedore.icon: Short-handled trench shovel with coal-blackened blade, wooden handle with tarred hemp rope lanyard and a small iron cargo hook.

patched_trench_shovel.name: Patched Trench Shovel
patched_trench_shovel.description: Wired to a hickory handle that once belonged to a broom, which explains the bristle still stuck in the joint.
patched_trench_shovel.icon: Trench shovel with chipped grey blade lashed to a mismatched pale hickory handle by twisted rusty wire, one stray straw bristle poking out.

plain_trench_shovel.name: Plain Trench Shovel
plain_trench_shovel.description: Army surplus, two bits at a Western Avenue pawnshop, no questions asked and none answered.
plain_trench_shovel.icon: Short-handled trench shovel with clean olive-drab painted blade, smooth plain wooden handle, simple steel collar.

sturdy_trench_shovel.name: Sturdy Trench Shovel
sturdy_trench_shovel.description: Fresh rivets and an iron collar keep the blade put, even when a burrower comes up right underneath it.
sturdy_trench_shovel.icon: Heavy trench shovel with thick dark steel blade, broad iron collar studded with bright rivets, solid oak handle bound with steel bands.

grauman_s_usher_coat.name: Grauman's Usher Coat
grauman_s_usher_coat.description: Sid Grauman dressed his ushers like palace guards and drilled them like a regiment. This one held his post through the first night of the invasion, seating patrons by flashlight until there were no patrons left to seat.
grauman_s_usher_coat.icon: Short crimson usher's jacket with a high mandarin collar, a double row of gilt buttons, gold braid frogging across the chest and fringed gold epaulettes.

brood_keeper_s_carapace_vest.name: Brood Keeper's Carapace Vest
brood_keeper_s_carapace_vest.description: Somebody quilted a canvas vest and stitched a drone's back-plate over the heart. The thing it came off had been guarding eggs in the Egyptian's basement, and the vest still twitches faintly when the house lights go down.
brood_keeper_s_carapace_vest.icon: Quilted tan canvas vest with a curved glossy green-black chitin plate stitched across the chest in heavy twine, faint amber resin smeared along the seams.

projectionist_s_eyeshade.name: Projectionist's Eyeshade
projectionist_s_eyeshade.description: Up in the booth, a projectionist threads reels by the glare of a carbon arc and keeps one eye on the fire bucket. Nitrate film forgives nobody, and the men who wore these learned to think fast and talk little.
projectionist_s_eyeshade.icon: Translucent green celluloid visor eyeshade on a black elastic band, small brass rivets at each temple, a faint brown scorch mark on one edge of the bill.

warden_s_chitin_helm.name: Warden's Chitin Helm
warden_s_chitin_helm.description: An M1917 doughboy helmet, its dents filled with a plate of invader shell hammered to the curve. The Legion armourer who made it called it the first good use anybody had found for the things.
warden_s_chitin_helm.icon: Wide-brimmed olive steel M1917 helmet, the crown overlaid with a glossy iridescent green-black chitin plate riveted around the rim, a worn leather chinstrap hanging loose.

matriarch_s_acid_etched_gloves.name: Matriarch's Acid-etched Gloves
matriarch_s_acid_etched_gloves.description: Brown kid gloves that went into the hive and came out pocked and pale wherever the spit landed. The acid left the leather tougher than before, which the glovemaker on Highland takes as a personal insult.
matriarch_s_acid_etched_gloves.icon: Pair of brown leather gloves with flared gauntlet cuffs, the backs pitted with pale lacy acid scars and faint greenish stains around the knuckles.

stagehand_s_rigging_gloves.name: Stagehand's Rigging Gloves
stagehand_s_rigging_gloves.description: Fly-gallery men haul sandbags and backdrops forty feet above the stage on hemp line, and a slipped grip means a lawsuit or a funeral. These have rope burns worn straight into the palms.
stagehand_s_rigging_gloves.icon: Thick padded tan canvas work gloves with darker leather-reinforced palms, a short coil of frayed hemp rope looped through one wristband.

egyptian_court_sandals.name: Egyptian Court Sandals
egyptian_court_sandals.description: Worn by a dancing girl in the stage prologue Grauman ran before every feature, back when a picture needed a pageant to sell it. Each step still sounds like a small curtain call.
egyptian_court_sandals.icon: Pair of flat gilded sandals with turquoise and lapis-blue straps, a painted lotus medallion on each toe strap and thin gold cord ties.

hive_mother_s_girdle.name: Hive Mother's Girdle
hive_mother_s_girdle.description: Cut from the belly-band of the brood mother nesting beneath the Egyptian's stage. It tightens slightly when insects are near, which some wearers find useful and others find reason to sleep in another room.
hive_mother_s_girdle.icon: Segmented belt of overlapping green-black chitin scales on brown leather backing, its buckle a lump of glowing amber hive resin with a dark shape suspended inside.

robin_hood_s_prop_tights.name: Robin Hood's Prop Tights
robin_hood_s_prop_tights.description: Douglas Fairbanks opened the Egyptian in 1922 with Robin Hood, and wardrobe never threw anything away. A dozen stuntmen went down a dozen castle walls in these, and the seat is patched exactly where you would expect.
robin_hood_s_prop_tights.icon: Forest-green leather tights with soft brown suede patches at the knees, a laced front and a single red-brown feather tucked into the waistband.

orchestra_pit_trousers.name: Orchestra Pit Trousers
orchestra_pit_trousers.description: The house orchestra played on the night the Dome came down, right up until the brass section was carried off. A violinist kept these, along with his low opinion of the conductor's tempo.
orchestra_pit_trousers.icon: Black wool dress trousers with satin side stripes and a sharp crease, folded sheets of blank music paper tucked over the waistband, a pale rosin smudge on one knee.

sid_s_opening_night_cufflinks.name: Sid's Opening Night Cufflinks
sid_s_opening_night_cufflinks.description: Grauman wore these to the 1922 premiere and every one after it, until he swore they had turned unlucky. He gave them away the week the Dome went up, which rather settled the argument.
sid_s_opening_night_cufflinks.icon: Pair of oval gold cufflinks with black onyx faces, each set with a tiny diamond chip, joined by a short fine gold chain.

scarab_signet.name: Scarab Signet
scarab_signet.description: Bought from a curio stall on the Boulevard the year everyone went mad for King Tut. The seller swore it came out of a real tomb; the brass showing under the green glaze suggests Pasadena.
scarab_signet.icon: Heavy brass signet ring set with a carved green-glazed scarab beetle, wings folded, thin gold leaf worn away at the edges.

pharaoh_s_paste_necklace.name: Pharaoh's Paste Necklace
pharaoh_s_paste_necklace.description: Every stone in it is glass and every inch of gilt is paint, built to read as a king's ransom from row thirty. Studio jewellers call that honesty, of a sort.
pharaoh_s_paste_necklace.icon: Broad Egyptian collar necklace of stacked rows of red, turquoise and gold paste beads, small falcon-head clasps at each end.

usher_s_brass_whistle_chain.name: Usher's Brass Whistle Chain
usher_s_brass_whistle_chain.description: Ushers carried these to whistle down rowdy patrons and runaway children. Lately the shrill blast scatters broodlings too, and the head usher counts that as a promotion.
usher_s_brass_whistle_chain.icon: Polished brass whistle on a short braided brass chain, a small stamped lotus tag and a red silk tassel hanging from the ring.

crypt_keeper_s_shroud.name: Crypt Keeper's Shroud
crypt_keeper_s_shroud.description: Linen wrappings from a keeper who watched over the Hollywood Cemetery crypts long after the mourners stopped coming. It smells of lilies, damp stone and something chemical underneath that the mortuary staff decline to discuss.
crypt_keeper_s_shroud.icon: Long hooded robe of pale grey linen wrapped in loose bands, frayed hem stained with dark earth, a small tarnished silver clasp at the throat.

sexton_s_mud_boots.name: Sexton's Mud Boots
sexton_s_mud_boots.description: Twenty years the sexton dug graves at Hollywood Cemetery, and this autumn he filled them faster than ever. His boots never once stuck in the clay, which he credited to clean living and a pint of dubbin a week.
sexton_s_mud_boots.icon: Pair of tall brown leather work boots caked in grey clay to the ankle, rawhide laces, iron hobnails studding the heels.

warner_grip_s_harness.name: Warner Grip's Harness
warner_grip_s_harness.description: A grip on the Sunset lot buckled this on to climb the catwalks and rig lamps for Warner pictures. The invaders kept the stages running after he was gone; the harness turned up hanging from a scaffold, still clipped.
warner_grip_s_harness.icon: Padded canvas work belt with crossed shoulder straps, heavy brass D-rings and a steel snap hook, a coil of white sash cord hanging at the hip.

superior_opening_night_tailcoat.name: Superior Opening Night Tailcoat
superior_opening_night_tailcoat.description: Cut for a Pantages premiere that the Dome postponed indefinitely. The tails still hang straight, which is more than can be said for the guest list.
superior_opening_night_tailcoat.icon: Crisp black wool tailcoat with long split tails, glossy black satin peaked lapels, a white piqué waistcoat edge and polished jet buttons, immaculately pressed.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_intellect.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of Intellect
opening_night_tailcoat_of_intellect.description: Its last owner was a scenario writer who read every contract twice and still got no screen credit. The inside pocket holds a pencil stub and a grudge.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_intellect.icon: Black tailcoat with grey silk lapels, a slim black fountain pen clipped in the breast pocket and a folded blue silk pocket square.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_spirit.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of Spirit
opening_night_tailcoat_of_spirit.description: Worn to the Hell's Angels premiere in May, when searchlights crossed the sky over Grauman's. Whoever owned it kept the programme folded in the lining like a pressed flower.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_spirit.icon: Midnight-blue tailcoat with silver satin lapel facings and a pale lavender carnation boutonnière, tails falling long and smooth.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_stamina.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of Stamina
opening_night_tailcoat_of_stamina.description: A doorman stood in this through eleven hours of premiere and two fistfights over seating. The seams have never once complained.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_stamina.icon: Heavy broad-shouldered black tailcoat with thick double-stitched seams in dark red thread and sturdy brass buttons, tails squared and solid.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_engineer.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of the Engineer
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_engineer.description: Borrowed off a First National wardrobe rack by a Lockheed draughtsman who needed something decent for a banquet. He returned it with oil on one cuff and a wing-spar sketch in the pocket.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_engineer.icon: Black tailcoat with steel-grey silk facings, a small brass wrench charm pinned to the lapel and a faint dark oil smudge on one cuff.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_doctor.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of the Doctor
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_doctor.description: On call through every first night of the season, its owner left before the second reel whenever a telephone rang. The left pocket still smells of ether and good cigars.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_doctor.icon: Black tailcoat with white silk lapels, a tiny red enamel cross pin on the lapel and a crisp folded white handkerchief in the breast pocket.

opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_deacon.name: Opening Night Tailcoat of the Deacon
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_deacon.description: Angelus Temple's choir director wore it for broadcasts over KFSG, where no listener could see him. He dressed properly regardless, on the principle that the Lord has excellent reception.
opening_night_tailcoat_of_the_deacon.icon: Sober black tailcoat with a deep purple hymnal ribbon trailing from the breast pocket and a small gold cross pin on the lapel.

chitin_lined_opening_night_tailcoat.name: Chitin-lined Opening Night Tailcoat
chitin_lined_opening_night_tailcoat.description: Wardrobe in Burbank sewed shell plates under the silk after the drones began attending premieres uninvited. It rustles when it bows.
chitin_lined_opening_night_tailcoat.icon: Black tailcoat hanging open to reveal a lining of overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates beneath torn black satin, tails slightly stiffened.

chitin_plated_opening_night_tailcoat.name: Chitin-plated Opening Night Tailcoat
chitin_plated_opening_night_tailcoat.description: Taken from an usher the hive kept seating empty rows at the Pantages long after the audience stopped coming. The shell grew over the lapels on its own; a tailor only finished the buttonholes.
chitin_plated_opening_night_tailcoat.icon: Rigid tailcoat armoured with iridescent green-black chitin plates over shoulders and lapels, seams glinting with amber hive resin, tails edged in curved shell.

pressed_thompson_m1928.name: Pressed Thompson M1928
pressed_thompson_m1928.description: Cleaned, oiled and returned to the rack at Stembridge with a rental tag still wired to the sling swivel. The studio insists it was only ever fired at extras, and only with blanks.
pressed_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with straight stick magazine, clean walnut stock and twin pistol grips, freshly blued finned barrel, small blank paper rental tag wired to the sling swivel.

thompson_m1928_of_agility.name: Thompson M1928 of Agility
thompson_m1928_of_agility.description: One Strip bouncer swore by it: keep the feet moving and the muzzle down. He kept both, right up until the night a Flier came through a speakeasy skylight.
thompson_m1928_of_agility.icon: Thompson submachine gun with round drum magazine, slim walnut foregrip wrapped in pale green cord, blued steel finned barrel, small brass feather charm hanging from the sling swivel.

thompson_m1928_of_stamina.name: Thompson M1928 of Stamina
thompson_m1928_of_stamina.description: Belonged to a night watchman at the Christie lot who held the paint-shop door for nine hours with it, then walked home for breakfast. Nobody has managed to make him tell it differently.
thompson_m1928_of_stamina.icon: Thompson submachine gun with stick magazine, thick dark walnut stock bound in red leather wrap, blued receiver, spare magazine strapped to the stock with a canvas band.

thompson_m1928_of_the_acrobat.name: Thompson M1928 of the Acrobat
thompson_m1928_of_the_acrobat.description: Rented for a rooftop chase picture in which the double leapt from the Taft Building onto a moving truck. He did it in one take, gun and all, and the director asked for another.
thompson_m1928_of_the_acrobat.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, walnut stock scuffed pale at the edges, blued barrel, bright orange pennant ribbon knotted around the rear sight.

thompson_m1928_of_the_marksman.name: Thompson M1928 of the Marksman
thompson_m1928_of_the_marksman.description: A Prohibition agent filed the front sight to his own taste and fired it in short, thrifty bursts of two rounds apiece. The Bureau never reimbursed him for the file.
thompson_m1928_of_the_marksman.icon: Thompson submachine gun with stick magazine and muzzle compensator, honey walnut stock, blued steel, polished brass rear sight with a small filed cross-hair notch.

thompson_m1928_of_the_stevedore.name: Thompson M1928 of the Stevedore
thompson_m1928_of_the_stevedore.description: Came ashore at San Pedro in a crate marked pianos, underneath four hundred pounds of actual pianos. The longshoreman who found it decided he had earned the commission.
thompson_m1928_of_the_stevedore.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, walnut stock with a rope-burn groove, blued barrel, coil of tarred hemp rope and a small cargo-hook charm tied to the sling.

tailored_thompson_m1928.name: Tailored Thompson M1928
tailored_thompson_m1928.description: Its last owner had the stock refinished to match his spats and the sling cut by his own tailor on Wilshire. The invaders were unimpressed. The head waiter at the Brown Derby was not.
tailored_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with stick magazine, glossy polished walnut stock, mirror-blued receiver, cream calfskin sling with brass buckles, thin gilt band around the barrel.

heavy_thompson_m1928.name: Heavy Thompson M1928
heavy_thompson_m1928.description: Fitted with an oversized drum and a steel buttplate by a Legion armourer who believed nothing should be left to chance. Lifting it is half the argument in its favour.
heavy_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with oversized drum magazine, thick dark walnut stock with steel buttplate, heavy blued finned barrel, riveted steel bracing strap along the receiver.

reinforced_thompson_m1928.name: Reinforced Thompson M1928
reinforced_thompson_m1928.description: Riveted bands hold the receiver together where a Soldier's mandibles closed on it outside Universal. The mechanic who mended it charged double and called it a bargain.
reinforced_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, battered walnut stock bound with riveted steel bands, gunmetal grey receiver, two deep scraped grooves across the barrel.

superior_thompson_m1928.name: Superior Thompson M1928
superior_thompson_m1928.description: Burbank machinists tuned the action to run as smooth as an aero engine. Since the hive moved into the Lockheed sheds, the men who did the work are not around to accept compliments.
superior_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, fine dark walnut stock, bright precision-machined steel receiver, polished brass bolt handle, ribbed aluminium cooling sleeve on the barrel.

chitin_lined_thompson_m1928.name: Chitin-lined Thompson M1928
chitin_lined_thompson_m1928.description: Grips and drum housing are lined with Elder Drone shell, which never slips in a wet hand and never quite stops smelling of the hive. Gunmen say it runs cooler. Nobody asks why.
chitin_lined_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, walnut grips inlaid with iridescent green-black insect shell, blued steel barrel, chitin lining showing around the drum's rim.

chitin_plated_thompson_m1928.name: Chitin-plated Thompson M1928
chitin_plated_thompson_m1928.description: Plated end to end in salvaged shell at the forward camp below the sign, by men who had stopped caring how a gun looked. On Mount Lee, anything that survives a Brute's charge is handsome enough.
chitin_plated_thompson_m1928.icon: Thompson submachine gun with drum magazine, wholly plated in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin segments, blackened steel barrel poking through, hooked shell spur jutting below the foregrip.

fine_horsehide_jacket.name: Fine Horsehide Jacket
fine_horsehide_jacket.description: Cut for a motorcycle officer who privately preferred his horse. The leather has forgiven the switch better than he did.
fine_horsehide_jacket.icon: Waist-length horsehide jacket, button front, wide pointed collar, clean dark brown leather with a soft sheen, two flap chest pockets, brass buttons, tidy tan stitching.

horsehide_jacket_of_agility.name: Horsehide Jacket of Agility
horsehide_jacket_of_agility.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch rider who could slide out of the saddle and under a corral fence before the director called cut. The elbows are worn to suede.
horsehide_jacket_of_agility.icon: Brown horsehide jacket with suede-worn elbows, bright yellow-tan contrast stitching, small silver spur charm hanging from the top button, slightly flared waistband.

horsehide_jacket_of_stamina.name: Horsehide Jacket of Stamina
horsehide_jacket_of_stamina.description: Two winters on a Cahuenga Pass road crew and one determined Spitter have not managed to finish it off. The acid scars across the back look like a map of Ventura County.
horsehide_jacket_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown horsehide jacket, pale bleached acid-scar blotches on the back, turned-out collar showing red wool lining, heavy iron buttons.

horsehide_jacket_of_spirit.name: Horsehide Jacket of Spirit
horsehide_jacket_of_spirit.description: Found folded on a pew in a Beachwood Canyon chapel, with a pressed poppy in the breast pocket. Nobody came back for it, and nobody has had the heart to ask why.
horsehide_jacket_of_spirit.icon: Mid-brown horsehide jacket folded neatly, a single orange California poppy tucked in the breast pocket, soft cream stitching, horn buttons.

horsehide_jacket_of_the_acrobat.name: Horsehide Jacket of the Acrobat
horsehide_jacket_of_the_acrobat.description: High falls for Pickford-Fairbanks paid thirty dollars a jump, and this jacket went off the roof with its owner eleven times. The studio paid for the man's shoulder, though not the jacket's.
horsehide_jacket_of_the_acrobat.icon: Tan horsehide jacket with a torn left shoulder mended in green thread, scuffed sleeves, small green felt patch on the elbow, brass buttons.

horsehide_jacket_of_the_stevedore.name: Horsehide Jacket of the Stevedore
horsehide_jacket_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up the coast from the San Pedro docks on the back of a man who carried a sack in each hand and never asked what was in them. It still smells of creosote and salt.
horsehide_jacket_of_the_stevedore.icon: Heavy russet horsehide jacket with dark tar stains on the cuffs, a coiled hemp-rope loop hung from one shoulder strap, scuffed brass buttons.

horsehide_jacket_of_the_deacon.name: Horsehide Jacket of the Deacon
horsehide_jacket_of_the_deacon.description: Sister McPherson's ushers wore these on night patrols around Echo Park, and a hymnal fits the inside pocket exactly. A note in the lining asks the finder to return it to Angelus Temple, care of anyone.
horsehide_jacket_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark chestnut horsehide jacket with a white silk hymnal ribbon tied through the top buttonhole, plain bone buttons, neat cream stitching.

pressed_horsehide_jacket.name: Pressed Horsehide Jacket
pressed_horsehide_jacket.description: Pressing leather is not a thing a sensible tailor does, but the valet at the Chateau Marmont does it anyway, and charges accordingly.
pressed_horsehide_jacket.icon: Glossy oxblood horsehide jacket with crisp sharp creases down the sleeves, polished brass buttons, smooth unmarked leather, neat narrow collar.

tailored_horsehide_jacket.name: Tailored Horsehide Jacket
tailored_horsehide_jacket.description: Made to measure for a Universal contract player who wanted to look rugged in the commissary. He was taken from the backlot the week after his final fitting.
tailored_horsehide_jacket.icon: Slim fitted chocolate horsehide jacket with cream contrast piping along the seams, carved horn buttons, nipped waist, shaped lapel collar.

heavy_horsehide_jacket.name: Heavy Horsehide Jacket
heavy_horsehide_jacket.description: Double-thick hide from a saddlery's best stock, heavy enough that the river camp crews hang it on a nail rather than a hanger. Spitter acid beads on it for a full second before it gets ideas.
heavy_horsehide_jacket.icon: Very thick black-brown horsehide jacket with riveted seams, a quilted leather shoulder yoke, wide storm collar, heavy blackened iron buttons.

fine_quilted_vest.name: Fine Quilted Vest
fine_quilted_vest.description: Standard issue at the Mulholland Dam keeper's house, where the night shift learned that wind off Lake Hollywood cuts through anything thinner.
fine_quilted_vest.icon: Sleeveless navy quilted cotton vest, clean diamond stitching, round collarless neck, row of tin buttons, crisp unfaded fabric.

quilted_vest_of_agility.name: Quilted Vest of Agility
quilted_vest_of_agility.description: A Hollywood Bowl usher wore this running between seats in the dark. The padding still holds the shape of someone who never once bumped a knee.
quilted_vest_of_agility.icon: Light grey quilted vest, narrow and trim, thin green piping on the edges, small brass buttons, slim diamond quilting.

quilted_vest_of_strength.name: Quilted Vest of Strength
quilted_vest_of_strength.description: Quilted by a grip's wife from a studio moving blanket, which explains why it takes a lamp stand to the chest without complaint. The grip never did say where the blanket went.
quilted_vest_of_strength.icon: Bulky quilted vest in faded blue moving-blanket cloth, bold red binding around the edges, square stitched quilting, large wooden buttons.

quilted_vest_of_stamina.name: Quilted Vest of Stamina
quilted_vest_of_stamina.description: Every stitch is doubled, and the padding is cotton batting, horsehair and what appears to be a Saturday Evening Post. Post 43 men swear by it, and occasionally at it.
quilted_vest_of_stamina.icon: Thick khaki quilted vest with doubled stitching, a scrap of newsprint peeking from a split seam, dull brass buttons, deep puffy padding.

quilted_vest_of_the_boxer.name: Quilted Vest of the Boxer
quilted_vest_of_the_boxer.description: Friday nights at the Legion Stadium, a cut man called Dutch wore this ringside, and the stains down the front are mostly not his. He claimed it brought luck to whoever was paying him.
quilted_vest_of_the_boxer.icon: Maroon quilted vest with faint dark stains down the front, a small brass boxing-glove pin on the breast, white towel-cloth trim at the neck.

quilted_vest_of_the_marksman.name: Quilted Vest of the Marksman
quilted_vest_of_the_marksman.description: Its owner practised on the Stembridge range on Marathon Street and stitched a pad into the right shoulder where a Springfield's butt sits. The left side is untouched; he never once switched.
quilted_vest_of_the_marksman.icon: Olive quilted vest with a brown leather shooting patch on the right shoulder, one brass button stamped with a cross-hair notch, tidy diamond stitching.

quilted_vest_of_the_acrobat.name: Quilted Vest of the Acrobat
quilted_vest_of_the_acrobat.description: Light enough to tumble in and padded enough to land in, it belonged to a trapeze man stranded when the Dome came down over his tour. He still asks after it at the Roosevelt bar, which officially serves only coffee.
quilted_vest_of_the_acrobat.icon: Crimson and gold striped quilted vest with spangled sequin trim along the hem, snug cut, small gilt buttons.

quilted_vest_of_the_engineer.name: Quilted Vest of the Engineer
quilted_vest_of_the_engineer.description: Lockheed riveters wore these on the plant floor, with lining pockets for a slide rule and a pencil stub. One pocket here holds a sketch of an invader wing, carefully dimensioned.
quilted_vest_of_the_engineer.icon: Grey-blue canvas quilted vest, a pencil stub tucked in the breast pocket, small brass wrench charm on a button, rectangular quilting.

pressed_quilted_vest.name: Pressed Quilted Vest
pressed_quilted_vest.description: Somebody at the Hollywood Hotel sends these out to be steamed and pressed until the padding stands up like a parade. The quilting runs straight enough to please a sergeant.
pressed_quilted_vest.icon: Crisp cream quilted vest with sharp precise diamond stitching, standing collar, polished nickel buttons, bright clean fabric.

tailored_quilted_vest.name: Tailored Quilted Vest
tailored_quilted_vest.description: Wardrobe at Universal cut this for a Foreign Legion picture that never got made, so it fits beautifully and looks faintly Moroccan.
tailored_quilted_vest.icon: Fitted tan quilted vest with braided burgundy cord trim, shaped waist, toggle-and-loop fastenings, fine narrow quilting.

heavy_quilted_vest.name: Heavy Quilted Vest
heavy_quilted_vest.description: Packed with felt and a sheet of boiler canvas, it stands up in a corner on its own like a patient extra. River camp men sit on it when they are not wearing it.
heavy_quilted_vest.icon: Stiff thick dark brown canvas vest with heavy padded rolls, two leather side straps with iron buckles, reinforced riveted edges.

heavy_m1905_bayonet.name: Heavy M1905 Bayonet
heavy_m1905_bayonet.description: Sixteen inches of Springfield steel, ground thicker by a surplus dealer on Main Street who priced his stock by the ounce and never once gave short weight.
heavy_m1905_bayonet.icon: Long straight single-edged bayonet with thick dull grey blade, deep fuller groove, dark walnut grips, ring crossguard, plain olive canvas loop at the pommel

m1905_bayonet_of_agility.name: M1905 Bayonet of Agility
m1905_bayonet_of_agility.description: A Universal stunt double learned to flip it end over end between takes of All Quiet on the Western Front. The picture wrapped in the spring. He never quite stopped flipping it.
m1905_bayonet_of_agility.icon: Long straight bayonet with polished grey blade, ring crossguard, slim walnut grips wrapped near the pommel with a thin bright yellow cord tassel

m1905_bayonet_of_stamina.name: M1905 Bayonet of Stamina
m1905_bayonet_of_stamina.description: It went from the Argonne to a Legion locker on Highland, then back out when the Dome came down. Its owner claimed it had outlasted three sergeants and one marriage.
m1905_bayonet_of_stamina.icon: Long straight bayonet with scratched blued blade, ring crossguard, worn walnut grips, a dented olive-drab metal scabbard tip and a small brown leather wrap

m1905_bayonet_of_the_acrobat.name: M1905 Bayonet of the Acrobat
m1905_bayonet_of_the_acrobat.description: A knife-thrower from a stranded circus closed every show by pinning an apple on his sister's head. She switched to pears afterward, which sit lower.
m1905_bayonet_of_the_acrobat.icon: Long straight bayonet with bright steel blade, ring crossguard, walnut grips, a red and white striped ribbon knotted at the pommel ring

m1905_bayonet_of_the_marksman.name: M1905 Bayonet of the Marksman
m1905_bayonet_of_the_marksman.description: Its first owner fixed it to his Springfield and rarely needed it, being the sort who hit what he aimed at from three hundred yards. The grips are worn only where he cleaned it.
m1905_bayonet_of_the_marksman.icon: Long straight bayonet with keen grey blade, ring crossguard, smooth walnut grips with a small brass cross-hair notch inlaid near the pommel

m1905_bayonet_of_the_stevedore.name: M1905 Bayonet of the Stevedore
m1905_bayonet_of_the_stevedore.description: Before the Dome it rode up from San Pedro in a longshoreman's boot, where it cut cargo netting, hawser line and the occasional argument about overtime.
