m1905_bayonet_of_the_stevedore.icon: Long straight bayonet with salt-dulled grey blade, ring crossguard, walnut grips bound with tarred hemp rope, a small iron cargo hook charm on the pommel

reinforced_m1905_bayonet.name: Reinforced M1905 Bayonet
reinforced_m1905_bayonet.description: A Lockheed riveter backed the spine with a strip of aircraft steel, reasoning that anything good enough for a Vega would hold against a drone's leg.
reinforced_m1905_bayonet.icon: Long straight bayonet with heavy grey blade, a riveted strip of bright aluminium-grey steel along the spine, ring crossguard, dark walnut grips

superior_m1905_bayonet.name: Superior M1905 Bayonet
superior_m1905_bayonet.description: Reground and blued twice over in the First National machine shop. The armourer took it to the river camp and did not come back. The knife did, carried in by somebody else.
superior_m1905_bayonet.icon: Long straight bayonet with deep blue-black blade and a fine silver edge, crisp ring crossguard, oiled dark walnut grips, faint green-black chitin smear near the tip

reinforced_chitin_crested_helmet.name: Reinforced Chitin-crested Helmet
reinforced_chitin_crested_helmet.description: An M1917 shell riveted over a ridge of invader carapace by a Burbank machinist who needed the work. The crest deflects a falling blow; the rivets complain about it.
reinforced_chitin_crested_helmet.icon: Shallow wide-brimmed steel helmet in drab olive, a dark green-black chitin ridge running front to back, heavy steel rivets and a doubled leather chinstrap

chitin_crested_helmet_of_strength.name: Chitin-crested Helmet of Strength
chitin_crested_helmet_of_strength.description: Its last owner pried a Brute's jaws apart on Olive Avenue and wore this to do it. The dent over the left ear is the Brute's side of the story.
chitin_crested_helmet_of_strength.icon: Olive steel helmet with a tall iridescent green-black chitin crest, a deep dent on one side, red-painted rim band

chitin_crested_helmet_of_stamina.name: Chitin-crested Helmet of Stamina
chitin_crested_helmet_of_stamina.description: Taken off a Legion corporal who held the Lockheed fence for two days without sleep. He kept the helmet on the whole time and asked for it back afterwards. The answer was no.
chitin_crested_helmet_of_stamina.icon: Battered olive steel helmet with a broad chitin crest, thick padded leather liner showing beneath the brim, khaki canvas chinstrap

chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_boxer.name: Chitin-crested Helmet of the Boxer
chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_boxer.description: Painted inside with the dates of nine Friday nights at the Legion Stadium. The crest was added after the tenth, when the opponent had six legs.
chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive steel helmet with a chitin crest, a small brass boxing-glove pin fixed to the front, red cord wrapped around the brim

chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_stevedore.name: Chitin-crested Helmet of the Stevedore
chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up the coast in a crate marked machine parts and smells faintly of San Pedro tar. Dockmen say the crest was meant for catching swung cargo hooks, and occasionally does.
chitin_crested_helmet_of_the_stevedore.icon: Olive steel helmet with a chitin crest, a coil of tarred rope tied around the base, small iron cargo-hook charm on the chinstrap

superior_chitin_crested_helmet.name: Superior Chitin-crested Helmet
superior_chitin_crested_helmet.description: The First National machine shop turned these out between pictures, polished well enough to pass for a costume. The insects have not been fooled.
superior_chitin_crested_helmet.icon: Clean polished steel helmet with a smooth glossy chitin crest, bright brass rivets, new tan leather chinstrap

chitin_lined_chitin_crested_helmet.name: Chitin-lined Chitin-crested Helmet
chitin_lined_chitin_crested_helmet.description: Shell outside, shell inside, and a soldier somewhere between. The lining keeps acid off the scalp and keeps the wearer from forgetting what it used to be.
chitin_lined_chitin_crested_helmet.icon: Heavy steel helmet with a tall chitin crest, iridescent green-black shell plates visible lining the inner rim, dark leather strap

chitin_plated_chitin_crested_helmet.name: Chitin-plated Chitin-crested Helmet
chitin_plated_chitin_crested_helmet.description: Little steel left showing under the overlapping plates. Men on the Mount Lee ridge wear them to the last camp below the sign, and say the hive goes quiet when one walks past.
chitin_plated_chitin_crested_helmet.icon: Massive helmet fully plated in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin scales, a jagged spined crest, thin steel rim and blackened rivets

tailored_quilted_cuffs.name: Tailored Quilted Cuffs
tailored_quilted_cuffs.description: Cut to measure by a Universal wardrobe man who still pins a chalk mark on anything that holds still long enough.
tailored_quilted_cuffs.icon: A pair of crisp quilted canvas cuffs in clean tan, neat diamond stitching, trim brown leather edging and two bright brass snaps.

quilted_cuffs_of_agility.name: Quilted Cuffs of Agility
quilted_cuffs_of_agility.description: Belonged to a second-unit rider who could drop from a galloping horse onto a moving stagecoach, then ask whether the take was any good. It always was.
quilted_cuffs_of_agility.icon: Olive-drab quilted canvas cuff with sky-blue piping along both edges and a small brass horseshoe charm stitched near the snap.

quilted_cuffs_of_strength.name: Quilted Cuffs of Strength
quilted_cuffs_of_strength.description: A grip on the Universal backlot wore these hauling a Model T out of a hive pit by its bumper. The bumper gave up first.
quilted_cuffs_of_strength.icon: Olive-drab quilted canvas cuff with deep red piping, thick stitching and a tiny iron anvil-shaped rivet set beside the brass snap.

quilted_cuffs_of_stamina.name: Quilted Cuffs of Stamina
quilted_cuffs_of_stamina.description: Padding thick as a hotel mattress and roughly as clean. The last owner stood night watch at the Universal front gate for eleven straight shifts and never once sat down.
quilted_cuffs_of_stamina.icon: Bulky olive-drab quilted canvas cuff, overstuffed batting bulging between seams, dark green piping and a worn brass snap.

quilted_cuffs_of_the_boxer.name: Quilted Cuffs of the Boxer
quilted_cuffs_of_the_boxer.description: Stitched from the wrist wraps of a Legion Stadium middleweight who took up invader work because it paid better than Friday nights and the crowd was friendlier.
quilted_cuffs_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive-drab quilted canvas cuff bound with red-and-white tape wraps, a small red enamel boxing glove pin on the band.

quilted_cuffs_of_the_marksman.name: Quilted Cuffs of the Marksman
quilted_cuffs_of_the_marksman.description: Tight at the wrist so nothing shakes the sights. Found folded beside a Springfield on a Universal water tower, with forty spent casings and not one of them wasted.
quilted_cuffs_of_the_marksman.icon: Snug olive-drab quilted canvas cuff with black piping and a brass snap engraved with a small cross-hair notch.

quilted_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.name: Quilted Cuffs of the Acrobat
quilted_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.description: Survived four falls from the Notre Dame façade on the Universal backlot. The director wanted a fifth, with more feeling.
quilted_cuffs_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light olive quilted canvas cuff edged in red-and-yellow striped circus piping, a small gilt star stitched at the wrist.

quilted_cuffs_of_the_engineer.name: Quilted Cuffs of the Engineer
quilted_cuffs_of_the_engineer.description: Grease-stained along the seams and scorched at one edge where a studio generator argued back. A Stage 28 rigger swore by them, mostly while rewiring.
quilted_cuffs_of_the_engineer.icon: Olive-drab quilted canvas cuff with dark grease stains, one scorched edge, orange piping and a tiny brass wrench charm on the snap.

heavy_quilted_cuffs.name: Heavy Quilted Cuffs
heavy_quilted_cuffs.description: Double-batted for river camp work along the Los Angeles River, where spitter acid finds any thin seam.
heavy_quilted_cuffs.icon: Thick double-layered quilted canvas cuffs in drab khaki, heavy cord stitching, broad leather edging and iron snaps.

reinforced_quilted_cuffs.name: Reinforced Quilted Cuffs
reinforced_quilted_cuffs.description: Steel wire runs through the quilting now. Nobody sews canvas cuffs for comfort anymore.
reinforced_quilted_cuffs.icon: Dark khaki quilted canvas cuffs with grey steel wire visible in the stitching channels and riveted iron edge strips.

superior_quilted_cuffs.name: Superior Quilted Cuffs
superior_quilted_cuffs.description: Burbank piecework from a Lockheed upholsterer, who used aeroplane-seat batting and charged accordingly.
superior_quilted_cuffs.icon: Smooth charcoal quilted canvas cuffs, tight even stitching, polished nickel snaps and fine black leather trim.

chitin_lined_quilted_cuffs.name: Chitin-lined Quilted Cuffs
chitin_lined_quilted_cuffs.description: Under the canvas sits a thin curve of invader shell. It twitches on cold mornings, or so the quartermaster claims.
chitin_lined_quilted_cuffs.icon: Charcoal quilted canvas cuff, opened edge showing an iridescent green-black chitin lining, dark leather trim and iron snaps.

chitin_plated_quilted_cuffs.name: Chitin-plated Quilted Cuffs
chitin_plated_quilted_cuffs.description: Plates cut from a Soldier's foreleg, sewn on with sailmaker's twine. What once guarded a hive now guards a wrist.
chitin_plated_quilted_cuffs.icon: Dark quilted canvas cuff covered in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates lashed with pale twine, iron snaps.

tailored_chitin_bracers.name: Tailored Chitin Bracers
tailored_chitin_bracers.description: The first chitin to pass through a Hollywood tailor's hands. He measured twice, cut once, and sharpened his shears eleven times.
tailored_chitin_bracers.icon: Neatly trimmed curved bracer of polished green-black chitin, clean edges, tan leather straps with small brass buckles.

chitin_bracers_of_strength.name: Chitin Bracers of Strength
chitin_bracers_of_strength.description: Hammered flat on a Universal machine-shop anvil from Hardened Soldier shell. The smith says it fought back until the third blow.
chitin_bracers_of_strength.icon: Curved green-black chitin bracer with hammer-dented surface, a red enamel inset at the centre and dark leather straps.

chitin_bracers_of_stamina.name: Chitin Bracers of Stamina
chitin_bracers_of_stamina.description: Thick enough to stop a mandible and heavy enough to make the walk home a long one.
chitin_bracers_of_stamina.icon: Very thick green-black chitin bracer bound by two broad dark iron bands, green-dyed leather straps and iron buckles.

chitin_bracers_of_the_boxer.name: Chitin Bracers of the Boxer
chitin_bracers_of_the_boxer.description: Taped over at the knuckle end in Legion corner fashion. A former sparring partner wears them on the Pass road, where opponents never wait for the bell.
chitin_bracers_of_the_boxer.icon: Green-black chitin bracer wrapped at one end in white tape, a small red boxing glove pin on the leather strap.

chitin_bracers_of_the_stevedore.name: Chitin Bracers of the Stevedore
chitin_bracers_of_the_stevedore.description: Shipped up from the San Pedro docks inside a crate of bananas, which explains the smell and possibly the tarantula.
chitin_bracers_of_the_stevedore.icon: Green-black chitin bracer lashed with coarse hemp rope, a small iron cargo hook charm hanging from the strap.

heavy_chitin_bracers.name: Heavy Chitin Bracers
heavy_chitin_bracers.description: Two layers of shell riveted back to back. Hard on invaders and harder on shirt cuffs.
heavy_chitin_bracers.icon: Bulky double-layered green-black chitin bracer, two shells riveted together with dark iron rivets, thick leather straps.

reinforced_chitin_bracers.name: Reinforced Chitin Bracers
reinforced_chitin_bracers.description: Banded with gun-rack steel at the edges, since chitin alone tends to split along the grain.
reinforced_chitin_bracers.icon: Green-black chitin bracer with grey steel bands riveted along both edges, heavy black leather straps and iron buckles.

superior_chitin_bracers.name: Superior Chitin Bracers
superior_chitin_bracers.description: Elder shell, cured a month over a river-camp fire. Veterans trade cigarettes for these and do not haggle.
superior_chitin_bracers.icon: Smooth deep green-black chitin bracer with a rich oily sheen, silver rivets and fine black leather straps.

chitin_lined_chitin_bracers.name: Chitin-lined Chitin Bracers
chitin_lined_chitin_bracers.description: Chitin lined with more chitin, on the theory that if one shell is good, two will please the front office. Oddly, the theory holds.
chitin_lined_chitin_bracers.icon: Ridged green-black chitin bracer showing a second iridescent chitin layer inside, layered edges, dark straps with iron buckles.

chitin_plated_chitin_bracers.name: Chitin-plated Chitin Bracers
chitin_plated_chitin_bracers.description: Built at the forward camp below the HOLLYWOODLAND sign from shell nobody wanted to ask about. Resin still seeps from the joints at night, faintly warm.
chitin_plated_chitin_bracers.icon: Overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates forming a heavy bracer, glowing amber hive resin seeping from the joints, black straps.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_strength.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of Strength
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_strength.description: Lifted off a grip from the First National lot who carried two sandbags under each arm and the pass between his teeth. The guards at the Burbank gate never once asked to see it.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_strength.icon: Rectangular brass-framed studio pass with a blank cream celluloid face, hung on a thick steel ball chain; red enamel border and a tiny iron dumbbell charm at the clasp.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_agility.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of Agility
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_agility.description: Rigging men on the Lockheed catwalks tucked these inside their shirts so the chain could not snag a cable. This one still smells faintly of dope varnish and aeroplane fabric.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_agility.icon: Slim brass-framed studio pass with blank cream celluloid face on a fine silver link chain; pale sky-blue enamel edge and a small propeller-shaped charm.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_stamina.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of Stamina
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_stamina.description: Issued for a fourteen-day shoot that ran ninety. The bearer outlasted the director, two writers and the catering contract, and wore it up the ridge to Mount Lee out of sheer habit.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy brass-framed studio pass, celluloid face yellowed and scuffed, on a heavy blackened chain; deep green enamel border and a dented brass tag riveted to one corner.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_intellect.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of Intellect
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a script girl who kept continuity on six pictures at once and never lost a cufflink between takes. Her pencilled notes on hive shift changes now sit in a Legion map case.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_intellect.icon: Neat brass-framed studio pass with blank celluloid face on a delicate gold chain; violet enamel edge and a tiny stub of yellow pencil tied to the clasp with thread.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_spirit.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of Spirit
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_spirit.description: Found hanging on the gatehouse hook at United Airport long after the gateman stopped coming back. Someone tied a sprig of white sage through the clip, and it has kept quietly green ever since.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_spirit.icon: Brass-framed studio pass with blank pale celluloid face on a thin silver chain; soft white enamel border and a small green sprig of sage tied through the clip with string.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_boxer.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Boxer
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_boxer.description: Credited to a Legion Stadium heavyweight who doubled for leading men in fight scenes at union scale. The chain was rejoined with a bent horseshoe nail after a Friday night that went ten rounds outside the ring.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_boxer.icon: Battered brass-framed studio pass, celluloid face cracked, on a heavy steel chain mended with a bent nail; crimson enamel edge and a tiny red boxing glove pin.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_acrobat.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Acrobat
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_acrobat.description: Tumblers on the Mack Sennett lot traded these like pocket money: a pass meant a meal, and a meal meant another fall off a roof. This one has survived several hundred falls and shows no sign of retiring.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_acrobat.icon: Bent brass-framed studio pass with blank celluloid face on a long light chain; bright orange enamel border and a small spinning tin pinwheel charm at the clasp.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_stevedore.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Stevedore
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro around the neck of a longshoreman who unloaded lumber for Paramount set builds. He claimed it was good for any gate in the county, and proved it by carrying the gate.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_stevedore.icon: Square brass-framed studio pass, salt-stained celluloid face, on a rope-twisted iron chain; navy blue enamel edge and a tiny steel cargo hook hanging beside it.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_marksman.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Marksman
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_marksman.description: Stembridge's gun room on Marathon Street checked these before any live round went near a set. The last owner put a bullet through a Spitter's eye at eighty yards and never bothered to mention it.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_marksman.icon: Brass-framed studio pass with blank celluloid face on a gunmetal chain; black enamel border with a filed cross-hair notch and a single brass cartridge case as a charm.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_engineer.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Engineer
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_engineer.description: An electrical foreman wore this through twelve-hour nights on Universal Stage 28, keeping the arc lamps burning while the hive moved in around him. The chain is spliced with copper wire from his own toolbox.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_engineer.icon: Brass-framed studio pass with blank celluloid face on a steel chain spliced with bright copper wire; amber enamel edge and a small wrench charm.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_doctor.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Doctor
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_doctor.description: Studio nurses had the run of every stage, since stars fainted on schedule and extras fainted from hunger. The iodine stain on the clip belonged to a woman who followed the taken into the Hive Tunnels.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_doctor.icon: Clean brass-framed studio pass with blank white celluloid face on a fine silver chain; white enamel border with a small red cross pin and a brown iodine stain on the clip.

studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_deacon.name: Studio Pass on a Chain of the Deacon
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_deacon.description: Carried by a deacon who walked from Angelus Temple to the Burbank lots every Sunday to preach to the night crews. It is creased from long service as a hymnal bookmark, always at the third verse.
studio_pass_on_a_chain_of_the_deacon.icon: Creased brass-framed studio pass with blank celluloid face on a plain dark chain; royal blue enamel edge and a short purple hymnal ribbon tied to the clasp.

fine_brass_knuckles.name: Fine Brass Knuckles
fine_brass_knuckles.description: Polished every Sunday by a bouncer at a Sunset Boulevard speakeasy who liked his tools to catch what little light the place allowed.
fine_brass_knuckles.icon: Four-ring brass knuckleduster in three-quarter view, clean polished yellow brass, smooth rounded finger rings, plain curved palm grip, faint buffing marks.

brass_knuckles_of_agility.name: Brass Knuckles of Agility
brass_knuckles_of_agility.description: Light enough to leave a vest pocket before the other fellow finished his sentence. A Gower Gulch stunt double carried them through eleven pictures and never once got a credit.
brass_knuckles_of_agility.icon: Slim brass knuckleduster with thin delicate finger rings, bright brass, a short green silk cord knotted through the palm grip, tapered spurs.

brass_knuckles_of_stamina.name: Brass Knuckles of Stamina
brass_knuckles_of_stamina.description: The previous owner was a night watchman on the Christie lot who backed three Drones down a stairwell and walked home afterward. He kept his hat on throughout.
brass_knuckles_of_stamina.icon: Thick-barred brass knuckleduster with dark aged patina, heavy rounded rings, palm grip wound in worn red friction tape, a dent in one ring.

brass_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.name: Brass Knuckles of the Acrobat
brass_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.description: Belonged to a stuntwoman who made her living falling off Pacific Electric cars for two-reel comedies. She claimed the trick was landing angry.
brass_knuckles_of_the_acrobat.icon: Brass knuckleduster with grip wrapped in blue and white striped cloth, small brass trapeze-ring charm dangling from the end ring, bright warm brass.

brass_knuckles_of_the_marksman.name: Brass Knuckles of the Marksman
brass_knuckles_of_the_marksman.description: Found in the overcoat of a Red Squad detective who hit what he aimed at, with or without a revolver. The inside of the rings is worn smooth from patient waiting.
brass_knuckles_of_the_marksman.icon: Brass knuckleduster with blued gunmetal edging, a small cross-hair notch filed into the centre ring, compact squared spurs, dark leather palm pad.

brass_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.name: Brass Knuckles of the Stevedore
brass_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.description: Off the San Pedro docks, where longshoremen settled wage disputes before the foreman finished his coffee. Still smells of tarred rope and somebody's spilled cargo.
brass_knuckles_of_the_stevedore.icon: Brass knuckleduster smeared with black tar stains, rough hemp rope wound around the palm grip, tiny iron cargo hook charm hanging from one end.

pressed_brass_knuckles.name: Pressed Brass Knuckles
pressed_brass_knuckles.description: Machined in a studio prop shop for a gangster picture, then quietly pocketed when the Production Code trimmed the scene.
pressed_brass_knuckles.icon: Crisp bright brass knuckleduster with sharp machined edges, flat polished faces, neat squared spurs, precise even finger rings, clean grip bar.

tailored_brass_knuckles.name: Tailored Brass Knuckles
tailored_brass_knuckles.description: Measured to one particular hand at a Hollywood Boulevard jeweller's, each ring sized like a wedding band. The client paid in cash and asked for the receipt in his mother's name.
tailored_brass_knuckles.icon: Gilded brass knuckleduster with ornate scrollwork engraving, slender elegant finger rings, ivory-inlaid palm grip, small pearl stud on the centre spur.

heavy_brass_knuckles.name: Heavy Brass Knuckles
heavy_brass_knuckles.description: Cast thick enough to crack the shell of a Hardened Drone, which is the only review that counts on the street these days.
heavy_brass_knuckles.icon: Massive dark bronze knuckleduster with thick blunt studded spurs, iron-reinforced palm bar, deep scratches and greenish scuffs of insect shell on the striking face.

fine_smith_wesson_38_military_police.name: Fine Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police
fine_smith_wesson_38_military_police.description: Cleaned, oiled and test-fired at Stembridge before it went back on the rack, which is more care than most studio pictures get.
fine_smith_wesson_38_military_police.icon: Blued steel six-shot revolver with slim tapered barrel and rounded butt, smooth walnut grips, cylinder freshly oiled with a clean even sheen, three-quarter view.

smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_agili.name: Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police of Agility
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_agili.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch extra who practised his fast draw between takes for eleven years and never once got a close-up. The speed, at least, was real.
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_agili.icon: Blued steel revolver with slim barrel and walnut grips, a small white silk tassel tied to the lanyard ring, three-quarter view.

smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_stami.name: Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police of Stamina
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_stami.description: A night-shift patrolman carried this through three hive surges on Highland and walked home after each one. The holster wore through twice; he did not.
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_stami.icon: Blued revolver with holster-burnished silver edges on the barrel, dark walnut grips, a faded red cord lanyard looped through the butt ring.

smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_a.name: Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police of the Acrobat
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_a.description: Stuntmen on the Pickford-Fairbanks lot passed it hand to hand across the rigging, so it has fallen from more balconies than any revolver deserves and still shoots straight.
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_a.icon: Scuffed blued revolver with yellow-painted front sight, walnut grips, short leather lanyard carrying a tiny brass trapeze-bar charm.

smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_m.name: Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police of the Marksman
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_m.description: Its last owner filed a notch in the grip for every Spitter he dropped at thirty yards, then stopped when he ran out of grip.
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_m.icon: Blued revolver with walnut grips scored by neat rows of small filed notches, fine gold bead front sight, three-quarter view.

smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_s.name: Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police of the Stevedore
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_s.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks in a longshoreman's coat pocket, alongside a cargo hook and a union card. The grip still smells faintly of tar and hemp.
smith_wesson_38_military_police_of_the_s.icon: Heavy blued revolver with grips wrapped in dark tarred hemp twine, a small iron cargo-hook charm hanging from the lanyard ring.

pressed_smith_wesson_38_military_police.name: Pressed Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police
pressed_smith_wesson_38_military_police.description: Somebody in the wardrobe department buffed the frame and boiled the grips, on the theory that a gun should look its best in a fight.
pressed_smith_wesson_38_military_police.icon: Bright polished blued revolver with crisp gleaming edges, pale buffed ivory-toned grips, spotless cylinder, three-quarter view.

tailored_smith_wesson_38_military_police.name: Tailored Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police
tailored_smith_wesson_38_military_police.description: Fitted with custom grips for a director who never fired it, only pointed it at writers. Under the Dome it finally earns its keep.
tailored_smith_wesson_38_military_police.icon: Deep blue-black revolver with hand-checkered rosewood grips set with a round mother-of-pearl medallion, slender polished barrel.

heavy_smith_wesson_38_military_police.name: Heavy Smith & Wesson .38 Military & Police
heavy_smith_wesson_38_military_police.description: Rebuilt on a Universal City machine-shop bench with a thicker barrel and a frame stout enough to turn aside a Drone's mandible.
heavy_smith_wesson_38_military_police.icon: Thick heavy-barrelled revolver in dull gunmetal grey, frame reinforced with riveted steel side plates, black hard-rubber grips.

fine_remington_model_8.name: Fine Remington Model 8
fine_remington_model_8.description: Hangs in the Stembridge gun room with a clean tag on its trigger guard and a waiting list three names long.
fine_remington_model_8.icon: Slim self-loading rifle with a long tubular steel jacket over the barrel, clean blued finish, smooth oiled walnut stock and forend, blank paper tag on the trigger guard.

remington_model_8_of_agility.name: Remington Model 8 of Agility
remington_model_8_of_agility.description: Texas Rangers swore by the type for brush-country gunfights. This one was bought for a Poverty Row Western and has seen more real brush since the Dome came down than the picture ever did.
remington_model_8_of_agility.icon: Self-loading rifle with long tubular barrel jacket, blued steel, walnut stock, a bright green ribbon tied around the forend.

remington_model_8_of_stamina.name: Remington Model 8 of Stamina
remington_model_8_of_stamina.description: Carried up and down Beachwood Canyon by the dam keeper's nephew, who never sat down on watch. It shows the miles in its sling and nowhere else.
remington_model_8_of_stamina.icon: Self-loading rifle with long barrel jacket and walnut stock, thick padded olive-drab canvas sling worn pale at the shoulder.

remington_model_8_of_the_acrobat.name: Remington Model 8 of the Acrobat
remington_model_8_of_the_acrobat.description: Went over the side of a Hollywoodland switchback with its owner. Both landed upright in the sage, and only one of them needed a new sight.
remington_model_8_of_the_acrobat.icon: Self-loading rifle with scuffed walnut stock, long blued barrel jacket, bright red-painted front sight blade, short brown leather sling.

remington_model_8_of_the_marksman.name: Remington Model 8 of the Marksman
remington_model_8_of_the_marksman.description: Five rounds, five Fliers, one morning on the Pass summit. The man who did it was a county surveyor before the war and still measures distance in chains.
remington_model_8_of_the_marksman.icon: Self-loading rifle with long blued barrel jacket, walnut stock, small brass peep sight on the tang with a fine cross-hair notch.

remington_model_8_of_the_stevedore.name: Remington Model 8 of the Stevedore
remington_model_8_of_the_stevedore.description: Loaded onto a Cornero rum boat in a crate marked as machine parts, then unloaded at night by a deckhand who kept it as his fee.
remington_model_8_of_the_stevedore.icon: Self-loading rifle with long barrel jacket, walnut stock with tarred rope wrapped around the wrist and a coil of hemp lashing on the forend.

pressed_remington_model_8.name: Pressed Remington Model 8
pressed_remington_model_8.description: Freshly reblued by a studio armourer who insists the forend had warped. Nobody argued with a man holding a self-loading rifle.
pressed_remington_model_8.icon: Self-loading rifle with deep glossy blue barrel jacket, crisp clean edges, freshly varnished bright walnut stock and forend.

tailored_remington_model_8.name: Tailored Remington Model 8
tailored_remington_model_8.description: Commissioned by a cowboy star for his publicity stills, with an engraved receiver and a stock cut to his exact reach. His stand-in did all the shooting, then and now.
tailored_remington_model_8.icon: Self-loading rifle with silver scrollwork engraving on the receiver, figured burl walnut stock, polished blued barrel jacket.

heavy_remington_model_8.name: Heavy Remington Model 8
heavy_remington_model_8.description: Reinforced at the Universal backlot armoury with a steel buttplate meant for clubbing as much as recoil. Hardened Soldiers have a habit of closing the distance.
heavy_remington_model_8.icon: Self-loading rifle with dark gunmetal barrel jacket, thick steel buttplate, riveted reinforcing bands around a dark-stained stock.

brass_locket_of_strength.name: Brass Locket of Strength
brass_locket_of_strength.description: Inside is a tintype of a Bakersfield blacksmith who could lift a buggy by the axle. His granddaughter swore the picture made her arms stronger. Nobody in the family argued with her.
brass_locket_of_strength.icon: Oval brass locket on a heavy curb chain, lid embossed with a small anvil, a red enamel dot at the clasp, warm polished brass.

brass_locket_of_agility.name: Brass Locket of Agility
brass_locket_of_agility.description: Found in the gutter outside the Pantages after a pickpocket was chased the length of the Boulevard. He was never caught, and left the locket behind as a sort of receipt.
brass_locket_of_agility.icon: Slim teardrop brass locket on a thin snake chain, green enamel swallow inlaid on the lid, bright clean brass.

brass_locket_of_stamina.name: Brass Locket of Stamina
brass_locket_of_stamina.description: A cannery girl wore it through fourteen-hour shifts and a long red-car ride home, every day for six years. The hinge gave out before she did.
brass_locket_of_stamina.icon: Round, thick-walled brass locket with a dented lid, heavy chain, dull brass, a brown leather cord wrapped around the bail.

brass_locket_of_intellect.name: Brass Locket of Intellect
brass_locket_of_intellect.description: The photograph has been swapped for a folded slip carrying a column of figures in very small handwriting. A studio bookkeeper's, by the look of it, and the figures do not add up in the studio's favour.
brass_locket_of_intellect.icon: Rectangular brass locket opened a crack to show a folded white paper slip, blue enamel edging, fine link chain.

brass_locket_of_spirit.name: Brass Locket of Spirit
brass_locket_of_spirit.description: Pressed violets from Hollywood Cemetery, still faintly sweet. The widow who kept it sat by the lake there every Sunday and claimed she always came home lighter than she went.
brass_locket_of_spirit.icon: Heart-shaped brass locket slightly open showing pressed purple violets, soft aged patina, delicate thin chain.

brass_locket_of_the_boxer.name: Brass Locket of the Boxer
brass_locket_of_the_boxer.description: Engraved on the back: a date, and the round a welterweight went down at the Legion Stadium on a Friday night in 1928. His girl kept the locket. He kept the cauliflower ear.
brass_locket_of_the_boxer.icon: Scratched oval brass locket on a sturdy chain, a tiny red boxing-glove charm hanging beside it, worn bright at the edges.

brass_locket_of_the_acrobat.name: Brass Locket of the Acrobat
brass_locket_of_the_acrobat.description: Belonged to a wire-walker from a circus that went broke in Los Angeles in '29. She worked street corners for nickels afterward, and never once looked down at the hat.
brass_locket_of_the_acrobat.icon: Small round brass locket with a gold star charm, lid engraved with big-top stripes, light chain through a tiny brass hoop.

brass_locket_of_the_stevedore.name: Brass Locket of the Stevedore
brass_locket_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks in a longshoreman's pocket, smelling of hemp and bunker oil. The photograph inside is of a ship, which says something about the man.
brass_locket_of_the_stevedore.icon: Square brass locket on a rough hemp cord, small iron cargo-hook charm, tarnished green at the edges with salt stains.

brass_locket_of_the_marksman.name: Brass Locket of the Marksman
brass_locket_of_the_marksman.description: Every notch along the rim marks a jackrabbit a Gower Gulch extra shot from the saddle at full gallop. There are a great many notches and, according to the other extras, very few rabbits.
brass_locket_of_the_marksman.icon: Oval brass locket with a ring of small filed notches around the rim, a tiny crosshair engraved on the lid, black cord.

brass_locket_of_the_engineer.name: Brass Locket of the Engineer
brass_locket_of_the_engineer.description: Built by a grip on the Christie lot from a lamp fitting and a hinge pin, then soldered shut so nobody could see whose picture was inside. Union rules are silent on lockets.
brass_locket_of_the_engineer.icon: Hexagonal brass locket with a visible silver solder seam, a tiny steel wrench charm, copper wire wrapped around the bail.

brass_locket_of_the_doctor.name: Brass Locket of the Doctor
brass_locket_of_the_doctor.description: Smells faintly of iodine. A nurse at a Highland Avenue aid station kept her patients' names folded inside, small enough to leave room for a photograph of her mother.
brass_locket_of_the_doctor.icon: Round brass locket with a small white enamel cross on the lid, rubbed edges, a faint orange iodine stain, fine chain.

brass_locket_of_the_deacon.name: Brass Locket of the Deacon
brass_locket_of_the_deacon.description: Carried on foot to Angelus Temple every Sunday, four miles out from Hollywood and four miles back. The hymnal page folded inside has gone soft as cloth at the creases.
brass_locket_of_the_deacon.icon: Oval brass locket with a short purple hymnal ribbon tied at the bail, small engraved cross on the lid, softly worn brass.

fine_pleated_flannel_trousers.name: Fine Pleated Flannel Trousers
fine_pleated_flannel_trousers.description: Grey flannel with two pleats and cuffs deep enough to hide a streetcar token. Bought for a premiere that got cancelled when the sky did.
fine_pleated_flannel_trousers.icon: Pair of mid-grey pleated flannel trousers, neat front crease, deep turned-up cuffs, plain brown belt loops, clean soft wool texture.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_intellect.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of Intellect
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_intellect.description: Scenario writers at Warner Bros. wore the knees out of pairs like these, kneeling to retrieve rejected pages from under the desk. The pocket still holds a pencil stub and three unfinished endings.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_intellect.icon: Charcoal pleated flannel trousers, a yellow pencil clipped into the front pocket, small blue ink stain near the hip, sharp crease.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_spirit.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of Spirit
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_spirit.description: Kept for Sundays and pressed every Saturday night by an Edendale widow who held that a clean crease was a modest form of prayer.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_spirit.icon: Soft dove-grey pleated flannel trousers, gentle crease, a small sprig of pale green white sage tucked into the waistband pocket.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_stamina.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of Stamina
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched through the seat by a Melrose tailor who had seen what a long night on a barricade does to flannel. He charged extra, and nobody argued.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_stamina.icon: Heavy brown-grey pleated flannel trousers, darker reinforced patches on both knees, thick visible red stitching along the seams.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_engineer.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of the Engineer
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_engineer.description: An RKO sound man wore these up and down the catwalks, which explains the scorch on one cuff and the fuse wire threaded through the belt loops.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_engineer.icon: Slate-grey pleated flannel trousers, black scorch mark on one cuff, coil of copper wire looped through a belt loop, tiny brass wrench charm.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_doctor.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of the Doctor
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_doctor.description: Midnight calls at the Hollywood Hotel were made in these, by a house physician famous for discretion. The iodine on the left knee has never told a soul.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_doctor.icon: Navy-grey pleated flannel trousers, faint orange iodine stain on one knee, slim silver thermometer case peeking from the pocket, small white cross pin.

pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_deacon.name: Pleated Flannel Trousers of the Deacon
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_deacon.description: Walked to Angelus Temple and back every Sunday for years. The hems are pale with Glendale Boulevard dust, and the back pocket still smells faintly of hymnals.
pleated_flannel_trousers_of_the_deacon.icon: Brown pleated flannel trousers with dusty faded hems, a purple hymnal ribbon tied to one belt loop, gentle worn crease.

pressed_pleated_flannel_trousers.name: Pressed Pleated Flannel Trousers
pressed_pleated_flannel_trousers.description: Creased sharp enough to slice a lobby card. A Roosevelt Hotel valet did this pair the week before the hotel started taking in refugees instead of guests.
pressed_pleated_flannel_trousers.icon: Pale grey pleated flannel trousers with a knife-edge crease and crisp cuffs, folded neatly over a polished wooden hanger.

tailored_pleated_flannel_trousers.name: Tailored Pleated Flannel Trousers
tailored_pleated_flannel_trousers.description: Fitted three times for a supporting player who wanted his legs to look longer in a medium shot. The hive took him for its next picture and left the trousers behind.
tailored_pleated_flannel_trousers.icon: Charcoal chalk-stripe pleated flannel trousers, burgundy silk-lined waistband, horn buttons, crisp tailored pleats and a flawless crease.

heavy_pleated_flannel_trousers.name: Heavy Pleated Flannel Trousers
heavy_pleated_flannel_trousers.description: Winter-weight flannel is absurd in an autumn under glass, but it turns a spitter's acid long enough to step out of the way.
heavy_pleated_flannel_trousers.icon: Thick dark charcoal flannel trousers, dense nubby wool, leather-reinforced cuffs, brass suspender buttons along the waistband.

fine_riding_breeches.name: Fine Riding Breeches
fine_riding_breeches.description: Tan whipcord flared at the thigh, the uniform of directors who have never sat a horse but like carrying the crop.
fine_riding_breeches.icon: Tan whipcord riding breeches flared wide at the thigh, buckskin knee patches, laced lower legs, clean and well kept.

riding_breeches_of_agility.name: Riding Breeches of Agility
riding_breeches_of_agility.description: Cowboy extras on Gower vaulted corral rails in these for a dollar a day and a box lunch. The good ones cleared the rail without spilling the lunch.
riding_breeches_of_agility.icon: Dusty fawn riding breeches with suede knee patches, laced calves, a small silver spur-rowel charm hanging from a belt loop.

riding_breeches_of_stamina.name: Riding Breeches of Stamina
riding_breeches_of_stamina.description: Stable hands at the Gower Gulch barns ride twelve hours in breeches like these, then walk the last mile when the horse gives out. The seat is triple-lined for a reason.
riding_breeches_of_stamina.icon: Dark brown riding breeches with a heavy triple-stitched seat, thick green stitching, broad leather knee patches.

riding_breeches_of_spirit.name: Riding Breeches of Spirit
riding_breeches_of_spirit.description: Quiet miles on the Griffith Park bridle trails, back when the worst thing in the brush was a rattler. Some of that calm stayed in the cloth.
riding_breeches_of_spirit.icon: Soft olive riding breeches with faded knees, gentle flare, a pale blue ribbon tied at the calf lacing.

riding_breeches_of_the_acrobat.name: Riding Breeches of the Acrobat
riding_breeches_of_the_acrobat.description: Hung upside down from a galloping horse for a Universal serial. The stitching held, and the stuntman got a screen credit nobody stayed in their seat to read.
riding_breeches_of_the_acrobat.icon: Cream riding breeches with reinforced suede inner legs, a thin red stripe down the side seam, small star-shaped tumbler patch at the hip.

riding_breeches_of_the_stevedore.name: Riding Breeches of the Stevedore
riding_breeches_of_the_stevedore.description: Somebody's cousin brought these up from San Pedro after the dock work dried up. Whipcord takes a cargo hook better than a horse takes a stranger.
riding_breeches_of_the_stevedore.icon: Grey-green whipcord riding breeches with a rope-burn scuff on one thigh, a coil of hemp cord at the belt, anchor-shaped brass button.

riding_breeches_of_the_deacon.name: Riding Breeches of the Deacon
riding_breeches_of_the_deacon.description: Circuit preachers rode the Valley in these before the red cars came. This pair arrived at Angelus Temple in a donation barrel with a gospel tract still folded in the pocket.
riding_breeches_of_the_deacon.icon: Black riding breeches with a worn saddle shine, folded paper tract tucked in the pocket, purple hymnal ribbon at the waist.

pressed_riding_breeches.name: Pressed Riding Breeches
pressed_riding_breeches.description: Starched for the polo crowd, then abandoned at a Sunset Boulevard laundry once the Dome made polo a poor use of horses.
pressed_riding_breeches.icon: Crisp cream riding breeches with a sharp pressed crease, polished brown leather knee patches, neat laced calves.

tailored_riding_breeches.name: Tailored Riding Breeches
tailored_riding_breeches.description: Cut to a director's own pattern, flared at the thigh for authority and tapered at the calf for the photographers. He never rode in them. The horse was billed below him anyway.
tailored_riding_breeches.icon: Rich chestnut riding breeches with a dramatic thigh flare, burgundy piping, row of small gilt buttons up each calf.

heavy_riding_breeches.name: Heavy Riding Breeches
heavy_riding_breeches.description: Mounted patrol issue, thickened with an extra layer of hide after the fliers started diving at police horses on the Boulevard.
heavy_riding_breeches.icon: Thick dark brown leather riding breeches, heavily reinforced thighs, riveted knee plates, brass buckles at the calves.

worn_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.name: Worn Levi Strauss Waist Overalls
worn_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.description: Somebody wore the knees through digging a trench on Selma Avenue and never came back for them. The rivets still hold.
worn_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.icon: Faded pale-blue denim waist overalls, knees worn white and frayed open, dull tarnished copper rivets, a sagging cinch-back buckle and a blank, cracked leather waist patch.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_agility.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of Agility
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_agility.description: Cut loose in the seat by a Gower Gulch extra who climbed into the saddle forty times a day for three dollars and a box lunch. Still smells faintly of horse.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_agility.icon: Deep indigo denim waist overalls with orange stitching, bright copper rivets, and a small silver spur charm sewn beside the watch pocket.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_strength.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of Strength
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_strength.description: Bought new on Western Avenue by a grip who carried arc lamps up ladders two at a time. The back pocket has taken the shape of a pipe wrench.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_strength.icon: Indigo denim waist overalls with thick red bar-tack stitching at the pockets, copper rivets, and a small iron anvil pin on one belt loop.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_stamina.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of Stamina
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched by a wardrobe seamstress who had seen three productions run past midnight and expected a fourth. The denim tends to give out long after its owner does.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_stamina.icon: Dark indigo denim waist overalls with heavy doubled seams in mustard thread, copper rivets, and a green canvas reinforcing patch on one knee.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_boxer.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of the Boxer
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_boxer.description: Worn ringside at the Legion Stadium on Friday nights, where the owner sold peanuts between bouts and settled arguments after them. There is resin dust in the cuffs.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_boxer.icon: Indigo denim waist overalls with rolled cuffs, copper rivets, and a tiny red boxing-glove pin fixed to the watch pocket.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_marks.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of the Marksman
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_marks.description: The owner shot rabbits off the Cahuenga Pass road for the pot and never needed a second cartridge. One brass casing still rattles in the watch pocket like a lucky coin.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_marks.icon: Indigo denim waist overalls with brass rivets, a small cross-hair notch scratched into the blank leather patch, and one brass casing peeking from the watch pocket.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_acrob.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of the Acrobat
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_acrob.description: Property of a stuntman who fell off the Christie lot's rooftops for a living and swore he had never once missed the mattress. The scuffs on the denim tell it differently.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_acrob.icon: Indigo denim waist overalls with scuffed knees, copper rivets, a mustard-yellow patch at the hip and a small stitched tumbling-star emblem.

levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_engin.name: Levi Strauss Waist Overalls of the Engineer
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_engin.description: A studio electrician kept tie-wire, a test lamp and his union card in these. The singe along the hip is from the one live cable he forgot about.
levi_strauss_waist_overalls_of_the_engin.icon: Indigo denim waist overalls with a brown scorch mark along one hip, copper rivets, and a small brass wrench charm hanging from a belt loop.

patched_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.name: Patched Levi Strauss Waist Overalls
patched_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.description: Mended at the knee with a flour sack, and the flour sack mended with a feed sack. Nobody under the Dome throws anything away.
patched_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.icon: Faded blue denim waist overalls with a mismatched cream flour-sack patch on one knee, a brown burlap patch over it, and dull copper rivets.

plain_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.name: Plain Levi Strauss Waist Overalls
plain_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.description: Fresh off the shelf of a Boulevard dry-goods store whose clerk left in a hurry when the Dome came down. The price tag is still pinned on, unpaid.
plain_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.icon: Crisp mid-blue denim waist overalls with stiff fold creases, shiny copper rivets, and a small blank paper tag tied to a belt loop with string.

sturdy_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.name: Sturdy Levi Strauss Waist Overalls
sturdy_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.description: Broken in properly by a season of hauling scenery flats around Poverty Row. Every rivet has earned its keep.
sturdy_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.icon: Deep indigo denim waist overalls softened into worn folds, bright copper rivets, a brown leather waist patch and a heavy iron cinch buckle.

good_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.name: Good Levi Strauss Waist Overalls
good_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.description: Lined at the knees with duck canvas by a Gower saddlery that does not believe in doing anything halfway, or quickly.
good_levi_strauss_waist_overalls.icon: Rich dark indigo denim waist overalls with tan duck-canvas knee panels, polished copper rivets and an oiled blank leather waist patch.

worn_steel_kneed_breeches.name: Worn Steel-kneed Breeches
worn_steel_kneed_breeches.description: Army surplus from the Great War, the steel knee cups dented from crawling. The wool has outlasted two owners and a sergeant's patience.
worn_steel_kneed_breeches.icon: Faded olive-drab wool riding breeches with flared thighs, dull dented grey steel knee cups, and frayed laces at the calves.

steel_kneed_breeches_of_strength.name: Steel-kneed Breeches of Strength
steel_kneed_breeches_of_strength.description: Kept in a footlocker at Post 43 against the day they might be needed again. The man who wore them out could shift the captured German field gun's trail by himself.
steel_kneed_breeches_of_strength.icon: Olive wool riding breeches with flared thighs, polished steel knee cups riveted on, and a small brass kettlebell charm at the waistband.

steel_kneed_breeches_of_stamina.name: Steel-kneed Breeches of Stamina
steel_kneed_breeches_of_stamina.description: Their first owner marched from the Argonne to the Rhine, then from Highland Avenue to the Dome wall, and complained about neither walk.
steel_kneed_breeches_of_stamina.icon: Olive wool riding breeches with steel knee cups, thick grey felt padding showing under the knee straps, and green canvas reinforcement at the seat.

steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_boxer.name: Steel-kneed Breeches of the Boxer
steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_boxer.description: Sparring partners at the Legion Stadium learned not to clinch with the man who wore these. Tape and liniment are still crusted around the straps.
steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_boxer.icon: Olive wool riding breeches with steel knee cups wrapped in white boxing tape and a small red boxing-glove pin at the waistband.

steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_stevedore.name: Steel-kneed Breeches of the Stevedore
steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who caught the wrong red car home. The steel has knelt on more cargo hatches than church pews.
steel_kneed_breeches_of_the_stevedore.icon: Navy-blue wool breeches with salt-stained cuffs, steel knee cups, and a short coil of hemp rope tied to one belt loop.

patched_steel_kneed_breeches.name: Patched Steel-kneed Breeches
patched_steel_kneed_breeches.description: Darned at the seat in three colours of wool, with one knee plate held on by baling wire. Fashion left the building some time ago.
patched_steel_kneed_breeches.icon: Faded olive breeches with brown and grey darned patches, one rusty steel knee cup wired on crookedly with baling wire.

plain_steel_kneed_breeches.name: Plain Steel-kneed Breeches
plain_steel_kneed_breeches.description: Issued without ceremony from a Legion supply closet, the steel freshly painted to hide whatever it went through last time.
plain_steel_kneed_breeches.icon: Clean olive-drab riding breeches with knee cups painted matte grey and a row of plain brass buttons at each calf.

sturdy_steel_kneed_breeches.name: Sturdy Steel-kneed Breeches
sturdy_steel_kneed_breeches.description: Machine-shop steel bolted onto cavalry twill by a Warner Bros. carpenter who reckoned that if it could hold up a set, it could hold up a knee.
sturdy_steel_kneed_breeches.icon: Khaki twill riding breeches with thick steel knee plates showing heavy bolt heads, and brown leather laces at the calves.

good_steel_kneed_breeches.name: Good Steel-kneed Breeches
good_steel_kneed_breeches.description: Studio armourers fitted these for a war picture that never finished shooting. The knee plates are real; the regimental piping was the director's idea.
good_steel_kneed_breeches.icon: Crisp khaki riding breeches with red piping down each leg, bright polished steel knee plates, and brass buckles at the calves.

fine_kid_gloves.name: Fine Kid Gloves
fine_kid_gloves.description: Goatskin thin enough to read a contract through, sold on the Boulevard to men who wanted to look as if they owned the studio.
fine_kid_gloves.icon: A pair of slim wrist-length dress gloves laid one over the other, dove-grey kidskin with three fine stitched points on the back and a single small pearl button.

kid_gloves_of_intellect.name: Kid Gloves of Intellect
kid_gloves_of_intellect.description: Script girls at Paramount wore pairs like these to turn pages without smudging the continuity notes. This one could recite every scene of the picture the hive has been reshooting since summer.
kid_gloves_of_intellect.icon: A pair of slim cream kidskin dress gloves, three stitched points on the back, a navy enamel button at each wrist and a stub of blue pencil tucked in one cuff.

kid_gloves_of_spirit.name: Kid Gloves of Spirit
kid_gloves_of_spirit.description: Folded on a pew at Blessed Sacrament the morning the Dome came down. Nobody has claimed them, and the sexton swears whoever wears them sleeps the night through.
kid_gloves_of_spirit.icon: A pair of soft ivory kidskin dress gloves folded neatly together, pale gold stitched points on the back, a small white dove-shaped button at the wrist.

kid_gloves_of_stamina.name: Kid Gloves of Stamina
kid_gloves_of_stamina.description: Double-stitched at every seam by a wardrobe mistress who had watched too many leading men split a pair in one take. They have outlasted three leading men since.
kid_gloves_of_stamina.icon: A pair of slim fawn kidskin dress gloves with heavy doubled dark brown stitching along every seam and thick reinforced cuffs.

kid_gloves_of_the_engineer.name: Kid Gloves of the Engineer
kid_gloves_of_the_engineer.description: Sound men at Warner's wore these while splicing cable through sixteen-hour days. The fingertips are scorched, the cuffs are spotless, and the last owner kept all ten fingers.
kid_gloves_of_the_engineer.icon: A pair of grey kidskin dress gloves with blackened scorched fingertips, copper wire wound once around one cuff, a tiny brass wrench charm on the wrist button.

kid_gloves_of_the_doctor.name: Kid Gloves of the Doctor
kid_gloves_of_the_doctor.description: Carried in the coat pocket of a surgeon at Hollywood Receiving Hospital who liked to take a pulse in gloves. A faint smell of iodine has never washed out.
kid_gloves_of_the_doctor.icon: A pair of white kidskin dress gloves with a small amber iodine stain on one fingertip and a red enamel cross button at each wrist.

kid_gloves_of_the_deacon.name: Kid Gloves of the Deacon
kid_gloves_of_the_deacon.description: Ushers at Angelus Temple wore pairs like these for the Sunday crowds, five thousand hands to shake before the sermon. They still smell of hymnals and floor wax.
kid_gloves_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of black kidskin dress gloves with white stitched points, a narrow purple hymnal ribbon tied around one cuff in a small bow.

pressed_kid_gloves.name: Pressed Kid Gloves
pressed_kid_gloves.description: Steamed flat by a valet at the Roosevelt, who charged a dime and politely declined to ask about the stains.
pressed_kid_gloves.icon: A pair of crisp cream kidskin dress gloves pressed perfectly flat with sharp creases, bright pearl buttons and clean white stitched points.

tailored_kid_gloves.name: Tailored Kid Gloves
tailored_kid_gloves.description: Cut to the measure of a director's hands, so he could point at things with real authority.
tailored_kid_gloves.icon: A pair of glossy black kidskin dress gloves, close-fitting fingers, silver-grey stitched points and a polished mother-of-pearl button at each wrist.

heavy_kid_gloves.name: Heavy Kid Gloves
heavy_kid_gloves.description: Lined twice over with flannel since the hive started spitting. Elegance has had to make room.
heavy_kid_gloves.icon: A pair of thick chocolate-brown kidskin gloves, cuffs turned back to show a red plaid flannel lining, heavier stitching and dark horn buttons.

fine_riding_gauntlets.name: Fine Riding Gauntlets
fine_riding_gauntlets.description: Gower Gulch extras paid two days' wages for a pair, then wore them past the Columbia gate every morning hoping to be mistaken for somebody.
fine_riding_gauntlets.icon: A pair of tan leather riding gauntlets with wide flared cuffs, neat brown stitching and a short row of fringe along each cuff edge.

riding_gauntlets_of_agility.name: Riding Gauntlets of Agility
riding_gauntlets_of_agility.description: A trick rider swung under a galloping horse in these for a Tom Mix picture and came up with his hat still on. The palms are worn to a shine.
riding_gauntlets_of_agility.icon: A pair of light honey leather riding gauntlets with flared cuffs, green stitching, glossy worn palms and a small brass horseshoe charm on one cuff.

riding_gauntlets_of_stamina.name: Riding Gauntlets of Stamina
riding_gauntlets_of_stamina.description: Saddle-sore and stubborn, like the wrangler who wore them through a nine-day location shoot in the Mojave. The leather has long since stopped complaining.
riding_gauntlets_of_stamina.icon: A pair of thick oxblood leather riding gauntlets with broad flared cuffs, heavy doubled cream stitching and sun-faded patches across the knuckles.

riding_gauntlets_of_spirit.name: Riding Gauntlets of Spirit
riding_gauntlets_of_spirit.description: Someone stitched a tiny cross inside the left cuff. The wrangler who owned them said a prayer over every horse before a fall and never lost one.
riding_gauntlets_of_spirit.icon: A pair of soft fawn leather riding gauntlets with flared cuffs, one cuff turned out to show a small white stitched cross on its lining.

riding_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.name: Riding Gauntlets of the Acrobat
riding_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.description: Stuntmen call these lucky. Their owner jumped from a Poverty Row rooftop onto a moving horse forty times for one shot, and the director used the first take.
riding_gauntlets_of_the_acrobat.icon: A pair of tan leather riding gauntlets with flared cuffs scuffed pale at the edges, a small red felt star patch sewn on the back of each.

riding_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.name: Riding Gauntlets of the Stevedore
riding_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks on a longshoreman who traded hay hooks for horses when the picture work paid better. Still smells of tar and hemp.
riding_gauntlets_of_the_stevedore.icon: A pair of dark brown leather riding gauntlets with flared cuffs, black tar smudges across the palms and a coil of hemp twine knotted around one wrist.

riding_gauntlets_of_the_deacon.name: Riding Gauntlets of the Deacon
riding_gauntlets_of_the_deacon.description: Rode to Echo Park every Sunday on a deacon's hands, reins in one and a hymnal in the other. The horse knew the way to the Temple better than he did.
riding_gauntlets_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of black leather riding gauntlets with flared cuffs, plain grey stitching and a purple hymnal ribbon threaded through a cuff buckle.

pressed_riding_gauntlets.name: Pressed Riding Gauntlets
pressed_riding_gauntlets.description: Oiled and pressed at a Gower saddlery, which seems a great deal of fuss for something meant to hold reins.
pressed_riding_gauntlets.icon: A pair of polished chestnut leather riding gauntlets with crisp flared cuffs, bright even stitching and a small gleaming brass buckle at each wrist.

tailored_riding_gauntlets.name: Tailored Riding Gauntlets
tailored_riding_gauntlets.description: Measured for a cowboy star who never touched a horse off camera. His stunt double wore them instead, and got no credit for that either.
tailored_riding_gauntlets.icon: A pair of glossy black leather riding gauntlets with tall flared cuffs, white piped edges and a row of small silver conchos along each cuff.

heavy_riding_gauntlets.name: Heavy Riding Gauntlets
heavy_riding_gauntlets.description: Riveted at the knuckles after the wranglers learned that a Drone bites harder than any horse.
heavy_riding_gauntlets.icon: A pair of thick dark brown leather riding gauntlets with wide flared cuffs and dull steel rivets and stitched leather plates across the knuckles.

chitin_lined_trench_knife.name: Chitin-lined Trench Knife
chitin_lined_trench_knife.description: The knuckle guard has been lined inside with a strip of invader shell. It grips a sweating hand better than leather ever did and never quite stops smelling of the hive.
chitin_lined_trench_knife.icon: Mark I trench knife, straight double-edged steel blade, cast bronze knuckle-bow grip lined with dull green-black iridescent chitin, small spiked pommel nut, blade slightly worn

trench_knife_of_agility.name: Trench Knife of Agility
trench_knife_of_agility.description: Carried over the top at Saint-Mihiel by a lance corporal who later worked falls for Fox. He said the trick was the same in both trades: be somewhere else when it lands.
trench_knife_of_agility.icon: Mark I trench knife, polished double-edged steel blade, bright bronze knuckle-bow grip, spiked pommel, thin sky-blue cord wrapped around the guard as an accent

trench_knife_of_stamina.name: Trench Knife of Stamina
trench_knife_of_stamina.description: Its owner held a doorway at the Lockheed plant for most of one night with this and a bad leg. The Legion kept the knife. The doorway is still disputed.
trench_knife_of_stamina.icon: Mark I trench knife, broad double-edged steel blade, dark bronze knuckle-bow grip wrapped in heavy olive-drab canvas tape, spiked pommel, red ribbon tied at the guard

trench_knife_of_the_acrobat.name: Trench Knife of the Acrobat
trench_knife_of_the_acrobat.description: A Universal stunt rider kept it in his boot through forty-one falls off the backlot church tower and one off a real roof. The insurance men never did hear about the knife.
trench_knife_of_the_acrobat.icon: Mark I trench knife, slim double-edged steel blade, bronze knuckle-bow grip, spiked pommel, small brass trapeze-ring charm hanging from the guard on yellow cord

trench_knife_of_the_marksman.name: Trench Knife of the Marksman
trench_knife_of_the_marksman.description: Notches on the knuckle bow count shots, not stabs. The previous owner preferred a rifle and kept this for when the rifle ran dry above Burbank. Twelve notches, room for more.
trench_knife_of_the_marksman.icon: Mark I trench knife, straight double-edged steel blade, bronze knuckle-bow grip with a row of small filed notches, spiked pommel, tiny cross-hair ring etched near the hilt

trench_knife_of_the_stevedore.name: Trench Knife of the Stevedore
trench_knife_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a San Pedro lighter wrapped in oilcloth, alongside a crate of Cornero's Scotch that never reached Hollywood. Dock men used it to open crates, then to settle arguments about them.
trench_knife_of_the_stevedore.icon: Mark I trench knife, heavy double-edged steel blade, scuffed bronze knuckle-bow grip, spiked pommel, length of tarred hemp rope and small cargo hook tied to the guard

chitin_plated_trench_knife.name: Chitin-plated Trench Knife
chitin_plated_trench_knife.description: Plated along the spine with shell cut on the ridge below the sign. The men at the Mount Lee forward camp call it the souvenir that bites back.
chitin_plated_trench_knife.icon: Mark I trench knife, double-edged steel blade with thick iridescent green-black chitin plating along the spine, bronze knuckle-bow grip capped in chitin, heavy spiked pommel

worn_shirt_cuffs.name: Worn Shirt Cuffs
worn_shirt_cuffs.description: Detachable cuffs, frayed at the edge and grey where a bookkeeper rested them on his ledger for eleven years.
worn_shirt_cuffs.icon: A pair of detachable white shirt cuffs, frayed and yellowed at the edges, a dull grey smudge along one rim, tarnished plain brass cufflinks.

shirt_cuffs_of_intellect.name: Shirt Cuffs of Intellect
shirt_cuffs_of_intellect.description: Starched linen with a column of pencilled figures on the left cuff, the habit of a studio accountant who did his sums where the producer could not borrow the paper.
shirt_cuffs_of_intellect.icon: A pair of crisp starched white cuffs, faint grey pencil lines across one, small blue enamel cufflinks shaped like open books.

shirt_cuffs_of_spirit.name: Shirt Cuffs of Spirit
shirt_cuffs_of_spirit.description: Their owner wore them to the Easter sunrise service at the Hollywood Bowl every year and swore they never wrinkled before noon. The pastor called it grace; the laundry called it starch.
shirt_cuffs_of_spirit.icon: A pair of soft white cuffs with pale gold stitching, small pearl cufflinks, a thin lavender ribbon tied around one cuff.

shirt_cuffs_of_stamina.name: Shirt Cuffs of Stamina
shirt_cuffs_of_stamina.description: Double-thick cotton, stitched for a court stenographer who sat through the longest trials of 1929 and outlasted two judges.
shirt_cuffs_of_stamina.icon: A pair of thick heavy cotton cuffs with a double row of navy stitching and squared plain steel cufflinks.

shirt_cuffs_of_the_engineer.name: Shirt Cuffs of the Engineer
shirt_cuffs_of_the_engineer.description: Spare fuses rode tucked into these on a Warner's sound man, which saved a picture once and his thumb twice.
shirt_cuffs_of_the_engineer.icon: A pair of grey-white cuffs with a slight scorch mark, copper cufflinks shaped like tiny wrench heads, a small glass fuse tucked under one band.

shirt_cuffs_of_the_doctor.name: Shirt Cuffs of the Doctor
shirt_cuffs_of_the_doctor.description: Iodine never quite washed out of these. Their last owner, a studio doctor, rolled them back for stitches and forward again for the bill.
shirt_cuffs_of_the_doctor.icon: A pair of clean white cuffs with a faint orange iodine stain, silver cufflinks bearing tiny red cross enamel.

shirt_cuffs_of_the_deacon.name: Shirt Cuffs of the Deacon
shirt_cuffs_of_the_deacon.description: Thinned on the underside from resting on pew-backs at Angelus Temple. They still smell faintly of hymnals and the long walk up Glendale Boulevard.
shirt_cuffs_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of slightly shiny worn-thin white cuffs, black cufflinks with tiny gold crosses, a faded purple hymnal ribbon looped through one.

patched_shirt_cuffs.name: Patched Shirt Cuffs
patched_shirt_cuffs.description: Mended with a square of flour-sack cotton by someone who could not afford new ones and could not bear to go without.
patched_shirt_cuffs.icon: A pair of off-white cuffs with a visible square patch of printed flour-sack cotton, uneven black thread stitches, mismatched buttons.

plain_shirt_cuffs.name: Plain Shirt Cuffs
plain_shirt_cuffs.description: Nothing to recommend them and nothing to apologise for. Central Casting likes that in an extra too.
plain_shirt_cuffs.icon: A pair of plain clean white cotton cuffs fastened with simple white shell buttons, no ornament.

sturdy_shirt_cuffs.name: Sturdy Shirt Cuffs
sturdy_shirt_cuffs.description: Heavy-weave cuffs from a downtown department store, cut for clerks who leaned on counters all day and wanted nothing to show for it.
sturdy_shirt_cuffs.icon: A pair of thick heavy-weave white cuffs with firm square corners and polished nickel cufflinks.

good_shirt_cuffs.name: Good Shirt Cuffs
good_shirt_cuffs.description: Crisp enough to pass inspection at the Roosevelt's front desk, which these days is a sandbagged barricade.
good_shirt_cuffs.icon: A pair of crisp bright white starched cuffs with sharp folded edges and gleaming gold-tone oval cufflinks.

worn_leather_wrist_straps.name: Worn Leather Wrist Straps
worn_leather_wrist_straps.description: Cracked leather bands once buckled on by a stable hand in Gower Gulch. The horse is gone; the straps are what is left.
worn_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of cracked dark brown leather wrist straps with scuffed edges and small dull iron buckles.

leather_wrist_straps_of_agility.name: Leather Wrist Straps of Agility
leather_wrist_straps_of_agility.description: A Sennett stuntman buckled these on for the roof falls nobody else would take. He took a great many, and billed for every one.
leather_wrist_straps_of_agility.icon: A pair of supple narrow tan leather wrist straps, bright brass buckles, a small red pennant tag hanging from one.

leather_wrist_straps_of_stamina.name: Leather Wrist Straps of Stamina
leather_wrist_straps_of_stamina.description: Thick as a saddle girth and nearly as stiff. A teamster on the Lankershim road swore by them for twelve-hour days.
leather_wrist_straps_of_stamina.icon: A pair of wide thick dark brown leather straps with double-stitched edges and heavy square steel buckles.

leather_wrist_straps_of_spirit.name: Leather Wrist Straps of Spirit
leather_wrist_straps_of_spirit.description: Hand-tooled with a sprig of white sage by a Temple volunteer who said the work kept her calm. Nobody argued with her.
leather_wrist_straps_of_spirit.icon: A pair of honey-brown leather wrist straps tooled with a small sage-leaf pattern, pale green stitching, silver buckles.

leather_wrist_straps_of_the_acrobat.name: Leather Wrist Straps of the Acrobat
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_acrobat.description: Taped at the seams by a trapeze man who came west with a circus and stayed for picture money. He maintained that falling was the easy part.
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_acrobat.icon: A pair of light tan leather wrist straps wrapped with strips of white cloth tape, small brass buckles, blue-striped trim.

leather_wrist_straps_of_the_stevedore.name: Leather Wrist Straps of the Stevedore
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_stevedore.description: Salt-stained from the San Pedro docks, where they held a longshoreman's wrists together through ten years of cargo hooks and crates of tinned peaches.
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_stevedore.icon: A pair of broad dark leather wrist straps with white salt-stain tide lines, iron buckles, a small brass cargo-hook charm.

leather_wrist_straps_of_the_deacon.name: Leather Wrist Straps of the Deacon
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_deacon.description: Buckled on every Sunday for the walk to service and the long afternoon of stacking chairs afterward. Faith, the deacon maintained, was mostly furniture.
leather_wrist_straps_of_the_deacon.icon: A pair of black leather wrist straps with plain stitching, a small gold cross stamped near each buckle, a purple ribbon tab.

patched_leather_wrist_straps.name: Patched Leather Wrist Straps
patched_leather_wrist_straps.description: Somebody sewed a strip of boot tongue over the split. It holds, which is more than the boot did.
patched_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of brown leather straps with a mismatched darker leather strip sewn over a split, coarse waxed thread, dull buckles.

plain_leather_wrist_straps.name: Plain Leather Wrist Straps
plain_leather_wrist_straps.description: Saddlery stock from Gower Gulch, sold by the dozen to cowboy extras between pictures.
plain_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of simple medium-brown leather wrist straps with even stitching and plain steel buckles.

sturdy_leather_wrist_straps.name: Sturdy Leather Wrist Straps
sturdy_leather_wrist_straps.description: Oil-dressed cowhide, the kind telephone linemen wore before the Dome made climbing poles a dangerous habit.
sturdy_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of oiled chestnut leather straps, thick and glossy, reinforced stitching, solid steel buckles.

good_leather_wrist_straps.name: Good Leather Wrist Straps
good_leather_wrist_straps.description: Cut from one hide and matched by a saddler who would not sell an uneven pair, even to a director in a hurry.
good_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of matched rich brown leather wrist straps with neat cream stitching and polished brass buckles.

fine_leather_wrist_straps.name: Fine Leather Wrist Straps
fine_leather_wrist_straps.description: Polo-grade leather from a Pickford-Fairbanks riding party, lost somewhere on a bridle trail and never sent for.
fine_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of slim glossy oxblood leather wrist straps with gilt buckles and a tiny stamped crest near one edge.

pressed_leather_wrist_straps.name: Pressed Leather Wrist Straps
pressed_leather_wrist_straps.description: Pressed flat in a Burbank harness shop, then lacquered against the Valley dust. They creak like new shoes for a week.
pressed_leather_wrist_straps.icon: A pair of smooth flat-pressed dark tan leather straps with a lacquered sheen, an embossed border line, bright nickel buckles.

good_blackjack.name: Good Blackjack
good_blackjack.description: Leather over a lead slug, stitched tight by a Gower Street saddler who asked no questions. Short, quiet and easy to lose in an overcoat pocket.
good_blackjack.icon: Short teardrop-shaped blackjack, swollen weighted head, dark brown stitched leather, plain tan stitching, braided leather wrist loop, honest everyday wear.

blackjack_of_strength.name: Blackjack of Strength
blackjack_of_strength.description: Taken off a Crawford collector who settled accounts on the Strip with it. The lead inside has been topped up twice, and the leather has long since stopped complaining.
blackjack_of_strength.icon: Teardrop blackjack with an unusually bulging head, black oiled leather, bold red thread stitching along the seam, iron-grey leather wrist strap.

blackjack_of_stamina.name: Blackjack of Stamina
blackjack_of_stamina.description: A night watchman's sap from the Christie lot, worn smooth by thirty years of rounds. Its owner outlasted two studio heads and a fire, and meant to outlast the bugs as well.
blackjack_of_stamina.icon: Well-worn teardrop blackjack, faded brown leather rubbed smooth, grip wrapped in dull green tape, small brass ring at the wrist loop.

blackjack_of_the_boxer.name: Blackjack of the Boxer
blackjack_of_the_boxer.description: Some fights at the Legion Stadium carried on in the alley afterward. The trainer who owned this swore it had a better left hook than his heavyweight, and cheaper upkeep.
blackjack_of_the_boxer.icon: Tan leather blackjack laced at the grip like a boxing glove cuff, rounded heavy head, small red boxing-glove charm hanging from the wrist loop.

blackjack_of_the_stevedore.name: Blackjack of the Stevedore
blackjack_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro in a longshoreman's hip pocket after the strike of '23, when the docks settled arguments with something heavier than words.
blackjack_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered salt-stained grey-brown leather blackjack, tarred rope wrist loop, small iron cargo hook charm tied at the end.

fine_blackjack.name: Fine Blackjack
fine_blackjack.description: Kid leather and French seams, balanced by a cane-maker who once did work for John Barrymore. Persuasion for a better class of alley.
fine_blackjack.icon: Slim glossy black kid-leather blackjack, fine white stitching, polished nickel cap on the grip end, neat narrow wrist strap.

pressed_blackjack.name: Pressed Blackjack
pressed_blackjack.description: The wardrobe department pressed the leather flat and shiny and billed the picture for it. Nobody has explained what a creased blackjack is for, but it photographs well.
pressed_blackjack.icon: Flattened paddle-shaped sap, glossy oxblood leather with a crisp creased edge, bright nickel rivets, tidy matching wrist strap.

good_crowbar.name: Good Crowbar
good_crowbar.description: Standard issue in every studio carpentry shop, where sets come down faster than they go up. Pries open crates, doors and the occasional hive wall.
good_crowbar.icon: Straight forged crowbar with curved gooseneck claw at one end and flat chisel tip at the other, dark grey steel, light rust spots.

crowbar_of_intellect.name: Crowbar of Intellect
crowbar_of_intellect.description: Kept beside a Warner Bros. drafting table to correct carpenters who misread the blueprints. Mostly the designer only had to glance at it.
crowbar_of_intellect.icon: Gooseneck crowbar in blued steel, faint white chalk tick marks along the shaft, scrap of blueprint-blue cloth tied near the claw.

crowbar_of_spirit.name: Crowbar of Spirit
crowbar_of_spirit.description: Pulled from a fallen Melrose bungalow by a man who said a prayer each time he lifted a beam. He found eleven people alive and kept the bar afterward.
crowbar_of_spirit.icon: Dark steel gooseneck crowbar with pale worn grip, strip of white cloth wound round the middle, small brass medal hanging from it.

crowbar_of_the_engineer.name: Crowbar of the Engineer
crowbar_of_the_engineer.description: Friction tape on the handle, a gaffer's initials scratched under it. He pried open junction boxes with it and carried a slide rule in the other pocket for balance.
crowbar_of_the_engineer.icon: Steel gooseneck crowbar with black friction-tape grip, faint scratched marks on the shaft, small brass wrench charm tied at the claw.

crowbar_of_the_doctor.name: Crowbar of the Doctor
crowbar_of_the_doctor.description: An ambulance driver from the Hollywood receiving hospital carried it for jammed doors and pinned legs. The armband knotted round it has never once been washed.
crowbar_of_the_doctor.icon: Grey steel gooseneck crowbar with a white cloth armband bearing a red cross emblem knotted mid-shaft, clean ground claw.

crowbar_of_the_deacon.name: Crowbar of the Deacon
crowbar_of_the_deacon.description: Every Easter an Edendale church caretaker opened the hymnal crates with it, then walked it down to Angelus Temple when the Dome came. It still smells of pine shelving and old hymnals.
crowbar_of_the_deacon.icon: Dark steel gooseneck crowbar, grip stained with wood varnish, purple hymnal ribbon tied in a bow near the claw.

fine_crowbar.name: Fine Crowbar
