fine_crowbar.description: Drop-forged and ground true, with a claw that pulls a nail without marking the wood. The prop department lists it as decorative to keep it off the insurance.
fine_crowbar.icon: Polished bright steel gooseneck crowbar, crisply ground claw and chisel tip, red-lacquered handle end, spotless finish.

pressed_crowbar.name: Pressed Crowbar
pressed_crowbar.description: Somebody at Paramount had it flattened and plated for a picture about a gentleman burglar. The production folded; the crowbar kept its creases and its billing.
pressed_crowbar.icon: Flattened elegant crowbar, nickel-plated with a sharp crease along its length, black enamel grip, gleaming curved claw.

good_pickaxe.name: Good Pickaxe
good_pickaxe.description: Bought for the Hollywoodland road crews in '23 and never returned. The developers still want it back, and the deposit.
good_pickaxe.icon: Double-ended pickaxe, curved steel head with pointed end and chisel end, long ash-wood handle, honest scuffs and dirt on the head.

pickaxe_of_strength.name: Pickaxe of Strength
pickaxe_of_strength.description: Six years on the Owens Valley aqueduct went into this handle, and the man who swung it came home with shoulders like a piano mover. Granite gave way to it. Chitin, it turns out, is softer.
pickaxe_of_strength.icon: Heavy pickaxe with an oversized thick steel head, dark weathered hickory handle, iron collar band, chipped granite dust on the point.

pickaxe_of_stamina.name: Pickaxe of Stamina
pickaxe_of_stamina.description: Dug three miles of trench at United Airport before opening day, and was back on the job the next morning without so much as a loose wedge.
pickaxe_of_stamina.icon: Sturdy pickaxe with dull grey steel head, handle wrapped in grey canvas at the grip, painted blue band below the head.

pickaxe_of_the_boxer.name: Pickaxe of the Boxer
pickaxe_of_the_boxer.description: Legion regulars knew the groundsman who swung it between bouts to keep his arms loose. He claimed it gave him a better clinch than anyone on the card.
pickaxe_of_the_boxer.icon: Steel pickaxe, handle bound with red lacing at the grip, small red boxing-glove charm hanging below the head.

pickaxe_of_the_stevedore.name: Pickaxe of the Stevedore
pickaxe_of_the_stevedore.description: Wilmington wharf men used the point to drag hogsheads off the lighters and the flat end to argue with the dock boss. Both ends show the wear.
pickaxe_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pickaxe with salt-dulled steel head, handle wrapped in tarred rope, small brass anchor charm tied beneath the head.

fine_pickaxe.name: Fine Pickaxe
fine_pickaxe.description: Oil-tempered head, straight-grained hickory and a balance a Caltech geologist might admire. Mostly it digs Hollywood clay, but it does so with manners.
fine_pickaxe.icon: Clean pickaxe with bright polished steel head and keen points, honey-coloured hickory handle, brass ferrule at the joint.

pressed_pickaxe.name: Pressed Pickaxe
pressed_pickaxe.description: Lacquered and buffed to a mirror for a Western in which the miner never digs anything. The studio kept the pick and cut the miner.
pressed_pickaxe.icon: Pickaxe with glossy black lacquered head trimmed in bright nickel edges, polished dark walnut handle, crisp showroom finish.

signet_ring_of_strength.name: Signet Ring of Strength
signet_ring_of_strength.description: Pressed into warm sealing wax, the face leaves a clean crest; pressed into a looter's jaw, much the same. A Melrose prop man swears it belonged to a wrestler who signed his contracts with a fist.
signet_ring_of_strength.icon: Heavy gold signet ring seen straight on, thick squared shank, flat oval face stamped with a clenched-fist crest, deep red enamel rim around the face.

signet_ring_of_agility.name: Signet Ring of Agility
signet_ring_of_agility.description: Lifted off a cardsharp at the Christie lot who could palm an ace, a wristwatch and a payroll envelope in one pass. The band is worn thin inside where his thumb kept turning it.
signet_ring_of_agility.icon: Slim silver signet ring seen straight on, narrow tapered shank, small square face stamped with a swallow-in-flight crest, bright green enamel inlay around the bird.

signet_ring_of_stamina.name: Signet Ring of Stamina
signet_ring_of_stamina.description: Its owner worked double shifts at the Warner Bros. gate through the first month of the Dome and never once sat down. The gold has rubbed bright on the knuckle side, like an old work glove.
signet_ring_of_stamina.icon: Broad brass signet ring seen straight on, wide rounded shank, oval face stamped with an oak-tree crest, dark navy enamel band circling the face.

signet_ring_of_intellect.name: Signet Ring of Intellect
signet_ring_of_intellect.description: Lawyers on Sunset seal their letters with rings like this and their clients' fates with the fine print beneath. The crest is an owl; the attorney who wore it saw the invasion coming and billed for the consultation.
signet_ring_of_intellect.icon: Polished gold signet ring seen straight on, slender shank, rectangular face stamped with an owl crest, rich purple enamel border framing the face.

signet_ring_of_spirit.name: Signet Ring of Spirit
signet_ring_of_spirit.description: Fished out of the reeds at Echo Park Lake by a boathouse attendant who kept it a week, slept better than he had in years, then gave it away on principle.
signet_ring_of_spirit.icon: Rose-gold signet ring seen straight on, smooth thin shank, round face stamped with a dove crest, pale sky-blue enamel ring around the edge.

signet_ring_of_the_boxer.name: Signet Ring of the Boxer
signet_ring_of_the_boxer.description: A middleweight wore it into the Legion Stadium every Friday night, taped under his wraps against the rules. Nobody caught on, though three opponents carried the crest on their cheekbones into Saturday.
signet_ring_of_the_boxer.icon: Chunky gold signet ring seen straight on, square face with a stamped laurel crest, tiny red boxing-glove charm dangling from the thick shank.

signet_ring_of_the_acrobat.name: Signet Ring of the Acrobat
signet_ring_of_the_acrobat.description: Belonged to a Gower Gulch stunt rider who claimed he had fallen off every horse in the Valley at least twice, always on cue. The ring came through all of it; his collarbones did not.
signet_ring_of_the_acrobat.icon: Slim silver signet ring seen straight on, oval face stamped with a small trapeze-bar emblem, a thin mustard-yellow enamel stripe running around the shank.

signet_ring_of_the_stevedore.name: Signet Ring of the Stevedore
signet_ring_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks on a longshoreman's hand, which was how most of the cargo moved too. Salt air has eaten into the crest, and nobody has bothered to polish it out.
signet_ring_of_the_stevedore.icon: Weathered bronze signet ring seen straight on, salt-pitted square face stamped with an anchor crest, a few turns of dark tarred rope wrapped around the shank.

signet_ring_of_the_marksman.name: Signet Ring of the Marksman
signet_ring_of_the_marksman.description: The Legion range officer who owned it fired with the face turned inward so the sun would not glint off it. He hit what he aimed at, and insisted he only aimed at things that deserved it.
signet_ring_of_the_marksman.icon: Steel-grey signet ring seen straight on, round face stamped with a crosshair notch crest, a small brass bead set at the centre of the cross.

signet_ring_of_the_engineer.name: Signet Ring of the Engineer
signet_ring_of_the_engineer.description: A Fox lot sound man scratched wiring diagrams inside the band with a jeweller's needle so he could check them in the dark. The diagrams still work, which is more than can be said for the sound stages.
signet_ring_of_the_engineer.icon: Copper signet ring seen straight on, octagonal face stamped with a gear crest, burnt-orange enamel band on the shank, tiny steel wrench charm hanging below.

signet_ring_of_the_doctor.name: Signet Ring of the Doctor
signet_ring_of_the_doctor.description: Stamped on more prescriptions for medicinal whiskey than any physician on Vine would care to count. The doctor scrubbed it nightly with carbolic soap, so it still smells faintly of the ward.
signet_ring_of_the_doctor.icon: White-gold signet ring seen straight on, oval face stamped with a serpent-and-staff crest, small white enamel cross inset beside the crest, clean polished shank.

signet_ring_of_the_deacon.name: Signet Ring of the Deacon
signet_ring_of_the_deacon.description: Every Sunday a deacon wore it on the long walk from Edendale to Angelus Temple, leaving a faint polish on each hymnal he handed out. It smells of paper, candle wax and patience.
signet_ring_of_the_deacon.icon: Plain yellow-gold signet ring seen straight on, round face stamped with a cross-and-flame crest, a thin violet hymnal ribbon tied through the shank.

tailored_remington_model_11.name: Tailored Remington Model 11
tailored_remington_model_11.description: Somebody paid a Paramount prop man to refinish the walnut and polish the hump, as though the gun might be asked to a premiere. It still kicks like the plain ones.
tailored_remington_model_11.icon: Semi-automatic shotgun with a square humpbacked receiver, freshly polished blued steel, glossy oiled walnut stock with fine checkering, slim fore-end, crisp and clean finish.

remington_model_11_of_agility.name: Remington Model 11 of Agility
remington_model_11_of_agility.description: Lighter in the hands than it looks. Its last owner, a Gower Gulch rider, could swing it off a saddle horn and fire before the horse had noticed.
remington_model_11_of_agility.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued steel barrel, honey walnut stock, a strip of bright yellow tape wound neatly around the fore-end.

remington_model_11_of_stamina.name: Remington Model 11 of Stamina
remington_model_11_of_stamina.description: Carried through three hive surges at the Universal front gate by a night watchman who refused to go home. The gate held. The watchman, eventually, went home.
remington_model_11_of_stamina.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued steel barrel, scuffed walnut stock with a faded red wool scarf knotted around the wrist of the stock.

remington_model_11_of_the_acrobat.name: Remington Model 11 of the Acrobat
remington_model_11_of_the_acrobat.description: A Universal stuntman borrowed it from a western set and never returned it, on the grounds that it had done most of its rehearsing upside down.
remington_model_11_of_the_acrobat.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued steel, light walnut stock, sling of red-and-white striped canvas, tiny brass tumbler charm hanging from the trigger guard.

remington_model_11_of_the_marksman.name: Remington Model 11 of the Marksman
remington_model_11_of_the_marksman.description: Shotguns are not meant for picking a single Flier out of the sky at forty yards. Nobody told the Lake Hollywood duck hunter who filed this front bead by hand.
remington_model_11_of_the_marksman.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, long blued barrel with a raised ivory front bead and a small crosshair notch filed into the rib, dark walnut stock.

remington_model_11_of_the_stevedore.name: Remington Model 11 of the Stevedore
remington_model_11_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a lumber schooner at San Pedro wrapped in oilcloth, listed on the manifest as fence posts. The receiver still smells faintly of tar and harbour water.
remington_model_11_of_the_stevedore.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued steel with a tar-black smudge on the receiver, walnut stock bound with a coil of rough tan hemp rope.

heavy_remington_model_11.name: Heavy Remington Model 11
heavy_remington_model_11.description: Built with a thicker barrel and a weighted butt, so the recoil arrives as a shove rather than a punch. River camp men favour it for Burrowers, which rarely allow a second shot.
heavy_remington_model_11.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun with a thick heavy barrel, dark iron-grey steel, chunky walnut stock ending in a wide black rubber recoil pad.

reinforced_remington_model_11.name: Reinforced Remington Model 11
reinforced_remington_model_11.description: Steel bands at the wrist of the stock were riveted on by a Burbank machinist after an Invader Brute snapped the first one over its knee.
reinforced_remington_model_11.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued barrel, walnut stock clamped with two riveted steel bands at the wrist, steel-capped butt plate, sturdy and heavy.

superior_remington_model_11.name: Superior Remington Model 11
superior_remington_model_11.description: The best the Valley gun rooms could turn out before factory stock ran dry. Stembridge would have rented it at double rates and called it a favour.
superior_remington_model_11.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, deep bright blued steel with fine gold-line inlay on the receiver, richly figured walnut stock, polished brass front bead.

chitin_lined_remington_model_11.name: Chitin-lined Remington Model 11
chitin_lined_remington_model_11.description: Thin Invader shell lines the fore-end and grip, keeping the hands cool through long volleys. Nobody asks where the sheet came from, and the gunsmith does not say.
chitin_lined_remington_model_11.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun, blued barrel, fore-end and grip lined with thin iridescent green-black insect shell, worn walnut showing at the edges.

chitin_plated_remington_model_11.name: Chitin-plated Remington Model 11
chitin_plated_remington_model_11.description: Plated in Elder Soldier shell from receiver to butt, it looks less like a Remington every week. Men at the forward camp beneath the sign swear it hums when the hive is close.
chitin_plated_remington_model_11.icon: Humpbacked semi-automatic shotgun with receiver and stock fully plated in overlapping iridescent green-black chitin segments, dark blued barrel, faint glowing amber resin seams.

cracked_mandible.name: Cracked Mandible
cracked_mandible.description: Half a jaw that once worked through plaster, lath and a studio carpenter's lunch pail. The junkman on Cahuenga pays by the pound and asks no questions.
cracked_mandible.icon: A single curved insect mandible, dull brown-black chitin with a jagged crack running down its serrated inner edge, tip chipped off.

bent_antenna.name: Bent Antenna
bent_antenna.description: Kinked at the middle like a rabbit-ear aerial after a bad night. Radio men swear these things hum on the KFSG frequency.
bent_antenna.icon: One long segmented insect antenna, glossy black, bent sharply at a right angle midway, fine bristles along its length, frayed at the snapped base.

dull_chitin_flake.name: Dull Chitin Flake
dull_chitin_flake.description: Too thin for armour, too ugly for jewellery. Somebody on the Boulevard is surely selling them as lucky charms.
dull_chitin_flake.icon: A small flat shard of insect shell, matte greenish-grey with a faint oily sheen at one edge, irregular broken outline.

matted_fur.name: Matted Fur
matted_fur.description: A clump of coyote coat, burrs included at no extra charge. The Gower Gulch saddlery won't touch it.
matted_fur.icon: A tangled clump of tawny grey fur knotted around a couple of brown burrs and dried twigs, ragged at the edges.

chewed_bone.name: Chewed Bone
chewed_bone.description: Something gnawed it clean and then lost interest. Best not to wonder what it came from.
chewed_bone.icon: A short pale bone with knobbed ends, its shaft scored with tooth marks and one end splintered, yellowed and dusty.

empty_hip_flask.name: Empty Hip Flask
empty_hip_flask.description: Dry as the Volstead Act intended. It still smells of rye and poor decisions.
empty_hip_flask.icon: A curved pewter hip flask with a dented side and a screw cap hanging loose on its tiny chain, tarnished grey with scratches.

pawn_ticket.name: Pawn Ticket
pawn_ticket.description: Redeemable for one gold watch at a shop on Cahuenga that the hive took in its first week. The interest keeps accruing regardless.
pawn_ticket.icon: A small buff card stub with a punched hole and a torn perforated edge, blank lines faded, a smudged purple stamp mark in one corner.

broodling_husk.name: Broodling Husk
broodling_husk.description: The shed skin of a young one, light as tissue paper and still faintly warm. It crackles when picked up, which nobody enjoys.
broodling_husk.icon: A hollow translucent insect moult the size of a cat, amber-brown and papery, split open along its back, curled legs still attached.

acid_pitted_scale.name: Acid-pitted Scale
acid_pitted_scale.description: Spitter acid ate a constellation of holes clean through it. Worth nothing, though it does make a fine cheese grater for the desperate.
acid_pitted_scale.icon: A palm-sized oval scale of dark green-black chitin, riddled with small round corroded pits ringed in sickly yellow-green stains.

torn_movie_ticket.name: Torn Movie Ticket
torn_movie_ticket.description: Half an admission to Grauman's Chinese, from the night before the Dome came down. Hell's Angels is still playing, which hardly seems fair.
torn_movie_ticket.icon: Half of a small red paper admission ticket torn across the middle, ornate gold border, blank faded centre, creased and slightly curled.

worn_winchester_model_1894.name: Worn Winchester Model 1894
worn_winchester_model_1894.description: Rented to so many cowboy pictures that the lever has worn a groove the shape of somebody else's palm.
worn_winchester_model_1894.icon: Lever-action rifle with a faded, scuffed walnut stock gone pale at the grip, rust-speckled dull blued barrel, loose saddle ring hanging from the receiver.

winchester_model_1894_of_agility.name: Winchester Model 1894 of Agility
winchester_model_1894_of_agility.description: Light enough to swing from the hip off a running board, which is exactly how its last owner left Gower Street in a hurry.
winchester_model_1894_of_agility.icon: Lever-action rifle with a glossy walnut stock, blued octagonal barrel, and a narrow strip of green ribbon tied around the forestock.

winchester_model_1894_of_stamina.name: Winchester Model 1894 of Stamina
winchester_model_1894_of_stamina.description: Carried the length of Hollywood Boulevard and back every night for a month by a night watchman who never once sat down. His feet gave out before the rifle did.
winchester_model_1894_of_stamina.icon: Lever-action rifle wrapped in a thick brown leather sling with red stitching, brass buttplate, worn but solid walnut stock, dark blued barrel.

winchester_model_1894_of_the_acrobat.name: Winchester Model 1894 of the Acrobat
winchester_model_1894_of_the_acrobat.description: A stunt rider at the Christie lot fired it upside down from under a galloping horse, for two dollars a take and a bandage.
winchester_model_1894_of_the_acrobat.icon: Lever-action rifle with white tape wrapped around the wrist of the stock, blued barrel, a small silver spur charm dangling from the saddle ring.

winchester_model_1894_of_the_marksman.name: Winchester Model 1894 of the Marksman
winchester_model_1894_of_the_marksman.description: Its rear sight has seven small scratches filed beside it. The owner said they were for jackrabbits, and nobody pressed him on the matter.
winchester_model_1894_of_the_marksman.icon: Lever-action rifle with a raised tang peep sight, brass bead front sight, deep blued barrel, a row of tiny file notches cut into the walnut stock.

winchester_model_1894_of_the_stevedore.name: Winchester Model 1894 of the Stevedore
winchester_model_1894_of_the_stevedore.description: Came off a San Pedro lumber schooner wrapped in oilcloth, traded for a case of something the manifest described as canned peaches.
winchester_model_1894_of_the_stevedore.icon: Lever-action rifle with an oil-darkened stock, dark blued steel, a coil of tarred rope knotted around the sling swivel.

patched_winchester_model_1894.name: Patched Winchester Model 1894
patched_winchester_model_1894.description: Somebody mended the cracked forestock with baling wire and faith. Both are holding, for now.
patched_winchester_model_1894.icon: Lever-action rifle with a split forestock bound in twisted grey wire, mismatched lighter-wood buttstock, dull greyish barrel.

plain_winchester_model_1894.name: Plain Winchester Model 1894
plain_winchester_model_1894.description: Exactly what Winchester sold to ranchers for thirty years, minus the ranch. An honest gun in a town running short of honesty.
plain_winchester_model_1894.icon: Clean, unadorned lever-action rifle with medium-brown walnut stock, even blued steel barrel and receiver, simple loop lever.

sturdy_winchester_model_1894.name: Sturdy Winchester Model 1894
sturdy_winchester_model_1894.description: Pulled from the Stembridge rental racks after the Dome went up. The tag tied to the trigger guard says it is due back Tuesday, and Stembridge is still waiting.
sturdy_winchester_model_1894.icon: Sturdy lever-action rifle with a thick walnut stock, fresh blued finish, and a blank manila rental tag tied by string to the lever.

good_winchester_model_1894.name: Good Winchester Model 1894
good_winchester_model_1894.description: Oiled, sighted and kept in a felt-lined case by a Legion man who regards the invaders chiefly as an insult to his cleaning routine.
good_winchester_model_1894.icon: Polished lever-action rifle with rich dark checkered walnut, deep blue barrel, and a gleaming brass saddle ring on the receiver.

worn_winchester_model_1897.name: Worn Winchester Model 1897
worn_winchester_model_1897.description: Sat in a Boulevard pawnshop window with its hammer down and its pump stiff, priced to move. It never did, until now.
worn_winchester_model_1897.icon: Pump-action shotgun with exposed hammer, faded scratched stock, rust-blotched barrel and a cracked wooden slide handle.

winchester_model_1897_of_agility.name: Winchester Model 1897 of Agility
winchester_model_1897_of_agility.description: Quick on the pump and quicker out of a doorway. Its owner kept the slide slick with cold cream lifted from a Max Factor counter.
winchester_model_1897_of_agility.icon: Pump-action shotgun with a slim slide handle wrapped in a green rubber band, polished blued receiver, exposed hammer, light walnut stock.

winchester_model_1897_of_stamina.name: Winchester Model 1897 of Stamina
winchester_model_1897_of_stamina.description: This one stood guard outside the Hollywood police station for nine straight nights. The patrolman holding it managed eight.
winchester_model_1897_of_stamina.icon: Short-barrelled riot shotgun with a heavy dark wooden stock, wide brown leather sling, and dark blued steel receiver with exposed hammer.

winchester_model_1897_of_the_acrobat.name: Winchester Model 1897 of the Acrobat
winchester_model_1897_of_the_acrobat.description: Taken off a stuntman who did his own falls at Columbia and his own shooting everywhere else. The buttplate is dented from landings.
winchester_model_1897_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pump-action shotgun with a dented brass buttplate, scuffed stock wrapped in tan tape, and a tiny horseshoe charm on the sling swivel.

winchester_model_1897_of_the_marksman.name: Winchester Model 1897 of the Marksman
winchester_model_1897_of_the_marksman.description: Most men buy a shotgun so they need not aim. The fellow who owned this one aimed anyway, and the Gower Gulch extras still talk about it.
winchester_model_1897_of_the_marksman.icon: Pump-action shotgun with a raised ventilated rib along the barrel, bright brass bead front sight, polished walnut stock, a single notch on the rib.

winchester_model_1897_of_the_stevedore.name: Winchester Model 1897 of the Stevedore
winchester_model_1897_of_the_stevedore.description: Rode shotgun on Tony Cornero's liquor trucks up from the San Pedro waterfront, which is a job description as well as a figure of speech.
winchester_model_1897_of_the_stevedore.icon: Pump-action shotgun with a salt-stained stock, tarnished steel, and a twist of hemp cargo cord knotted around the grip.

patched_winchester_model_1897.name: Patched Winchester Model 1897
patched_winchester_model_1897.description: Sawn short by one owner and splinted back by the next. Nobody agrees on what either of them was thinking.
patched_winchester_model_1897.icon: Pump shotgun with a crude steel sleeve clamped over a joined barrel, stock repaired with visible screws, dull mismatched grey metal.

plain_winchester_model_1897.name: Plain Winchester Model 1897
plain_winchester_model_1897.description: The standard pump gun of every hardware store from Bakersfield to the border, and of a good many Los Angeles policemen besides.
plain_winchester_model_1897.icon: Plain pump-action shotgun with exposed hammer, smooth brown walnut stock, long clean blued barrel, ridged wooden slide.

sturdy_winchester_model_1897.name: Sturdy Winchester Model 1897
sturdy_winchester_model_1897.description: Built heavy enough to stop a coyote or a door. Post 43 men trust it the way they trust a good sergeant: grudgingly and completely.
sturdy_winchester_model_1897.icon: Heavy pump-action shotgun with a thick walnut stock and steel buttplate, dark blued receiver, sturdy brown leather sling.

good_winchester_model_1897.name: Good Winchester Model 1897
good_winchester_model_1897.description: Twelve years ago the Army called this pattern a trench gun and the Kaiser's men called it something unprintable. An invader drone takes the same view.
good_winchester_model_1897.icon: Trench shotgun with a perforated steel heat shield over the barrel, bayonet lug at the muzzle, olive drab canvas sling, walnut stock.

fine_winchester_model_1897.name: Fine Winchester Model 1897
fine_winchester_model_1897.description: Cleaned to a mirror by a Warner Bros. property master who swears it was only ever loaded with blanks. The scorched chitin flakes in its action suggest otherwise.
fine_winchester_model_1897.icon: Glossy pump-action shotgun with bright blued steel, finely checkered figured walnut, polished nickel trigger guard and hammer.

pressed_winchester_model_1897.name: Pressed Winchester Model 1897
pressed_winchester_model_1897.description: Fox's wardrobe department would not let a gun go before the camera looking slept in, so somebody ironed the sling. The hive soldiers remain unimpressed.
pressed_winchester_model_1897.icon: Immaculate pump-action shotgun with a crisply creased cream canvas sling, polished deep-blue steel, gleaming walnut stock, brass bead sight.

reinforced_cummerbund.name: Reinforced Cummerbund
reinforced_cummerbund.description: Stitched over a strip of canvas webbing so it keeps its pleats when the wearer is thrown across a soundstage. The tailor charged extra and still called it formalwear.
reinforced_cummerbund.icon: A black satin pleated cummerbund laid flat, its back reinforced with visible tan canvas webbing and heavy steel hook-and-eye clasps, doubled stitching along both edges.

cummerbund_of_intellect.name: Cummerbund of Intellect
cummerbund_of_intellect.description: Belonged to a Universal story editor who read four hundred scripts a year and bought six. He kept notes in the pleats; a pencil stub still rides in the top fold.
cummerbund_of_intellect.icon: Pleated midnight-blue silk cummerbund with a small silver pen clip fixed at one end and a stubby yellow pencil tucked into the top pleat.

cummerbund_of_spirit.name: Cummerbund of Spirit
cummerbund_of_spirit.description: Worn to the last dance in the Roosevelt's Blossom Room before the Dome came down. Its owner kept dancing afterward, after a fashion, and swears a good sash settles the nerves.
cummerbund_of_spirit.icon: Pleated pale rose silk cummerbund with a pressed white gardenia pinned at the clasp and soft cream lining showing at one curled edge.

cummerbund_of_stamina.name: Cummerbund of Stamina
cummerbund_of_stamina.description: Recovered from a Burbank banquet hall where the head waiter held the kitchen door against three Drones for most of an evening. He maintains the sash did half the work.
cummerbund_of_stamina.icon: Broad, heavy pleated oxblood-red wool cummerbund with a sturdy brass buckle and a faint scuff mark across the lowest pleat.

cummerbund_of_the_engineer.name: Cummerbund of the Engineer
cummerbund_of_the_engineer.description: A Lockheed draughtsman wore it to the company dinner, then straight back to the drafting room when the sirens went. Grease-pencil figures on the lining work out stress loads for a wing nobody built.
cummerbund_of_the_engineer.icon: Pleated charcoal silk cummerbund with a tiny brass wrench charm on the clasp and faint blue grease-pencil figures scrawled across the exposed lining.

cummerbund_of_the_doctor.name: Cummerbund of the Doctor
cummerbund_of_the_doctor.description: Cut from the evening clothes of a Vine Street surgeon called away from the Brown Derby mid-soup. Iodine stains along the hem suggest he never did get back to the soup.
cummerbund_of_the_doctor.icon: Pleated white silk cummerbund with a small red enamel cross pin at the clasp and a faint amber iodine stain near the hem.

cummerbund_of_the_deacon.name: Cummerbund of the Deacon
cummerbund_of_the_deacon.description: Sister Aimee's ushers wore something like it on Sunday nights. This one made the long walk from Echo Park to the Burbank line and still smells of hymnals and lamp oil.
cummerbund_of_the_deacon.icon: Pleated deep purple silk cummerbund with a short violet hymnal ribbon tied at the clasp, the satin softly worn along the folds.

superior_cummerbund.name: Superior Cummerbund
superior_cummerbund.description: Lined in heavy grosgrain by a tailor who refused to discuss the price in front of the client. The client found out anyway.
superior_cummerbund.icon: Crisp black grosgrain pleated cummerbund with sharp even pleats, glossy satin piping on the edges and a polished gilt clasp.

chitin_lined_cummerbund.name: Chitin-lined Cummerbund
chitin_lined_cummerbund.description: Wardrobe at the Sennett lot sewed shell scraps behind the pleats once the satin ran out of arguments. It creaks at the waist like a cheap chair.
chitin_lined_cummerbund.icon: Black satin pleated cummerbund whose turned-back lining shows rows of overlapping iridescent green-black chitin scales, fastened with a dull silver clasp.

chitin_plated_cummerbund.name: Chitin-plated Cummerbund
chitin_plated_cummerbund.description: Nothing about it is formal now but the cut. Curved plates of Elder Drone shell ride over the pleats, and the banquet it was made for has been postponed indefinitely.
chitin_plated_cummerbund.icon: Wide cummerbund faced with curved overlapping plates of glossy green-black chitin over black satin pleats, iridescent sheen on each plate, heavy dark iron clasp.

reinforced_sam_browne_belt.name: Reinforced Sam Browne Belt
reinforced_sam_browne_belt.description: Double-stitched cowhide with a cross-strap stout enough to hold a man halfway up a fire ladder. Motorcycle officers favoured the pattern long before anyone needed it against mandibles.
reinforced_sam_browne_belt.icon: Broad brown leather Sam Browne belt with its diagonal shoulder strap attached, double-stitched edges, heavy brass buckle and two brass D-rings.

sam_browne_belt_of_agility.name: Sam Browne Belt of Agility
sam_browne_belt_of_agility.description: Off a Lockheed test pilot who walked away from three crashes and a breach-of-promise suit. The shoulder strap is cut short so nothing snags on the way out of a cockpit.
sam_browne_belt_of_agility.icon: Slim tan leather Sam Browne belt with a shortened shoulder strap, a light quick-release buckle and a small brass propeller charm on the D-ring.

sam_browne_belt_of_stamina.name: Sam Browne Belt of Stamina
sam_browne_belt_of_stamina.description: Issued to an LAPD motorcycle sergeant who patrolled Ventura Boulevard eleven days without relief. The leather is cracked across the back where he slept sitting up.
sam_browne_belt_of_stamina.icon: Thick dark brown leather Sam Browne belt with heavy shoulder strap, a crack across the back, and a brass police button riveted beside the buckle.

sam_browne_belt_of_spirit.name: Sam Browne Belt of Spirit
sam_browne_belt_of_spirit.description: Through Burbank's worst week a Salvation Army captain wore this while pouring coffee from a tin urn for anyone who asked. The strap still smells of grounds and gun oil.
sam_browne_belt_of_spirit.icon: Mid-brown leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, a small red enamel shield pin on the cross-strap and a tin cup hanging from one ring.

sam_browne_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Sam Browne Belt of the Acrobat
sam_browne_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Taken off a Sennett stunt double who could fall down a staircase and bill for it twice. The buckle is padded with felt, which tells you how many staircases there were.
sam_browne_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light honey-brown leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, the buckle wrapped in green felt padding and a tiny brass star charm on the D-ring.

sam_browne_belt_of_the_stevedore.name: Sam Browne Belt of the Stevedore
sam_browne_belt_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from San Pedro on a longshoreman who worked the lumber schooners. He wore the cross-strap to carry a cargo hook and called it the only uniform he ever liked.
sam_browne_belt_of_the_stevedore.icon: Scarred black leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, a steel cargo hook hanging from one D-ring and salt-whitened stains along the edges.

sam_browne_belt_of_the_deacon.name: Sam Browne Belt of the Deacon
sam_browne_belt_of_the_deacon.description: Hung with a Bible, this strap rode the red cars from Angelus Temple out to the Valley every Sunday. The leather at the hip is worn smooth where the book bumped against it, mile after mile.
sam_browne_belt_of_the_deacon.icon: Worn walnut-brown leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, a small black book pouch at the hip and a thin violet ribbon tied to the D-ring.

superior_sam_browne_belt.name: Superior Sam Browne Belt
superior_sam_browne_belt.description: Bridle leather from a Burbank saddlery, oiled weekly by a quartermaster who considered a dull buckle a moral failing. He would have made a fine censor.
superior_sam_browne_belt.icon: Glossy chestnut bridle-leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, mirror-polished brass buckle and D-rings, tight even white stitching.

chitin_lined_sam_browne_belt.name: Chitin-lined Sam Browne Belt
chitin_lined_sam_browne_belt.description: Somebody in the Universal leather shop found that Spitter shell turns acid better than cowhide and sewed a lining of it inside the strap. It fits close and sweats cold.
chitin_lined_sam_browne_belt.icon: Dark brown leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap, its edges revealing a thin inner lining of iridescent green-black chitin, dull brass fittings.

chitin_plated_sam_browne_belt.name: Chitin-plated Sam Browne Belt
chitin_plated_sam_browne_belt.description: Plates of Elder Soldier carapace are riveted along belt and cross-strap, the kit of the men who go up the ridge behind the sign. Few who wear one say where the plates came from, or who did not come back with them.
chitin_plated_sam_browne_belt.icon: Black leather Sam Browne belt with shoulder strap armoured in riveted overlapping green-black chitin plates, oily iridescent sheen, blackened iron buckle and heavy rings.

reinforced_weighted_gloves.name: Reinforced Weighted Gloves
reinforced_weighted_gloves.description: Lead shot sewn across the knuckles, then a second row for when the first stopped impressing anyone. The stitching is waxed harness thread from a Gower Gulch saddlery, rated for a mule.
reinforced_weighted_gloves.icon: Pair of heavy brown leather gloves, knuckles bulging with double rows of sewn lead-shot pouches, thick tan stitching, riveted steel strap across the back, scuffed but solid.

weighted_gloves_of_agility.name: Weighted Gloves of Agility
weighted_gloves_of_agility.description: Light enough to throw a punch and be somewhere else when the answer comes back. Taken off a Dragna gunman in Studio City who reached for his pocket a half-second too late.
weighted_gloves_of_agility.icon: Slim black leather gloves with a narrow band of lead weight over the knuckles, cut-away backs, bright yellow stitching and a small feather charm on the wrist strap.

weighted_gloves_of_stamina.name: Weighted Gloves of Stamina
weighted_gloves_of_stamina.description: Built for a long night. The last owner held the Laurel Canyon crossing until dawn, then handed these over with a yawn and the advice to keep the left one higher.
weighted_gloves_of_stamina.icon: Thick padded oxblood leather gloves with broad lead-weighted knuckles, quilted wrist cuffs, deep red stitching and a small iron shield-shaped stud on each strap.

weighted_gloves_of_the_acrobat.name: Weighted Gloves of the Acrobat
weighted_gloves_of_the_acrobat.description: A Sennett tumbler wore these for pratfalls that ended in punches. The palms are scuffed from catching himself off rooftops, which the studio called comedy and the insurance man called something else.
weighted_gloves_of_the_acrobat.icon: Supple tan leather gloves with weighted knuckle pads, palms scuffed pale, green stitching, and a tiny brass trapeze-bar charm hanging from the wrist buckle.

weighted_gloves_of_the_marksman.name: Weighted Gloves of the Marksman
weighted_gloves_of_the_marksman.description: The right trigger finger is cut away, so the owner could punch with one hand and shoot with the other. He kept score in pencil on the cuff and never once rounded up.
weighted_gloves_of_the_marksman.icon: Grey-brown leather gloves, lead-weighted knuckles, right index finger cut open, blue stitching, pencil tally marks on the cuff and a small brass cross-hair stud.

weighted_gloves_of_the_stevedore.name: Weighted Gloves of the Stevedore
weighted_gloves_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks with a longshoreman who settled wage disputes before the union got around to it. They still smell of tar, hemp and bananas.
weighted_gloves_of_the_stevedore.icon: Battered dark leather gloves with heavy lead knuckle bars, tar-stained palms, coarse hemp rope wrapped around one wrist and a small iron cargo-hook charm.

superior_weighted_gloves.name: Superior Weighted Gloves
superior_weighted_gloves.description: Every ounce of lead weighed and signed off by a Lockheed inspector who should have been checking rivets. Balanced as neatly as a propeller, and about as friendly.
superior_weighted_gloves.icon: Polished chestnut leather gloves, knuckles shod with smooth riveted steel plates over lead, crisp cream stitching, aluminium buckle straps gleaming like aircraft fittings.

chitin_lined_weighted_gloves.name: Chitin-lined Weighted Gloves
chitin_lined_weighted_gloves.description: Somebody in Burbank discovered that invader shell keeps a punch from travelling back up the wrist. Under the leather the lining clicks faintly whenever the fist closes.
chitin_lined_weighted_gloves.icon: Black leather gloves with weighted knuckles, split seams revealing an iridescent green-black chitin lining at the cuffs and palms, dark stitching and steel rivets.

chitin_plated_weighted_gloves.name: Chitin-plated Weighted Gloves
chitin_plated_weighted_gloves.description: Plates of drone carapace are bolted across the knuckles, still faintly warm on cold mornings. Men at the forward camp below the sign sleep in them, and nobody makes jokes about it anymore.
chitin_plated_weighted_gloves.icon: Heavy gloves armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates across the knuckles, bolted with brass rivets onto scarred dark leather, a ridge of shell spurs.

worn_canvas_web_belt.name: Worn Canvas Web Belt
worn_canvas_web_belt.description: Army surplus from 1918, sold by the pound on Cahuenga. The eyelets once carried a canteen; now they mostly carry lint.
worn_canvas_web_belt.icon: Faded olive-drab woven canvas belt in a loose coil, frayed edges, tarnished dull brass buckle, rows of empty eyelets, a brown coffee stain near the tip.

canvas_web_belt_of_agility.name: Canvas Web Belt of Agility
canvas_web_belt_of_agility.description: Cinched tight on a Gower Gulch extra who could vault a hitching rail without spilling his coffee. Central Casting kept calling him back for the falls.
canvas_web_belt_of_agility.icon: Olive canvas web belt with a bright brass buckle and a thin yellow stitched stripe running its length, small brass tip, light and neatly coiled.

canvas_web_belt_of_strength.name: Canvas Web Belt of Strength
canvas_web_belt_of_strength.description: A crate man at the Christie lot wore this hauling scenery flats two at a time. The union steward asked him to stop making the others look bad.
canvas_web_belt_of_strength.icon: Khaki canvas web belt with a broad heavy brass buckle, red stitched edging and a stout iron hook hanging from one eyelet.

canvas_web_belt_of_stamina.name: Canvas Web Belt of Stamina
canvas_web_belt_of_stamina.description: Survived a full week of night shoots on a Poverty Row serial, which is more than the leading lady managed.
canvas_web_belt_of_stamina.icon: Olive canvas web belt with blue edge stitching, dull brass buckle and a dented tin cup clipped to one side.

canvas_web_belt_of_the_boxer.name: Canvas Web Belt of the Boxer
canvas_web_belt_of_the_boxer.description: Bought outside the Legion Stadium on a Friday night from a cornerman short of carfare home. It still smells faintly of liniment and cheap cigars.
canvas_web_belt_of_the_boxer.icon: Tan canvas web belt with a squared brass buckle bearing a small red enamel boxing glove pin, worn tape wrapped around the tip.

canvas_web_belt_of_the_marksman.name: Canvas Web Belt of the Marksman
canvas_web_belt_of_the_marksman.description: Its pouches were sized for stripper clips by someone who counted every round and seldom needed the second one.
canvas_web_belt_of_the_marksman.icon: Olive canvas web belt lined with snap-flap ammunition pouches, black stitching, brass buckle engraved with a small cross-hair notch.

canvas_web_belt_of_the_acrobat.name: Canvas Web Belt of the Acrobat
canvas_web_belt_of_the_acrobat.description: Left on a trapeze rig after a circus picture wrapped. The grips swear the stunt girl who owned it walked home along a telephone wire.
canvas_web_belt_of_the_acrobat.icon: Pale khaki canvas web belt trimmed with a white and red striped band, small silver star charm hanging from a brass buckle.

canvas_web_belt_of_the_engineer.name: Canvas Web Belt of the Engineer
canvas_web_belt_of_the_engineer.description: Sound-stage electricians kept pliers, tape and a pencil stub in its loops, and kept the generator turning through two hive surges.
canvas_web_belt_of_the_engineer.icon: Olive canvas web belt with tool loops holding small pliers, copper rivets along the edge, a tiny brass wrench charm on the buckle.

patched_canvas_web_belt.name: Patched Canvas Web Belt
patched_canvas_web_belt.description: Mended with sailcloth and a laundry tag from a Selma Avenue boarding house. The landlady kept the deposit anyway.
patched_canvas_web_belt.icon: Olive canvas belt with mismatched off-white sailcloth patches, uneven black thread stitching, dull scratched brass buckle.

plain_canvas_web_belt.name: Plain Canvas Web Belt
plain_canvas_web_belt.description: Nothing to look at and nothing to complain about. The Legion quartermaster hands these out without asking for a name.
plain_canvas_web_belt.icon: Clean even khaki canvas web belt, plain bright brass box buckle, neat evenly spaced eyelets, straight and unadorned.

sturdy_canvas_web_belt.name: Sturdy Canvas Web Belt
sturdy_canvas_web_belt.description: Double-woven for Pacific Electric linemen, who spend their days hanging from poles and their evenings complaining about it.
sturdy_canvas_web_belt.icon: Thick double-layered tan canvas belt, heavy steel buckle, brown leather reinforced ends, a steel D-ring on one side.

good_canvas_web_belt.name: Good Canvas Web Belt
good_canvas_web_belt.description: Clean, stiff and smelling of fresh sizing, the sort a prop master would buckle on a doughboy for the close-up.
good_canvas_web_belt.icon: Crisp olive canvas web belt with sharp edges, polished brass buckle, two snap-flap pouches with gleaming brass snaps.

worn_plated_belt.name: Worn Plated Belt
worn_plated_belt.description: Leather riveted with scrap steel by someone who expected trouble and got it. The dents suggest he lost.
worn_plated_belt.icon: Cracked brown leather belt with dented rusty steel plates, a few missing rivets, dull iron buckle hanging crooked.

plated_belt_of_strength.name: Plated Belt of Strength
plated_belt_of_strength.description: Columbia's lot blacksmith built it for a strongman picture, then wore it himself after the strongman complained it was too heavy.
plated_belt_of_strength.icon: Dark leather belt with broad polished steel plates, a red leather backing stripe showing between them, heavy square steel buckle.

plated_belt_of_stamina.name: Plated Belt of Stamina
plated_belt_of_stamina.description: The steel came off a wrecked Model T door and the leather off a saddle nobody missed. Between them they have taken more punishment than a contract player's dignity.
plated_belt_of_stamina.icon: Brown leather belt with curved steel plates showing traces of black paint, blue stitching, thick sturdy steel buckle.

plated_belt_of_the_boxer.name: Plated Belt of the Boxer
plated_belt_of_the_boxer.description: Worn under a robe by a Legion Stadium heavyweight who claimed it was for his back. The referee never checked, and the other fellow never asked twice.
plated_belt_of_the_boxer.icon: Black leather belt with riveted steel plates, small red enamel boxing glove charm on a polished steel buckle.

plated_belt_of_the_stevedore.name: Plated Belt of the Stevedore
plated_belt_of_the_stevedore.description: Came up from the San Pedro docks on a longshoreman who unloaded Cornero's boats and never once wondered aloud what was in the crates.
plated_belt_of_the_stevedore.icon: Salt-stained leather belt with weathered steel plates, rope-wrapped end, a small iron cargo hook clipped beside the buckle.

patched_plated_belt.name: Patched Plated Belt
patched_plated_belt.description: Two plates are original. The rest are flattened tobacco tins, which at least keep the rust company.
patched_plated_belt.icon: Brown leather belt with mismatched plates, some grey steel, some bright tin with faded red paint, crooked uneven rivets.

plain_plated_belt.name: Plain Plated Belt
plain_plated_belt.description: Grey steel, brown leather, an iron buckle. A Post 43 man called it the only honest thing left in Hollywood.
plain_plated_belt.icon: Brown leather belt with evenly spaced plain grey steel plates and a square black iron buckle, clean and simple.

sturdy_plated_belt.name: Sturdy Plated Belt
sturdy_plated_belt.description: Riveted in a studio machine shop between camera cranes, with the same rivets and about the same tolerance for nonsense.
sturdy_plated_belt.icon: Wide dark leather belt with thick steel plates and heavy round rivets, broad steel buckle with a reinforcing bar.

good_plated_belt.name: Good Plated Belt
good_plated_belt.description: Even plates, sound leather and a buckle that closes the first time. In a town short on sound things, that counts for plenty.
good_plated_belt.icon: Oiled brown leather belt with neatly overlapping blued steel plates and a polished steel buckle, tidy and well kept.

fine_plated_belt.name: Fine Plated Belt
fine_plated_belt.description: Polished bright enough to serve as a shaving mirror, which is how a Warner Bros. heavy used it between takes.
fine_plated_belt.icon: Rich chestnut leather belt with gleaming mirror-polished steel plates and a steel buckle with an engraved scroll border.

pressed_plated_belt.name: Pressed Plated Belt
pressed_plated_belt.description: Pressed from a single sheet on a studio hydraulic ram, then edged in leather by a Gower Gulch saddler with opinions about the result.
pressed_plated_belt.icon: Seamless curved steel band with crisp pressed ridges, black leather edging stitched along both sides, bright nickel buckle.

reinforced_logger_boots.name: Reinforced Logger Boots
reinforced_logger_boots.description: Hobnailed and double-stitched for men who felled timber in Oregon and came south to build sets instead. The caulks bite into a hive floor about as well as they ever bit into a fir log.
reinforced_logger_boots.icon: Tall brown leather logger boot, high lace-up shaft with steel eyelets, thick lug sole studded with caulk spikes, riveted canvas padding at the ankle, oil-stained toe cap.

logger_boots_of_agility.name: Logger Boots of Agility
logger_boots_of_agility.description: A set carpenter at First National wore these up and down scaffolding forty feet above the stage floor and never once grabbed a rail. The foreman docked him for it anyway, on principle.
logger_boots_of_agility.icon: Tall tan logger boot with high lacing and a spiked sole, bright green laces, a small brass feather charm dangling from the top lace hook.

logger_boots_of_strength.name: Logger Boots of Strength
logger_boots_of_strength.description: Built for a man who carried railroad ties on each shoulder at the Studio City lumberyard and complained they were uneven. The heels are worn flat from leaning into heavy loads.
logger_boots_of_strength.icon: Dark brown logger boot with a broad thick heel and spiked sole, red laces, a small iron anvil charm hanging from the lacing.

logger_boots_of_stamina.name: Logger Boots of Stamina
logger_boots_of_stamina.description: Whoever owned these walked the Los Angeles River bed from Laurel Canyon to Burbank twice a day running messages. The soles have been replaced three times; the man, never.
logger_boots_of_stamina.icon: Oiled black-brown logger boot with an extra-thick spiked sole, grey wool sock cuff folded over the top, deep blue laces.

logger_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Logger Boots of the Boxer
logger_boots_of_the_boxer.description: Stadium sweepers swear a heavyweight wore these into the ring at the Legion one Friday night, lost on points, and refused to take them off for the photograph. The left toe has a dent shaped like somebody's chin.
logger_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Scuffed brown logger boot with red laces, a small red boxing glove pin on the shaft, a round dent in the steel toe cap.

logger_boots_of_the_marksman.name: Logger Boots of the Marksman
logger_boots_of_the_marksman.description: Its last owner kept watch from the Burbank water tower with a Springfield and a thermos of coffee. The tally notched into the heel counts Spitters, and it ran out of room.
logger_boots_of_the_marksman.icon: Tan logger boot with khaki laces, a small brass disc with a crosshair notch on the outer ankle, a row of tally cuts along the heel.

logger_boots_of_the_acrobat.name: Logger Boots of the Acrobat
logger_boots_of_the_acrobat.description: Sennett's people say these went off a rooftop on Ventura Boulevard, through an awning and onto a moving truck in one take. The stuntman walked away limping; the boots walked away fine.
logger_boots_of_the_acrobat.icon: Light tan logger boot with yellow laces, a torn patch of red-and-white striped awning canvas stitched onto the shaft, spiked sole.

logger_boots_of_the_engineer.name: Logger Boots of the Engineer
logger_boots_of_the_engineer.description: Lockheed riggers favoured this pattern because the steel toe survived a dropped propeller hub and a pocket sewn inside the shaft held a slide rule. Two pencils are still in there, both chewed.
logger_boots_of_the_engineer.icon: Brown logger boot with grey canvas padding, a small wooden slide rule tucked into an inner shaft pocket, a tiny wrench charm on the laces.

superior_logger_boots.name: Superior Logger Boots
superior_logger_boots.description: Every seam is triple-stitched and every caulk hand-filed. Timber crews felling Valley oaks for barricades will trade a week's rations for a pair, and the bootmaker knows it.
superior_logger_boots.icon: Polished chestnut logger boot, double row of brass eyelets, thick quilted padded tongue, sharp clean steel caulks, crisp rawhide laces.

chitin_lined_logger_boots.name: Chitin-lined Logger Boots
chitin_lined_logger_boots.description: Somebody in a Burbank cobbler's shop discovered that invader shell, boiled and shaved thin, keeps acid out better than any oilskin. Nobody asked where the shell came from, and he did not volunteer it.
chitin_lined_logger_boots.icon: Heavy brown logger boot with iridescent green-black chitin lining showing at the collar and tongue edges, steel caulked sole, dark laces.

chitin_plated_logger_boots.name: Chitin-plated Logger Boots
chitin_plated_logger_boots.description: Plates of Drone carapace riveted over toe and shin, still faintly warm on cold mornings below the sign. The men at the Mount Lee forward camp prefer not to think about why.
chitin_plated_logger_boots.icon: Bulky logger boot armoured with overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates on toe and shin, brass rivets, spiked black sole.

reinforced_chitin_shod_boots.name: Reinforced Chitin-shod Boots
reinforced_chitin_shod_boots.description: Steel toe caps, steel shanks and soles shod with filed-down invader mandible, made by a welder who once built ship ladders at San Pedro. Loud on pavement, quieter on a hive floor.
reinforced_chitin_shod_boots.icon: Heavy black leather boot with grey riveted steel toe cap and shin guard, sole edged with pale curved chitin mandible studs.

chitin_shod_boots_of_strength.name: Chitin-shod Boots of Strength
chitin_shod_boots_of_strength.description: Rumour on the Burbank line says a Veteran kicked a Brute's knee out from under it wearing these. The Brute's opinion went unrecorded.
chitin_shod_boots_of_strength.icon: Steel-capped black boot with a crimson leather strap across the instep, grey steel shin plate, sole studded with pale chitin.

chitin_shod_boots_of_stamina.name: Chitin-shod Boots of Stamina
chitin_shod_boots_of_stamina.description: Forty pounds the pair, and the Legion sergeant who issued them swore a man could march to the Dome wall and back in them. Several tried. The boots made it every time.
chitin_shod_boots_of_stamina.icon: Steel-plated boot with an olive drab canvas gaiter wrapped over the shaft, khaki buckled straps, chitin-studded sole.

chitin_shod_boots_of_the_boxer.name: Chitin-shod Boots of the Boxer
chitin_shod_boots_of_the_boxer.description: Taped at the ankles like a fighter's wrists and smelling of liniment and Legion Stadium cigars. Fight-night regulars swear they never lost a round, mainly because they were never allowed in the ring.
chitin_shod_boots_of_the_boxer.icon: Steel boot with white cloth tape wound around the ankle, a small red boxing glove pin on the steel shin plate, chitin sole studs.

chitin_shod_boots_of_the_stevedore.name: Chitin-shod Boots of the Stevedore
chitin_shod_boots_of_the_stevedore.description: Shipped up from San Pedro before the Dome came down, made for men who walked cargo nets and hauled crates marked machine parts that sloshed. The customs men never looked closely, and nobody looks now.
chitin_shod_boots_of_the_stevedore.icon: Salt-stained steel-capped boot laced with tarred rope, a small iron cargo hook charm at the top, pale chitin studs on the sole.

superior_chitin_shod_boots.name: Superior Chitin-shod Boots
superior_chitin_shod_boots.description: Bench-forged at the First National machine shop back when it made scenery instead of barricades. The chitin studs are matched by size, which the foreman called excessive before ordering a pair.
superior_chitin_shod_boots.icon: Polished grey steel boot with crisp riveted greave plates, black leather, brass buckles, a neat row of matched pale chitin studs on the sole.

chitin_lined_chitin_shod_boots.name: Chitin-lined Chitin-shod Boots
chitin_lined_chitin_shod_boots.description: Twice the shell for twice the trouble: carapace on the sole and more of it sewn inside against Spitter acid. Quartermasters at the river camp call them double-bugged and keep a straight face.
chitin_lined_chitin_shod_boots.icon: Dark steel-plated boot with iridescent green-black chitin lining showing at the collar, chitin-studded sole, blackened rivets.

chitin_plated_chitin_shod_boots.name: Chitin-plated Chitin-shod Boots
chitin_plated_chitin_shod_boots.description: Hardly a scrap of honest leather left, only steel and shell from heel to knee, sealed with hive resin that hums when the Mount Lee Hive is near. They were made for the last road up the ridge, and they look it.
chitin_plated_chitin_shod_boots.icon: Knee-high armoured boot of overlapping iridescent green-black chitin plates over dark steel, glowing amber hive resin at the seams, spiked sole.
